text.body:
<śrīḥ>
<paṇḍitabuddhisāgaraśarmaṇo'dhyakṣatāyāṃ>
śrīḥ
{atha pratiṣṭhālakṣaṇasārasamuccayaḥ}
prārabhyate
oṃ namastasyai (kh: oṃ namaḥśivāyeti nāsti)
tattvatrayatridahanatriguṇatriliṅga (g: tanutrayeti) kālatrayatribhuvanatrisurīśarīram | netratrayatripathagāhipavitragotra putrītriśūlabhṛtamīśamahaṃ praṇamya || 1 ||
āgamebhyaḥ samākṛṣya kuryāṃ lakṣaṇasaṅgraham | ṛjusakṣepasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvasthāpanasaṅkulam (g: sadguṇamiti) || 2 ||
asaṃdigdhaṃ sphuṭārthaṃ ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadam | hitāya mandabuddhīnāṃ smaraṇāya manīṣiṇām || 3 ||
kiñcit kvacit sphuṭaṃ cāṅgaṃ naikasmin sarvamaṅgakam (kh: sarvagātrakam) | bahutantrāṇyato vīkṣya krameṇaikatra likhyate || 4 ||
siddhiliṅgāśritevaṃ śivaproktaṃ śivāgame | tadā (mu. a, k: tantrā) gamānusāreṇa liṅgaṃ vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam || 5 ||
yato jātamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | līyate pralaye yatra tadidaṃ liṅgamucyate || 6 ||
arūpamapramāṇaṃ yattattridhā rūpamānataḥ | hīnādi (kh: hīmādi) siddhayastasmācchivapūjopacārataḥ || 7 ||
dravyānukalpana tyaktvā (k, kh, g: nyastvā) bhaktyā vārādhya tatsadā | sarvajñaṃ sarvadaṃ śuddhaṃ śivatattvaṃ ca mokṣadam || 8 ||
mantraiḥ śivoditaiḥ siddhā mukhyā brahmādilokapāḥ | ṛṣayo vasavo rudrā gaṇā yakṣā grahoragāḥ ||
daityā rakṣāṃsi siddhādyāḥ paraiśvaryapadaṃ gatāḥ | ato narādibhistattu liṅgarūpamupāsyate || 10 ||
liṅgasya darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ pāpanāśanam | mahārājyapradā pūjā dhyānaṃ mokṣapradāyakam || 11 ||
śatāyutāśvamedhānāṃ yajvanāṃ yatphalaṃ (mu. a, k, g, gh: yatphalaṃ lābhato) bhavet | tatphalaṃ dviguṇaṃ samyag liṅgaikasthāpanāpanāddhruvam || 12 ||
prāsāde hemaratnādyairyatpuṇyaṃ (kh: hemaratnāḍhye prasthitaṃ) nṛpaterbhavet | tadeva tṛṇakuḍyādyairdaridrāṇāmaśāṭhyataḥ || 13 ||
devāsuroragaiḥ sthāpye narūpaṃ naivalakṣaṇam | lakṣaṇaṃ liṅgadhāmādau narebhyo vakṣyate'dhunā (kh: sadā) || 14 ||
tatsyāttridhā yathāsaṅkhyamavyaktaṃ vyaktamiśrakam | liṅgaṃ ca (gh, ṅ: liṅgārcā; kh: liṅgasya) mukhaliṅgaṃ ca puṃstriyau ca napuṃsakam || 15 ||
vipadgṛha (mū. a, k: vipaṭṭasta; gh, ṅ: viyaṭvṛtta) haro vyāpī sadā vahnirivendhanam | sūryāṣṭāṣṭāsrake (mū. a: puryaṣṭāṣṭā; g: sūryacchāyā) viṣṇurbrahmā vedāsrake vibhuḥ || 16 ||
eṣāmaikyaṃ tribhiryogālliṅgamavyaktakaṃ bhavet | (vyaktaṃ (kh: ayaṃ cāpacinhāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ nāśti) mūrdhādisaṃyuktaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ dvirūpakam || 17 ||
pañcadhā vyaktamāvedyaṃ vyaktākhyaṃ saptadhā tathā | dvyātmakaṃ daśadhā proktaṃ sarvaṃ dvedhā calācalam || 18 ||)
avyaktaṃ mokṣadaṃ nūnaṃ vyaktaṃ bhuktipradāyakam | bhuktimuktipradaṃ miśramityetadrūpato bhavet || 19 ||
liṅgaṃ yadātmakaṃ kāryaṃ tanmānaṃ caiva yāddaśam | śīghraṃ siddhikaraṃ yacca kāmyākāmyāya yadbhavet || 20 ||
taddravyāṇāṃ parīkṣā ca ācāryasya ca lakṣaṇam | kārukā mūrtipāścaiva vanayātrādikaṃ yathā || 21 ||
nagā nagādhipā ye ca nadyo yā ye drumādayaḥ | puṇyasthānavibhāgaśca vāstugrahaṇamarcanam || 22 ||
yathā purastathādvārayogāhṛ (g: dvāre yenokta) tkalaśo'dhvaraḥ | śivo liṅgavidhiryāgo dhvajaparyantakaṃ tathā || 23 ||
pañcasthāpanasaṃyuktaḥ prāsādaścaiva tādṛśaḥ | yatīnāmāśrayo yādṛk pratiṣṭhā pañcadhā ca yā || 24 ||
ṛtunakṣatrayogaśca (mū. a: yośvaiva) vāralagnādhivāsanam | sthāpane yaśca saṃbhāra ityādyakhilamucyate || 25 ||
kuryālliṅgānyayoratnamṛtkāṣṭhopalacitrakaiḥ (mū. a, k: -siddhā-) | kṣudrakāmāya lohotthaṃ ratnajaṃ bahusiddhidam || 26 ||
mṛnmayaṃ sarvakāmārthaṃ dārujaṃ tvāśusiddhidam (mū, a, k: vā susiddhidam) | khādhāreṇa vyavasthāpyaṃ naśvaraṃ dhātudārujam (mū. a, k, ṅ: naśvaratvāttu dārujam) || 27 ||
bhogamokṣapradaṃ śailaṃ tacca veśmani rogadam | liṅgaṃ ca dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ (mū. a, k: proktaṃ) calaṃ caivācalaṃ tathā || 28 ||
calaṃ vairatnajaṃ proktaṃ dhātujaṃ ca calācalam | sthiralakṣmīpradaṃ haimaṃ rājataṃ caiva rājyadam || 29 ||
prajāvṛddhikaraṃ tāmraṃ vāṅgamāyuḥ pravardhanam (kh, g: rāṅgamāyuṣya vardhanam) | vidveṣakārakaṃ kāṃsyaṃ rītijaṃ śatruvālanam || 30 ||
rogadaṃ saisakaṃ śatrorāyasaṃ ripunāśanam | aṣṭalohamayaṃ liṅgaṃ kuṣṭharogakṣayāvaham || 31 ||
trilohasambhavaṃ liṅgamantardhānaprasiddhidam | sikthaṃ kṛtvā mṛdā liptvā taptvodvāsya ca kārukaḥ || 32 ||
vikārārkadiśā randhravṛddhyā sikthānprapūrayet | hemāhibhyāṃ kramātāratāmravaṅgāraghoṣakaiḥ || 33 ||
dhūstūrasya (mū, a, k: dhūtyūrasya; g: dhūttūrasya) rasairghṛṣṭva rasaṃ hema tadaṅghrimat | kāṣṭhaṃ kṣiptvā dṛḍhaṃ tattu śilāghṛṣṭaṃ savālukam || 34 ||
jambīrarasasāmudrapiṣṭaṃ tatpiṣṭakaṃ bhavet | tayā lavaṇapūrāmbu (mū. tayālabāla pūrāḍhyaṃ) yuktayā lepayedbudhaḥ || 35 ||
karāṅguṣṭhena saṃpreryākoṭya koṣṭhikayā tataḥ (ṅ: kaṭyekoṣṭhikayostayoḥ) | bālakuñcikayā (mū. -kāla) sāmyaṃ nayettatkramaśaḥ śanaiḥ || 36 ||
bhūyo bhūyo'gnisantāpāttridhāliṅgaṃ rasojjhitam | tato'numā (kh: tato'ntarmā) rjayedyatnānmaṇinā (gh: ye drūkṣā) madanāmbubhiḥ || 37 ||
punarvahnisthamākṛṣya liṅgaṃ trividharūpakam | rasaye (mū.: vāsayet) ttāmrajaṃ śilpī hāṭakena sucārūṇā || 38 ||
dāhe (kh: bāhye) raktaṃ sitaṃ chede nikaṣe kuṅkumaprabham | guru snigdhaṃ mṛdusparśe (ṅ: mṛduṃ pakve) ṣaḍvidhaṃ hemaśobhanam || 39 ||
lohajaṃ pārthivaṃ caiva kuryānmantrairvidhānataḥ | dhātūdbhavaṃ samākhyātaṃ ratnajādi (mū. a, k: ratnajāpi) vadāmyataḥ || 40 ||
āyuṣyaṃ hīrajaṃ jñeyaṃ rogahṛnmauktikodbhavam (kh: mauktikaṃ bhavet ) | sukhakṛtpuṣparāgotthaṃ vaidūryaṃ śatrudarpahṛt || 41 ||
padmarāgaṃ ca lakṣmīdamaindra nīlaṃ yaśaḥ pradam | liṅgaṃ mārakataṃ puṣṭyai sphaṭikaṃ sarvakāmadam || 42 ||
mahāratnotthaliṅgāni kṣudraratnodbhavānyataḥ | vaidrumaṃ vaśyakamārthaṃ (g: vadhyakarmārthaṃ) kārketanamamitrahṛt || 43 ||
pulakotthaṃ tu vidyākṛdrājāvartamarātihṛt | baladaṃ jīvajātījaṃ ṭaiṭṭibhaṃ śatrumardanam || 44 ||
vidveṣakārakaṃ śauktaṃ (gh: tautthaṃ) śāṅkhaṃ saukhyapradāyakam | iti prasthānaliṅgāni śuddhimānānyataḥ param || 45 ||
dvividhaṃ ratnajaṃ liṅgaṃ nirmitaṃ cāpyanirmitam | kārukai (kh: kārubhiḥ; mū. a, k: dārubhi) rghaṭitaṃ yacca talliṅgaṃ nirmitaṃ smṛtam || 46 ||
svabhāvotthaṃ viśuddhaṃ yadratnajaṃ cāpyanirmitam | tatpūjyaṃ rājabhiryatnādbhuktimuktyarthibhiḥ sadā || 47 ||
tyajedbindvanvitaṃ raudraṃ śūlāgraṃ (mū.: śūlābhraṃ) cipiṭaṃ kṛśam | ūrdhvādhovadanaṃ dīrghamadhaḥ sthūlaṃ ca niṣprabham || 48 ||
miśravarṇaṃ tathāvyaṅgaṃ khaṇḍaṃ devopabhuktakam | chidraṃ (g: sthiraṃ) ca sphuṭitaṃ trastaṃ (mū. a, k, kh: bhrastaṃ) śalyānvitaṃ (g, ṅ: śūlānvitaṃ) surojjhitam || 49 ||
tiryak cādhaḥkṛtaṃ yattu hīnaṃ madhye vivarjayet | rāṣṭragotrajanagrāma (ṅ: kulagrāma) dhanamitrasutānapi (mū, a, g: yutānapi) || 50 ||
śasya yānābalābandhubhṛtyānnighnanti tāni ca | rogaṃ parājayodvegaṃ (ṅ: parākramodvegaṃ) janadveṣaṃ kaliṃ tathā || 51 ||
pravāsaṃ duḥkha dāridryaṃ mṛtyuṃ dadyātkramādbhṛśam | tatsyāddoṣairvinirmuktaṃ dṛḍhaṃ snigdhaṃ prabhānvitam || 52 ||
aṅgādyaṅgula (gh: mudgādyaṅgula; mū, a, k: muṅgāmuṅgala; ṅ: mudrādyaṅgula) paryantaṃ śāstrajñaiḥ suparī kṣatam | mahāratnaṃ mahāmūlyaṃ guṇayuktaṃ yajetsadā || 53 ||
tasthārcanājjayaḥ śāntirārogyaṃ vipulāḥ śriyaḥ | supratāpo (kh: saṃpratāpo) yaśaścāyurbhaveyurnṛpateściram || 54 ||
mahāratnānmahāsiddhiḥ kṣudrātkṣudrā prajāyate | nīlaṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ cāpi śastaṃ ratnamanirmitam || 55 ||
jaleśavātaviṣṇvindrāgnyantakā vajradevatāḥ | śaṅkhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ javārambhādaladyuti || 56 ||
haridrārasatulyaṃ ca śaśababhbra(?)kṣisannibham | dhautāsyābho dvijātīnāṃ nṛpārhau (nṛpādau, li. pu. pā) pītaraktakau || 57 ||
vaiśye haritapītau ca dhūsaraṃ tu caturthake | śūlaṃ cādhordhvato yasya vajraṃ syāttacchivātmakam | talliṅgamāyuṣo vṛddhayai sarvarogavināśakam || 58 ||
sitaṃ raktaṃ kramātpītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ śubham | śakrāgni(gnī) casamitroye (gh: śakrāgnicalamitrottha; ṅ: śakrāgnīndrasamitrāye) caturdhā tatkvacinmatam || 59 ||
nistaraṅgaṃ guṇopetaṃ tejovatpāṇḍunirmalam | śaradambunibhaṃ svacchaṃ snigdhaṃ ca sphāṭikaṃ hitam || 60 ||
citraṃ bindvanvitaṃ rūkṣaṃ sphuṭitaṃ bhinnavarṇakam | sagarbhamūrmisaṃyuktaṃ jyotirmuktaghanaṃ (muktaṃ punaḥ, iti pāṭhāntara) tyajet || 61 ||
savraṇaṃ kīlakopeta śūlāgraṃ cakravarjitam (mū, a, k: vaktravarjitam) | sthūlaṃ dīrgha kuśaṃ hrasvaṃ madhyādyanteṣu vā kṛśam (mū.: cākṛśam) || 62 ||
tuṣārākṛtibindvāḍhyaṃ kalikābhiḥ (kh: kaṇikābhiḥ; g: karṇikābhiḥ) supūritam | anyajātivilagnaṃ ca viddhaṃ bhītikaraṃ tyajet || 63 ||
suṣamaṃ mānasaṃyuktaṃ śāstralakṣaṇalakṣitam | sphāṭikaṃ liṅgamiṣṭārthaṃ mṛtyujitkāmadaṃ yajet || 64 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ svalpadoṣaṃ kvacitsmṛtam (ṅ: kvacinmatam) | liṅgaṃ sadāgnihotrābhaṃ pūjya no doṣakṛnnṛṇām || 65 ||
cārucchatre bhavedrājyaṃ mṛdulaṃ (kh: mṛtyutvaṃ; g: mṛdutvaṃ ; gh: pṛthutvaṃ; ṅ: mṛdbaddhaṃ) mūrdhni (g: mūrtiḥ) vai manāk | sadā nimnena siddhiḥ syāducce tūccā same samā || 66 ||
tatra (mū. a, k, ṅ: bhadra) sarvasamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yavamadhyaṃ varapradam | ratnaliṅgaṃ dvidhākhyātaṃ svapīṭhaṃ dhātupīṭhajam (mū, a: sūpīṭhaṃ dhātupīṭhakam) || 67 ||
dhātujaṃ tu svayonisthaṃ (g: tattvayonitthaṃ) siddhimuktipradāyakam | calaliṅgaṃ dvidhākāryaṃ dhāturatnamayaṃ śubham || 68 ||
hemādicalaliṅgaṃ syādaṅgulāditripañcakam | kṣudraratnotthamapyevaṃ svamānā (g: pramāṇā) dvararatnajam || 69 ||
tithyantamagrajātīnāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ yāvadindrakam | vaiśyānāṃ manmathāntaṃ syācchūdrāṇāṃ dvādaśāvadhiḥ (kh: khagagāvapi; gh: śāṅkagajāvadhi) || 70 ||
yakṣādīnāṃ kvacilliṅgaṃ vikārādekaviṃśatiḥ | calaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ devānāṃ trayoviṃśatikāṅgulam || 71 ||
veśmastha pūjayedatatsaṃsūcyane sthirāṇyataḥ | acalaṃ khadrūbhasthāyi karādanavasāmakam (mū, a, k, kh: sīsakam) || 72 ||
avyaktaṃ navahastāntaṃ vyaktaṃ pañcaguṇaṃ tathā | saḍḍhataṃ miśrakaṃ liṅgaṃ nordhvaṃ ca sthiramiṣyate || 73 ||
navahastaṃ bhavecchailaṃ trihastaṃ lohajaṃ kvacit | ṣaḍḍhastānnādhikaṃ vārkṣaṃ pārthivaṃ śailavatsadā || 74 ||
āhastānnavahastaṃ syādetalliṅgaṃ tu mānuṣam | yakṣarakṣo'suravyāla gandharvāpsarasāṃ kvacit || 75 ||
kinnarāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ hastātpañcadaśaiva tu | pariṇāhocchrayābhyāṃ ca devānāmekaviṃśatiḥ || 76 ||
aihikaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ yāvannordhvaṃ gandhabhavādikam | pañcāṅgulaṃtu paiṣṭyādyaṃ phalajaṃ svapramāṇataḥ || 77 ||
gāndha saubhāgyadaṃ liṅgaṃ paiṣṭa bhuktipradāyakam | sthaṇḍile maṇḍale pūjya syāddīkṣāsthāpanādike (kh: -nānhike; gh: -nāntike) || 78 ||
ekābdā (mū, a.: ekāṅgā) nyaihikānyatra procyante siddhimicchatām | prabhumānapradaṃ śāṅkhaṃ (kh: śārṅgaṃ) sainyacchinnāgadantajam || 79 ||
kūrmakasika (g: kūrmakāmīka) saṃjātaṃ nṛṇāṃ (gh: nūnaṃ) pātālasiddhidam | aṇimādinṛkulyotthamanyonyabdārdhataḥ (mū: nyaccharddhataḥ) sadā || 80 ||
paiṣṭānyaṣṭaprakārāṇi saṅgrīkṛṣṇaka (kh: saddhrikṛṣṭaka; g, ṅ: saṃbaddhakṛṣṭaka) jāni tu | śālipiṣṭodbhavaṃ puṣṭyai ṣāṣṭikaṃ puṣṭivardhanam (mū,: buddhivardhanam) || 81 ||
gaudhūmaṃ vātarogaghnaṃ yavajaṃ balasaukhyadam | ripubhedakaraṃ maudgaṃ strīdaṃ śyāmākasambhavam || 82 ||
tilapiṣṭaṃ dharādāyī nīvāraṃ (mū, a, k, g: saiddhārtha) bhayanāśanam | sukhakṛnnāvanītaṃ tu gomayaṃ roganāśanam || 83 ||
ānnamāyuḥpradaṃ jñeyaṃ gauḍaṃ prītipravardhanam | nānāphalodbhavaṃ (kh: lohabhavaṃ) liṅgaṃ nānākāmapradāyakam || 84 ||
guṇadaṃ saikataṃ bhūri syātsaubhāgyāya lāvaṇam | uccāṭane tu pāṃśavyaṃ maulaṃ (ṅ: mārṣaṃ) śatrukṣayāvaham || 85 ||
vaṃśāṅkurasamudbhūtaṃ vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ bhavet | purakṣobhakaraṃ pauraṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g: ghoraṃ) rāmaṭhaṃ caugryakārakam || 86 ||
śatrumṛtyupradaṃ sārjaṃ saiktha (kh: sitthaṃ; g: sandhyaṃ) mākarṣaṇe matam | mṛdbimbodbhavamiṣṭārthaṃ lepātsyuḥ sarvasaṃpadaḥ || 87 ||
gandhādibimbajāntāni na sthirāṇi calāni no | tāvatkāla tu (g: tārako'nanta) saṃpūya visṛjya tāni (kh: visarjyaitāni) ke kṣipet || 88 ||
piṣṭāṃ gośarkarāṃ sūkṣmāṃ (gh: śuklāṃ) pakvaciñcāsthiyojitām | niṣkvāthya (mū: niṣkāṭhya; gh: niṣkāsya; ṅ: niṣkāma) paṭamālepya saṃśoṣya (g: saṃsodhya) pārimārjya ca || 89 ||
khaṭikālaktakākuṣṭanīlīdaradakajjalaiḥ | dhātubilvarasairlekhyaṃ tridhā liṅgaṃ paṭādike || 90 ||
madhurā (kh: mayūrā) citralekhā ca kāryā vai samasandhikā | balasaṃvartanīcchāyā dṛṣṭi (k, g, ṅ: sṛṣṭi) bhāvāśritā sadā || 91 ||
śṛṅgāravīrabībhatsaraudrahāsyabhayānakāḥ | karuṇādbhutaśāntāśca navabhāvātmikāḥ kvacit || 92 ||
paṭajā vitrajā raktā (k, g, gh, ṅ; tajñā) samyaṅmantravidhānataḥ | svecchayā pūjayedetanmṛnmayānyucyate (mū, a: dyucyate; kh: mayo hyucyate) 'dhunā || 93 ||
apakvaṃ pakvajaṃ (k, ṅ: apaṅkaṃ paṅkajaṃ) kāryaṃ mukhyāmukhyavyavasthayā | sadyomantreṇa cāpakvaṃ (ṅ: cāpaṅkaṃ) kramānnavakarādikam || 94 ||
pakvaṃ (ṅ: paṅkaṃ; kh: pakṣaṃ) trihastakaṃ kuryāt ghoramantrānvitaṃ (kh: -rcitaṃ) varam | dvijādijātibhirmṛdbhiravyaktādi ca kāmataḥ || 95 ||
padminīṣu nadītīre vṛkṣamūle ca mṛttikāḥ | vāpīkūpataḍāgeṣu dīrghikāyāḥ samāharet || 96 ||
sumarditamṛdā kāryaṃ pakvaṃ mṛtsaṃbhavaṃ sadā | puṣṭyai trilohagarbhaṃ ca dhanakoṣavivṛddhaye || 97 ||
śucyupalāṃśca (mū: śucyutpalāṃ; kh: bhuvyutpalāṃ) saṃgṛhya sadyojātena mantravit | vāmākhyena citāṃ kṛtvā (ṅ: dhṛtvā) ghoreṇa paridāhya ca || 98 ||
liṅgaṃ śivāgnināmṛjya (mū., a: mṛdya) puruṣeṇāvalokya ca | īśānena gṛhītvā tu tataḥ saṃskṛtya pūjayet || 99 ||
pañcatvaṅnimba (mū: tvagnīṃśca) pānīyaṃ bilvamajjā (mū, a: sarja) phalatrayam | sarjahiṅgupuraṃbola (puraḥ - gugguluḥ | puro guggulurākhyāto iti dharaṇi | bolaḥ - gandharasaḥ, bolagandharasaprāṇaḥ; ityamaraḥ) matasītailameva ca || 100 ||
sana (sanaḥ = ghaṇṭāpārulivṛkṣe | haskirṇeti bṛhadvācaspatyam) śrībālagodhūmayavamāṣātasīrajaḥ | mṛdi kṣiptvā vyavasthāpya māsaṃ tāṃ parimṛdya ca || 101 ||
asthibandhaṃ (mū., a, k, kh, gh: asthiratva) dṛḍhaṃ cādau dṛḍhalohena dāruṇā | śaṇatatvanvitaṃ (k: tatsūtritaṃ) katvā mṛnmayaṃ ghaṭayecchubham || 102 ||
kṣiptvā dhātvauṣadhīratnalohabrīhīn yathākramam | ityeteṣāmabhāve tu rasendraṃ vajrasaṃyutam || 103 ||
supuṣṭaiḥ (ṅ: adhuṣṭaiḥ) karkaraiḥ kṣīradadhibālaguḍānvitaiḥ | gavyasarjayutaiścaiva lepyaṃ varṇakapuṣṭaye || 104 ||
vanānu (k: vanāndha) kānanaṃ gaccheddārūpalagahītaye | sadvārarkṣartuyuktenhi cārulagnasamanvite || 105 ||
tadā gamanakāle tu śakunā (kh: kuśalā) nyatha lakṣayet | divyāntarikṣabhaumāni śubhāśubhaphalāptaye || 106 ||
suprasannamaruvartmasādityāmbhakṣaṇaprabham | ityādi śubhakṛddivyamato'śubhakaraṃ tvidam || 107 ||
ulkāpāto'śanistārāpatanaṃ ketusambhavaḥ | digdāhastīvravātaśca candrasūryopamardanam (mū, a, kha: pasarjanam) || 108 ||
akasmādgagane śabdaḥ pracyutiḥ phalapuṣpayoḥ | vāsavṛkṣāgrasaṃsthāyi (ṅ: śramasthāyi) balibhuṅmadhurārutiḥ || 109 ||
pakṣimaṇḍaliko tadadāntarikṣamidaṃ śubham | pāṃśvasṛgvarṣaṇaṃ ghoramāntarikṣamaśobhanam || 110 ||
pārthivānyadhunā vakṣye nimittāni śubhāni tu | dadhyakṣatayavā (mū, a: dadhyuddhṛtadharā) dūrvā dīpo gorocanā dhvajaḥ || 111 ||
śaṅkhaśchatraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ hemadhānyābjasārasāḥ | govṛṣaśca kharo vājī bhasmākṣo bhūpatirdvipaḥ || 112 ||
paṇyastrīmatsyamāṃsādi darśanādeva śobhanam | śivaḥ śivodakuṃbhasthaḥ kauśiko vāmataḥ śubhaḥ || 113 ||
savyata (mū. a, gh: savyataḥ = dakṣiṇataḥ savyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe iti haimaḥ | savyaṃ vāme ca dakṣiṇe ityajayaḥ | savataḥ) stvaśubhaṃ viddhi riktakuṃbhādidarśanam | muktakeśaḥ parākṣepaḥ kṣāro'ṅgāraśca dāru ca || 114 ||
snehābhyakto naraḥ sarpaḥ kṣapaṇaḥ (gh: pakvaṇaḥ) śākyadaṇḍinau (g: kṛpaṇaḥ śāṭhyadambhinau) | chinnāṅgo'locano rogī kapālī bhūprakampanaḥ || 115 ||
tuṣagomayakarpāsatailatakratṛṇāni ca | kṣutkṣāmonmattakau tantuścauṣadhīṣaṇasañcayaḥ (g: pañcamaḥ) || 116 ||
śubhairgamanamicchanti tvaśubhaiśca nivartanam | pakṣārdhārdhaṃ tu saṃtyajya prasthānaṃ kriyate śubhe || 117 ||
kṛttikādibharaṇyantaṃ prācyādau saptasaptakam | vedase syādvite (gh: yugāsrau syāddhitaiḥ) yātā tvagnidaṇḍānatikramāt || 118 ||
śaṅkhabherīravaistūryairmāṅgalyairvaidikaiḥ svanaiḥ | iṣṭādau (kh: indrādau) śaṅkaraṃ śastaṃ prāgīśenduvanaṃ (mū, a, k,: śendravanaṃ) vrajet || 119 ||
māghādimāsaṣaṭke ca na riktāyāṃ tithau site | budhārkendusite jīve vārkṣe prāguttarasthite (gh: sthire) || 120 ||
yogeṣu śubhasaṃjñaṣu karaṇe viṣṭivarjite | ekāntarāsu (k: ekākarāsu) tārāsu śeṣe cāniṣṭakarmaṇi || 121 ||
meruca mandaraḥ śveto himākhyo hemakūṭakaḥ | niṣadho nīlagandhākhyaḥ śaṅgīketurnagādhipāḥ || 122 ||
mahendraḥ pāriyātraśca hariścandro'tha śuktimān | nandākhyo malayo vindhya ujjayanto'tha (k: urjayanta) ṛkṣakaḥ (g: ṛṣyakaḥ) || 123 ||
śrīśailākhyastathā sahyo vikhyātāḥ kulabhūdharāḥ | yojanāni daśaiteṣāṃ girīṇāṃ nikaṭe vanam || 124 ||
tatprasūta (g: tatvamūla) nadītīre bhavedupavanaṃ sadā | etatkṣetrotthitā ye tu pāṣāṇāstaravaḥ śubhāḥ || 125 ||
svayameva vrajetkartā taddhito'nyo'pi vā janaḥ | sācāryaḥ sādhakaḥ śilpijanaiḥ parivataḥ śubhaiḥ || 126 ||
caruṃ bhuktvā dadhiprāśya natvā pūrṇaghaṭaṃ tathā | dhyātvādhaḥ prākṛtaṃ tattvaṃ śivatattvamayīṃ mahīm || 127 ||
vidyārājñīṃ tato dhyāyedagrato'rghakarāṃ sthitām | diśo virecya cāstreṇa vighnanāśāya daiśikaḥ || 128 ||
samyagvihitasambhāro dhyāyamānastrilocanam | mantrarakṣāvidhi kṛtvā saṃjapa (kh: saṃyajan) nniṣṭadevatām || 129 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye liṅgadravyanirṇayavanapraveśo nāma prathamovidhiḥ] || 1 ||
[atha dvitīyaḥ]
kartuśca deśikasyāpi śilpināṃ mūrtidhāriṇām | svarūpaṃ kathyate samyagiṣṭāniṣṭa ca karmaṇi || 1 ||
ṛjurāḍhyaḥ subhaktaśca śāntātmādṛṣṭabhīrukaḥ | dhīraḥ śāstrārthakārī ca kartā yaḥ sātviko varaḥ || 2 ||
dīnaḥ (k: pīnaḥ; kh: vana) śaṭhaḥ kudharmaśca vyasanī rājaso mataḥ | nāstikastārkikaḥ krūraḥ kartā yastāmaso'dhamaḥ || 3 ||
īśasaṃcoditābuddhiḥ śivasaṃsthāpane bhavet | tasmātte guravo'nveṣyā ye tacchāstreṣu bhāṣitāḥ (g: preṣitāḥ) || 4 ||
aujjanyā mādhyadeśāśca kaurūṣakāśca (gh: kaurukṣetrāśca) lāṭajāḥ | antarvedīpratiṣṭhānaśrāvastyā (mū, a: cāraptyā; g: cārakṣyā; k: cāvantyā) guravo varāḥ || 5 ||
rāḍhā vārendrakāstairā gaujarā māgadhāstathā | āṅgā jāṭodbhavāśceti (kh: āryajāto) saptaite madhyamāḥ smṛtāḥ || 6 ||
āndhrāḥ kāliṅgakārṇāṭā māhārāṣṭrāśca ḍhakkajāḥ | vīrajā drāviḍāpauṇḍrāstvaṣṭaiteguravo'dhamāḥ (gh: -tvaṣṭau te-) || 7 ||
kāmarūpāśca campākā (k: cāmpākā; kh: laṃpākā; g: panyākā) nepālotthāśca saindhavāḥ | vāṅgagāndhārapauliṅgā ete saptāntyajā matāḥ || 8 ||
kāñcikāḥ (g: kāthikāḥ; gh: kārakā) kausalāḥ kācchāḥ kāverāḥkauṅkaṇoḍrajāḥ | saurāṣṭrā devarāṣṭrāśca aṣṭaite (k, kh, g, gh: aṣṭau) ninditā bhṛśam || 9 ||
aśeṣakāmadāḥ śreṣṭhā madhyamā bhūtidāyinaḥ | adhamādyāḥ śubhe neṣṭā āryāvarte hi (kh: na) doṣadāḥ || 10 ||
sindhośca karatoyāyā himavadvindhyayorapi | yo deśo madhyabhāgaḥ syādāryāvartaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ || 11 ||
catuṣpadāstribodhāśca ṣaṭpadādhvavibhūṣitāḥ | gotragocarasaṃyuktāḥ samayādyuktalakṣaṇāḥ || 12 ||
catvāro gotrāḥ gāyatrī sāvitrī sarasvatī manonmanīti | catvāro gocarāḥ śivaḥ; śikhaḥ vimalajyotiḥ; sāvitraśceti (sāvitrāśceti catvāro gocarāḥ; iti likhitapustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ) ||
ṛcīkātreyadaurvāsagautamā iti antare (kh: catvāra) | dīkṣāguṇenasaṃpūrṇāṃ (mū, a, k, ṅ: dīkṣāsthāpanasaṃyuktāṃ) ye jānantyatha saṃhitām || 13 ||
ācāryāste tu vijñeyā anyathā lokadāmbhikāḥ | bhāryāvartodbhavāḥ śaivāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ || 14 ||
vinītā bhaktiyuktāśca liṅgajñāḥ śāstravedakāḥ | pīṭhadhāmādikuṇḍajñāḥ pratiṣṭhāsthānavedakāḥ || 15 ||
vāratārādikālajñā adhidevapravedakāḥ | lobhamohaparityaktāḥ śāntā dāntā vimatsarāḥ || 16 ||
niyamavratasaṃpannā dayādākṣiṇyasaṃyutāḥ | sātvikā nipuṇā dakṣāḥ pañcaśrautārthavedakāḥ (k: -tattvārtha-) || 17 ||
tattvasthāśchinnasaṃdehāḥ samayācārapālakāḥ | dṛḍhavratājanadrohisatyavāgbhūtavatsalāḥ (g: vāgghatavāsanāḥ) || 18 ||
ājñābhiṣekasaṃpannāḥ ṣaṭsu karmasu tatparāḥ | dīkṣitāḥ śivaśāstre smiṃścatvāro brāhmaṇādayaḥ ||19 ||
sarvānugrahakṛtyarthamācāryatvena sammatāḥ | yojitaḥ śivatattve yaḥ śivarūpamavāptavān || 20 ||
jātināśo bhavettasya śivadharmopajīvinaḥ | bhūdārvayo śmaratnānāṃ jātisaṃpādanaṃ yathā | śūdrādīnāṃ tathā mantrairyuktānāṃ śreṣṭhatā (mū, a, g, ṅ: hīnānāṃ śreṣṭhato) bhavet || 21 ||
tāmrādi syādyathā hema siddhaṃ pāradayogataḥ | tathaiva mantrasaṃyogāccāturvarṇaḥ śivī bhavet || 22 ||
nagarīnirjharādyambho gaṅgāṃ prāpyaikatāṃ yathā | dīkṣāyogāttatheśasya śūdrādiḥ śivatāṃ vrajet || 23 ||
dīkṣāto mucyate dehī tiṣṭhanmukto'pi vigrahe (g: pavitratā) | yathā kulālacakrastho'vicchinnaṃ bhramate ghaṭaḥ || 24 ||
svakarmabandhanairbaddhaḥ (g: vaśya) paśurātmā malāśritaḥ (mū, a: paśurātmā manoyutaḥ; k, g: prabhurātmā manodyata) | malaṃ viṣamadaṃ yadvaddhanti vai mantratejasā || 25 ||
paṅkaiḥ kaluṣitaṃ toyaṃ ghaṭasthaṃ nirmalaṃ yathā (kh: yadvadghaṭasthanirmalam) | syātkatakaphalairyogāttadvanmantraistu mānavaḥ || 26 ||
karṣakaḥ karṣayed (gh: kaṭṭakaḥ kaṭṭayed) yadvad bhrāmako bhrāmayedyathā (kh: bhrāmayedbhrāmako yathā) | tathaiva mantrasāmarthyānmalaṃ hatvā śivī bhavet || 27 ||
yathārkakarasaṃyogādvahnirutpadyate maṇeḥ | tatheśamantrasaṃparkā (mū, a, k, g: saṃyogā) cchivatvaṃ jāyate paśoḥ || 28 ||
śivaśaktyātmakā mantrāḥ śivaśaktibhiranvitāḥ | śaivācāryāḥ prayacchanti śivatvaṃ sa carācare || 29 ||
yathā mṛdratnalohāni (gh: lohaiśca) mantrairgacchanti devatām | ācāryo'pi (kh: mantra tantra) tathaivātra śivatvaṃ yāti mantravit || 30 ||
mantratattve sthitā devā mantraḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ | saṃskriyante hi mantraiśca devācāryatapasvinaḥ || 31 ||
dārvaśmalohamṛdratnajātaṃ liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | yathāpūjyaveda (gh: -pūjama-) jñastathā śudro'pi daiśikaḥ || 32 ||
mṛdādidravyajātīnāṃ (mū, a, k, g, ṅ: jātānāṃ) śivatvaṃ yaḥ prayacchati (gh: pradīpayet) | sa śivaḥ svayameva syānnānyarūpaḥ kadācana || 33 ||
sarpadaṣṭā yathā suptāścāṇḍālāntā dvijādayaḥ | mantrayogādvibudhyante naṣṭāniṣṭaṃ tathā śive || 34 ||
karṇadhāro yathā pāraṃ dvijādīnnayati (k, kh, g: naukayā yāti tat) kṣaṇāt | śaivācāryaḥ (mū, a, k: śaivācāryāḥ) paraṃ sthānaṃ tadvattā (kh: tattvato) nmantranaukayā || 35 ||
(karṇadhāro (koṣṭhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ gh, saṃjñakatāḍapatrapustake vartate, anyeṣu pustakeṣu nāsti) yathāpāraṃ naukayā yāti tatkṣaṇāt | tathācāryaḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ yāti vai mantranaukayā || 36 ||)
caturdivyābdasāhasraiḥ kṛta (mū, a, k: kṛte) sandhiḥ śataṃ yathā | śeṣe tvekaikahāniḥ syātsahasre ca śatakramāt (mū, a, k: dveśate kramāt) || 37 ||
caturyugasahasrānte dinamekaṃ prajāpateḥ | pitāmahaśataṃ yāvadviṣṇormānaṃ vidhīyate || 38 ||
rudrasya (g: candrasya) nimiṣārdhena sahasrāṇi caturdaśa | vinaśyanti tathopendrā asaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ || 39 ||
īśasya vāsaraikena kṣīyante bahavo harāḥ | sādākhyanimiṣeṇeśo layaṃ yāti na saṃśayḥ || 40 ||
svecchayā paratruṭyā (k, g: parakrudhyā) tu sādākhyastatra līyate | śivātparataraṃ nāsti iti śāstreṣu niścayaḥ || 41 ||
evaṃ mānaviśeṣaistu mantravīryaṃ tu tādṛśam | tasmācchivadito mantraḥ siddhimuktiphalapradaḥ || 42 ||
vāgīśī jananī yasya vyomavyāpī pitā śivaḥ | mantraiḥ śivādhvare (k: śivapure; kh, g: śivāpure) jātaḥ sa śūdraḥ syātkathaṃ punaḥ || 43 ||
mṛdbhavānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ saṃskārānnamṛdā yathā (asya samanantaraḥ pāṭho'yaṃ ka pustake prakṣipto yathāḥ- ye viprādikamadvāramabhiṣiktāścaranti te | vedena hatvā dīkṣānyā patitā raurave sphuṭam | tathaiva dīkṣāmantrāṇāṃ tatprakṛtyā samāgatāḥ | iti) | tathaiva pāpahānaṃ ca prākṛtāstu prajāyate (k: prākṛtaṃ tu na jāyate; kh: na prakṛtyāstu jātaḥ) || 44 ||
hatvā dīkṣābhiṣekādīṃścaṇḍena pātitāstu te | lakṣyā (mū, a, k, kh: loke) viprādikācārānnārakīṇo na tārakāḥ (kh: kārakāḥ) || 45 ||
narāṇāṃ śivasaṃskārācchivatvaṃ na bhavedyadi | na bhaveyustadā nūnaṃ dvijā devādidaiśikāḥ || 46 ||
tasmānmantrapradhānatvaṃ nigrahānugrahaṃ prati | viṣabhūtagrahādyāśca nigṛhyante hi mantrataḥ || 47 ||
mantrasaṃskāradīkṣābhiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ guruṇā yadā | carācaraṃ prapadyeta śivatvaṃ tatkṣaṇāddhruvam || 48 ||
cāturvarṇyamanugrāhyaṃ cāturvarṇyānnabhojanam | etatsiddhaṃ sadā śaivaṃ gururūpamajanmakam (kh: gururūpamayātmakam) || 49 ||
kaupīnamekhalāyuktā jaṭāyajñopavītinaḥ | śivāntanāmakāḥ sarve bhasmāṅgā (mū, a, kh, gh, ṅ: bhasmākṣā) brahmacāriṇaḥ || 50 ||
dīkṣayā hanyate dīkṣā pūrvadīkṣā hi naśyati | viśeṣayātu sāmānyā gururapyevameva tu || 51 ||
naganāntāstu (mū, a, k, g: nagaṇāntāstu; kh: narāṇāṃ) vaiśeṣāḥ śaivāḥ śivāntasaṃjñakāḥ | ambhojaṃ paṅkajaṃ yadvattadvacchaivā na cetare || 52 ||
hasto'syāstīti hastī syādrūḍhito netaro (mū, a, k, kh: netare) yathā | tathaiva śivaliṅgānāṃ śaivāḥ pāśupatādayaḥ || 53 ||
tapasvyācāryadevān yaḥ (mū, a: devānāṃ) pūrvarūpeṇa manyate | liṅgabhedaphalairyukto yātyasau rauravaṃ dhruvam || 54 ||
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavirodhena netareṣāṃ tathā vidhiḥ | anyathā pāpakārī syādityājñā pārameśvarī || 55 ||
gurūnnirūpayettasmād dvividhaṃ śaivamuttamam | brahmacārīgṛhasthatvabhedabhinnaṃ dvidhā sthitam || 56 ||
akāmikāmibhedena vakṣyamāṇaguṇānvitam | kāmyakāmikriyāṃ vacmi sāmprataṃ saṃprabhedataḥ || 57 ||
tapasvya (g: tapasyā; gh: tapasya) kāmināmeva pratiṣṭhādikriyocyate | bhuktimuktīcchukaḥ kāmī kuryāddīkṣādimājñayā || 58 ||
gṛhasthastu dvidhā proktaḥ sāntāniko vratārpakaḥ | pratiṣṭhādikriyāśeṣā tatkṛtā saṃpraśasyate || 59 ||
yoṣidyuktaḥ sakeśaśca jaṭādiparivarjitaḥ | śivādhikāravṛttiryaḥ sa sāntānika ucyate || 60 ||
vratī vratāsamartho yo vidhinā vratamarpayet | paścātkuryādvivāhaṃ ca gṛhasthaḥ sa vatārpakaḥ || 61 ||
brahmacaryaṃ carennityaṃ jaṭābhasmasamanvitaḥ | bhaikṣyāśī saṃyatātmā ca vratī sa parikīrtitaḥ || 62 ||
gotragocarasa tāvasaṅketaiḥ (k: saṅgataiḥ; kh: saṅkīrtaḥ) kramaśo guruḥ | puṣpapātābhidhānaṃ tu maṭhī (mū, g: mathī; k: sacī) mudrābhiriṣyate || 63 ||
strīsraggandhārthaśayyāsiyānatāmbūlabhūṣaṇam | sadvastramañjanaṃ tailaṃ nayate ramate hi tam (mū, a, k: ramaterhitaḥ; kh: ramatordhvataḥ; gh: rayaterhitam) || 64 ||
bhuktyai (mū, a: bhujñaṃ; g: bhuñje) sāntānikaṃ nityaṃ bhuktimuktyorvranāpakam (mū, a, g: bhuktimuktivratārpitam; k: bhuktimuktipradārpitam) | mākṣāya vratinaṃ caiva varayenmatimānnaraḥ || 65 ||
putrau dvau tu gṛhasthasya pāralaukikalaukikau | laukiko dravyabhāgī syādvidyābhāk pāralaukikaḥ || 66 ||
vratiśiṣyasya yacchāstramṛṇaṃ cāthaṃ ca tadguroḥ | bhrātṛṇaṃ gurvabhāve syādgṛhasthānāṃ svaputrakam (mū, a, k: svaputragam; kh: suputrakaḥ) || 67 ||
yati (mū, a, k, kh: yadi) putraḥ prapautro vā tatsantānodvāstathā | ayogyāḥ śivakāryeṣu ghaṇṭāsambandhino haret (g: ghaṇṭāmayuktilohavat) || 68 ||
vratinaḥ śiṣyaputraḥ syādyogyaḥ sarveṣu karmasu | ṛṇe dravye ca piṇḍe ca sa evaikaḥ praśasyate || 69 ||
śiṣyāmnāyena sambhūta ācāryaḥ śubhaśāntikṛt | caturgocaramadhye ca śaivo jyeṣṭhāyate (mū, a, k, g: jyeṣṭhoyateḥ) param || 70 ||
sarvānugrahakṛdyasmādādyaḥ sarvagataḥ śivaḥ | śaivācāryastataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sthāpayetsarvadevatāḥ (saha devatā, iti pāṭhāntaram) || 71 ||
dakṣiṇārhottamaṃ pātraṃ darśanānāṃ (g: ttamaḥ pātramarhatānāṃ) śivaḥ prabhuḥ | bhuktimuktipradātā ca nānyo vai viśvakṛdguruḥ || 72 ||
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ śaivaḥ sthāpaka iṣyate | tadabhāve (gh: vadadāve) tu kartavyāḥ svadevavratacāriṇaḥ (kh: vratadhāriṇaḥ) || 73 ||
janmanā jāyate śūdraḥ kriyayā dvija ucyate | śrutena śrotriyaścaiva brāhmaṇo brahmacaryataḥ || 74 ||
svamantrasaṃskṛto vipraḥ svakarmavratapālakaḥ | manuṣyajātisāmānye ko vidveṣaḥ śivadvije || 75 ||
strīpuṃnapuṃsakānāṃ ca yathābhedāstriliṅgataḥ | na tathā brāhmaṇādīnāṃ tasmājjātirnakāraṇam (g: prakāraṇam) || 76 ||
pañca (kh: yaśca) tattvaviśuddhyarthaṃ pañca (kh: yaśca) brahmavinirmitam | upavītaṃ sadā dhāryaṃ śaivācāryairna cetaraiḥ || 77 ||
śivo vipraḥ śikhā (kh: śivo) rājā jyotirvicchūdrajātikaḥ | sāvitra itthamī parṇā proktā nānā śivāgame || 78 ||
guruḥ śivaḥ śikhādīnāṃ (kh: śivādīnāṃ) trayāṇāṃ śikhasaṃjñakaḥ | dvayoḥ syājjyātirityuktaḥ sāvitrastu svagocaraḥ || 79 ||
kāhalātūryaḍhakkāśrīghaṭikāśaṅkhasusvanaiḥ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: susvaraiḥ) | dhvajaiśchatrairyutāḥ sarve śaivācāryā nṛpā iva || 80 ||
guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pratiṣṭheta yatra rāṣṭre ca tatra ca (k: rāṣṭre'dbhuta ca) | syādvṛddhirvijayaḥ (gh: sthāpiterdevaistatkartā ca) śāntirārogyaṃ dharmavardhanam || 81 ||
ebhiśca sthāpite deve kartā jana dhanānvitaḥ | āyuṣā yaśasā lakṣmyā (gh: lakṣmī) putrapautrairvivardhate (gh: pravardhate) || 82 ||
pitarastasya nandanti yāvattiṣṭhanti devatāḥ | tāvadya gasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate || 83 ||
sthānasya devatāyāśca ciravṛddhiḥ prajāyate (gh: vṛddhiśca) | nākāle mriyate kartā parataḥ śivatāṃ vrajet || 84 ||
yāvattatkīrtivikhyātistāvattasya mahāphalam | padaṃ saṃprāpya rudrasya sukhamakṣayamaśnute || 85 ||
athādhamādideśotthā ye cānyatrātininditāḥ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: nyatra vininditāḥ) | (k: tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate pāṭho'yaṃ gh pustake'dhikaḥ, aprāsaṅgikaśca) tāṃstu sarvān prayuñjīta krūrakarmasu sarvadā || 86 ||
hīnavyaṅgādhikāṅgāśca kubjavāmanakhañjakāḥ | vikṛtāḥ śavalā (kh: sacarā) raudrāḥ śaṭhāḥ krūrāḥ (mū: sevā) kuvṛttikāḥ || 87 ||
pāpivyādhitakiñciñjñā devacchāyopajīvinaḥ | vākkaṇṭhā baghiraḥ sthūlāḥ kunakhāśca kumūrdhajāḥ || 88 ||
sūcakāstārkikā vaidyāḥ sevakāḥ karṣakāstathā | purodhāḥ paṇyajīvī (gh: ścānyajīvī) ca vaṇijo dhātuvādinaḥ || 89 ||
liṅgadhārī (gh: cārī) kuśīlāśca (gh: kuśīlātmā) dyūtakārakalampaṭāḥ | vakranāsāṅgalamboṣṭhā mūrkhāḥ spandanagātrakāḥ || 90 ||
kusaṅgākulajā bālāḥ kākasvarānunāsikāḥ | granthaviplākā (kh: viprocakā) vṛddhā vyasanī samayacyutaḥ || 91 ||
danturāḥ ślīpadāḥ stabdhā arbudī (k, g: arbhadī) galagaṇḍakāḥ | etaistu sthāpitā devā dhanāyuḥ putranāśakāḥ || 92 ||
anyāśramimagāmotthāḥ (kh, gh: magānmottha) punarbhūḥ kuṇḍagolakāḥ | katthakāḥ (kh, g, gh: kaṇṭhakā) kauśikā (k, g: kaulikā) stajjāstrikarṇādyāśca varjitāḥ || 93 ||
cārvākāścārhatā bauddhāḥ sāṅkhyadarśanino dvijāḥ | sanyāsavratinaścānye sthāpane nādhikāriṇaḥ || 94 ||
śākadvīpātpurānītā magā gomāṃsabhakṣakāḥ (kh: -khādakāḥ) | nirmālyabhakṣyaṇārthaṃ tu śāmbenācyutasūnunā || 95 ||
śaivīṃ dīkṣāṃ vinā yastu śāstramātraprapāṭhakaḥ | śivādīn sthāpayennityaṃ svayambhūḥ sa narādhamaḥ || 96 ||
prāpta (kta) naṃ liṅgamutsṛjya yaḥ śaivaṃ vratamācaret (mū, a, k: tu tamāśrayet) | sa punarbhūḥ parijñeyo varjanīyaḥ śivāgame || 97 ||
svadhave vidyamāne tu jāyate jārato hi yaḥ | kuṇḍaḥ krūrasvabhāvaḥsyānmṛte patyau tu golakaḥ || 98 ||
ācāryadharmapatnīṣu yo jātaḥ saguroḥ suta | prāvrājyānnaśyate (mū, a, kh: duṣyate) pūrvaṃ strīyogādaparaṃ tathā || 99 ||
ubhābhyāṃ yaḥ pranaṣṭaḥ syāttasyāpatyastu katthakaḥ | trikarṇotthāstrikarṇāśca trikapānātma (mū, a: trikarṇastu tri) karṇakā || 100 ||
nityanainittikāgantugurudevāgnyapūjanāt | bhasmāṅkurastu (g: gurustu) katthosthastatsutāḥ kauśikādayaḥ || 101 ||
bhojakā vratiputrāśca kauśikānyāśca (mū, a: kauśikādyāśca) kutsitāḥ | rāṣṭrakṣayakarā hyete ye ca paṣāṇḍino narāḥ || 102 ||
samayādiṃ vinā mūḍhaḥ sthāpanaṃ kurate tu yaḥ | śāstrāvalokanādeva caṇḍeśastasya śāsakaḥ || 103 ||
yo'śaivaḥ sthāpayedīśaṃ lobhavyāmūḍhamānasaḥ | sa yāti narakaṃ sadyo yājñikaiḥ saha daiśikaḥ || 104 ||
pañcasrotaḥ su ye pañcasamayāḥ śaṃbhunoditāḥ | teṣāmācaraṇānnityamācārya iti kīrtyate || 105 ||
ācāryaḥ śivarūpeṇa lokānugrahakārakaḥ | tasmānna mānavīṃ buddhiṃ kārayeddaiśikaṃ prati || 106 ||
īśaṃ vaktraṃ tathāghoraṃ guhyaṃ cājātasaṃjñakam (mū, a, k: ca jāta-) | pañcavaktrāṇi devasya pañcāgamavivṛddhaye || 107 ||
kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ māntrīṃ (mū, a: cintyaṃ; k, g: cāntyaṃ; kh: mitryaṃ) kāraṇaṃ cājitaṃ tathā | dīptaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca sāhasramaṃśuma (kh: asumat) tsuprabhaṃ daśa || 108 ||
śivabhedāḥ samākhyātā rudrabhedānataḥ (?) param | vijayaṃ pāramaiśvaryaṃ niśvāsodgītasaṃjñakam || 109 ||
prodgītaṃ mukhabimbaṃtu siddhaṃ santānameva ca | narasiṃhaṃ candrahāsaṃ vīraṃ svāyambhurauravam (kh: rocanam) || 110 ||
mākuṭaṃ kiraṇaṃ caiva lalitaṃ virasaṃ (g: vivaraṃ) param (mū, a, k: smaram) | (cāpacinhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ ka pustake nāsti) rudrabhedāḥ samākhyātā daśāṣṭādaśa cordhvagāḥ || 111 ||
haraṃ huṅkārakaṃ caiva bindusāraṃ kalā (kh: karā) mṛtam | davatrāsaṃ ca sutrāsa sāvaraṃ kālasāvaram || 112 ||)
pakṣirājaṃ śikhāyogaṃ śikhāsāraṃ śikhāmṛtam | pañcabhūta (mū, a: pañcāmṛta) vibhāgaṃ ca śūnyabheda (kh: -mada) vinirṇayam || 113 ||
kālakāṇṭhaṃ (kh: maṇikaṇṭhaṃ) ca kālāṅgaṃ kālakūṭaṃ paṭadrumam | kambojaṃ kambalaṃ kaṅkaṃ kālakuṇḍaṃ kaṭāhakam || 114 ||
suvarṇarekha (k: suvarṇavaṇyaṃ) sugrīvaṃ tottala tottalottaram (mū: totalaṃ totaloktam; kh: tottaratottarottaram) | gāruḍasya tvime bhedā aṣṭāviṃśatirīritāḥ || 115 ||
svacchandabhairavaṃ caṇḍaṃ krodhamunmattabhairavam | asitāṅgaṃ ruruṃ caiva kapālīśaṃ samuccayam || 116 ||
aghoraṃ ghoṣaṇaṃ (kh: ghorasaṃ) ghoraṃ niśāsañcāradurmukham | bhīmāṅgaṃ ḍāmarārāvaṃ (kh: -rāgaṃ) bhīmaṃ vetālamardakam || 117 ||
ucchuṣmaṃ vāma (gh: ucchuṣmavāhi) kāpālaṃ śekharaṃ puṣpamadvayam | triśiraṃ caikapādaṃ tu siddhayogeśvarīmatam || 118 ||
pañcāmṛtaṃ prapañcaṃ ca (gh: prapañcāhi) yoginī jāla (gh: jala) sambaram | viśvarikaṇṭha saṅkocaṃ (mū: vikaṇṭha; kh: jhaṅkāra) tilakodyānabhairavam || 119 ||
evaṃ dvātriṃśatantrāṇi sottarāṇi ca taddvayam | catuḥ ṣaṣṭipramāṇāni dakṣiṇāsyādbhavāni ca || 120 ||
nayaṃ nayottara mūkaṃ mohanaṃ mohanāmṛtam | karapūjāvidhānaṃ tu vīṇātantraṃ taduttaram || 121 ||
jayaṃ ca vijayaṃ caiva ajitaṃ cāparājitam | siddhanityodayaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ cintāmaṇimahodayam || 122 ||
vāgbhavaṃ kuhakaṃ citraṃ kāmadhenukadambakam | ānandarudrabhadrākhyaṃ (kh: bhadrākṣe) kiṅkaraṃ kiṅkarānugam || 123 ||
anantavijayaṃ śaukraṃ daurvāsaṃ bījabhedakam | vāmadaṃ vāmadevoktaṃ (mū, a, k: devotthaṃ) caturviṃśatibhedagam (k: bhedajam) || 124 ||
halāhalaṃ hayagrīvaṃ karakoṭaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭam | karoṭaṃ (mū, a, g: kavāṭaṃ; k: kalphoṭaṃ) muṇḍamālaṃ ca kaṅkoṭaṃ khaḍgarāvaṇam (mū, a: vāraṇam) || 125 ||
caṇḍāsidhāraṃ huṅkāraṃ hāhākāraṃ śivāravam | ghorāṭṭahāsamucchiṣṭaṃ ghurghuraṃ duṣṭatrāsakam (mū, a: duṣkṛtāsanam) || 126 ||
vimalaṃ vikaṭaṃ caiva sudhāraṇaṃ (mū: svadhāvaṇaṃ) mahotkaṭam | yamaghaṇṭaṃ ca bhūtāhvaṃ (mū: bhūtāṅgaṃ; kh: bhūtājyaṃ) viṣabhedamajātajam || 127 ||
ityevaṃ śaivatantrāṇi (kh: sūtrāṇāṃ; gh: sūtrāṇi) catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ śatam | punarlakṣavibhedana grabhinnaḥ śāstrasaṅgrahaḥ || 128 ||
śivo rudrastato devā devebhya ṛṣayastathā (mū, a, k: -sadā) | ṛṣibhyo mānuṣāḥ śiṣyāḥ sarvaśāstrāvatārakāḥ || 129 ||
siddhānto gāruḍaṃ caivaṃ bhairavaṃ vāmabhautikam | iti sāmayikaṃ proktaṃ śambhunāgamapañcakam || 130 ||
siddhānte caturvarṇānnabhojanaṃ gāruḍe viṣam | ekatrabhojanaṃ ghore vāme vāmāmṛtaṃ tathā || 131 ||
bhūtatantre śavasparśaḥ pañcasrotaḥsvayaṃ vidhiḥ | ācaret samayān pañca yaḥ sa ācārya ucyate || 132 ||
ācāramācarecchaivaṃ (mū: caivaṃ) śāstroktaṃ gurubhāṣitam | tadavaśyaṃ hi kartavyamanyathā patanaṃ bhavet || 133 ||
pūjā homo balirbhikṣā caruścātithipūjanam | ṣaṭkarmāṇi tu kāryāṇi śivācāryeṇa no paraiḥ || 134 ||
vyākhyānaṃ śravaṇaṃ caiva pradānaṃ ca pratigrahaḥ | dīkṣāṃ ca sthāpanaṃ ceti (mū: caiva) ṣaṭkarmāṇi sadā guroḥ || 135 ||
na dīkṣāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryācchiṣya ācāryasannidhau | krośān pañca parityajya gurvādeśāttadācaret || 136 ||
samayī samayasthaḥ syātputrakaścāgama (a, k, kh, g, ṅ: putrakaḥ svāgama) śrutiḥ | sādhakaḥ sādhayetsiddhirācāryo dīkṣayetpaśūn || 137 ||
samayādikrameṇaiva yo'bhiṣiktaḥ sa daiśikaḥ | pratiṣṭhādikriyā tasya na pāṭhādagra (mū, a: pāṭhānnaivāgra; kh: nayāvadagra; g: yāvanta vipra) janmanaḥ || 138 ||
śivādisthāpane samyaṅ nyāyamārgeṇa dhīmatām | yuktiḥ saṃsūcyate kācidyā coktā pārameśvare || 139 ||
pāṭhādeva dvijo yatra śivaṃ lobhātpratiṣṭhayet | nāśmādau śivatā tatra hyāṃśave dūrataḥ śivaḥ || 140 ||
pratiṣṭhayed dvijo yastu pramadāddevatāḥ kvacit | cāṇḍālo'sāvabhojyānnaḥ pātakī nātra saṃśayaḥ (kh, gh: nārakī bhavet) || 141 ||
śivasaṃsthāpanādvipraḥ śvayonyāṃ jāyate dhruvam | anyagotre (mū, a: śrotre; k: tyāśre) kuśā (kh: tre'ṅkuśā) pātānnārakī syād dvijādhamaḥ || 142 ||
paṭhantyādeśato vedānādeśena yajanti ye | liṅgādisthāpakā ye ca te cāṇḍālasamā dvijāḥ || 143 ||
śūdre caivaṃ bhavedvṛttaṃ brāhmaṇe na ca vidyate | mantavyo vipravacchūdraḥ śūdrātpāpatarastu saḥ || 144 ||
viśvāmitro dvijībhūtaḥ kṣatriyo dvijavṛttataḥ | vṛttātsiddhā vasiṣṭhādyā vyāsenoktaṃ ca bhārate || 145 ||
agniṣṭomādikānyajñān vihāya sthāpayecchivam | narake patati kṣipraṃ kartā svapitṛbhiḥ saha || 146 ||
pratiṣṭhārthe navartante dvijatve na ca ye sthitāḥ | svabrāhmaṇyaṃ gataṃ teṣāṃ brahmahatyāṃ (brahmahatvaṃ, li, pu) ca saṃsthitam || 147 ||
brāhmaṇyahāra kairvipraiḥ sthāpitā ye śivādayaḥ | te krūrā dhvaṃsakā jñeyā yajamānakṣayāvahāḥ || 148 ||
śivādisthāpanādvipra ubhābhyāṃ bhraśyati kṣaṇāt (gh: dvijaḥ) | dānārcanādyanarhaḥ syādvinaṣṭā brāhmaṇī (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: naṣṭo brāhmaṇo) yathā || 149 ||
duṣṭapātrasthitaṃ kṣaudraṃ yadvadamlaṃ tu doṣadam | tadvadvedāḥ kuviprasthāḥ kartuḥ syuraśubhapradāḥ || 150 ||
śivaḥ śirastathā jyotiḥ sāvitraśca caturthakaḥ | ete śaivāḥ samākhyātā na tvete brāhmaṇāḥ kvacit || 151 ||
brahmakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca śivādhvare | saṃskṛtānāṃ yatasteṣāṃ naśyante pūrvajātayaḥ || 152 ||
ye brahmaṇā na te śaivā ye ca śaivā na te dvijāḥ | pṛthaṅmantrāgamāveṣāṃ (mū, a, k, kh: -ścaiṣāṃ) vratāni kratavaḥ pṛthak || 153 ||
lubdhā dvijādhamā mūrkhāḥ svabrahmaghnā (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: brahmaghnā) vikarmagāḥ | mugdhāḥ kurvanti ye viprāḥ śivādisthāpanaṃ kalau || 154 ||
dvijabauddhādiyāgeṣu mantrāḥ śaivādayastathā (mū, a, k, kh: śaivā yatheha na) | tathaiva śivayāgeṣu na mantrā vaidikādayaḥ || 155 ||
na vede trividhaṃ liṅgaṃ na ca (gh: naiva) prāsādalakṣaṇam | na dvāraṃ maṇḍapādiśca sthāpanaṃ na śivādike || 156 ||
śivasiddhānta evoktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śāṅkarādikam | tasmācchaivena mantreṇa pratiṣṭheta (mū, a: pratiṣṭheyaṃ) śivādikam || 157 ||
calācala (carācara, li pu pā) prabhedena dvidhā liṅgaṃ śivasya yat | śivamantraistayoḥ samyak śivatvaṃ nānyamantrataḥ || 158 ||
na vedaiḥ pañcarātraistu ṛṣyuktairnāpi cāgamaiḥ | nānyadarśanamantrairvā pratiṣṭhā syācchivasya tu || 159 ||
na vede śaivasaṃskāro nāpi vede śivavratam | na ca śaivīkriyā vede na ca khaḍgadisiddhayaḥ || 160 ||
garbhādhānādisaṃskārā (k: saṃskārān; kh, gh: saṃskāraiḥ) stribhistraivarṇikaṃ vratam | agniṣṭomādayo yajñā vedoktā īśvareṇa tu || 161 ||
cāturvarṇyavrataṃ śaivaṃ caturarthaprasādhanam | siddhāntasthāpanaṃ dīkṣāṃ noktaṃ vedeṣu śaṃbhunā || 162 ||
svalpa (g: alpa) bījo vaṭo (?) (kh: ṭaṭā) yadvacchiṣyo'pyevaṃ svabījataḥ | svamantrabījajā devā na bavhakṣaraḍambarāt (mū, a, k, g: na ca hṛtkaṇṭhaḍambaraiḥ) || 163 ||
vandi (k: vahni) dvijajanāśchātrāḥ prakaṭāḥ (g: śrukaṭāḥ) pāṭhajīvinaḥ | naite śivādhvatattvajñāḥ stāvakā janarañjakāḥ || 164 ||
vedādiśabda (k: śanta; kh: sarva; g: śaṭha) śāstraistu kaiḥ stuto na śivaḥ prabhuḥ | stutyaiva sthāpanaṃ na syācchivaliṅge calācale (carācare, li. pu. pā.) || 165 ||
pratiṣṭhā pañcadhā yā ca śivenoktā śivāgame | śaivācāryaistu sā kāryā rudrabrahmārkacakriṇām || 166 ||
sthāpyāḥsurā (kh: tārā) grahāḥ sarve lokapālāstathoragāḥ (mū, a, k, g: sahoragāḥ) | yakṣarākṣasayoginyo gaṇā gauryastathāparāḥ || 167 ||
sthityutpattivipattīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | svasaṃvedye (kh: sukhaṃ vede) 'pi rāgāndhā dvijā īśvaranindakāḥ || 168 ||
śaivāntaḥ pātino ye 'pi pañcārthāḥ (kh: yaścārthāḥ) kārakādayaḥ | te'pi tyājyāḥ pratiṣṭhādau dūrādbauddhadvijādayaḥ || 169 ||
tasmācchivātmakenaiva śivācāryeṇa dhīmatā | śivādisthāpanaṃ kāryaṃ nānyaistu brāhmaṇādibhiḥ || 170 ||
svadarśanasthitā nityamācāryāścaiva ṣaḍvidhāḥ | svakarmābhiratā viprāḥ śaivādyāḥ kāpilāntakāḥ || 171 ||
śrutismṛtyarthavidvipraḥ svaśāstravratapālakaḥ | svaṣaṭkarmānvito nityaṃ nānyakarmā dvijo bhavet || 172 ||
dānaṃ pratigrahaḥ pāṭho yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā | adhyāpanamiti syuśca ṣaṭkarmāṇi sadā dvije || 173 ||
ṛtusevātapo dānaśrāddhavaiśvānarārcanaiḥ (mū: lekhānarārcanaiḥ) | tṛṇādimūlyabhikṣānnavṛttiḥ syābrāhmaṇo varaḥ || 174 ||
khaḍgajīvo maṣījīvī (mū, a, k, g: makhājīvī) dvārapālo purohitaḥ | ādeśī vedavikretā ṣaḍete śūdravaddvijāḥ || 175 ||
śrutirvedāḥ samākhyātāḥ smṛtayastūnaviṃśatiḥ | manurdakṣo vasiṣṭho'triḥ kātyāyano'tha gautamaḥ || 176 ||
yājñavalkyaśca savarto vyāso viṣṇuryamo'ṅgirāḥ | śaṅkhalikhitahārītaśātātapaparāśarāḥ || 177 ||
āpastambośanojīvāḥ smṛtayastu taduktayaḥ | na śaivāditipraṣṭhāyāmete niprā niyāmakāḥ || 178 ||
pratiṣṭhākalpakaumāraṃ kiraṇaṃ (g: keraṇaṃ ma. pā. | kevalaṃ) piṅgalāmatam | devyā mataṃ mayaṃ nandiṃ pratiṣṭhā pārameśvaram || 179 ||
bhāskaraṃ liṅgakalpaṃ ca vidyāpurāṇavāṭhulam | śakākhyaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca dvidhā paitāmahaṃ tathā || 180 ||
bāṇagargamataṃ yāmyaṃ haṃsākhyaṃ vaiśvakarmakam (mū, a, g: vaiśvasargakam) | pratiṣṭhātantrāṇyetāni śivoktānyekaviṃśatiḥ || 181 ||
etebhyaḥ sāramādāya nāradātpauṣkarāttathā | padmotthamārkaṇḍeyābhyāṃ rambhā (kh: gaurī) siddhādi rambhataḥ (mū, a, k, g: sauryataḥ) || 182 ||
ratnaprayojanāccāhitilakebhyastathāparān | mārtaṇḍāhrayato (kh, g: mārkaṇḍā-) lakṣyaṃ sarvametatsamuccayam (g: sarvatatva-) || 183 ||
bahudhā guhyatantrāṇi naitāni brāhmaṇasya tu | śivāśramasthitaiḥ śaivaiḥ pratiṣṭhā nānyadarśanaiḥ || 184 ||
aśaivaiḥ sthāpita liṅgamitarairyaddvijātibhiḥ | śaivāstanna namasyanti sthāpitaṃ cānyadarśanaiḥ || 185 ||
brahmavratesthito (kh: brahmāvrate-) nityaṃ śaivādivratamācaret (k, kh, g: -vṛtti-) | śaivasaṃskārahīnastu umābhyāṃ patati dvijaḥ || 186 ||
patite tadgataṃ yacca gṛhītā yā ca dakṣiṇā | kṛtaṃ yadvratabandhādi tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhaven || 187 ||
svayamanyasvarūpeṇe karmāṇi kriyate tu yat (mū, a, g: nānyakarma tu) | na bhavedīpsitaṃ tatra vṛthaivāsau phariśramaḥ || 188 ||
sarvārthagrahaṇe muktiḥ (mū, a: nugrahaṇe yuktiḥ) siddhayaśca śivāgamaiḥ | śivoktaiśca vinā mantraistadetatprāpyate katham || 189 ||
yadi vedairbhavelliṅgaṃ śūdrādyārādhanaṃ katham | miśrairvāpyatha doṣādya (k, g: doṣāḍhyaṃ) tkumāradyuktaśāstrataḥ || 190 ||
anyad devaśca mantraśca vidhiścānyaṃ karoti yaḥ | karmacaṇḍaṃ bhavettasya karma caṇḍālakaśca saḥ || 191 ||
na svadarśana uktatvānnāpi rāgād (mū, a: navirāgād; k, kh: bhakṣyādyānāpirāgād) dvijādiṣu | muktisiddhaṃ (mū, a, kh: yuktisiddhaṃ) hitaṃ loke skandoktaṃ cātra likhyate || 192 ||
sanakātreyavyāsādyairṛṣibhiryā pracoditā | kriyā sā na bhavetsādhvī mantrasaṃkaradūṣitā || 193 ||
kṣayā viṣayadoṣādyā vedavidyā (mū: devavidyā) pracoditāḥ | agniṣṭomādayo yadvatpratiṣṭhāpīṣyate tathā || 194 ||
dravyābhijanamantrādyaiḥ śaucaśuddhayai prasāritā (k: prasādhitā) | svargalokaphalā sādhvī vijñeyā vaidikīkriyā || 195 ||
svargalokātparibhraṣṭāḥ somādādityamāgatāḥ | vānaspatyaṃ samāsādya saṃsarantīha yājñikāḥ || 196 ||
iṣṭvā kratuśataṃ śakraḥ svargalokamavāptavān | punaḥ puṇyakriyākṣīṇaḥ sthāvarādiṣu jāyate || 197 ||
satyalokotparaṃ nāsti jñānasyāpi phalaṃ mahat | tasmātte munayaḥ sarva śaivārthe na viśāradāḥ || 198 ||
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ kriyā śaivī phalapradā | trayāṇāṃ brahmaṇādīnāṃ vedavidyāpracoditā || 199 ||
svargākhyaphalakāmāya agniṣṭomādike sadā | yajñe carūpuroḍāśapañcagavyādibhiḥ saha || 200 ||
śūdrādernādhikāro'tra vede ca pratiṣidhyate (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: na pratiśiṣyate) | śūdrādīnāṃ ca yo dadyādvedavidyāprasādhitam || 201 ||
haviṣyaṃ sa gururyāyāttaiḥ sārdhaṃ narakaṃ dhruvam | tasmācchaivo vidhiḥ prājñaiḥ śaivairmantraiḥprasādhitaḥ || 202 ||
śivādisthāpane yāge dīkṣāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | sarveṣāmapi varṇānāmanu grahakaraḥ paraḥ || 203 ||
lakṣakoṭi sahasrāṇi viṃśatirarbudāni ca | koṭikharvāvja vṛndaṃ ca mantrāstvīśādvinirgatāḥ || 204 ||
dvāsaptatisahasrāṇi koṭi lakṣaṃ tathārbudam | ayutāni ca pañcāśanmantrā vaktrā (g: rudrā) dviniḥsṛtāḥ || 205 ||
triṃśatkoṭisahasrāṇi (gh: viṃśat-) saptāṣṭakaśatāni ca | niyutāni ca ṣaṭtriśanmantrā rudrādvinirgatāḥ || 206 ||
navakoṭisahasrāṇi pañcāśītyayutāni ca | koṭiśatāni pañcāśanmantrā vāmādviniḥsṛtāḥ || 207 ||
saptakoṭisahasrāṇi saptatriṃśacchatāni ca | śataṃ sahasalakṣaṃ ca sadyojātādvinirgatāḥ || 208 ||
pañcavaktrodbhavairmantraiḥ śivoktaiḥ siddhimuktidaiḥ | taistu liṅgādi saṃsthāpyaṃ nānyairvedādicoditaiḥ || 209 ||
akārādikṣakārāntāḥ sadāśivāṅganirgatāḥ (mū, a, k, kh, g: śivādvinirgatāḥ) | taiḥ kṛtaṃ pañcadhā śāstraṃ śaivākhyaṃ siddhimuktidam || 210 ||
aṇimādimahāsiddhyai siddhyanti khecarādayaḥ | liṅgāśrayādyathāsiddhāḥ prāguktā vedhasādayaḥ | tathā vyāḍīndradantādyāḥ kambalā bhāskarā (kh: lābhāsthirā) dayaḥ | nimatsarā vadantyāśu (kh: drava) siddhāḥ (kh: śivāḥ) śavoktamantrataḥ || 212 ||
nāsatyamaiśvaraṃ vākyaṃ ke na siddhā yuge yuge | samyagvidhānattvajñairdīkṣito mucyate paśuḥ || 213 ||
sabījāḥ sasphurāḥ (kh: saphalāḥ) śaivāḥ saceto'gniśivāntagāḥ (mū, kh: sarvato - -ntakāḥ) | sarvānugrāhakā mantrāścaturvarga (k, g: caturdaśa) prasādhakāḥ || 214 ||
ṛgatharvatathā sāmavajuśceti krameṇa ca | prāgyāmyendujalāśāsyairlakṣagranthaiḥ kṛtā śrutiḥ || 215 ||
na vigrahātmakā (g: navagrahānmahā) devā vedeṣu stutipūrvakāḥ | siddhimuktī vinā sarvaṃ śabdamātraparā matāḥ || 216 ||
trayīnibandhahetvarthaṃ trayāṇāṃ ca vrate'dhvare | īśānoktā śrutiḥ paścāt svargākhyaphalasādhane || 217 ||
śaivāgamapurāṇeṣu tathā śāstrāntareṣu ca | avadhūtoktito'jñatvaṃ brahmaviṣṇornamadvaraḥ (kh: rasaṅgatam) || 218 ||
āstāṃ tavānyadapi tāvadatulyakakṣa- maiśvaryamīśvarapadasya nimittabhūtam | tvacceha so'pi bhagavannagato'vasānaṃ viṣṇuḥ pitāmahayutaḥ kimatāparasya || 219 ||
avairbramādibhirvedā kṛtāśceddoṣakāriṇaḥ | gonarāśvādikaṃ hatvā yajvanāṃ narako bhavet || 220 ||
sūryaśatāṃ (mū, a, kh, ṅ: ślokasyāsya prathamāntaḥ pāṭhaḥ pustakeṣu) tṛptimanādibodhaṃ svatantratāṃ nityamaluptaśaktim | anantaśakti ca vibhorviditvā (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: vidhijñā) prāhuḥṣaḍaṅgāni maheśvarasya || 221 ||
vedāḥ pramāṇāmaśoktāḥ svargaṃ (mū, a: vedaprāmāṇyamīśāttayā svargaḥ) sarvajñakāraṇam | īśvaraṃ kāraṇa nyāyādvadanti tarkavādinaḥ || 222 ||
bhedaḥ sāṅkhyā (k, g: sāndhyā) yanaścaika āślāyako (mū, a, k, kh, g: āśnīyako) dvitīyakaḥ | śatāniṃdaśa mantrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇo dvisahasrakaḥ || 223 ||
ṛgvado hi pramāṇena smṛtī dvaipāyanādibhiḥ | ekonedve sahasre ca mantrāṇāṃ yajuṣastathā || 224 ||
śatā ne daśa viprāṇāṃ ṣaḍaśītiśca śākhikāḥ | kāṇva (k, kh, gh: kārṇa) madhyandināsaṃjñā kaṭhī prācyakaṭhī tathā || 225 ||
maivāyaṇīyasaṃjñā ca taittirīyābhidhānikāḥ | vaijavāpa neketyādyāḥ śākhā yajuṣi saṃsthitāḥ || 226 ||
sāna kauthūma (gh: kaustuma) saṃjñaikā dvitīyā ca carāyaṇī (mū: dharāyaṇī) | gānānyapi ca catvāri veda āraṇyakastathā || 227 ||
ūha (k, kh, gh: ūhaṃ) ukha (k: ūpyaṃ) caturtha ca mantrā navasahasrakāḥ | santuḥ śatakāścai brahmaprabhavakāḥ (gh: haṭakāḥ) smṛtāḥ || 228 ||
pa~caviṃśatirevātra sāmno mānaṃ prakīrtitam | sumanturjājaliścaiva ślokāyanistathāparaḥ (gh: ślokādhyāya-) | śaunakaḥ pippalādaśca muñjakeśādayo'pare || 229 ||
ṛṣibhirbahubhistajjñaiḥ prokto'tharvasamuccayaḥ | mantrāṇā yutaṃ sāṣṭaśaṃtaṃ copari ṣaṭśatam (gh: copaniṣacchatama) || 230 ||
tasmātsvadaśanācāryairmantraḥ kāryastathādhvaraḥ (k: dhvajaḥ) | śivādīnāṃ prayatnena hyanyathā doṣadāyakāḥ || 231 ||
saugatārhatavedādimantrarvā sthāpite śive | rāṣṭrarājñobhaveddoṣaḥ (gh: rāṣṭra rājño bhave-) kartu kārayitustathā || 232 ||
dvijarājanyaviṭaśūdrāḥ śaivasaṃskāravarjitāḥ | nārakāste(kh: no rakṣiṇaḥ; gh: nārakinaḥ) samākhyātāḥ kartuḥ kulānvakārakāḥ || 233 ||
pustakādhyayanādeva liṅgādīn sthāpayeddvijaḥ | saṃkīrṇavṛttirvijñeyastvabhojyaḥ sarvadā budhaiḥ || 234 ||
uparodhātpramādādvā bhuktvā tatra śataṃ japet | bahurūpasya mantrasya nirdoṣo vai bhavettataḥ || 235 ||
sabalodyeṣa (mū, a, k: sacalo hyeva) vikhyāto nāmamātreṇa sa dvijaḥ | ācāryo gīyate loke na hyasau pāramārthikaḥ || 236 ||
dīkṣā (kh, gh: vyākhyā) sthāpanamantrādyairvartitastu pitāmahe | daiśikāstrividhā grāhyoḥprāguktā ye gurukramāt || 237 ||
deva (gh: deve) kartari nāśo (mū, a: vināśo) vābhogo vā yatpratiṣṭhite | śivatulyo'pi sa tyājyodagdhahasto (mū: grāhyo-) guruḥsa hi || 238 ||
śaivasaṃskārasaṃpannāḥśāstrajñāḥ sādhakottamāḥ | pratiṣṭheyuḥ surānsarvānabhāve daiśikasya tu || 239 ||
vinīto dharmavāndakṣo nirālasyo vimatsaraḥ | ṛjurlajjānvitaḥ sādhurjitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 240 ||
lakṣyalakṣaṇamānajño vāstukālādi vedakaḥ | sudṛṣṭiḥ (k, g: atṛṣṇiḥ) kulajo dhīmānnodvegī sūkta (gh: sūtra) tatparaḥ || 241 ||
patraṃ catuṣpadaṃ liṅgastambhaṃ piṇḍiṃ ca rūpakam | prāsādaṃ maṇḍapaṃ dvāraṃ vidyādyo (vindyādyo, liṃ pu. pā.) hi sa (g: hema) kārukaḥ || 242 ||
sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇāḥ śivasaṃskārasaṃyutāḥ | śivadharma (gh: karma) vidhānajñā mūrtipā daiśikādayaḥ || 243 ||
sahāyāḥ kulajā dhīrāḥ samarthā bhaktitatparāḥ | vinītā nipuṇā dakṣā gurorādeśavartinaḥ (k, kh: rājñānuvartinaḥ) || 244 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasārasamuccaye karturācāryādiparīkṣā nāma dvitīyo vidhiḥ] || 2 ||
[atha tṛtīyaḥ]
daiśikaiḥ śilpibhiḥ sārdhaṃ grāhyā ye taravaḥ śubhāḥ | śilā vā jāti (mū, a, k, g: rājābhi) bhedena adhunaiva nirūpyate (kh: nirūpyante'dhunocyate) || 1 ||
vanapuṣpākulā bhūryā vāruṇī sā bahūdakā | kāśmīrī prāci yāmye vā khadiro brahmavṛkṣakaḥ || 2 ||
yasyāmalikapotāhiśikhigṛdhrāmiṣāśinaḥ | antargata jalastokaṃ sāgneyī rūpato dharā (kh: parā) || 3 ||
brīhikṣetraṃ ca yāmye syātkṣīravṛkṣaśca paścime | saumye toyaṃ ca māhendrī pīlūddālasnuhīyutā (g: dvālastu saṃyutā) || 4 ||
śarkarārkadrumākīrṇā mṛgatṛṣṇānvitā ca yā | atṛṇāmbuśagālāḍhyā vāyavī sā mahī smṛtā || 5 ||
āsu bhūṣu (k, g: āgvavṛkṣa) kramājjātāḥ śilā vṛkṣāstadātmakāḥ | māhendrīvāruṇījātāḥ śastrāścānye ca garhitāḥ || 6 ||
spandano madhukaḥ śipro (k, kh, gh: sipro) rudrākṣo dhavacandane (k: nāgakeśaraḥ) | śamīdrākṣā surāhvaśca navaite vipraśāntidāḥ || 7 ||
śrīvṛkṣāragvadhāriṣṭaśirīṣāruṇacandanam | kadarā (kadaraḥ=śvetakhadiraḥ, iti vācaspatyam) śokaśākaṃ ca śṛṅgī (g: vṛkṣī) ca nṛpabhūtidā || 8 ||
śyāmābakulakāśmīrījambucampakaśiṃśapāḥ | saralaḥ panaso bīja ityete vaiśyavṛddhidāḥ || 9 ||
karṇikāro'rjuno nimbaḥ (k, kh, gh: hema) saptasāro'thai (gh: sāraśca) tindukaḥ | kāñcanāsana (kh: mara) lodhrāśca sāla śūdrasyapuṣṭidāḥ || 10 ||
grāhyāḥ snigdhā mahākāyāstvagrāhyāḥ patrasaṅkulāḥ | subhūsthāḥ (g: asvasthāḥ) śobhanā hṛdyā, ārogyā yauvanodvahāḥ || 11 ||
anye'pi śobhanā (kh: sānamā) vṛkṣā ghanāḥ kṣīrasamanvitāḥ | sāramadhyā draḍhīyāṃso nānyakāryeṣu yojitāḥ || 12 ||
saṃśliṣṭānsphuṭitān vakrān kṛmyādyān koṭarānvitān | granthitulyaśirāyuktān bṛddhabālāturāṃstarūn || 13 ||
śuṣkān vajrāgnidagdhāṃśca khagabhūtādisevitān | valmikotthāñśmaśānotthān phalāmbhaḥ sevitāṃstyajet || 14 ||
madhyāvāsānsvayaṃ pātānnadīma (mū, a: nadīdru) marutāhatān | kharitsaṅgamadevotthāṃstāpasāśramajāṃstyajet (mū, a, k: śrayajāṃ-) || 15 ||
avalāṃścālayedyastu prāsādān brā hāṇāndrumān (mū, a, k: kvacit) | acireṇaiva kālena cālako na bhavedasau || 16 ||
vidhimantropacāreṇa teṣāṃ chedanaścālane (mū, a: bhedana-) | devakārye na doṣaḥ syādityuktaṃ pārameśvare || 17 ||
dṛṣṭvā kulakṣaṇaṃ vṛddhi (k, kh, gh, m: vṛkṣa) kuryāttasyādhivāsanam | śodhayedbhūmibhāgaṃ tu caturdikṣu samantataḥ || 18 ||
dakṣiṇābharguruḥ (g: bhava) pūjyo vastraiḥ svarṇavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | tataḥ śilpipradhānāśca sahāyāḥkusumādibhiḥ || 19 ||
yadaivāmantrito vṛkṣaḥ kampate mānavīṃ vadet | viparīta tadā mantrī dūratastaṃ vivarjayet || 20 ||
kṣālayedvāriṇā vṛkṣa śilāṃ vātha manoramām | gomayena tato bhūmi lepayitvā gurustadā || 21 ||
kṛtāhnika śuvistatra brahmāṅgakṛtavigrahaḥ | dhyātvā devaṃ ca vijñāpya kṛtvācārghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ (k: kṛtvācāyaṃ vicakṣaṇam) || 22 ||
ātmapūjāṃ purā kṛtvā kuryāddigavalokanam | astraṃ dhyātvā yajenmantrī (kh: japen-) varmaṇā (mū: carmaṇā) pariveṣṭayet || 23 ||
bhūmiśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇe sthaṇḍile yajet | śiva saṃpūjya vahnistha navadyaṃ ḍhaukayeccarum || 24 ||
mantrasantarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ dadyācchivena tu | vijñāpya karmaśastrāṇi pūjayettarpayedapi (kh: darpaye) || 25 ||
diśamāśritya kauverī vāyavīṃ vā samāhitaḥ | tato vijñāpya deveśa kuryādālaṃbhanaṃ punaḥ (gh: kṛtvācālaṃbhanaṃ purā) || 26 ||
tajjātīśena kumbhaiśca caturbhiḥ snāpayedapi | tāḍanaṃ bhasmanāstreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ śivavāriṇā || 27 ||
lekhanaṃ cāstradarbheṇa varmaṇā (mū, a: carmaṇā) parirakṣaṇam | vastraṃ trisūtraṃ vṛkṣasya śilāyāśca kuśānvitam || 28 ||
jñātvā śubhanimittāni (k, g: śubhāni siddhāni) yajetātha gurustarum | saṃhitoktena mantreṇasnānavastrādikaṃ bhavet || 29 ||
gandhena puṣpadhūpābhyāṃ naivedyaiḥ pūjayeddrumam | dadyād baliṃ ca māṣānnairāmiṣāsavasaṃyutaiḥ || 30 ||
aindrāgāre'tha hotavya rudrasyādraṣṭottaraṃ (vṛkṣasyā-) śatam | arghaṃ datvā ca vṛkṣasya (mū, a: rudrasya) mantra saṃśrāvyakaṃ vadet || 31 ||
oṃ (praṇavotu yaṃ, mūla, a, kh pustakeṣu nāsti) śrīniketa namastubhyaṃ devajuṣṭavanaspate | saṅkramānyaditaḥ sthānādguṇavadyanmanoharam || 32 ||
oṃ śrī(/) hrī vauṣaṭ || iti saṃśrāvyamantraḥ ||
pūrṇāhutiṃ śivenaiva tato dadyādbahirbalim | yo yasmin (mū, a, k, g: yatra) vihito mantraḥ śāstre syādbalikarmaṇi || 33 ||
sa eva balimantraḥ syāt (mū, a, k, g: vihito mantraḥ) svanāmapraṇavo'thavā | sthāne'smin yāni bhūtāni piśācā rākṣasāśca ye || 34 ||
siddhāvidyādharā nāgā devāścaiva sadānavāḥ | tāṃstu saṃpūjya vidhivatpriyavākyaiḥ pratoṣayet || 35 ||
śivaliṅgārthamasmākaṃ yātrā caiṣā (a: yaiṣā) śivājñayā | śivārthaṃ yadbhavetkāryaṃ yuṣmākamapi tadbhavet || 36 ||
anena balidānena prītā bhavata sarvadā | sukhena gacchatānyatra muktvā sthānamidaṃ drumam || 37 ||
tataścācamya vidhivatsakalī (kh: saphalī) kṛtavigrahaḥ | śivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatsvapnamāṇavakaṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g: vijñāpya-) japet || 38 ||
caruṃ prāśya svapettatra kuśatalpeṣuyājñikaḥ (gh: talpe tu yājñike) | svapnamāṇavakaṃ rātrau śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet || 39 ||
oṃ namo jaya trinetrāya piṅgalāya mahātmane | vāmāya viśvarūpāya (1) svapnādhipataye namaḥ || 40 ||
svapne kathaya me tathyaṃ sarvakāryeṣvaśeṣataḥ | kriyāsiddhiṃ vidhāsyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 41 ||
oṃ hili (2) mātaṅgin maheśvara (maheśvara iti pāṭhaḥ kh, gh pustakayornāsti) śūlapāṇe duḥsvapnaṃ hana (2) śubhaṃ darśaya (2) hu(/) phaṭ svāhā ||
iti svapnamāṇavakamantraḥ |
nirdhūmaṃ jvalitaṃ (k: phalitaṃ) vakṣaṃ puṣpitaṃ phalitaṃ (k: jvalitaṃ; kh: haritaṃ) śriyā | rudreṇa cānvitaṃ svapne dṛṣṭvā vācyaṃ śubhaṃ sadā || 42 ||
sicyamānaṃ tu raktena rakṣobhūtayutaṃ tathā | kapyuṣṭrairbhakṣamāṇaṃ vā taṃ tyajedaśubha (k: jeccāśubha) pradam || 43 ||
na śakyate yadā tyaktuṃ lakṣaṇāḍhyaṃ suśobhanam | juhuyācca tadā snātvāghoraṃ doṣanivṛttaye || 44 ||
ūrdhvaṃ vanaspatermūrdhā syādadhaḥ pādakalpanā | aindre saumye tatheśāne avyaktādimukhaṃ kramāt || 45 ||
īśāśāyāṃ drumaṃ hanyāt siddhādyaistajjapakriyā (mū: jayakriyaḥ) | kṣaudrājyābhyaktaśastreṇa ghorāstreṇābhimantrya ca || 46 ||
ātmānaṃ śivavaddhyātvā śastraṃ caivāstrarūpiṇam | ācāryaḥ prathamaṃ hanyācchivāstraṃ saṃjapaṃstataḥ || 47 ||
paścāt sunipuṇaḥ (mū: nipuṇaṃ) śilpī karma kuryādyathoditam | vārkṣa (g: karka) mantrāntadikkaṃ (?) (g: didaṃ) vai ghaṭayelliṅgamādarāt (k, g: tadanukramāt) || 48 ||
indreśānaśaśāṅkāśā bhūtidāḥ patatastaroḥ | saṃchindyātpatitaṃ (mū, a: saṃcintyāt-) vṛkṣamajātenaiva (k, c: jātenaiva; g: mathatenaiva) bhaktimān || 49 ||
raktakṛṣṇaṃ varaṃ (kh: kṛṣṇāṃbaraṃ) sāraṃ madhyamaṃ pītaraktakam (g: vattarum) | gṛhṇīyāddāru liṅgārthaṃ tyajedāpāṇḍaraṃ laghu || 50 ||
yadyathā vṛkṣapārśvaṃ (k, g: pārśvavṛkṣaṃ) tu tattathaiva pratiṣṭhayet | sthāpitaṃ viparītaṃ tu rāṣṭravibhramamādiśet || 51 ||
vakṣasyordhvaṃ śiro jñeyamadhomūlaṃ sukhāvaham | adhaḥ śiro yadā liṅgaṃ tadā gotrakṣayo bhavet || 52 ||
prapāto'nyadiśobhāge vṛkṣasya na sukhāvahaḥ | tato digdevatāśāntiṃ kuryāddoṣavimuktaye || 53 ||
pāśupatena śāstreṇa hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam | anyadikpātadoṣeṇa mucyate śāntimāpnuyāt || 54 ||
itthaṃ dikśodhanaṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ saṃpūjya tarpayet | dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ cāpi tataḥ kāmānavāpnuyāt || 55 ||
pramādādyadi vṛkṣasya chedane rudhiraṃ sravet | patane madhyabhaṅgaḥ syāttadā homo vidhīyate || 56 ||
ājyāhutisahasraṃ vai bahurūpeṇa homayet | dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ cāpi śivenāśivahāriṇā || 57 ||
juhuyāddurnimitte tu ghoramantraṃ śataṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: ca ghoramantreṇa taṃ) śubham | śilādāne tathā pūjā dārvādāne yathoditā || 58 ||
śilāḥ sampratyahaṃ vacmi yuvādistryāditastridhā | dvijādivarṇabhedena rūpabhedena ca sthitāḥ || 59 ||
dvātriṃśallakṣaṇā hyaṣṭā (kh: jyeṣṭhā) śītidoṣavivarjitāḥ | yuvatī sā śilā grāhyā triṣu liṅgeṣu netarāḥ || 60 ||
dharmāyurdhanabhūnāthaprajārāṣṭra (kh: prajānāṃ sva) kulasya ca | vṛddhiṃ dadyācchilā nūnaṃ taruṇī lakṣaṇānvitā || 61 ||
ākarau dvau tu vijñeyau vanopavanasaṃjñakau | trayo'ṅkurā diśastisro gandhāsvādau (mū: gandhasvādau) caturvirdhā || 62 ||
rekha nava trayaḥ (mū, a: navāstraya; k, kh: navādhvayaṃ) śabdāścatasro jātayastathā | tāruṇamekamityevaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāni tu || 63 ||
vistīrṇā mahatī sthūlā samādīrghaikavarṇinī | snigdhānimnā śilā dhanyā siktā puṇyanadījalaiḥ || 64 ||
kulādrijā ca bhūguptā bhṛśaṃ gambhīraśabdakṛt | sugandhī niviḍāṅgī ca dramacchāyāsthitā sadā || 65 ||
arogā garbhahīnā ca rekhā kīlakavarjitā | dṛḍhā manoramā gurvī madhuradhvanibhūṣitā || 66 ||
guḍābhayāmranimbānāmāsvādena dvijāditaḥ | krameṇābjājyagovarvo (mū, a, gh: gocarvī) mūtragandhāḥ śubhāḥśilāḥ || 67 ||
meghavīṇāravā ghaṇṭāśaṅkhaśabdāḥ śilā varāḥ | śāntiṃ jayaṃ dhanaṃ cāyuścāturvarṇye prayacchati || 68 ||
puṇyatīrthāśritā sādhvī suniṣecyā (k, kh, g, gh: sevyā) suśītalā | sutejā rūpasaṃpannā dhanadeśendra (kh: śendru) dik sthitā || 69 ||
pāṇḍarābjopamā śvetā kumudābhā śilā dvijā | nakṣatraṃ ca mṛgaṃ tasyāstaddevaḥ śaśalāñchanaḥ || 70 ||
kulatthābhāruṇāśyāmā hyutpalā (a, k, kh: yā syādutpalā) bhā ca sā nṛpā | asyā ṛkṣaṃ bhavejjyeṣṭhā devatā ca śatakratu || 71 ||
haritpītā kapotābhā guḍābhā kapilā ca vit | nakṣatraṃ phalgunī cāsyā devaśca (mū: devatā) bhagasaṃjñakaḥ || 72 ||
māṣapārāvatābhā yā kṛṣṇā śūdreti sā smṛtā | nakṣatramaśvinau (mū, a: maśvinī) cāsyā devau caivāśvinau (gh: dvau cāśvinau) matau (mū: smṛtau) || 73 ||
ghanā ca susvanā (mū, a, k: susvarā) snigdhā viśālā bahalacchaviḥ | śītalā ca sukhasparśā niviḍāṅgī manoramā || 74 ||
kadalīdalatulyā strīśilā strīṇāṃ sukhārthadā | ekavarṇaḥsthiraḥsnigdho gajakaṇṭho (kh: ghaṇṭo) pamasvanaḥ || 75 ||
vahalo vṛttadīrghaśca vaṭapatranibhacchaviḥ | pāṣāṇo'ya guru pumān puruṣāṇāṃvibhūtidaḥ || 76 ||
napuṃsakaṃ dvirūpaṃ syānnapuṃsakavivṛddhikṛt | striyā strīpratimā kāryā ṣaṇḍhaṃ ṣaṇḍhena nā nṛbhiḥ || 77 ||
bhagnakāṃsyasvaraṃ rūkṣaṃ gairikākhaṭikopamam | śirāḍhyaṃ karkaśaṃ tva rju (k: varja; kh: vakṣya; g: tvajjā) idamaśma napuṃsakam || 78 ||
puṃliṅgalakṣaṇopetaḥ pāṣāṇaḥśivakarmasu | śeṣāṇāṃ strīśilāḥ proktāḥ pīṭhikādyāśca (g: yāśca) śūlinaḥ || 79 ||
kṛṣṇe sitāṅkarāḥ śrīdāḥ pītāśmani ca lohitāḥ | sarvavarṇātmake śvetāḥśeṣāśca śubhadāḥ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: stvaśubhadā) smṛtāḥ || 80 ||
śvetāḥ padmopamā rekhā dvijātīnāṃ vivṛddhidāḥ (mū: -ddhikṛt) | raktā pītā ca bhūpasya viśaḥ śyāmakulatthabhāḥ || 81 ||
śūdrāṇāṃ haritāḥkṛṣṇāḥ svavarṇā (mū, a, k: suvarṇa) dadhikāśca yāḥ | indracāpopamārekhāḥ sarvāśrīvasubhūtidāḥ || 82 ||
hīnarekhottamā hīnā hīnarekhottamā śubhā | lakṣaṇāḍhyālpadoṣā yā grāhyā sā homaśodhitā (kh: śobhitā) || 83 ||
hṛnmantreṇāṅkayeddikṣu sadyomantreṇa coddharet | indreśānendukāṣṭhāsu tasyā mastakamiṣyate || 84 ||
tadūrdhvādho yathā saṅkhyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ vaktraṃ ca lakṣayet | trividheṣvapi liṅgeṣu śilāyāṃ nāparo vidhiḥ || 85 ||
digādijātiparyantaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇāḥ śilāḥ | doṣān vṛddhādikān brūmaścāṣṭāśītiprabhedataḥ || 86 ||
vṛddhabālakabimbāni chidrakīlakasandhayaḥ | śūṣiraṃ sphoṭakaṃ (kh, gh: sphāṭikaṃ) vyomaṃ gārā (kh: galā) paṭalajālakam || 87 ||
dvādaśaite mahādoṣāḥ sarvasthāneṣu varjitāḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmyeṣāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa prabhedataḥ || 88 ||
yā sarpabhekamīnāṅkaiścitratā (mū, a, g: mīnāṅgai-) cātikarkaśā | niṣṭhurā cātirūkṣā ca vṛddhā kāryavināśinī || 89 ||
tanvī mṛdvī ca bālā syādīṣaddagdheṣṭakopamā | ṭaṅkaghātāsahiṣṇuñca na tāṃ devāya yojayet || 90 ||
maṇḍalājjāyate garbho garbhāddoṣo'vagamyate | tasmādbimbātmakaṃ cāśma saṃchindyāddāru vai tathā || 91 ||
sāndrāṇi sarvadṛśyāni daśāṣṭau maṇḍalāni ca | saptānyāni ca citrāṇi caturdhā lepanaṃ tathā || 92 ||
pāṇḍaraṃ guḍakhaṇḍābhaṃ māñjiṣṭhaṃ raktapītakam | kāpilaṃ haritālābhaṃ kāpotamalivarṇakam (kh, gh: mallikādhautavarṇakam) || 93 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ nīlaṃ ca madhvābhaṃ cāṣābhaṃ (mū, a, k: vāsābhaṃ) bhasmarūpakam | kiṃśukābhaṃ kusumbhābhamatasīpuṣpasannibham || 94 ||
śuddhāṣṭādaśabimbāni saptacitrāṇyatho bruve | campakābhaṃ ca nīlābhaṃ miśralohitapītakam || 95 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ (kh: kṛtsnaṃ) nānāvidhaṃ citraṃ yā (mū, a: cānyadā) spadaṃ śīmikā (mū: śīvikā) tathā | raktaṃ (kh: rūkṣaṃ) ca pāṇḍaraṃ caiva garbhadoṣān vadāmyata (kh: myaham) || 96 ||
matsyaḥ pāṇḍarake bimbe mriyante'jāvikāstataḥ | guḍavarṇe śilānyā syāttenāvṛṣṭirbhavecciram || 97 ||
khaḍgābhe (mū: khaṇḍābhe) sphāṭike vāpi (gh: vāyo) garbhahṛtsvāmihṛcca tat | mañjiṣṭhābhe bhavedbhekaḥ śasyanāśo jalādbhayam || 98 ||
lohite kṛkalāsaḥ syāt sakuṣṭhadhanahānikṛt | pīte godhā nṛpaṃ hanyāṅṭavāṃ pīḍākarī ca sā || 99 ||
ākhuḥkapile śotha (kh: so'tha) śvāsataskarabhītikṛt (gh: bhītidaḥ) | tālābhe karkaṭaḥpittarogadarbhikṣakṛcca saḥ || 100 ||
bhṛṅgābhe ca viṣaṃ tacca viṣako'pi na vṛṣṭikṛt | jyeṣṭhā kapotakaṇṭhābhe vyādhidāridryabhītidā || 101 ||
kṛṣṇe'hiḥ sa prajā hanti kartuśca kulanāśakṛt (mū, a, k, g, ṅ: nāśanaḥ) | nīlake makṣikā sā ca hanyādbhāryāṃ saputrakām (kh: saputrikām) || 102 ||
khadyotaḥ kṣaudravarṇe syāt sa dāridryāgnibhītidaḥ | nṛpakṣī cāṣavarṇe syāttena kartuḥprajākṣayaḥ || 103 ||
bhasmābhe vālukāḥ khaṃ vā naiḥsvaṃ caurabhayaṃ tataḥ | kiṃśuke śakragopaḥ syāttena rājño dhanakṣayaḥ || 104 ||
śatapādī kusumbhābhe bhavettenāmayo mahān | atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśe garbhe vidyāt pipīlikā || 105 ||
tayā cintā bhaya śokaḥ śatruvṛddhiśca jāyate | ityaṣṭādaśa bimbāni kathitānyatra saṃkhyayā || 106 ||
guḍavarṇātmake bimbe citrite campakābhayā | bhaveyuḥ kṛmayo garbhe nāśo dehārthayostataḥ || 107 ||
nīlacitre bhavetkāko gṛdhro (k: mṛgo) vātha kapotakaḥ | tena rājā ca mantrī ca kārako mriyate kramāt || 108 ||
madhvābhe śavale citrī tayā śasyadhanakṣayaḥ | raktacitre ca śṛṅgī syāttayā śokabhayaṃ muhuḥ (gh: śokakaraṃ bahu) || 109 ||
pītacitre pataṅgaḥ syāt sa vai (gh: sarva) svasthānahānidaḥ | kṛṣṇacitre ca gonāśaḥ so'nekavyādhikāraka || 110 ||
vṛściko bahucitresyācchūlarugviṣabhīṃtidaḥ (g: -syādgala-; gh: -sacchūla-) | saptaitāni tu citrāṇi jñeyāni bāhyalakṣaṇaiḥ || 111 ||
bāhyādyadyupa(mū: dyanupa; g: dyastyupa) labdhirno tadā bhrāntaḥ pralepayet | caturvikārabhedena garbhaṃ vidyātpralepataḥ || 112 ||
brahmāṇaṃ karavīraṃ ca ṛddhivṛddhisamanvitam | saurāṣṭrī tālasaṃyuktaṃ (kh: kalasaṃyuktaiḥ) sauvīreṇa (mū, a: saurīreṇa) ca peṣayet (gh: pāvayet) || 113 ||
tena liptā sthitā (mū: sitā) rātrau vāṣpasvedādisaṃyutāḥ | bhṛṅgāhī kṛṣṇamatsyaṃ vā jñātvā tā doṣadāstyajet || 114 ||
triphalāśvaghnamāṃsī ca meghakuṣṭha (k: murata) samanvitāḥ | piṣṭavaivaṃ samabhāgaṃ tu nārī kṣīreṇa lepayet || 115 ||
lepācchimiśimāṃ jñātvā (mū: śilāṃ jñātvā; kh: cchimāṃ japtvā) garbhe vidyānmahāviṣam | tena karturbhavenmṛtyustasmāttāṃ salile kṣipet || 116 ||
kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ pralipyāśma kārīṣaviṣagairikaiḥ | ahorātroṣite raktaṃ tyājyamūrmānvitaṃ ca yat (kh: kurmānvitaṃ yataḥ) || 117 ||
piśācāśvaghnavajrāṇi abhayā vaiṣṇavāṅkitāḥ | tīkṣṇaṃ rudrajaṭāyuktamavikṣīraiḥ prapeṣya ca || 118 ||
liptā śiloṣitā paścātpāṇḍarādi pradarśayet | dvayordvirūpakaṃ garbhe jñātvā prāgdoṣadāṃstyajet || 119 ||
chidraṃ cobhayaśchidraṃ (gh: śchidraiḥ) randhrākāraṃ bahirgatam | kartustatkulahṛnnūnaṃ gurordadyātkṣayāmayam || 120 ||
kīlakaṃ kīlakākāraṃ kāroḥ kartuśca nāśakṛt | ṭaṅkāghātādbhidākārī (kh: tādbhayā; mū: tābhidhā) sandhiḥ kartṛvināśakaḥ (mū, a: karturvināśakṛt) || 121 ||
śuṣiraṃ śuṣirākāraṃ kartustadvaṃśanāśakam (mū: kṛt) | sphoṭaṃ (gh: sphāṭaṃ) sphuṭitakaṃ vidyācchastraghātāntadāyakam || 122 ||
sūkṣmagarbhai (mū: garte) rasaṅkhyātaiḥ paritaḥpariveṣṭitaḥ | vyomākāro bhavedvyoma so'cirātkartṛnāśakaḥ || 123 ||
(cāpāntargato'yaṃ pāṭho mūlapustake nāsti) sphaṭikābhā bhavedgārā (k, kh: ddārā) taṅkabhaṅgakarī ca sā | tayā kartṛprajānāśaḥ śīghrameva na saṃśayaḥ || 124 ||
bhūrjatbagupamo'śmā (mū, a, g: moṣmā) yaḥpaṭalīti sa kīrtitaḥ | tena kuryānna liṅgāni kṛte ca dvau vinaśyataḥ || 125 ||
jālakaṃ ṣaṭprakāraṃ syānmadhukoṣapuṭomam | pītaṃ sitaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ nīlaṃ ca miśrakam || 126 ||
nāśaino bandhadaścaiva bhāryāputrārthahṛtkramāt | navatyardhaṃ mahādoṣā bhedabhinno iti smṛtāḥ || 127 ||
madhyadoṣān pravakṣyāmi nāmnā ṣoḍaśadhā sthitān | brahmopendravibhāgasthāṃstridhā liṅgeṣvadoṣadān (mū: liṅgeṣu doṣadān) || 128 ||
rudrabhāgāśritān duṣṭāṃstyajettānaśubhapradān | śirā (śirāśabdo'yaṃ tālavyo dantyaścetyūṣmabhede) granthituṣāraiśca vimalaṃ dadu bindubhiḥ || 129 ||
chinnarekhā kurekhā ca makṣikāvarta (gh: varti) hīrakau (k, kh: hīrakaiḥ; gh: hīnakaiḥ) | viḍālāśvoṣṭragomāyukākapādāṅkitāṃstyajet || 130 ||
yā vivarṇalatākārā sā śilā bahudoṣadā | granthirūponnatagranthirjaṭharāmayadāyaka || 131 ||
padmapatrasthapānīyakaṇikāsadṛśaṃ tu yat | tuṣāraṃ tadvijānīyā putraśokārtidāyakam (kh, gh: kārakam) || 132 ||
caturdhā vai malaṃrūpa mīnagandhopalakṣitam | hemaghoṣāmayaṃ tāmra tadduṣṭaṃ piṅgalāmate || 133 ||
durbhikṣāvṛṣṭidaṃ haimaṃ ghoṣaṃ kartṛvināśakam (kh, gh: śadam) | janaṃ hantyāyasākrāntā śilā tāmī ca (gh: tāmrācca) śilpinam || 134 ||
mṛdī vṛttā ca dhūmrābhā dadruḥ syādatirogadā | kṛṣṇaḥ pīto'ruṇo binduḥ sa śokabhayarogadaḥ || 135 ||
mūrdhni bindau site mṛtyūrakte pāpa bhaveddhruvam | pīte dhanakṣayaḥ kartuḥ kṛṣṇe bandho dvayordvidhā || 136 ||
sthūlātidurbalā rūkṣā rekhāhikuṭilā ca yā | rekhā rekhānubiddhā vā (mū, a, k: ca) pārthivaṃ sā vināśayet || 137 ||
bhāryāghnī chinnarekhā syād dvitricchinnā sutārthahṛt | svāmidhnī ca catuśchinnā bahucchinnā kulāntakṛt || 138 ||
dhūmrāṃ nīlāsitā rekhā duḥkhadurbhikṣarogakṛt | makṣikā makṣikākārā tayā kuṣṭhaṃ sudāruṇam || 139 ||
āvartaṃ iva cāvarto rudradeśe tu (kh: raṃśeṣu) cetsthitaḥ (mū, a: cotthita) | tadā nānā gadān kuryāt kartuścaiva na saṃśayaḥ || 140 ||
nānā sthāneṣu vāmāṅga āvarto yadi dṛśyate | tyājyaṃ tadā tridhā liṅgaṃ nṛparāṣṭraprajārthinā || 141 ||
lakṣaṇasya tu madhyastha āvarto yadi dṛśyate (kh, gh: jāyate) | vāmapārśvāśritaḥ kiṃciddhanyādrāṣṭraṃ sarājakam || 142 ||
raktāṅgī pītahīrā (gh: hīnā) yā sā durbhikṣagadapradā (gh: bhayapradā) | sarvavarṇā bhṛśaṃ (kh, gh: daśa) nūnaṃ prāṇahṛtkṛṣṇahīrikā || 143 ||
caturbhiḥ sandhibhiryuktā (mū: pañcabhi-; gh: -muktā) nakhaiḥ pañcabhiragrataḥ | unnato lakṣyate yaśca (mū: yatra) viḍālāṅghriḥ sa doṣabhāk (kh: kṛt) || 144 ||
hayoṣṭrajambukadhvāṅkṣapadakākrāntapaṅkavat | śilāyā rūpamālakṣya tyajettāmaśubhapradām || 145 ||
madhyadoṣāstrayoviṃśadbhedairuktā ime mayā | svalpadoṣān prakṣyāmi yathā śāstreṣu bhāṣitān || 146 ||
tyājyā śilānyasaṃśliṣṭā śliṣṭā yā pādapāṅghriṇā | valmīkoṣaracityutthā koṣṇā kṣārāmbumadhyagā || 147 ||
apuṇyakṣetrasaṃjātā bhillādijanasevitā | kudiksthā sūryasantaptā kadutthāmethyadūṣitā (k, g: bhūṣitā) || 148 ||
kugandhā kurasā caiva tathā vajrāgnidūṣitā | duṣṭajīvasvarā yā ca yojitā nānyakarmaṇi || 149 ||
cāṇḍālī cāntyajā caiva āsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate | yā yopalānulagnā sā snehavicchittikārikāḥ (mū, a: kāraṇam) || 150 ||
adhvadā tarumūlasthā valmīkasthā raṇapradā | ūṣarasthārthahṛjjñeyā citisthā duḥkhadāyinī || 151 ||
koṣṇā vidveṣakṛtkṣāra (k, g: vora) vāristhā darbhagatvadā (k, g: durbhagaṃ dadā) | pāṣadāpuṇyadeśasthā vadhakṛdbhilla (kh: liṅga) sevitā || 152 ||
hutāśayamarakṣo'mbumaruddiksthā yathākramam | dāhaṃ hāniṃ ca śokaṃ ca naiḥsvaṃ rogaṃ tathāvahet || 153 ||
tejohṛtsūyataptā syādaputrādharmakṛtsadā (gh: putrāddhūtāhṛtsadā) | surāpakṣivasāgandhā udvegajananī śilā || 154 ||
lavaṇā kaṭukā yā ca sā kṣadhātṛptikāriṇī | vajradagdhāgnidagdhā ca rājño'nalabhayapradā || 155 ||
bhinnabhāṇḍoṣṭra (k: bhāṇḍaja) kākahva (mū: kākāṅga) kaṅkapādātirogadā (gh: kaṅkaṇā-) | anyakarmārthamānītonmādāniṣpattikāriṇī || 156 ||
nistejā bahu (ga: baka) baṇā yā laghuravyaktavarṇinī | antyajā sā śilā jñeyā dvijādīnāṃ vigarhitā (gh: tu garhitā) || 157 ||
dhūmrā (kh: pūjyā) nīlā ca rakṣā yā sthūlaromā manoramā | nāna varṇā ca cāṇḍalī sā kartuḥ (kh: māna) kulanāśinī || 158 ||
laghudoṣānvitā grāhyā mantrasaṃskārasaskṛtā | prākṛtānāṃ hitārthāya kāmaṃ muktyarthināṃ nṛṇām || 159 ||
antyajā cāntyajānāṃ tu cāṇḍālānāṃ hitāvahā (mū, a, gh: svakā) | svalpadoṣā ime khyātā viṃśatirlakṣabhedataḥ || 160 ||
varṇajātivayo rekhā lāñchanāni ca maṇḍalam | (copāntargato'yaṃ, k, kh, g pustakeṣu nāsti) jñaya sadbhūmibhūtasya pāṣāṇasya drumasya ca || 161 ||
alpavarṇā śilā yā syādanyavarṇasya kalpyate |) tajja tīśena mantreṇa tajjātijananaṃ bhavet || 162 ||
yathābhimatamānena liṅgādyarthaṃ śilāṃ drumam | lāñcha yatvā yathānyāyaṃ kartayecchodhayedapi || 163 ||
yadvarṇaṃ yanmayaṃ liṅgaṃ tanmayaṃ pīṭhamiṣyate | piṇḍikāsahitaṃ tacca viṣṇubhāgāntamunnatam || 164 ||
liṅgāyāmena vistīrṇaṃ vartulābhi (mū, a, k, ṅ: vartanābhi) ralaṅkṛtam | ekakhaṇḍaiva kartavyā piṇḍikā vai śivasya tu || 165 ||
brahmapīṭhaṃ bahudalaṃ (k, g: ca sadalaṃ) kāryamekadalaṃ tathā | praṇālamaindrasaumye vā jalādhāramadhastathā || 166 ||
lāñchayitvā śilāmādau piṇḍikārthaṃ samāharet | anyakṣetrādapi grāhyā piṇḍikā liṅgavarṇikā | na tu brahmaśilā prājñairiti śāstreṣu (k, g: tantreṣu) bhāṣitam || 167 ||
liṅgamūlāvaśiṣṭā tu grāhyā brahmaśilā śubhā | liṅgachedordhvabhāgasthā tathādho (mū, a, k: tadadho) bhāgagāpi vā || 168 ||
liṅgasya sā tribhāgena caturthāṃśena vā bhavet | ucchrāyena tu liṅgānāmekakhaṇḍo vidhīyate || 169 ||
hastamātrasya liṅgasya niḥsārā dvyaṅgulādhikā | anyeṣāmapi liṅgānāṃ krameṇaikāṅgulādhilā (gh: -ṇaiva-) || 170 ||
yadvā karṇāyataṃ sūtraṃ brahmabhāgasya madhyataḥ | taccaturthena bhāgena liṅgavistarato'dhikā | athavā sā rāsāṃśena brahmāṃśo (mū, a, k, g: ca sāṃśena brahmaṇo) 'dhikavistarā | (cāpāntargatoyaṃ pāṭhaḥ k, g pustakayornāsti) svamānānmekhalā tasyāḥ khātaṃ vā tatpramāṇataḥ || 171 ||
padabhāgo'pi tulyaśca svatalaśca praśasyate | brahmāṃśādadhikaḥ (gh: brahmāṅgā-) khāto yavai ṣaḍbhiḥ pravistaraḥ || 173 ||
jyeṣṭho'rdhārdhayavairnyūnāstadanyeṣāṃ krameṇa tu | ratnādhārāṇi tanmadhye vṛttāni nava (mū: na ca) kalpayet || 174 ||
kāryā kūrmaśilā cāpi (mū: vāpi) śuddhā brahmaśilāpi vā (gh: -dhikā) |) svamānavistarārdhena bāhulyena samanvitā || 175 ||
api mānādhikā kāryā na mānāddhrāsayedabudhaḥ | vārkṣī brahmaśilā vārkṣe liṅge syātpiṇḍikā tathā || 176 ||
caturasrāṃ śilāṃ kṛtvā candanena vilepya ca | arcayedastra (gh: cchatra) puṣpādyairānetuṃ mantravittamaḥ || 177 ||
pūjayecca śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ tarpayecca prayatnataḥ | tāpasāñchivabhaktāṃśca tarpayitvānayedratham || 178 ||
taṃ rathaṃ mahiṣāñjyeṣṭhān yojayitvā ca daiśikaḥ | rathe kṛtvā ca deveśaṃ pūjayitvā tamānayet || 179 ||
śāntirdinedine kāryā yāvatprāptaṃ gṛhaṃ bhavet | yadā rathe rathāṅgānāṃ (mū: ratharathāṅgānāṃ) pramādātskhalitaṃ bhavet || 180 ||
śivāgniṃ janayitvā tu tarpayedbahurūpiṇam | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā mucyate sarvaduṣkṛtaiḥ || 181 ||
śivaṃ dhyātvā smaredastramardhaṃ liṅge samutkṣipet | rathaṃ mārgagataṃ kṛtvā śanaiḥ svapuramānayet || 182 ||
samīpaṃ yajamānastu pratyudgamya (k, kh: pratyaṅgasya) samarcayet | śobhāṃ dhvajapatākādyaiḥ strībhirmaṅgalagītakaiḥ || 183 ||
kārayitvā dvijān svastivācayitvā tamānayet | prāsādasyottare pārśve karmakuryānnivedayet || 184 ||
prāsādottaradigbhāge kanyasādivibhāgataḥ | pañcasaptaikādaśabhiḥ karaiḥ karmakuṭī matā || 185 ||
anyadiksaṃsthitā bhadrā gṛhītā vidhinā śilā | prāsādottaradiggarte kṣiptvā tāṃ pūrayenmṛdā || 186 ||
tasyopari śivaṃ ceṣṭvā vāruṇyāṃ diśi saṃsthitaḥ | tarpayedastrarājaṃ ca mahāpāśupataṃ ca yat || 187 ||
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥ | evaṃ santarpite hyastre (k, g: jyeṣṭhe) digdoṣairmucyate śilā || 188 ||
ākṛṣṭasyāpi (mū, a: ākṛṣṇāṃ-) yasyārthaṃ jñāyate na śiromukham | tasya liṅgasya sadvipraḥ kanyā śilpī ca pūjitā || 189 ||
eko'pi yadviśedaṅgaṃ (mū: yaddiśe-) spṛṣṭvā tacca śiromukham | dhruvaṃ kartavyamityāha bhagavān parameśvaraḥ || 190 ||
anyakarmopayuktā ca saṃskṛtā yena kenacit | śilāṃ tāṃ varjayedyatnānnaśastā liṅgakarmaṇi || 191 ||
piṇḍikādidalaṃ sarva vṛṣabhaṃ ca yathāvidhi | evaṃ dārumayaṃ cāpi (mū, a, k, kh: vāpi) liṅgādidravyamānayet || 192 ||
lakṣaṇāḍhyālpadoṣāyāḥ saṃskāre kathyate vidhiḥ | prāguktareśakāṣṭhāsu śilāṃ nyasya kvacinmate || 193 ||
ghoramantraśataṃ (mū, a, kh, ṅ: mantreṇa) hutvā ṣaḍaṅgāntaṃ yajeddharam | athavā mṛtyujetāraṃ vidyāṅgaiḥ (g: vidyāhvaiḥ) ṣaḍbhiranvitam || 194 ||
itthaṃ muñcantyamī doṣāḥ śirovaktrādimauḍhyajāḥ | ityanena vidhānena gṛhītvā dāru vāśma (k, kh: raśma) vā || 195 ||
śobhane divase samyaṅmaṅgale sakale kṛte | liṅgaṃ gurvājñyā kuryāttridhā mānopalakṣitam || 196 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye dāruśilāgrahaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyo vidhiḥ] || 3 ||
[atha caturthaḥ]
liṅgamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi caturbhedātmakaṃ bhavet | caturaṅgulamānena (mū, a, kh, g, gh, ṅ: calamaṅgula-) dvāragarbhakaraiḥ sthitam || 1 ||
bhānūsrairjālagairaṣṭa (mū, a, k, kh: bhānūsre jālage'ṣṭābhī) reṇubhiḥ syādaṇurbhṛśam | keśāgralikṣāyūkābhyāṃ (mū: yūkānāṃ) kramādaṣṭāṣṭabhiryavaḥ || 2 ||
tuṣahīnairyavaiḥ śreṣṭhairmṛdi sikthe'thavā sthitaiḥ | tiryak samodaraiḥ proktaṃ mānārthaṃ pārameśvare || 3 ||
yavairaṣṭarṣiṣaṭsaṃkhyairjyeṣṭādi tryaṅgulaṃ bhavet | kalāgolakanetrāṅka (gh: netrāhva) mātrābhirdvyaṅgalaṃ smṛtam || 4 ||
caturaṅgulakaṃ dharmaḥ śaktyākhyaṃ ca ṣaḍaṅgulam | ardhahastaṃ vitastiṃ ca tālaṃ ca dvādaśāṅgulam || 5 ||
dvitālakaṃ karaṃ vidyātkareṇa svecchayā kriyā | liṅgadhāmāsanādīnāṃ sarvakarmavidhau matā || 6 ||
aṅgulādgṛhaliṅgaṃ syādyāvat pañcadaśāṅgulam | dvāramānāttrisaṃkhyākaṃ navadhā garbhamānataḥ || 7 ||
navadhā karamānena liṅga dhāgni prapūjayet | evaṃ liṅgāni ṣaṭtriṃśajjñeyāni jyeṣṭhamānataḥ || 8 ||
madhyamānena ṣaṭtriṃśat ṣaṭtriṃśadadhamena ca | eṣāmaikyena liṅgānāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet || 9 ||
eṣāṃ pramāṇabhedena sāmānyena trirūpiṇām | yāni yāni ca nāmāni tāni tāni pṛthagbruve (kh: bhavet) || 10 ||
bhūmyambvagnyanilākāśaṃ digambarasarūpakam (k: svarūpakam) | sparśaśabdeśvaro nāsā jihvākṣitvakśrutīśvarāḥ || 11 ||
uttamāṅgula (ṅguli lipu.) liṅgānāṃ vidyātpañcadaśaiva tu | vacanagrahaṇotsargānandapragamaneśvarāḥ || 12 ||
vākpāṇipāyuguhyāṅghrimano'dhyahaṅkṛtīśvarān | prakṛtīśaḥ pumāṃścaiva madhyānāṃ daśa pañca ca || 13 ||
īśvaro'nantarudrau ca śrīkaṇṭhastriśikhastridṛk | vidyeśvaraḥ patiḥ sraṣṭā garutmāna sakalo'kalaḥ || 14 ||
māyāyogeśvarau śarvau (sarvā li. pu) daśapañcādhameṣu tu | śāntaścājo (mū: tejo) mahātejā dvārmānāduttamaṃ trayam || 15 ||
sudhāmā tryambakaḥ (kh: ścādau) śuddho madhyamaṃ dvāratastrikam | skandaḥ sūkṣmo' (mū: skandhaḥ sūryo) mbikānāthastrayaṃ dvārāttathādhamam || 16 ||
caṇḍeśo'tha (mū, g: caṇḍīśo) kapālīśaḥ khaḍgī pāśī dhvajī gadī | bhujaṅgī vṛṣabhī siṃhī uttamā nava garbhajāḥ || 17 ||
(cāpacintānhargato'yaṃ ślokaḥ mūlapustake nāsti) balī śaktī harī raṇī śmaśānī bhairavī tathā | piṅgī krodhī ca māyī ca madhyamā nava garbhajāḥ || 18 ||)
agraścāgraḥ pinākī ca cakrī nādī mahābratī | vyāpī śūlī viśālī (g: kirātī) cetthadhamā nava garbhajāḥ (gh: garbhikāḥ) || 19 ||
avyaktaḥ puṃścalīśaśca niyāmako'tha kālajit | sarvajño'tha vṛṣadhvajo niyāmaḥ pāpahā (gh: niryāmaḥ pāśahā) dhruvaḥ || 20 ||
hasteṣūttmamānena navaliṅgeṣu devatāḥ | śambhuḥ sthāṇurharo ḍiṇḍī hartā kartā śivo'vyayaḥ || 21 ||
navamaśca sureśākhyo madhyamā haratamānataḥ | bhadro'tha vimalo jyeṣṭho gāṇḍīvaḥ puṣṭivardhanaḥ || 22 ||
svayaṃbhūrbhuvaneśaśca śreṣṭhaḥ pālayitā tathā | navaite hastamānena tvadhamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 23 ||
ekāṅgulādipañcāntamadhamaṃ (gh: ntaṃ kanyasaṃ) calamucyate | ṣaḍādidaśaparyantaṃ calaliṅgaṃ ca madhyamam || 24 ||
ekādaśāṅgulādi syāt kramātpañcadaśāntikam | śreṣṭhaliṅgapramāṇaṃ tajjyeṣṭhādyaṅgulilakṣitam || 25 ||
ṣaḍaṅagulaṃ mahāratnairanyaratnairnavāṅgalam | ravibhirhematārotthaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣai (mū, a, k: śeṣairanyai) stripañcabhiḥ || 26 ||
icchāsiddhiḥ suto dharmaḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca ripukṣayaḥ | ārogyaṃ rājyasaukhyaṃ ca nṛpaśrījayalokakṛt || 27 ||
dhairyaṃ tu strīdhanāyuśca liṅgādekāṅgulāditaḥ | calaliṅgādbhavetkāryaṃ sādhakānāṃ kvacinmate (kh: tsamā) || 28 ||
ṣoḍaśāṃśaśca vedāstre yugaṃ luptvordhvadeśataḥ | dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṃśāśca koṇayostu vilopayet || 29 ||
catudiveśanātkaṇṭho viṃśatitriyugaistathā | pārśvābhyāṃ tu viluptābhyāṃ calaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaram (mū, a: ddhru vam) || 30 ||
dhāmno yugartunāgāṃśairdvāraṃ hīnāditaḥ kramāt | liṅgaṃ dvārocchrayādardhādbhavetpādonataḥ kramāt (mū, a, k, g, ṅ: samāt) || 31 ||
garbhārdhenādhamaṃ liṅgaṃ bhūtāṃśaiḥ syāttribhirvaram | tayormadhye ca sūtrāṇi sapta saṃpādayetsamam || 32 ||
evaṃ syunavasūtrāṇi bhūtasūtraistu madhyamam | dvyantare rāmarāmaṃ ca liṅgānāṃ dīrghatā nava || 33 ||
hastādvivadhaṃte hasto yāvatsyurnavapāṇayaḥ | strīya(?)madhyottamaṃ liṅgaṃ trividhaṃ (k, kh: tridhaiva) trividhātmakam || 34 ||
ekaikaliṅgamadhye ca trīṇi ca (mū, a, k: tu sūtrāṇi trīṇi) pādaśaḥ | liṅgāni ghaṭayeddhīmān ṣaṭsu vāṣṭāntareṣu vā || 35 ||
sthiradīrghapramaiṣā (mū: sthirā dairghyaprameyā) tu dvāragarbhakarātmikā | tadekaṃ sthāpayelliṅgaṃ hastātpādajameva vā || 36 ||
śāntirjīvitamānaṃ ca dvārmānātkramataḥ phalam | gabhādyaśo'rthaputrastrībhūrjayo'rtho ghṛṣāyuṣī || 37 ||
muktiḥ puṣṭī ripornāśa āyurjñānaṃ yaśo dhanam | siddhī rājyaṃ karaiḥ kāryā liṅgādantajāttathā || 38 ||
(kh. pustake nastyayaṃ, 39 ślokataḥ 50 ślokaṃ yāvat cāpacinhānvargataḥ pāṭhaḥ) liṅgānāmīpsitaṃ dairghyaṃ tena kṛtvāṅgulāni vai | dhvajādyā yaiḥ svarairbhūtaiḥ śikhibhirvā haretkṛtī || 39 ||
tānyaṅgulāni yaccheṣa lakṣayecca śubhāśubham | dhvajādiṣu dhvajaṃ siṃhaṃ vṛṣākhyaṃ ca gajaṃ śubham || 40 ||
aśubhān varjayeddhīmān dhūmaśva (mū: gajāśva) kharavāyasān | dhvaje rājyaṃ jayaṃ siṃhe vṛṣe lābhaṃ śriyaṃ gaje || 41 ||
dhūme doṣāḥ (gh: dādya) śunā mṛtyuḥ khareṇoccāṭanaṃ sadā | dhvāṅkṣeṇa sarvanāśaḥ syāttasmāttān parivarjayet || 42 ||
svareṣu ṣaḍjagāndhārapañcamāḥ śubhadāyakāḥ | lakṣmīprado bhavet ṣaḍjo gāndhāro janavṛddhikṛt || 43 ||
pañcamaḥ śrīprado nityaṃ bhūmilābhakaro nṛṇām | ṛṣabheṇārivṛddhiḥ syānmadhyamaḥ sutanāśakṛt (mū, a, k, g, ṅ: śubhanāśanaḥ) || 44 ||
dhaivatena kṣayaḥ karturniṣādaḥ sarvanāśakaḥ | bhūteṣu kṣmācarāścānye toyādyāścāśubhā (gh: toyāḍhyā) bhṛśam || 45 ||
pṛthvī sarvapradā puṃsāmāpo bhāryākṣayaṅkarāḥ | sajvaro (k, g: saddhīro) dāhakṛttejo vāyustu kulanāśakṛt || 46 ||
bhrātṛputrakalatrārṇanabho nṛpatināśakṛt | śasto'gniścāhavanīyo dvāvagnī cāśubhau matau || 47 ||
ādyo'gniḥ sarvadaḥ puṃsāṃ dvitīyaḥ sutanāśakṛt (mū, a, k: śubha-) | karturmṛtyuprado hyagnistṛtīyo nṛpabhītidaḥ || 48 ||
āyaśūnyeṣu hasteṣu hastādekāṅgulaṃ kṣipet | ṣaḍvā tadāyabhāgaṃ tu kṛtvaikaṃ saṃkṣipedvaram || 49 ||
dvibhāgaṃ madhyamenāha trīṇi bhāgāni kanyase | bhāgeśa cāpyanīśaṃ ca devejyaṃ tulyasaṃjñakam || 50 ||
catvāri liṅgarūpāṇi viṣkambhena tu lakṣapet | dairghyaṃ māyānvitaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kuryāttrirūpakam || 51 ||
caturaṣṭāsra (mū, a: caturasrāsra; k, kh: caturasrāṣṭa) vṛtaṃ ca tattvatrayaguṇātmakam | uktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe (mū: cāyāṃśe) nāgāṃśai (k, kh: bhāgārdhaiḥ) rbhāṃjite kramāt || 52 ||
rasabhūtāmbu (mū: būtāṃśu) ṣaṣṭhāṃśatryaṃśādhikaśatairbhavet | ādyānādyasurejyāhva (mū: -jyāṅka) tulyānāṃ caturasratā || 53 ||
pañcakatrayamānākhyaṃ vyāsānāhān pravṛddhitaḥ (mū: vyasānāhatya) | dvidhā bhedādbahūnyatra vakṣyante (k, g: lakṣyante) viśvakamataḥ || 54 ||
ādyādīnāṃ tridhā sthaulyādyavavṛddhyā tadaṣṭadhā | tridhā hastājjivākhyaṃ ca yuktaṃ sarvasamena ca || 55 ||
pañcaviṃśatibhedānyanādye (mū: liṅgāni na dya) devārcite tathā | pañca (mū: yaśca) saptatirekatvājjinaibhaktaṃbhavanti hi || 56 ||
caturdaśasahasrāṇi catuḥ śatayutāni (mū, a, g: śatāyutāni) ca | evamaṅgulavṛddhyā ca navaikakaragarbhataḥ || 57 ||
teṣāṃ karṇārdhakoṇasthaiśchindyātkoṇāni sūtrakaiḥ | vistāraṃ saptadhā kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayam || 58 ||
dvibhāgādūrdhvamaṣṭāṃśo dvyaṣṭāṃśaiḥ (mū: maṣṭāṃśo dvyaṣṭāṃśaiḥ) syācchivāṃśakaḥ (k: cchirāṃśakaḥ) | ekaikāṃśaṃ caturbhāgaṃ koṇahrāsaṃ dvibhāgataḥ || 59 ||
tattīryaksūtrasaṃpātāddaśanāsaṃ bhavetpunaḥ | tadekaikaṃ yugaṃ kṛtvā ekaikāṃśaṃ samāharet || 60 ||
dvayantayostu kramātsūtrairdaśanāsraṃ punardvidhā | kvacitkaṇaṃpraveśena lāñchayitvāsiśātanam || 61 ||
ṣoḍaśāsraṃ bhavettadvattadvadeva dviṣoḍaśa | tanmadhye sūtrasambhrānte rudro bhavati vartulaḥ || 62 ||
śubhārthamāyaiḥ (mū, a, g: ramāyaiḥ) saṃhṛtya bāṇāgninagabhāgibhiḥ | kṣipedvā śūnyadoṣaghnaṃ hastādekāṅgulaṃ kramāt || 63 ||
ṣoḍhā brahmādibhiryojyā tattvapakṣa (k, kh: tanupakṣa) guṇaiḥ kramāt | ṣoḍaśāṃśa kṣipedādye (kh, g, gh: nnādye) vedāṃśamamarorcite (kh: samākhyatrisamaiḥ surāḥ) || 64 ||
deyaṃ heyaṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: deyaṃ) ca vasvaśamādye sarvasamena tu | piṅgalāyā mate proktamādyāmarārcitena tu || 65 ||
svāyāmājjinabhāgāsra (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: bhāgāgra) maṅgulātkararandhrataḥ (k, g: vaktrataḥ) | bhaveyurvardhamānāni vasudviṣaṭ (gh: vasvatviṣaṭ) śatāni ca || 66 ||
athādyāditriliṅgānāṃ chāyādoṣavimuktaye | viśvakarmamataṃ (gh: mate) dṛṣṭvā vaktavyaṃ pīṭhavartanam (gh: pīṭhavartane) || 67 ||
adho madhyordhvadeśe ca bhāgatrayasamanvitam | tacca savasamaṃ liṅgaṃ prāsāde vā gṛhe hitam || 68 ||
evaṃ savasamaṃ kāryaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam | dvau pādau jānuparyantaṃ caturasrepitāmahaḥ || 69 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ nābhiparyanta viṣṇuraṣṭāsrake sthitaḥ | āmūrdhaṃ nābhitaścordhvaṃ vṛttabhāge haraḥ svayam || 70 ||
yathāvyakte tathārcāyāṃ mukhaliṅge sthitaḥ kramāt | pañcadhāvyaktaliṅgāni samapīṭhāni tāni ca || 71 ||
tulyākhyaṃ samukhaṃ (gh: sumukhaṃ) kuryādīśānaṃ vā surārcitam | evaṃ liṅgāni kāryāṇi doṣāya syurato'nyathā | pañcaliṅgavyavastheyaṃ śirovartinyathocyate (mū, a: vartanamucyate; k, kh: vartanyathocyateḥ) || 72 ||
chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍābhaṃ bālendutrapuṣākṛti | ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ kāmyarūpātphala vadet || 73 ||
vasvaṃśaiścarame'rthāṃśaiḥ (mū: methāṃśaiḥ) puṇḍarīkaṃ tapakṣayāt | yaśastena bhavetkarturviśālaṃ dvikṣayācchriye | śrīvatsaṃ trikṣayāt prītyai (gh: prītiḥ) diṅmardanaṃ catuḥkṣayāt | cirarājyaprada khyātaṃ chatrabhedāścaturvidhāḥ || 75 ||
yugāṃśe carame'ṣṭābhirvimalaṃ tattva (k, kh, g, gh: tanu) śātanāt | mānada (mū: mānāṅga) pakṣa (k, kh, g: padma) lopācca vipulaṃ khyātidaṃ bhavet || 76 ||
vardhamānaṃ trina śācca (mū, k, kh, gh: tribhāgācca) dhanadaṃ (k: padadaṃ; g: vanadaṃ) vedalopanāt | śrīvāsaṃ putradaṃ kurturdakṣāṇḍaṃ syāccaturvidham || 77 ||
tryaṃśātprāptairyugāṃśaiśca ekahānyāmṛtāhvayam (gh: -hvakam) | puṣṭidaṃ dvikṣayātpūrṇaṃ mahāhlādakarasadā (kh: tathā) || 78 ||
tryaṃśatyāgādbala khyātaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca (kh: saubhāgyadaṃ) yugakṣayāt | āyudaṃ kumudaṃ jñeyaṃ candaṃ caturvidhaṃ matam (mū: jñeyaṃ candraṃ caturvidham) || 79 ||
ṛtvaśaiścarame vedairvijayaṃ bhavanāśanam | sarvakāmapradaṃ proktaṃ vināśaṃ dvikṣayācchriye || 80 ||
trityāgājjayadaṃ bhīmaṃ citrākaṃ (kh: vidāvhaṃ; k, g: citrāṅkaṃ) vedaśātanāt | ballabhatvaprada tacca caturdhā trapuṣaṃ bhavet || 81 ||
trapuṣaṃ chatra candrābhaṃ kṛkavākvaṇḍakaṃ (mū: kvaṇḍavat) kramāt | kuryādviprādikāryārthamekaṃ vā kukkuṭāṇḍakam (kh: ṭāṇḍabhaṃ) || 82 ||
trapuṣādiṣṭasaṃsiddhī rājyaṃ syādātapatrataḥ | dīrghāyuṣṭvamatha cendoḥ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: mathārdhendoḥ) kṛkavākvaṇḍataḥ prajñāḥ || 83 ||
