liṅganāhavikārāṃśaṃ kṛtvā tu guṇayettataḥ | jinaviṃśatiśārdūlairādye brahmādiveṣṭanam || 84 ||
nakhāt ṣaṣṭi (k, kh: dṛṣṭi) vikārāṃśairanādye ca (mū: vai) tathā bhavet | vikāreṇa smareṇāṃśatṛtīyāṃśayutena ca || 85 ||
bhāgasyārdhavibhāgena yuktāṃśena (k, kh: yuktārkeṇa) surārcite | bhāgatṛtīyabhāgena nakhacandrānvitena ca || 86 ||
aṃśatṛtīyabhāgena cātyaṣṭāṃśayutena ca | sasaptadaśabhiścāṃśaiḥ paridhiḥ syātsamāṃśake (mū: samāhvake) || 87 ||
caturdoṃrbhirajoveṣṭaṃ (mū, k, kh, gh: rajoveṣṭayai) kṛtvā saptāṃśakaṃ bhujam | sārdhadvitribhujairviṣṇuḥ sāṅghryekatribhujairharaḥ || 88 ||
mūrdhonnate (k, kh: mūrdhnyunnate) mahābhogaḥ pṛṣṭhe golābha eva ca | yavagarbhe bhavetpuṣṭiḥ pānānnaṃ jaṭharonnate || 89 ||
sarvāṅgavartule saukhyaṃ prajālakṣmīvivardhanam | samakukṣau bhayaṃ hanyāt sthūlamūle tvarogatā (mū: hyarogatā) || 90 ||
śūlābhe vikale mūrdhni prajā hanti sakartṛkāḥ | nimne ca luñcite kuryāddhanadhānyavināśanam || 91 ||
kṣataṃ ca mūrdhni yalliṅgaṃ taddhanyātkatṛbhūbhujau | chidrānvitaṃ ca sadbhāyā (mū, a, k: tathā bhāryā) lalāṭe nimnaka sutam || 92 ||
mūrdhni sthūlaṃ ca kartṛghnaṃ cakraṃ cavārthaśilpihṛt | madhye kṛśaṃ ca śokāya dubhikṣadamadhaḥ kṛśam || 93 ||
hīnāṅge cipiṭāṅga ca bhayaṃ pīḍā ca jāyate | vraṇitāmayavṛddhiśca durbhikṣaṃ cātikoṭare || 94 ||
hanyāddīrghakṛśe rāṣṭraṃ hrasve vyādhiḥ prakupyati | dhanaghnaṃ pṛṣṭhanimnaṃ syādrogaṃ pārśve tathodare || 95 ||
suniṣpannaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ ghṛṣṭvā śāṇādibhirbudhaḥ | samyak sunirvraṇaṃ dhautaṃ tadā cinhāni lakṣayet || 96 ||
svastikā (k, g: muṣṭikā) vjāṅkuśacchatracakrāsidhvajakambu ca (gh: kambubhiḥ) | makarādarśacāpobhisrakkamaṇḍalutoraṇāḥ || 97 ||
matsyakūrmādribhānvinduyava (mū: ghṛṣa) siṃhākṣasūtrakāḥ | śrīvatsanandikāvartarathahārebhabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 98 ||
netrakuṃbhajaṭāliṅgāstrītārāśūlacāmarāḥ | mayūravājivāsobhistaruvajrapavitrakāḥ || 99 ||
prāsādakaravahnyarcirbhagākārā (mū, a, g: bhavākārā) ca rekhikāḥ | liṅgāṅge yatra tatra (gh: yatra yatra) syānnṛparāṣṭravivṛddhidāḥ || 100 ||
kabandhakapimārjāravyāghrabhallūkapevakaiḥ | karaṅkakaṅkagṛdhrāhiśyenakākakharākhubhiḥ || 101 ||
balākānigaḍolūkapāśasaṃdaṃśakīṭakaiḥ | pataṅgamuṇḍamāloṣṭra vṛkākāraśvarūpakaiḥ | yajamānaprajārājñāṃ liṅgaṃ bhīśa kadāyakam (mū: strīśoka) || 102 ||
(atra pārthivāditattvānāṃ varṇavibhājane varṇollekhane ca bhinnakramaḥ | ākāśatattvaṃ ca naiva varṇitam | granthāntareṣu tu pañcaiva tattvānāmullekhaḥ samupalabhyate | pāṭho'yamaśuddhaḥ apūrṇa iva ca pratibhāti | śaivāgamavida evātrapramāṇam | tattvavarṇavibhājanakramastu puraścaryārṇavasya prathamataraṅgasya dīkṣāprakaraṇe kulākula cakre prakārāntareṇa kṛtaḥ | sa ca yathā- vāyvagnibhūjalākāśāḥ iti | a ā e ka ca ṭatapayaṣā mārutāḥ i ī ai kha cha ṭha tha pha ra kṣā āgneyāḥ | ṛ ṝ au gha jha ḍha dha bhavasā jalīyāḥ | ḷ ḹ aṃ ṅa ña ṇa na maśahā nābhasāḥ iti |) i ī cha la dvayaṃ (gh: ḷ ḷ) caiva tathā pañcānunāsikāḥ | ete ca pārthivā varṇā liṅgacinhāni bhūtaye (k: bhūtale) || 103 ||
ū aṃ a ca ḍa ṭā (k, kh, gh: phaṭā) kṣādhaḥkasahājāvasā (mū: kahājava ṛsā) śiti | ete ca (gh: tu) vāruṇā varṇā prajāyurdhanalābhadāḥ || 104 ||
ṛ(-)ṝ(-)āyara aughā o visargaśca dakhāḥ pṛthak | āgneyā agnisantrāsadurbhikṣavyādhivardhanāḥ || 105 ||
e o e upagābhāthaṭhaḍhakārāvarṣāviti | vāyavyā vāyusantrāsakalahādvegakārakāḥ || 106 ||
miśrāstvete phalaṃ dadyurhīnādhikasamaṃ tataḥ | sādhane cāstriliṅgaṃ ca digliṅgaṃ caiva vakṣyate (kh: lakṣyate) || 107 ||
ekāsraṃ śatrunāśāya dvyasraṃ putravivṛddhidam | tryasraṃ cāśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ vedāsraṃ cepsitapradam || 108 ||
pañcāsraṃ śatrunāśāya ṣaḍasraṃ bhogadāyakam | saptāsraṃ dveṣakṛtkhyātamaṣṭāsraṃ kīrtivardhanam || 109 ||
uccāṭane navāsraṃ syāddaśāstraṃ roganāśane | rudrāsraṃ rogavṛddhyarthaṃ bhayaghnaṃ dvādaśāsrakam || 110 ||
kāmāsraṃ śatrunāśāya staṃbhane bhuvanāśrakam | tithyasraṃ puṇyakṛlliṅgaṃ vikārāsraṃ sukhapradam || 111 ||
pūrvavatkalpanaiteṣāṃ mānamastakarūpataḥ (k, kh, gh: rūpakam) | navāvadhikarāntasya śūnyadoṣo na kasyacit || 112 ||
vasukṛte diśāliṅge aṅgulaṃ vā karakramāt | tridhā mānena caikena (gh: caikyena) ṣoḍaśāsraṃ śatadvayam || 113 ||
taddairghyaiḥ sūryavatkāryo biṣkambho vedabhāgataḥ | caturaṣṭaṣaḍasraṃ tu indrāṅkaṃ (kh: candrāhvaṃ) vajrarūpakam || 114 ||
aṣṭāsraṃ pūrvavatkāryaṃ tryasrāṃśa (k, kh: tristryasra) minduyāmyayoḥ | bindusaṃpātsaṃyogāttiryaksūtrairvivartayet || 115 ||
nāhārdhaṃ rudrabhāgaṃ ca (mū: rudrabhāgena) bāṇāśa (k: bāṇāṃśe) ścaturasrakam | vasvasrordhvaṃ tu (mū: vasvasrordhe tu) saptāsraṃ śaktyāgneya ca dāhakṛt || 116 ||
kintusvāṃśā (mū: svasāṃ) vinā śatroyāmyaṃ cipiṭakaṃ tataḥ | nāhārdhaṃ navadhā kṛtvā śarairhṛtpṛṣṭhakoṭibhiḥ || 117 ||
pārśvād (mū: pārśve) dvyasrairgrahaiḥṣaḍbhiḥ koṇeṣvambuvināśanāt (mū, a, ṅ: koṇeṣu svavināśakṛt) | evaṃ cāṣṭāsravṛtaṃ syādyāmyadaṇḍaṃ (mū, a, k, g, ṅ: yāmadaṇḍaṃ) rujapradam || 118 ||
dairghyārdhaṃ (gh: daighyaivaṃ) rudravatkṛtvā bhūtāṃśaiścaturasrakam | aṣṭāsro'rdha (mū: -'rdhaṃ) daśāstraṃ syātkhaḍgābhaṃ rākṣasaṃ bhayam (k, kh: kṣaye) || 119 ||
nāhārdhaṃ munivatkāryaṃ viṣkaṃbhaṃ yugabhāgataḥ | caturaṣṭāsravṛttaṃ syātpāśavadvāruṇaṃ śubham || 120 ||
darghyārdhaṃ ravibhāgena vedāsraṃ (kh: candrāsraṃ) munibhāgataḥ | kṛśaṃ prāgrūpakaṃ dīrghaṃ calamuccāṭakṛddhvajam || 121 ||
kuryātsarvasamaṃ liṅgaṃ sthūlodaravinirmitam | yākṣaṃ (k: pākṣaṃ; g: mākṣaṃ) gadāgramūrdhānaṃ balavṛddhikaraṃ (gh: dhana-) śivam || 122 ||
nāhārdhaṃ rudrabhāgena viṣkaṃbhaṃ ṣaḍvibhāgataḥ (mū: vibhāgajam) | catuḥpañcāsrakaṃ (mū: caturasrāsrakaṃ) tryasraṃ śūlaṃ raudraṃ tu muktidam || 123 ||
rasabhāga (k, kh, g: rasabhāge) kṛtaṃ nāhaṃ (gh: nāhāt) pakṣāṃśe (kh: pakṣāṃśaiḥ) caturasrakam | aṣṭāsro' (g: aṣṭāṃśo) rdhaṃ ca vedāsraṃ brāhmaṃ svargāya padmavat || 124 ||
vāhārdhaṃ nagabhāgena viṣkaṃbhaṃ turyabhāgataḥ | caturaṣṭāsravṛttaṃ syādvaiṣṇavaṃ śaṅkhava (mū, a: śaktivat) cchubham || 125 ||
ṛtūdaye dvibhāgārdhatyāgādvajraśiro bhavet | rudrāttrihānitaḥ śuktirdaṇḍo digbhyastrihānitaḥ || 126 ||
tribhirhṛtai (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: -rhataiḥ) raṃsiḥ śailādbālendurvāruṇe śiraḥ | kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ ca vāyavye bhūtāṃśāddhi yate gadā || 127 ||
grahāṃśāttrivināśātsyāttryunnata śūlasaṃjñakam | dakṣāṇḍabhaja vaiṣṇośca ittha rekhā maṇerapi || 128 ||
hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ kṛśaṃ sthūlaṃ kubjaṃ khañjaṃ (gh: khañjakubjaṃ) ca cāmanam | sphuṭitaṃ garbhavaddaṣṭaṃ sthāpayedābhivārike || 129 ||
evamavyaktaliṅgāni kīrtitāni śubhāśubham | vyaktaliṅgāni cānyāni nānā rūpāṇi vacmyataḥ || 130 ||
[iti (iti pratiṣṭhātantre, likhitapustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ) lakṣaṇasamuccaye'vyaktaliṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma (liṅgavartanāvidhiḥ, iti likhita pustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ |) caturtho vidhiḥ] || 4 ||
[atha pañcamaḥ]
vyaktārcālakṣaṇaṃ samyagrudānīnāṃ pravakṣyate | pūrvāṅgulapramāṇena daśapañcāṅgulāṅgulāt || 1 ||
gṛheṣu pratimā pūjyā nādhikā hi praśasyate | kvaciddhastapramāṇā sā kvacicca triṃśadaṅgulā || 2 ||
adhikāṃsthāpayeddhāmni dvārahastapramāṇikām | dvārocchrayaṃ vibhajyādāvaṣṭadhaukaṃ (mū, a, k: vaṣṭadhaikaṃ) vidhāya ca || 3 ||
punastridhā vibhajyātha bhāgenaikena piṇḍikā | vidhātavyā dvibhāgena kanyasī pratimā ca sā || 4 ||
dvārdairghyaṃ navadhā kṛtvā tyaktvaikāṃśaṃ tridhā param | madhyamā syāddvibhāgena (gh: madhyamārcā vibhāgena) kāryaikāṃśena pīṭhikā || 5 ||
dvāranāhaṃ tridhā kṛtvā bhāgenaikena piṇḍikā | kartavyā taddvibhāgena pratimā sottamā matā || 6 ||
karamāne karādeḥ syādekaikasyottarottaram | navāntaṃ tritrikānteṣu kanyasādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 7 ||
garbhakarṇavibhāgena pratimāliṅgagocchrayam | pīṭha (gh: pīṭhaṃ) dvārapravistāraṃ mayaścakresvake mate || 8 ||
bāhye tu pratimā kāryā mahatī karamānataḥ | tithimāsanavatyardhaihīnamadhyottamāstridhā || 9 ||
sālaṅkārāstridhā bhūtā (mū, a, : striyo bhūtvā) vetālāḥ sthūla (g: sthala) vāmanāḥ | paṅgurūpāśca (gh: paṅgurūpāḥ sa) kūṣmāṇḍāḥ saptadhārcāśca (mū: dhārvāśca)vartayet || 10 ||
nirdoṣocchrāyasaṃyuktāṃ caturasrāyatāṃ śilām | vibhajya śaktisūtreṇa ṛkṣādibhyaḥ (mū, a, k, kh: ṛkṣyādityaḥ) śubhe dine || 11 ||
saṃpūjyādau guruṃ kāruṃ kṛtvā svastyayanādikam | pīṭhātmāśrayajīvāṃśca prabhādīṃśca prakalpayet || 12 ||
vistāravdiguṇaṃ (mū, a, ṅ: vistārāddviguṇaṃ) kṣetraṃ pañcadhā pravibhajya ca | kṛtvādhoṃśagataḥ (mū: cādhogataḥ) pīṭhaṃ tribhāge jīvakalpanā || 13 ||
bhūtāṃśena prabhāścaiva antaṃ vidyādharādikam | sātmāśrayāṃ sadūtīṃ (mū: sabhūtāṃ) ca pratimāṃ vartayettataḥ || 14 ||
sūtrāṇi saptatriṃśatsyustiryaklāṅghriśataṃ tathā | bhāgaikamaṅgula kṛtvā mahārcāṃ vatayedbudhaḥ || 15 ||
dairghyaṃ ca navadhā kṛtvā tatraikaṃ sūryasammitam | eka bhāge'ṅgulaṃ tasyā (gh: tasyāṃ) stenāṅgaṃ parikalpayet || 16 ||
maulilalāṭanāsābhrūnābhimeḍhrāṅghrikeṣu (k, kh: meḍhrādikeṣu) ca | maye sūtraṃ samaṃ nyasya ṛjvarcāṃ kārayecchubhām || 17 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhāllalāṭāntamaṣṭottaraśatāṅgulam | jīvasyāddairghyamānena pratyaṅgānyadhunā vruve || 18 ||
tālena mukuṭocchrāyastadvistāro daśāṅgulam | mātrābhistithisaṃkhyābhirmukuṭa (mū, a, k, kh: mukuṭe) veṣṭanaṃ bhavet || 19 ||
tālaikaṃ mūrdhni vistāra ucchrāyo golakadvayam | tālamānaṃ bhavedvakraṃ grīvā ca caturaṅgulā || 20 ||
kaṇṭhakūpa dadhaścūcūnābhigugraṃ yathākramam (mū, a, g: parākramam) | tālaikaikapramāṇaṃ syādūrū tālavinirgamau || 21 ||
dvikale jānunī tasyā jaṅghe caiva dvitālake | jñeyau gulphau dvinetrau ca pārṣṇīdvyaṅgulake mate (k: kramāt) || 22 ||
vṛtte ca tryaṅgulocchrāye pādau saptāṅgulāyatau | madhye kalādvayocchrāyovagresārdhārdha (kh: sā cārdha) mātrakau || 23 ||
tadvistārau (tri) dvinetrau ca aṅguṣṭhatryaṅgulastayo (g: dvayoḥ) | pañcāṅgulau veṣṭanena sārdhāṅgaladviparvaṇī || 24 ||
pradeśinī ca dairghyeṇa sā ca tryaṅgulakā matā | tryaṅgulā pariṇāhena kathyante tvadhunāparāḥ || 25 ||
anyādairghyavikārāṃśahīnāveṣṭena cāṣṭabhiḥ | pādāṅgulyastriparvāṇaḥ parvārdhanakhaśobhitāḥ || 26 ||
pādāṅguṣṭhanakhau nimnāvagre (mū, a, k, kh, ṅ: vatra) kāryau yavonnatau | kārāṅghri (mū, a, k, kh: nakhāṅghri) talakaṃ raktaṃ nakhāḥ savonnatāruṇāḥ || 27 ||
vakṣo dvitālavistāraṃ bāhumūle ṣaḍaṅgule | upabāhū daśāṣṭāṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulakau bhujau || 28 ||
saptāṅgulakara yāmaḥ pañcāṅgulapravistaraḥ | bhūtāṅgulā bhavenmadhyā ardhahīnā tvanāmikā || 29 ||
tatsamā tarjanī dharmāṅgulāṅgaṣṭakaniṣṭhike | madhyamādyāstriparvāṇo dviparvāṅguṣṭhako mataḥ || 30 ||
madhya (mū: madhyā) gra (mū: yāmātva) kalāyāmastva nthiṅgulārdha vināgrataḥ | tarjanyanāmikāparva sapādayavavarjitam || 31 ||
sā ca dviyavahīnā syātpratipavakaniṣṭhikā | dvyaṅgulo'ṅguṣṭhakagranthirāsāṃ parvārdhagā nakhāḥ || 32 ||
atha tryaṃśavibhaktāsyaṃ lalāṭaṃ nāsikāmukham | nāsotsedhaḥ savistārodvyaṅgulo dvipuṭaḥ (mū, a: dvikuṭaḥ) śubhaḥ || 33 ||
ardhāṅgulasame vṛtte nāsāyā vivare śubhe | dvyardhaṃ yavaṃ puṭe sthūle madhye vaśa (k, kh: viṃśaḥ) stribhiryavaḥ || 34 ||
(koṣṭhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ kh. pustake nāsti) nāsādho'rdhāṅgulaṃ gojī gojyā vādho (mū: cādho) ṅgulo'dharaḥ | adhe'paro'ṅgulakaṃ tu (k, g: ṅ gulakarṇa) dvyaṅgule cibukasthitiḥ || 35 ||
vedāṅgulaṃ mukha khātaṃ (mū: khyātaṃ) yavamānaṃ tu sṛkkaṇī |) nāsikāmūlapārśve tu locane dvyaṅgulāyate (g: locanamaṅgulāyate) || 36 ||
mīnodarā ca cāpābhā (gh: cavābhā) naradṛk (mū: navadṛk) kumudākṛtiḥ | indīvarābjapatrābhā paṭolaphalavatstriyāḥ || 37 ||
tadvistāro'ṅgulaṃ caikaṃ tārā syāttattribhāgikā | pañcamāṃśaṃ bhavejjyotiḥ sṛkkaṇīsūtratulyataḥ || 38 ||
rucirau yavamānau ca ghrāpuṭau (mū: dvau puṭau; g: nāsāpuṭau) samasūtrakau | ardhāṅgulasamā droṇī sārdhadvyaṅguladīrghatā || 39 ||
netrārdhe dvyaṅgulāyāme bhruvau dviyavavistarau | tayora taramātrārdhaṃ striyāṃ yavārdhavistṛte (gh: yathāmbuvistṛte) || 40 ||
kārmakābhe same śaste bhūsamā karṇayo (7) sthitiḥ | karṇau netradayāyāmau tadardhādvistarastayoḥ || 41 ||
yavadvayonmiti (gh: dvayamiti) vatī śaṣkulī tatsamā bhavet | kalārdhaṃ (tadukau (mū,a: tuḍhukau; k, g: tuṭukau; kh: tupukau) khalvau ?) pāśau kuryādyathepsitau || 42 ||
sārdhatalaṃ bhavenmūrdhni karṇayorūrdhvadeśataḥ | indrasaṅkhyāṅgulaṃ paścātkarṇayorantaraṃ viduḥ || 43 ||
sārdhaṃ yavaṃ tu karṇaṃ tu dalaṃ kuryānna cādhikam (kh: narādhikam) | lalāṭo'ṣṭāṅgulāyāmastryaṅgulaḥ śaṅkha ucyate || 44 ||
tadūrdhve dvyaṅgule śuktī (kh: śaktiḥ) tritāla (k: trikāla) veṣṭanaṃ śiraḥ (g: śivaḥ) | saptāṅgulau kapolau tu sāṅgulau sayavocchrayau || 45 ||
dvikalārdhākṣisṛkkā (mū, a, g: sūktā) tu tvapāṅgau sāyakāṅgulau | hanū kalā tradīrghau vdikalaścibukodgamaḥ || 46 ||
grīvāṣṭāṅgulavistārā veṣṭanena dvitālakā (kh, gh: tālikā) | skandho'ṣṭāṅgulavistārastadāyāmaścatuṣkalā || 47 ||
trigolāvaśakau khyātau ṣaḍaṅgulapṛthū bhujau | vistāraḥ kūrparastasmādbhūtāṅgulairyavaistathā || 48 ||
pañcāṅgulopabāhū ca tanmadhyaṃ ca (gh: tanmadhye tu) kalādvayam | caturaṅgulavistāro maṇibandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 49 ||
kramāttriguṇakaṃ bāhvoḥ pariveṣṭanametayoḥ | stanayorantaraṃ tālaṃ tayoḥ prāntau dvinetrakau || 50 ||
cūcukaṃ yavamātraṃ (gh: cūcūkau yavamātrau) tu dviyavaṃ stanamaṇḍalam | nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā nimnato'rdhāṅguloditā || 51 ||
vistāreṇāṅgulaṃ vidyānnābhyadho dvikalodaram | hṛdviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ proktaṃ nābhideśaścaturdaśa || 52 ||
aṣṭādaśāṅgulā śreṇī vistāreṇa pracoditā | pañcādaśāṅgulaṃ (mū, a, k, g: pañcāśadaṅgulaṃ) vakṣo hṛddeśaḥ pañcabhirvinā || 53 ||
veṣṭanena tato nābhirdvicatvāriśadaṅgulam | kaṭiḥ saṃveṣṭanenoktā śatācca (k, kh: sa tāvat) dvyadhikāṅgulā || 54 ||
sphicau pīnau suvṛttau ca samau ca dvikalonnatau | caturnetrapravistārau gajakumbhopamau śubhau || 55 ||
vṛṣaṇau dvyaṅgulāyāmau tanmadhye mehanasthitiḥ | mehanastryaṅgulo dairghyātyariṇāhe (mū: pariṇāhāt) ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ || 56 ||
tatkośāgraṃ dvinetraṃ ca pariṇāhena kīrtitam | pāyoścavṛṣaṇasyāntavistāreṇa dvigolakam || 57 ||
ūrumūle ca tanmadhye jānū dve jānudeśataḥ | tadadhaḥ piṇḍikāyāṃ ca jaṅghāyāṃ ghaṇṭikordhvataḥ || 58 ||
ekaikaṃ kṣīyate tālo (gh: tālād) yāvatpañcāṅgula (gh: paścāṅgala) sthitiḥ | evaṃ vistāra eteṣāṃ veṣṭanaṃ triguṇādhikam || 59 ||
yavagarbhe kṛśe liṅge karāṅgulyagrake tathā | bhujajaṅghāgrake caiva svavistārāttriveṣṭanam || 60 ||
etaduktaṃ ca sāmānyaṃ striyāḥ puṃsaśca lakṣaṇam (mū: veṣṭanam) | nāryaṣṭāṃśā ca tanvaṅgī (mū, a, kh: tattvaṅgī) cakṣuḥ śroṇī stanādhikā || 61 ||
gaṇḍāsthisūtrarāmeṇa (?) tryasraṃ kūrmonnataṃ bhagam | tanmadhyatastvadhobhāge randhraṃ syāt kuñjaroṣṭhavat || 62 ||
dakṣāṇḍābhaṃ tilākāraṃ devadevyormukhaṃ varam | vṛttaṃ vedāsrakaṃ cāsyaṃ kuryātpretādirakṣasām || 63 ||
navāṃśairitare khyātāḥ pradhānā daśabhāgikāḥ | brahmaviṣṇuharādīnāṃ saṃkṣepāllakṣma cocyate || 64 ||
mukuṭādyaṅgulaikaikaṃ (gh: mukuṭāddvaṅgu-) prakṣipeccaraṇāntike | vakṣobāhūrujaṅghānāṃ (gh: jaṅghāyāṃ) karādīnāṃ krameṇa tu || 65 ||
tālaikādaśabhi kuryādbhūtavetālarakṣasām | dve dve caivāṅgule deye vaktrādiṣu yathākramam || 66 ||
kiṅkarāḥ sthūlarūpāśca saptatālochrayā matāḥ | vāmanaḥ pañcatālaśca bhūtāṃśaiḥ paṅgukubjakau || 67 ||
kūṣmāṇḍakaścatustālairunmānena prakalpayet | buddhvā buddhvā tu yatnena sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 68 ||
poṣaṇaṃ haraṇaṃ kuryātsarvasminneva rūpake | acatanmānataḥ kāryāḥ sarvāvayavabhūṣitā || 69 ||
sarvaśāntikarī dhanyā na hīnā nādhikāṅgikā | sthānakaiḥ karaṇairyuktā pratimaiṣā phalapradā || 70 ||
vikṣiptādhomukhī stabdhā hīnā śuṣkā kunetrikā | vakrāṅgī (mū, a, k, kh, ṅ: cakrāṅgī) cipiṭā dīnā kṛśa (kh: bhūṣa) gātrī ca raudrikā || 71 ||
vikṣiptāṅgī kṣayaṃ kuryāt pāpadādhomukhī matā | saṅkocakārikā stabdhā hīnavaktrā ca rogadā || 72 ||
yānaghnī (k, kh: dānaghnī) kaṭihīnā syājjanahṛtpāṇipādataḥ (kh: pādapāṇitaḥ) | hīnajaṅghārisaukhyāthaṃ śuṣkā syānnṛpanāśinī || 73 ||
śuṣka (g: guhya) pāṇyaṅghrikadyā syādācāryaṃ śuṣkajaṅghikā | udvegajananī sā tu bhrāmaṇī ca sadā bhavet || 74 ||
kunetrā netrahṛtkhyātā vakraghrāṇā tu duḥkhaḥkṛt | vakrāṅgyarthāṅganāśāya cipiṭā duḥkhadāyinī || 75 ||
dīnārcā (mū: nīcārcā) śilpinaṃ hanyādraudrī kartṛvināśinī | dhanaghnī ca (mū: tu) kṛśāṅgī syācchasyaghnī tu kṛśodarī || 76 ||
gaṇḍottamāṅgahṛdvakṣa ādau nimnā dhruvaṃ haret | suhṛddhanasutāṃstasmātkāryā sallakṣaṇāḥ sadā || 77 ||
ṛju (k: ṛjvā; kh: ṛdvā; g: ṛdva) cakṣugataṃ sācī kṛtakaṃ gaṇḍabhītidam (gh: bhītikam) (?) | chāyāgataṃ ca sarvāṅga (gh: sarvāṅka) bhittikaṃ kṣiptakaṃ tathā || 78 ||
parāvṛttabhītimāni navasthānāni rūpake | karaṇāni śataṃ cāṣṭau vyantarā (k, kh: pyantarā) ścātivistarāḥ (?) || 79 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vyaktaliṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcamo vidhiḥ] || 5 ||
[atha ṣaṣṭhaḥ]
navaśaktayaḥ (asya granthasya pūrvabhāgātmake devatā citrasaṃgrahe pustake mudritānāṃ citrāṇāṃ nāmāni kramasaṃkhyā cātra tattatsthāne daktāni atroktalakṣaṇānāmudāharaṇāni tatraiva draṣṭavyāni | yathā- (navaśaktayaḥ) ītyasyodāharaṇe (1) saṃkhyākaṃ citraṃ draṣṭavyam | evaṃ sarvatra jñeyam |) (-)
vṛttasthā jaṭilāstryakṣā agnijvālāsamaprabhāḥ | kapālābhayahastogrā vāmādyā navaśaktayaḥ || 1 ||
śivaḥ (asya 2 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
caturbhujo'ravindasthaḥ śivaḥ kundendunirmalaḥ | dvīpicarmāhibhṛcchāntastryakṣo jaṭendubhūṣitaḥ || 2 ||
kapālaśūlapāṇiśca purottānakaradvayaḥ | aṅgaṣaṭkasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ syātsiddhidāyakaḥ || 3 ||
śivabhedaḥ (asya 3 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) -
sa evābjasthito devo digvāhurdṛktripañcakaḥ | (atra ka. pustakasyā ṭippaṇī-yuva= īśaḥ, yauvanaḥ=puruṣaḥ, vṛddhaḥ=aghora, strī=vāmadevaḥ, bālaḥ=sadyojātaḥ, iti |) yuvayauvanavṛddhastrībālābhaḥ pañcavaktrabhṛt || 4 ||
savye kartarikādarśakuṇḍīvaradaśūlabhṛt | vāmenā (kh: dakṣeṇa; atraiva k. pustakasya ṭippaṇyāṃ akṣamālā iti śabdaśva prakṣiptaḥ) bhayamantrāṅka (gh: mantrāhva) kapālotpalapūra (atrāpi k. pustakasya ṭippaṇyāṃ bījapura iti prakṣiptaḥ) bhṛt || 5 ||
hṛtsitaṃ kapilaṃ muṇḍaṃ pītā śikhā sitacchadam | dṛgraktāsihutāśābhāḥ sarve tryakṣā jaṭānvitāḥ || 6 ||
dvibhujāścakavaktrāśca kapālaśūlapāṇayaḥ | babhrubhrūśmaśruddā(?)bhīmamastraṃ pītaṃ svaśastra (k, kh, g: suśastra) bhṛt || 7 ||
śivabhedaḥ (asya 4 saṃ0 ci. dra0) (-)
kuṇḍī pāśāṅkuśaṃ ghaṇṭā śūlaṃ ca vāmahastake | śakti (pā: śānti) vajrākṣamālāsicakrāṇi dakṣiṇe kvacit || 8 ||
dvīpicarmavaro'bjastho nāgayajñopavītavān | ekāsyaḥ pañcavaktro vā tryakṣo jaṭendubhṛcchivaḥ || 9 ||
anantādyāścaturdikṣu raktanīlasitāruṇāḥ | koṇeṣu caika (mū: caiva) rudrādyāḥ sitāsaṅnīlalohitāḥ || 10 ||
sarve cāṣṭabhujāḥ saumyāścaturāsyā jaṭānvitāḥ | śivāyudhadharāstryakṣāḥ sṛṇyasibhyāṃ vinā kvacit || 11 ||
digvarṇā (mū, a: digdaṇḍā) jaṭilāstryakṣāḥ sthūlatri (mū, a, kh: stūratrī; gh: stūrastrī) śaladhāriṇaḥ | puṭāñjalikarāḥ sarve vidyeśāścaikavaktrakāḥ || 12 ||
someśvaraḥ (asya 5 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-) (prathama)
sitaścaturbhujastryakṣaḥ kajastho bhūṣaṇānvitaḥ | varābhayakapālābjajaṭendvajinanāgabhṛt || 13 ||
someśvaraḥ (asya 6 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-) (dvitīyaḥ)
kāryaḥ someśvaro raktaścaturāsyo'ṣṭabāhukaḥ | dakṣiṇe śūlanistriśakuṭhārābhayadhārakaḥ || 14 ||
ghaṇṭākapālakhaṭvāṅgapāśahastastu vāmake | muṇḍamālī śavārūḍho dvaitādvaite kramānmataḥ || 15 ||
nāṭyeśvaraḥ ( asya. 7 saṃ. ci. dra0) (-)
pīnāṅgaṃ yauvanodbhinnaṃ daśabāhuṃ (g: daśa dhāṅga) trilocanam | saumyaṃ prahasitāsyaṃ ca candramauliṃ jaṭādharam || 16 ||
vyāghracarmāṃśukaṃ śāntaṃ vyālayajñopavītinam | nāgendramekhalāyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam (kh: maṇḍitam) || 17 ||
ūrdhvameḍhraṃ mahādīptaṃ vaiśākhakaraṇe sthitam | nṛtyantaṃ mahāhṛṣṭamāyudhākula (mū, a: māyudhojjvala) pāṇinam || 18 ||
daṇḍāsiśaktiśūlāni bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe kare | balanākārakaṃ bāhumekaṃ kṛtvā hṛdi sthitam || 19 ||
kapālaṃ caiva khaṭvāṅgaṃ kheṭakaṃ nāganāyakam | vāme pratānitabhujaṃ samyak kṛtvā suśobhanam || 20 ||
kapālamālinaṃ divyaṃ suprasannaṃ subhūtidam | (koṣṭhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ k. pustake nāsti) sarvaśāntikaraṃ kuryādityevaṃ saumyarūpakam || 21 ||
vṛṣasthitaṃ haraṃ kuryāddevāsurasamāvṛtam | skandanandimahākālagaṇeśagaṇasaṃyutam || 22 ||
kūṣmāṇḍādyapsarobhiśca vṛtaṃ vidyādharādibhiḥ | sānandai rūpasampannairvīkṣyamāṇaṃ maheśvaram (kh, gh: vīkṣamāṇairmaheśvara) || 23 ||
divyāmbaraparīdhānaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ | tadagre ca pranṛtyaṃśca bhṛṅgīkāryaṃ kṛśo bhṛśaḥ || 24 ||
puraḥ prāṅmadhyato'nte ca dīptogrāḥ kāmarūpikāḥ (mū, a, k, kh: dīptāṅgāḥ saumyarūpikāḥ) | vikṛtāstīkṣṇanāsāścacaurāgnyādipradāḥ (kh: prapadāḥ) kramāt || 25 ||
yathārkasya bhavedrūpamādimadhyāntasaṃsthitam | harasyaivaṃ bhavedarcā sthāne sthāne phalapradā || 26 ||
caṇḍabhairavaḥ (asya 8 saṃ0 ci0 dra0)
vṛtanetraṃ ca pītāṅgaṃ piṅgabhrūśmaśrumūrdhajam | bhrukuṭībhīṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lelihānaṃ ca draṃṣṭriṇam || 27 ||
muṇḍamālākulaṃ divyaṃ kapālābharaṇojjvalam | nāgopavītinaṃ dīptaṃ nāgābharaṇabhūṣitam || 28 ||
vīrāsanaṃ śavasthaṃ ca gajacarmottarīyakam | caturdaśakaraikāsyaṃ saumyaṃ vyāghrājināmbaram || 29 ||
śūlāsiśaktibāṇāṃśca śāntikaṃ dakṣiṇe kare | khaṭvāṅgaṃ kheṭakaṃ pāśaṃ cāpābhayakapālakam || 30 ||
bibhrāṇaṃ vāmahastena (gh: haste ca) dvayośca gajacarma tu | mātṛbhūtānvitaṃ kuryādbhairavaṃ śāntikārakam || 31 ||
aghoraghaṇṭeśabhairavaḥ (asya 9 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
etatsarvasamāyuktaṃ kulisamudgarādhikam | kuryādaghoraghaṇṭeśaṃ dviraṣṭabhujamaṇḍitam || 32 ||
(koṣṭhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ gh. pustake vartate, anyeṣu nāsti) aṣṭavaktraṃ mahārūpaṃ digvarṇaṃ jinalocanam | upaviṣṭaṃ sadā kṛṣṇaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam || 33 ||
andhakāntakabhairavaḥ (asya 10 saṃ0 ci. dra0) (-)
uccālīḍhaṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: ūrdhvālīḍha) sthitaṃ kruddhaṃ prāgrūpaṃ pañcavaktrakam | aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ kuryādvaradābhaya (g: bhavadābhaya) varjitam || 34 ||
pāṇidvayasthasacchūlasaṃbhinnāndhakadānavam | ghṇṭāṃ ḍamarukaṃ caiva kuṭhāraṃ mudgaraṃ (k, g: mudgalaṃ) tathā || 35 ||
dhārayantaṃ sphuraddaṃṣṭraṃ bhairavaṃ tvandhakāntakam | sarvaśatruharaṃ nityaṃ mātṛbhiḥ parivāritam || 36 ||
vaidyanāthaḥ (asya 11 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
ṣaḍbhujaṃ jaṭilaṃ śvetaṃ trinetraṃ candrabhūṣitam (kh: candramaulinam) | vyāghrājināṃśuka saumyaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam || 37 ||
triśūlaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca (gh: tu) kapālaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ kramāt | yāmye saumye ca bibhrāṇa dvābhyāṃ vyākhyānakaṃ tathā || 38 ||
padmāsanasthitaṃ kuryādvaidyanāthaṃ haraṃ prabhum (kh: vibhum) | gauraṃ sitāmbaraṃ śāntaṃ kamaṇḍalusamanvitam || 39 ||
dhanvantari suṣeṇaṃ tu vānarāsyaṃ narāṅgakam | amṛtāgamahastaṃ ca kuryāttatpārśvayoḥ sadā || 40 ||
sadāśiva (asya 12 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
sadāśivaṃ tadākāraṃ (kh: tathā kālaṃ) kuṇḍikādyavivarjitam | ardhacandrāsanāsīnaṃ śvetarājīvamadhyagam || 41 ||
dalāṣṭake ca vidyeśairanantādyaiśca dikṣu ca | vidikṣu caika (mū, a: caiva) rudrādyaistathā gauryādibhirgaṇaiḥ | divyasiṃhāsanāsīnaṃ brahmādyaiḥ parivāritam || 42 ||
mṛtyuñjayaḥ (asya 13 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
trinetraṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ (kh, gh: ṣaṭkaraṃ) śāntaṃ jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍitam | kapālamālinaṃ śvetaṃ yogāsanaṃ kajasthitam || 43 ||
vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ rudraṃ nāgendrorasi bhūṣitam | triśūlaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca (kh, gh: tu) bibhrāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe kare || 44 ||
kapālaṃ kuṇḍikāṃ savye yogamudrāṃ karadvaye | kuryānmṛtyuñjayaṃ devaṃ mṛtyurogavināśakam (mū, a, g: -śanam) || 45 ||
ardhanārīśvaraḥ (asya 14 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
ūrdhvastho dvibhujaḥ kāryastvardhanārīśvaro haraḥ | vāmāṅge lalanā kāryā yoṣidābharaṇānvitā || 46 ||
dakṣiṇe puruṣastryakṣo jaṭānāgendrasaṃyutaḥ | īśe śūlaṃ kapālaṃ ca vāme jāpyamathotpalam || 47 ||
umeśvaraḥ (asya 15 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
ardhacandrāsanābjastho jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍitaḥ | kuṇḍalālaṅkṛtaḥ saumyo dvibhujo dvipicarmabhṛt || 48 ||
vāmorusthasurūpomā vāmapāṇirnigūḍhakaḥ | mithaḥ saṃvīkṣyamāṇāsyo yāmyahastasthitotpalaḥ || 49 ||
devīyāmyakarāśliṣṭaḥ skandhārko darpaṇe'pare (?) | vidheyaḥ śāstravidvadbhirūrdhvaliṅga umeśvaraḥ || 50 ||
rudrāḥ (asya 16, 17 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
ajaikapādahirbudhnyo virūpākṣo virocanaḥ | haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaśca sureśvaraḥ || 51 ||
jayanto daśamo rudraḥ śukaprabho'parājitaḥ | sadyaḥ prabhṛtijau dvau dvau tadvatkuḍyabjasaṃyutāḥ || 52 ||
(cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃpāṭhaḥ kh. pustake nāsti) ekādaśa kvacidrudrā himakundendusannibhāḥ | jaṭendumaṇḍitāḥ saumyāstryakṣāḥ sarpopavītinaḥ | vṛṣasthā varadāḥ kuṇḍīśūlapaṅkajapāṇayaḥ || 53 ||
viṣṇuḥ (caturbhuja, dvibhuja, aṣṭabhuja, nārāyaṇasya krameṇa 18, 19, 20. saṃ. ci. dra.-)
caturdvyaṣṭabhujaṃ cāru kuryādvā viṣṇurūpakam | śaṅkhacakrabhṛtaṃ vāme śeṣe śāntigadābhṛtam (gh: karam) || 54 ||
pītakauśeyavastrāḍhyamindīvarasamaprabham | śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ pīnāṅgaṃ pṛthuvakṣasam || 55 ||
kirīṭakuṇḍalopetaṃ vanamālopaśobhitam | prasannavadanaṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || 56 ||
ūrdhvaṃ vābjasthitaikāsyaṃ tārkṣyasthaṃ vā catuṣkaram | śaṅkhacakradhare kārye (gh: dharau kāryau) tatsaumyāgneyapārśvataḥ || 57 ||
sarasvatīśriyau tadvadvīṇāpadma (mū, a, g: dharma) kare kramāt | vāme'bhayapradaṃ śeṣe śaṅkhahastaṃ dvibhāhukam || 58 ||
saumyarūpaṃ gṛhe kuryāllambapāṇiṃ śubhapradam (mū, a, k, g, gh, ṅ: śukaprabham) | kruddha udyatahastaśca prāsādasthaḥ sadā mataḥ || 59 ||
nīlavarṇaścaturvaktro bhṛśaṃ caivāruṇekṣaṇaḥ | sandaṣṭauṣṭhapuṭaḥ kruddho viṣṇuraṣṭabhujo mataḥ || 60 ||
gadākhaḍgeṣuśāntiśca bibhrāṇo dakṣiṇe kare | cakraṃ cāpaṃ ca khetaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ vāmakare tathā || 61 ||
viṣṇuścaturbhujo mālī śaṅkhacakragadābjabhṛt | ekāsyaścaturāsyaśca trimukho vā maye mate || 62 ||
matsyaḥ (asya 21 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
dairghyaṃ kṛtvāṣṭadhā dravyamūrdhvādhomukhapucchakam | tattryaṃśavistaraṃ caiva puccho'dhaṃ saptabhāgaśaḥ || 63 ||
sūtrasya bhramaṇātpṛṣṭhaṃ (k, kh: bhramaṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ) tadvajjaṭharavartanam | hastau kroḍasamīpasthau pādau jaṭharapārśvataḥ || 64 ||
hastāṅghrī dvitribhāgābhyāmardhāṃśenāsyakalpanam | ardhāṅgulaṃ tu tannetraṃ dvisārdhaikārdhabhāgataḥ || 65 ||
mastakāddvidalaṃ tasya krameṇa pravibhajya ca (mū, a, k: tu) | śeṣaṃ rohitavatkuryānmatsyarūpadhare vibhau (k, kh, g, gh, ṅ: harervidhau) || 66 ||
kūrmaḥ (asya 22 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
vedāsrakoṇasūtrārdhaṃ tadvedāṃśaiḥ prakalpya ca | taddvyaṃśamadhyato vṛttaṃ kalāhīnaṃ tu pārśvayoḥ || 67 ||
ūrdhvādhayoḥ śirogrīvā pucchaṃ śeṣe karāṅghrike | dviguṇaṃ pādato dairghyādgrīvāṃ mastakasaṃyutām || 68 ||
pṛṣṭhaṃ samunnataṃ cāru pṛthuvedāṃśatodaram (mū, a, k, g, gh, ṅ: dalam) | nāsākṣinakhakarṇādi jñātvā kūrmaṃ vivartayet || 69 ||
varāhaḥ (asya 23 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
kandharāṣṭāṅgulāyāmā vadanaṃ golakāṣṭakam | hanū tadvaktrabhāge ca dairghyātsaptāṅgulau matau || 70 ||
saptāṅgulāsyaniṣkrāntaṃ mātraikā nāsikābilam | daṃṣṭre ca tryaṅgule vaktre sitarṣikalikopame || 71 ||
karṇocchrāyau dvinetraṃ ca tanmadhye ṣoḍaśāṅgulam | prāṅmānādyavahīnaṃ tu cakragāruṇalocanam (gh: locane) || 72 ||
āpādakaṇṭhaparyantaṃ nararūpaṃ caturbhujam | gadācakrābjaśaṅkhāḍhyamālīḍhakaraṇe sthitam || 73 ||
śrīrvāma (mū, a, g: grīvāṃ sa) kurparasthā tu kṣmānantau caraṇānugau | evaṃ varāharūpaṃ syādvanamālāvibhūṣitam || 74 ||
nṛsiṃha (asya 24 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
pūrvarūpaṃ ghanaṃ śvetamuccaskandhaṃ sakesaram | narāṅgaṃ (gh: varāṅgaṃ) siṃhavaktraṃ ca vṛttākṣaṃ bhrukuṭīyutam (mū, a, k, g, gh, ṅ: mukham) || 75 ||
vivṛtāsyogradaṃṣṭraṃ ca vāmorukṛtadānavam | tadvakṣo dārayantaṃ ca sphuraccakragadādharam || 76 ||
grasantamiva lokāṃstrīn duḥ sahaṃ dīptatejasam (kh: locanam) | vanamālānvitaṃ kuryānnarasiṃhaṃ jagatprabhum || 77 ||
vāmanaḥ (asya 25 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
prāṅmānaṃ vāmanaṃ kuryād dvibhujaṃ chatradhāriṇam | jaṭilaṃ kuṇḍikāyuktaṃ gauraṃ śyāmāruṇekṣaṇam || 78 ||
trivikramaḥ (asya 26 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
caturbhujaṃ gadāpāṇiṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ vibhum | vāmāṅghryākrāntaviśvaṃ ca tadbhedaṃ tu (mū, a, k: ca) trivikramam || 79 ||

dvibāhuṃ jaṭilaṃ tūṇīkuṭhāreṣu dhanuryutaḥ | śyāmavarṇo bṛhadvakṣo rāmaḥ kṣatrāntakārakaḥ || 80 ||
rāmabhadraḥ (asya 28 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
saumyarūpo viśālākṣaḥ kiñcitpīno dvibāhukaḥ | jaṭī cāpeṣuhastaśca rāmaḥ kāryo daśāsyahṛt || 81 ||
valabhadraḥ (asya 29 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)

śāntātmā lambakarṇaśca gaurāṅgaścīvarāvṛtaḥ | ūrdhvapadmasthito buddho varadābhayakārakaḥ || 83 ||
kalkī (asya 31 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
dhanustūṇānvitaḥ (kh: tālānvitaḥ; gh: skolānvitaḥ) kalkī mlecchotsādakaro dvijaḥ | gauro vājisthitaḥ khaḍgī kvacitpiṅgalalocanaḥ || 84 ||
daśadhāhariḥ-
matsyakūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ | rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca buddhaḥ kalkī ca te daśa || 85 ||
keśavaḥ (asya 32 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
otaprotāstrayogena (anulomavilomenetyarthaḥ) mūrtibhedo nigadyate | ūrdhvādhaḥ karayoḥ śaṅkhapadme dakṣiṇato mate (k, kh: dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ) || 86 ||
gadācakre tvadhaścordhvaṃ vāmapāṇyoryathākramam | jvaladagnisamākāraṃ kuryātkeśavarūpakam || 87 ||
nārāyaṇaḥ (asya 33 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
ūrdhvādhaḥ padmaśaṅkhau ca karayordakṣayostathā | vāmayośca gadācakre nīlaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vapuḥ || 88 ||
mādhavaḥ (asya 34 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
sudarśanagade cordhvamadhaścaivāpasavyayoḥ | savyayoḥ kambupadme ca mādhave rukmasannibhe || 89 ||
govindaḥ (asya 35 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
cakraṃ gadā tvadhaścordhvaṃ vāmayoḥ karayoḥ kramāt | ūrdhvādhobjaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca govinde piṅgalātmake (kh: piṅgalāṅgake) || 90 ||
viṣṇuḥ (asya 36 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
śaṅkhamūrdhvamadhaścakraṃ gadā cordhvamadho'mbujam | vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ kuryātsite viṣṇau kvacinmate || 91 ||
madhusūdanaḥ (asya 37 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
urdhvādhaścakraśaṅkhau ca kramāddakṣiṇahastayoḥ | vāmayośca gadāpadme candrābhe madhusūdane || 92 ||
trivikramaḥ (asya 38 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
dakṣiṇopari haste ca gadā deyāmbujaṃ tvadhaḥ | cakramūrdhvamadhaḥ śaṅkhaṃ gaure pūrvatrivikrame || 93 ||
vāmanaḥ (asya 39 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
uparyadhaśca cakraṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ dakṣiṇahastayoḥ | gadābje śeṣayoḥ pīte vāmane pūrvarūpake || 94 ||
śrīdharaḥ (asya 40 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
dakṣiṇordhvakare cakraṃ kuryādabjamadhaḥ kare | gadāśaṅkhaṃ tathā vāme śrīdhare vidrumopame || 95 ||

śaṅkhapadmamadhastūrdhvaṃ gadācakraṃ yathākramam | suvarṇābhe hṛṣīkeśe pāṇyoḥ savyāpasavyayoḥ || 96 ||
padmanābhaḥ (asya 42 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)

dvādaśadhāhariḥ-
vāsudevāttrayo jātāstrayaḥ saṃkarṣaṇātkramāt | pradyumnāccāniruddhācca vijñātavyāstrayastrayaḥ || 99 ||
pītāmbaradharāḥ sarve vanamālopaśobhitāḥ | mārgādikārtikāntaṃ ca proktā dvādaśamūrtayaḥ || 100 ||
vāsudevaḥ (asya 44 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
śāntaṃ sitaṃ kajārūḍhaṃ vāsudevaṃ caturbhujam | yogamudrāṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca gadācakradharaṃ dvayam || 101 ||
vāmamuṣṭyardhamaṅguṣṭhe dakṣiṇo'ṅguṣṭhaveṣṭanam | mudrāṃ kuryāddhṛdisthāṃ ca aśeṣāghapraṇāśinīm || 102 ||
(saṃkarṣaṇaḥ, pradyumnaḥ, aniruddhaḥ, (eṣāṃ 45, 46, 47 saṃ. ci. dra.)
caturdoścāruhemābhaṃ kuryātsaṃkarṣaṇaṃ vibhum | pātraśāntidharaṃ yāmye vāmake padmasīriṇau || 103 ||

tadvadbrahmā ca viṣṇuśca narasiṃhaśca sūkaraḥ | ebhiryuktaṃ navavyūhaṃ jñātavyaṃ daiśikottamaiḥ || 106 ||
dattātreyaḥ (asya 48 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
dattātreyaṃ vibhuṃ (kh, gh: hariṃ) kuryāddvibhujaṃ yauvanānvitam | vāmotsaṅgadhṛtaśrīkamardhacandrāsane sthitam || 107 ||
vāmapāṇidhṛtāmbhojāṃ surūpā (kh: subhru vā) māyatekṣaṇām | taddakṣiṇaṃ karaṃ skandhe devadevasya dakṣiṇe || 108 ||
savyāśliṣṭapriyaḥ kāryo dakṣiṇe madyapātrakam | padmastho ghūrṇitākṣaśca gātṛnartanakairvṛtaḥ || 109 ||
dattātreyastvayaṃ (k: dattātreyaḥ svayaṃ) vīro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ | advaitena vidhānena pūjanīyo vipaścitā || 110 ||
jalaśāyī (asya 49 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
pītavāsāścaturbāhuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | yoganidrāparāvasthaḥ (kh: dharāvasthaḥ) supto'nantatanūpari || 111 ||
phaṇāsaptānvito'nantaḥ kāryo mastopari prabhoḥ | pādalagnā dharādevī jalaśāyī grahāvṛtaḥ || 112 ||
padmanābhaḥ (asya 50 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
padmanābhaḥ śriyāyukto bhogitalpagato'pi vā | ābhyutthapaṅkajārūḍhaḥ pitāmahasamanvitaḥ || 113 ||
kāmaḥ (asya 51 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
kāmo (gh: kāryo) gauro yuvā kānto ratiprītyostu madhyataḥ | sā līḍho nandane rāgī sadā cāpeṣubhṛcchubhaḥ (gh: bhṛtsutaḥ) || 114 ||
garuḍaḥ (asya 52 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
upendrasyāgrataḥ pakṣī guḍākeśaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ | tuṅgaghrāṇo (k, kh: tuṅgaghoṇā) narāṅghirvā pakṣijaṅgho narāṅgakaḥ || 115 ||
kṛṣṇāsagghemacandrābho mūrdhādau phaṇibhūṣitaḥ | vāmajānugato bhūmau tārkṣyaḥ pakṣasamanvitaḥ || 116 ||
viśvaksenaḥ (asya 53 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
indīvaranibhaścakrī pītavāso gadānvitaḥ | halaśaṅkhavaro mālī viśvakseno harergaṇaḥ || 117 ||
baladevaḥ (asya 54 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
ūrdhvaṃ śvetaṃ caturbāhuṃ sahābhogaṃ halāyudham | padmasīradharaṃ vāme śeṣe muśalagodvaham (k, kh: khādyayugodvaham) || 118 ||
haraharī (hariharau, ityapi pāthaḥ | asya0 55 saṃ. ci. dra.)
jaṭārdhamukuṭārdhe ca nordhaliṅgena (gh: nordhva) cānvitam (?) | ardhe'rdhe bhūṣaṇaiḥ svaiḥ svairyuktamūrdhvaṃ kajasthitam || 119 ||
caturbhujaṃ mahātmānaṃ jaṭārdhārdhendubhūṣitam | akṣamālāṃ triśūlaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca kaumudīṃ kramāt || 120 ||
dakṣiṇottarapāṇibhyāṃ bibhrāṇamadha ūrdhvataḥ | puṃstrīsvarūpakaṃ kuryācchivanārāyaṇātmakam || 121 ||
brahmavargaḥ (asya 56 saṃ0 ci0 dra0 | atra tu ekasyaiva brahmaṇaścitraṃ vartate na brahmavargasya-)
caturmukhaṃ caturbāhuṃ lambakūrcaṃ mahodaram | brahmāṇaṃ vratinaṃ kuryājjaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitam (kh: bhūṣaṇam) || 122 ||
piṅgākṣaṃ saumyarūpaṃ ca sottarīyopavītikam | kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca tatskandhe vastraṃ cājinavāsasam || 123 ||
akṣamālāṃ śruvaṃ tasya daṇḍaṃ vā dakṣiṇe kare | sruvaṃ (gh: srucaṃ) kamaṇḍaluṃ vāme sakuśājyaghaṭaṃ tathā || 124 ||
haṃsārūḍhaṃ kajasthaṃ vā yogapaṭṭāsanā (mū: yogapadmāsanā) nvitam | gāyatrīṃ caiva sāvitrīmṛṣīṃstatpārśvayostathā || 125 ||
jaṭilāṃllambakūrcāṃśca vṛddharūpāṃśca lomaśān | riktavakṣo'kṣikukṣīṃśca sākṣamālākamaṇḍalūn || 126 ||
caṇḍī (asya 57 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
hemābhāṃ rūpiṇīṃ kuryāttrinetrāṃ yauvanasthitām | kruddhāmūrdhvasthitāṃ cāru kuryādviṃśatibāhukām || 127 ||
śūlāsiśakticakrāṇīṣuśaṅkhendrāyudhābhayāḥ | ḍamaruṃ śastrikāṃ yāmye haste sa bibhratīṃ sadā || 128 ||

navadurgāḥ (asya citrasaṃgrahapustake durgā nāmnā navadurgā nāmnā ca citradvayaṃ vartate, 59, 60 sa. ci. dra0) (-)
navapadmātmake sthāne pūjyā durgā svamūrtitaḥ | ādau madhye tathendrādau navatattvākṣaraiḥ kramāt || 134 ||
aṣṭādaśabhujaiḥ kāntapīnavakṣaḥ stanorukā | mūrdhajaṃ kheṭakaṃ ghaṇṭāmādarśaṃ tarjanīṃ dhanuḥ || 135 ||
dhvajaṃ ḍamarukaṃ pāśaṃ bibhratī vāmake'nyataḥ | śaktimudgaraśūlaṃ ca vajraṃ khaḍgamathāṅkuśam || 136 ||
śaraṃ cakraṃ śalākāṃ ca etairevāyudhairyutā | śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśahastāśca añjanī (mū: añjalī) ḍamaruṃ vinā || 137 ||
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā | caṇḍā caṇḍavatī caiva caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā || 138 ||
navamīcaṇḍikā cogrā (gh: navamī caṇḍacogrā) madhyasthāgnipramoditā | rocanābhāruṇā kṛṣṇā nīlā śuklā ca dhūmrikā (kh: sūkṣmā ca dhūmikā) || 139 ||
pītā ca pānḍurā (gh: pāṇḍarā) jñeyā ālīḍhasthā haristhitā | mahiṣotthaḥ pumāñśastrī tatkacagrahamuṣṭikāḥ || 140 ||

umā (citrasaṃgrahe pustake umāyā gaurī nāmnā citraṃ vartate | atraiva lalitāsarvamaṅgalākaiṭabhyādīnāṃ cāntarhitatvāt tattannāmnā 61, 62, 63, 64, saṃ. ci. dra0 |-)

skandhamūrdhvakarā (k, g: sūtrakarā) vāme dvitīye dhṛtadarpaṇā | yāmye phalāñjanīhastā saubhāgyā tatra cordhvikā (mū, a: cordhikā) || 144 ||

kālarātrī (asya 65 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)

vāmapāde ca sallohakṛtakhaḍakabhūṣaṇā | navatyūrdhva (mū, a, k, kh: vardhanyūrdhva) vajā kṛṣṇā kālarātrī bhayaṅkarī || 150 ||
mahāśrīḥ (asya 66 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
