līlāvatī ca dakṣasthā (mū: yakṣasthā | ṝkṣasthā, iti sādhuḥ pāṭhaḥ, citre'yi bhallukāsane sthitā |) līlā raktajaṭānvitā | bibhrāṇā paṭṭiśaṃ pāśaṃ vāme mastārdhamambujam || 345 ||
mūṣārūḍhā layā raktā yāmye daṇḍāsidhāriṇī | kartarīkārdhabhṛdvāme tarjanyākṛṣṭasṛkkikā || 346 ||
katarīṃ mārjanīṃ sūryaṃ saumye picchaṃ nṛkaṃ kare | śūlaṃ ruruyutaṃ dvābhyāṃ dhatte lolā sūsārase (?) || 347 ||
vāme lulāyamuṇḍaṃ ca tatpaśyantyasṛgraktakam | laṅkeśorusthitā laṅkā carvantīṃ (mū: varṣantī) piśitaṃ ghanam || 348 ||
saphaṇā (mū, a, g: triphalā)sakakheṭendro modakāṃsi ca dakṣiṇe | śoṇā laṅkeśvarī kuṇḍe ūrdhvabālāṃ ca (mū: ūrvālācaraṇe) bibhratī || 349 ||
dakṣiṇe varadaścakraṃ vāme kaṃ kambujaṃ (mū, a, k, g, gh, ṅ: kambukaṃ) kare | bibhrāṇā kolagā raktā lālāsṛglālāsā matā || 350 ||
dvipasthā vimalā raktā tryakṣālaṅkārabhūṣitā | kartarīkumbhabhṛdyāme saumye pāśakapālinī (kh: kadhāriṇī) || 351 ||
yāmyāṣṭakā (āsāṃ0 206 taḥ 213 saṃ0 ci0 dra0 |-)
kṛṣṇā hutāśanājasthā jvālinī dakṣiṇe sruvā | vāme cābhayahastā syādviṣṭarājyaghaṭānvitā || 352 ||
śūkarāsyā viśālākṣī yoṣitskandhasthitā sitā | kartaryabhayabhṛdyāmye vāme kaṇṭākapālinī || 353 ||
mīnāsyā mīnasaṃsthā ca huṅkārā sākṣamālikā | musalaṃ bibhratī yāmye somye ca phalapallavau || 354 ||
paryaṅkā vaḍavāsyā syādaṅkābhyāṃ bibhratī śiśa | samatsya (gh: samatse)kārdhabhṛdvāme matsyamanyatra vāsitā || 355 ||
tarjanyabhayabhṛtsaumye (k, g: saumye ca) yāmye daṇḍakapālinī (kh: kadhāriṇī) | hāhāravā sitā krūrā rāsabhāsyā kharāsanā (mū, a, g, gh: kharānanā) || 356 ||
lulāyāsyā lulāyasthā mahākrūrā sitā bhavet | vāme masīghaṭīṃ pāśaṃ lekhanīdaṇḍabhṛttataḥ || 357 ||
māṃsakhaṇḍaṃ kare yāmye khādantī krodhanā sitā | vāme samadiraṃ pātraṃ (g: śūlaṃ) bibhratī jambuke sthitā || 358 ||
kṛṣṇā bhayānanā gṛghre daṃṣṭogrāsthivibhūṣitā | yāmye'syāḥ khiṅkhirīṃ (?) śūlaṃ kharparaṃ lelihānyataḥ || 359 ||
naṝtyāṣṭakā (āsāṃ0 214 taḥ 221 saṃ0 ci0 dra0 |-)
kaṃśūlapustabhṛdvāme muṇḍaṃ ḍamarukaṃ śabam | bibhrāṇobhājina (ibha arjinam iti cchedaḥ |) dvābhyāṃ sarvajñā pretagāsitā || 360 ||
jānukṣiptau karau nyasya udyantī taralāyatā (k: u(/)dmatī taraṇāyatā) (?) | śalaḍamaruhastā ca godhāgā taralāsitā || 361 ||
tārāgaṇairvṛtā tārā kṛṣṇolūka sthitā nṛkam | śavārdhaṃ bibhratī saumye śūlaṃ mugdaramanyataḥ || 362 ||
ṝgvedābjasthitā kṛṣṇā jñānamudrāṃca bibhratī | dakṣiṇo jāpyayāmālāṃ ca vāme pusta kamaṇḍalum || 363 ||
kabandhasthāsitā raudrā turagāsyā hayānanā (k: hayāsanā) | śūrpamuṇḍakarā yāmye'nyatra śephālikākabhṛt || 364 ||
chinnahastaśave kṛṣṇā sārā sthūlajaṭādharā | khadvāṅgaṃ rurukaṃ saumye śūlolke bibhratī tataḥ || 365 ||
śavasthā rasasaṅgrāhī (k: varasaṅgrāhī) nṛtyantī jaṭilāsitā | kaśūlāndhakakaṅkālabhṛdadvayo ścamavāsinī || 366 ||
śave tadṛgdvije pṛṣṭhe kaniṣṭhā saravāsitā (?)(mū: bhavanā; kh, gh: śavarā) | vāme karoghadhāpāśaṃ(k, kh, g: dyathānāsaṃ; gh: pavānāsaṃ)ghaṇṭeśūlkadharānyathaḥ || 367 ||
vāruṇāṣṭakā (āsāṃ0 222 taḥ 229 saṃ0 ci0 dra0 |-)
tārkṣyasthā tālajaṅghākhyā sukāntā sphaṭikaprabhā | śaṅkhakheṭakahastogrā yāmye svastikakhaḍgabhṛt || 368 ||
gaṇḍāruḍhāca raktākṣī raktāpānā śaśiprabhā | gadādhvajadharā yāmye vāme pāśakapālabhṛt || 369 ||
vidyujjihvā sitā krūrā savye sīrakapālabhṛt (mū: kapālinī) | cakrasthā cakrakaṭṭārīdhārīṇī (kh: cakravākaśca cakrasthā) dakṣiṇe kare || 370 ||
grāhasthā cāmaracchatrabhṛddūtīyugasaṃyutā | kumbhapāśadharāśvetā kroḍaputrā karaṅkiṇī || 371 ||
candrābhā meghanādā syādkhaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī | jalairvṛtā ghanārūḍhā taḍinmaṇḍalamaṇḍitā || 372 ||
nakrasthā syātpracaṇḍogrā yāmye syātkartarīphalam | kapālaṃ muṇḍamanyatra śatrughnāḥ sphaṭikatviṣaḥ || 373 ||
śuklā jhaṣāsanā raudrā bibhratpadmākṣasūtrakam | kālakarṇī jagatkhyātā karṇe kālavibhūṣaṇā || 374 ||
vṛṣadaṃśasthitā śvetā varadā rupunāśinī | kartaryabhayabhradyāmye śūla (gh: pūra) pāśadharānyataḥ || 375 ||
vāyavyāṣṭakā (āsāṃ0 230 taḥ 237 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
candrā haṃsasthitā gaurī vedāsyendvarkayoḥ kramāt | kamaṇḍalukuśavyagrā cātrasūtrasruvānvitā || 376 ||
yāmye'bhayākṣamālābhṛccheṣe'bjadhvajadhāriṇī | candrāvalī ca hemābhā kṛṣṇasāramṛgāsanā || 377 ||
phalasraganvitā yāmye kambukuṇḍīdharānyataḥ | gajayānā prapañcākhyā gaurī viśvaprapañcikā || 378 ||
kapisthā sāndraśākhābhṛtkhāmbarā pralayāntikā | khādantyāmraphalaṃ nityaṃ kapyāsyā gaura varṇinī || 379 ||
picuvaktrā mṛgavyālapiṅgalā yāmyasaumyayoḥ | bhindipālakakheṭābhyāṃ prāsāsibhyāṃ ca saṃyutā (gh: saṃyuge) || 380 ||
kākāsyā śyenagā gaurī piśācī raktamaṇḍitā (k, g: vaktramaṇḍitā) | kaṃ phalaṃ kartarīṃ khaḍgaṃ bibhratī saumyayāmyayoḥ || 381 ||
phalatūladharā vāme yāmye śastrāsidhāriṇī | kharasthā babhruvarṇa syātpiśitāśātidurbalā || 382 ||
nṛtyantī lolupā pītā rathasthā yāmyasaumyayoḥ | dhvana iḍamaru(gh: dhvajaṃ ḍamaru)kartaryau pāśaṃ picchaṃ ca bibhratī || 383 ||
uttarāṣṭakā (āsāṃ0 238 taḥ 245 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
gadāpaṭṭiśabhṛtsaumye śūlatomariṇī tataḥ | vamanī (g: ramaṇī) puṣpakasthā syādgaurī yakṣagaṇānvitā || 384 ||
sarpāsyā sarpagā svaṅgī (gh: vaṅgā) gautyugrā tapanī varā | svaphaṇā(k, g: suphaṇā)yāna bhāje (k: nubhogā; kh: dhārabhāge) ca nyastahastā bhavediyam || 385 ||
pītā gehākhuge bhāsyā vāmanī bibhratī kare | kuṭhāraṃ laḍḍukaṃ vāme'kṣamālī panasaṃ tataḥ || 386 ||
śūlabhinnalulāyasya siṃhākṛṣṭaśarīriṇāḥ | jihvābhṛdvajriṇī pītā caturdorvikṛtānanā || 387 ||
śaṅkhapūraṇikā dvābhyāṃ nṛkābhayakarādvayoḥ | dvihaṃsavadrathasthā syāttālābhā vāyuvegikā || 388 ||
bhāsasthā syādvṛhatkukṣiḥ saumye muṇḍakapālabhṛt | mahākāyā ca gauryaṅka(mū: gauryarka)kartarī bhṛnnṛkādanī || 389 ||
uṣṭrasthā bikṛtā gaurī bhayakṛdvikṛtānanā | tūraṃ ḍamaruṃ yāmye'syāḥ śeṣe khaṭvāṅgamastakam || 390 ||
kheṭaśaṅkhābjabhṛdvāme gadācakrāsibhṛttataḥ | vīndrasthā (vīndrapakṣirājaḥ) viśvarūpā syāddhemābhā vanamālinī || 391 ||
aiśānyaṣṭakā (āsāṃ0 243 taḥ 253 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
musalaṃ mugdaraṃ yāmye paraśuṃ bandhanaṃ tataḥ | bibhratī yamajihvākhyā karālā mahiṣasdhitā || 392 ||
nṛtyantī vṛṣagā ścetā yāmye ḍamarūtūlabhṛt (gh: tūra bhṛt) | sadaityamuṇḍaśūlogrā (li. pu: sadaityaśūlamuṇḍogrā) jayantī vāmahastayoḥ || 293 ||
khaḍgakuntayutā (gh: kumbhīdyatā; mū: kuṇḍayutā) raudrāścāruḍhā durjayā matā | nānābhūtāvṛtā śvetā durgakānanasaṃsthitā || 294 ||
śūlabāṇadharā yāmye dhanuḥ śaktidharā (k, kh: karā) tataḥ | śakaṭasthātidhorāsyā kṣīravarṇā yamāntikā (mū, a: yavāntikā) || 395 ||
mārjārasthā viḍālī ca viḍālākṣī (kh, gh: viśālākṣī) bhavetsitā | vāme karaṃ (k, kh, g, gh: tūraṃ) ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ śūlaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ (gh: ghaṇṭaṃ) ca bibhratī || 296 ||
kṛśā piśācavakratrogrā pretasthā revatī (gh: potasthā raivatī) matā | triśūlayaṣṭi (k, kh, g, gh, ṅ: kaṃ śalayaṣṭi)bhṛdyāmye bhindipālagadāsibhṛt || 397 ||
kundābhā pretanā tryakṣā vikṛtāsthā savasthitā | kartarīśūlabhṛtsūrye (saumye) vāme muṇḍakapālabhṛt || 398 ||
ścetavarṇā bṛṣasthā ca vijayā vijayapradā | śūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ yāmye'syāḥ kārdhakhaṭvāṅgadhṛk tataḥ || 399 ||
divyāmbaradharāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | kartavyāḥ śilpibhirnityaṃ yoginyo'śeṣasiddhidāḥ || 400 ||
bhairavaḥ (asya0 254 saṃ0 ci0 dra0) (-)
bhairavaścārkahastaḥ syāccaturāsyo jaṭendubhṛt | khaḍgāṅkuśakuṭhāreṣu viśvābhayakṛdarkataḥ (gh: dakṣataḥ) || 401 ||
cāpatriśūlakhaṭvāṅgapāśakārdhakaro'nyataḥ | gajacarmadharo dvābhyāṃ kṛttivāso'hibhūṣitaḥ || 402 ||
tryakṣo daṃṣṭrākarālograḥ pracaṇḍāṭṭāṭṭahāsavān | pralayāmbudavarṇābho muṇḍakāpālamālinaḥ (kaḥ) || 403 ||
kūrmadharāmbupotābja(g: pātrābja)pretahṛdāsanāsthitaḥ (mū: sanasthitaḥ) | caṇḍākhyo mātṛmadhye tu saṃsthitaḥ pītakūrcabhṛt (gh: pīnakūrkhadhṛk) || 404 ||
khavilomāgniparyantaṃ dairghyāt khekaikabhedataḥ (k: dairghyāṣṭaikaikabhedataḥ; gh: dīrghāṣaikaikabheditaḥ) | tatṣaḍaṅgāni (g: taṃtsuta) jātyanataiḥ khānvitaṃ ca kramādyajet || 405 ||
mandirāṅgibalārūḍhaṃ svavarṇānugrahānvitam | nādabindvindusaṃyuktaṃ (k, g: bindusaṃyuktaṃ) mātṛnāthānta (kh: nāthāṅga)dīpitam || 406 ||
saṃkṣepāddevatāmūrtiḥ kathitā vartanī mayā | guhyadevānyarūpāṇāṃ sve sve śāstre viniścayaḥ || 407 ||
ūrdhvāsīnāya yānasthāḥ suptā caivāntarikṣagāḥ | pañcadhā pratimāḥ khyātā mānataḥ saptadhā tathā || 408 ||
ekasminneva dehe syuryathāṅgāni pṛthak pṛthak | tatheśvarātsurā sarve kāryakāraṇabhedataḥ || 409 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye rudrādi vyaktaliṅga vartanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭo vidhiḥ] || 6 ||
[atha saptamaḥ]
vyaktāvyaktaṃ pravakṣyāmi daśabhedairvyavasthitam | pañcāsyādi yathāliṅgaṃ bhavetsuvyaktapañcakam (mū, a: lakṣaṇam) || 1 ||
pañcāsyaṃ caturāsyaṃ ca tridvokāsyaṃ bhavetkramāt | pañcavaktramaniṣṭeṣu caturvaktraṃ sukhāvaham || 2 ||
trivaktraṃ śāntidaṃ nityaṃ dvivaktraṃ cābhicārikam | ekavaktraṃ syādrogaghnaṃ nādhikāmyaṃ calācalam || 3 ||
ekadvitrimukhaṃ vāpi prāsāde pūrvavaktrakam | caturmukhaṃ tu khādhāre (gh: mukhe sukhādhāre; k: tu prasāde) pañcāsyaṃ vā caturmukham || 4 ||
sitottānaṃ trinetraṃ ca maulikuṇḍala(mū: kuntala)śobhitam | liṅgamūrdhnisthita vaktramaiśānaṃ tvīśamīkṣakam (mū: vīkṣakam) || 5 ||
raktavarṇaṃ sutejaskaṃ tryambakaṃ maulimaṇḍitam | siṃhāsyaṃ (gh: siṃhāghraṃ) śmaśrukeśāḍhyaṃ maindraṃ tatpurūṣānanam || 6 ||
kṛṣṇaṃyāmyamaghorāsyaṃ (mū, a, k, g: kṛṣṇavarṇamaghorākhyaṃ) piṅgakūrca subhāsuram (mū, a, k, g: śubhāṃ śubham) | daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ vṛttākṣaṃ jvalatkeśādibhūṣitam || 7 ||
vāmavaktraṃ bhavetpītaṃ saumyaṃ dhanadadiksthitam | kāntālaṅkārakeśādi (k, kh: keśāṃḍhya; g: keśāśca) tilakolakamaṇḍitam || 8 ||
vārūṇāsyaṃ sitaṃ sadyaścandra maulijaṭādharam | tryakṣaṃ pīnaṃ yuvākāraṃ suprasannaṃ suśobhamam || 9 ||
vineśānaṃ caturvaktraṃ trimukhaṃ tvajavarjitam | sadyaḥ puṃbhyāṃ dvivaktraṃ syātpuruṣeṇaikavaktrakam || 10 ||
tulyaviṣkambhataḥ siddhe pūjā bhāgordhva vistṛte (kh: bhāgor'dhavistaraḥ; g: bhāge'rdhavistṛte) | tatvairliṅgaṃ grahairbhakte hṛtvāmbhoṃśo vidikṣu ca || 11 ||
madhyasūtrodbhamā (mū: sūtrabhramā) liṅgaṃ tālapañcakaveṣṭitam | digvibhāgena tadvaktraṃ (mū: tadvaktaṃ) bhūtavedānanaṃ sadā || 12 ||
ajāta (mū: sujāta) vadanadravyaṃ trigolakaṃ triṣu kṣipet | tadvaddyāsye dvimātrākhyamekāsye tritrikāṅgulān || 13 ||
tryāsyamaṣṭādaśāṃśaiśca (mū: saptadaśāsraiśca) liṅgaṃ syādravibhāgataḥ | hṛtvā koṇeṣu randhrāṃśairliṅgaṃ ṣaṭtālaveṣṭitam || 14 ||
dhṛtyaṃśena dvivaktraṃ syānmadhye (gh: tu madhye) liṅgamathaindrakam | (cāpacinhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭho g. pustake nāsti)dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ca tatrāsyaṃ liṅgaṃ saptāsyaveṣṭitam || 15 ||
triṃśadaṅgulavistāraṃ tālamānāsya nirgamam |) navatyaṅgulakaṃ (gh: tryaṅgulakaṃ) vṛttādekāsyaṃ pūrvavaktrakam || 16 ||
pūjāṃśe navadhābhakte liṅgamucce (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: mūrdhve) tribhāgataḥ | tadadhaḥṣaḍvibhāgena śivavaktrāṇi vartayet || 17 ||
tadvaktraṃ (kh: tadvakṣaḥ) skandhayormūlaṃ bhāgaikena galaṃ tathā | cibukoṣṭhau vibhāgena (mū, a, k, kh: ca bhāgena) nāsālalāṭastakam || 18 ||
kramato guṇabhāgena cārūmauliṃ tadūrdhvataḥ | liṅgapārśce dvibhāgena bhāgaṃ tyaktvā tadūrdhvataḥ || 19 ||
jūṭādīṃśca prayatnena pūrvoktā pratimā yathā | pañtrāsyādyekavaktrāntamayameva vidhiḥ punaḥ || 20 ||
vṛttākāraṃ tataḥ śeṣaṃ śiraśdvātrādikaṃ kramāt | pañcānanādikaṃ proktaṃ suvyaktamadhudanocyate || 21 ||
prāguktapañcavaktrāṇi sarvaiṃraṅgairyutāni ca | dvibāhūnyūrdhvadehāni viṣṇavantacaraṇāni ca || 22 ||
kuryāṃcca svadigīśānaṃ sākṣamālātriśūlinam (gh: śānamakṣamālā triśūlakam) | pūrvakāye pumāṃsaṃ tu mātuluṅgākṣaśalinam (k, kh: sūtritam) || 23 ||
yāmye'ghoramanākṣīnaṃ ghaṇṭāśūladharaṃ sadā | stryākāramuktare guhyaṃ darpaṇotpalasaṃyutam || 24 ||
paścime'jātaka rūpa varadābhayapāṇikam | suvyakta pañcadhāhyevamāsyovatābidhisaṃsthitam (mū: saṃyutam) || 25 ||
pañcadvitriyamaikena (gh: pañcācitrayamekenda) sampūrṇaṅga na tatkramāt | evaṃ niṣpādya liṅgāni piṇḍikāṃ vartayettataḥ || 26 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vyaktāvyaktaliṅgānāṃ daśadhā vartanaṃ nāma saptamo vidhiḥ athoṣṭama] || 7 ||
[atha aṣṭamaḥ]
piṇḍikā sāmprataṃ vakṣye athāṣṭamaḥ ca trividhe śubhom | mahatyāḥ prātamāyāśca digliṅgādeśca sādhane || 1 ||
piṇḍikā syādumādevī liṅgaṃ ca parameśvaraḥ | navajñāṃ kārayettasmātkadācidubhayorapi || 2 ||
liṅganāhapravistīrṇā ucchraye viṣṇusammitā | piṇḍikā tu samākhyātā na hīnā nādhikā śubhā || 3 ||
svatānaṣaṣṭhabhāgena (k, kh: svatāla) bāhulyena (gh: bāhalyena)samanvitā | mekhalā tattribhāgena khātaṃ tattryṃśahīnakam || 4 ||
svamānapādahīnaṃ vā trividhaṃ samudāhṛtam (mū: tadudāhṛtam) | madhye vṛttaṃ samālikhya vartayetkhātamādarāt || 5 ||
(canhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭho ga pustake nāsti)bahisthaṃ mavyagaṃ caiva bāhulyaṃ (gh: bāhalyaṃ) sadṛśaṃ yathā | vṛttasūtrātsamārabhya khātaṃ vai hrāsayetkramām || 6 ||)
tāvadyāvacchanairdhyā mekhalākhātamāpnuyāt | arvāg dairghyatribhāgena mekhalāvartanaṃ bahiḥ || 7 ||
praṇālaṃ pīṭhamadhyasthaṃ dairghye (mū: dairghya) mūlatribhāgakam | mukhe tadardhavistāraṃ tantribhāge'mbunirgamaḥ || 8 ||
sthaulyaṃ cāpi praṇālasya jalabhṛddalasaṃthitam | kaṇṭhādūrdhvaṃ sadā hyevamanyathā doṣadāyakam || 9 ||
guhyavaktrasthitaṃ nityaṃ praṇālaṃ cottaraplavam | ṣaṣṭhāṃśaveśanātkaṇṭhaścalānāṃ pañcamena vā || 10 ||
na vedāsrāṣṭakaṃ sarvaṃ pīṭhaṃ śvabhrasamānyathā (mū: catraṃ ca nā; g: pītaṃ putraṃ ca nā; kh: sūtrasamā) | avyakte miśrake svāṃśe (mū: bhyāṃśe; g: dyāṃśe) brahmaviṣṇu(kh, gh: viṣṇo)svarūpataḥ || 11 ||
pīṭhikāvistaratryaṃśe khātaṃ tanmadhyato bhavet | liṅgasthaulyapramāṇena samāsraṃ digvidiksthitam || 12 ||
caturasramathāṣṭāsraṃ brahmaviṣṇuvibhāgataḥ | samantājjyeṣṭhaliṅgasya yavaiḥ ṣaḍbhirvivardhitam || 13 ||
ardhārdhanyūnamanyeṣāṃ kanyase (kanīyase, ityarthaḥ) dviyavaḥ sadā | liṅgavannirmalā śuddhā kartavyā piṇḍikā budhaiḥ || 14 ||
aṣṭāsraṃ jyeṣṭhaliṅgasya dṛśyaṃ pañcayavādhikam | śeṣāṇāṃ liṅgānāmardhārdha hrāsayedyavam || 15 ||
praveśaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ prokto brahmabhāgasya bhūtale | kāmānāṃ vasutastasya bhedān brūmaḥ samāsataḥ || 16 ||
vibhakte tvaṣṭadhā brāhme tridhārdhobhāga eva vā | caturbhāgaḥ samasto vā praśasyate ca pañcadhā || 17 || (ka)
brahmabhāgapraveśaṃ ca jñātvā pīṭhaṃ prakalpayet | pīṭhikāyāḥ samucchrāyaṃ vikārāṃśena bhājayet || 18 ||
ekenāṅghrirdharāsīno jaṅghā turyāṃśake bhavet | guṇābhāge tathā kumbhaḥ kumbhapaṭṭi tu bhāgataḥ || 19 ||
rāmabhāgena kaṇṭhaśca tanvaṃśai(k, kh: tatvaṃśaiḥ; g: tathāṃśaiḥ)rgalapaṭṭikā | pakṣabhāge (k, kh: pakṣābhāge) jalādhāra ekāṃśe śeṣapaṭṭikā || 20 ||
praveśanirgamau caiva bhāgaikaikena (mū: bhāgenaikena) kaṇṭhataḥ | bāṇamatānusāreṇa kanyasī (kanīyasītyarthaḥ)tthaṃ payodharā || 21 ||
samāsātpnocyate cānyā pūrṇakumbhā harapriyā (kh: kumbhodarapriyā) | (ka ataḥ paraṃ k, kh. pustakayoradhiko'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ- pīṭhikāyāśca bāhulyaṃ tvāgame'ṣṭāsrakasya vai 1 cinhāntargataḥ pāṭho gh. pustake nāsti |) dyaṃśaṃ niveśayedbhūmau tribhāgaiḥ padapaṭṭikā || 22 ||)
dvābhyāṃ paṭṭopa(mū, a, g: paṭṭo'tha || iti ||) paṭṭī syāddhasākhyāt (k, kh, g: tu) tribhirmatā | paṭṭopapaṭṭikā kaṇṭho galapaṭṭaṭdayupapaṭṭikā || 23 ||
ekaikenārthibhiḥ (?) kumbho ghaṭo'rdhāṃdevamevaḥ tu | mekhalā paṭṭikā kintu bhāgakena tadūrdhvataḥ || 24 ||
madhyotthaṃ (tthā) pūrṇaṃkumbhākhyā dvātriṃśatriṃśadbhāganirmitā (kh: pīṭhikā) | ucchrāyārdha tu pīṭhyāḥ (ṭhī) syādrudrabhāge dvidhā kṛte || 25 ||
guṇāṃśaiḥ khurapaṭṭītu dvābhyāṃ paṭṭopapaṭṭikā | tribhiraljaṃ dvipaṭṭau (hi) tu dvābhyāṃ dvābhyā tathāmbujam || 26 ||
hīnopahīnika kaṇṭhaḥ paṭṭa(mū: ṣaṅka)ścaivopapaṭṭikā | dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ kramā(mū, a, k: tathā)tpadyaṃ sārdhāśe galanirgamaḥ || 27 ||
itthamevaṃ galādūrdhvamekāṃśenordhvapaṭṭikā | kaṇṭhadvayena (mū: kathadvayena) saṃyuktā ṣaḍbhiḥ padmairvibhūṣitā || 28 ||
padmākulābhidhāneyanuttamānāṃ sadaiva tu | samvartākhyā jalādhārā viṣṇubhāgāntamucchritā || 29 ||
pūrvoktanālakhātādiyuktā vṛttā prakīrtitā | liṅganāhatriveṣṭena vṛttāvyaktasya piṇḍikā || 30 ||
vyaktasya tu bhavedvāpī tannāhasamadīrghatā | taddīrghatvārdhavistārāttadardhānnālakocchrayau || 31 ||
praṇālamānavacchubhraṃ paridhī tryaṃśamadhyataḥ | ucchraye daśadhābhakte padaṃ kumbhaṃ tathā galam || 32 ||
vṛtta jalāśrayaṃ laghnyā (?) ddyaṃśaṃ dyaṃśena kalyayet | khuraṃ jaṅyā ca kūrṇauṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ caivopakaṇṭhikām (k, kh: pakarṇikām) || 33 ||
vṛtaṃ tatpaṭṭikāṃ caiva jalādharaṃ tathaiva (gh: dhārāntameva) ca | ekayugmaikapakṣaikayugmaikagalāṃśakaiḥ || 34 ||
madhyārdhānāṃ (gh: madhyarcānāṃ) bhavetpiṇḍī subhaktā dvādaśāṃśakaiḥ | ṣoḍaśāṃśakṛtocchāye jyeṣṭhānāmāsane sadā || 35 ||
pakṣenduyugmacandrāgnitanudyekadvisomakaiḥ | caraṇapaṭṭikākumbha paṭṭikā galapaṭṭikā || 36 ||
vṛttaṃ tatpaṭṭikādhāraṃ mekhalāpaṭṭikā bhavet | aṣṭadigravihastaiśca hīnamadhyottamāstribhiḥ || 37 ||
piṇḍikā syānmahārcānāṃ dvikhaṇḍāmbudhareva vā | praveśogdamabāhulyācchū bhranālādi (kh: mānādi) pūrvavat || 38 ||
abhūṣaṇā prabhāhīnā pratimaikārdhasaṃsthitā | tattryaṃśātpīṭhavistārastatpādonasamucchrayaḥ || 39 ||
pṛthūcchayau kalārkāṃśau hyekatatvaika(k: tastveka)candrataḥ | saha kumbho galo vṛtto vedāsrā paṭṭikā kramāt || 40 ||
praveśavṛttaśeṣākhyā tvardhaiṃkārdhaistribhiḥ kajam | (cāpāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ kh. pustake nāsti) anyatra tvevamevaṃ syātsaṃvṛttātkarṇa(gh: saṃvṛttāhvaṃtu)pīṭakam || 41 ||
mukhaliṅge'dhikā kāryā caturasrā dvikhaṇḍikā | suślakṣṇāśliṣṭasandhiśca rupeṇāmbudharādivat || 42 ||
tāmrai rūpyaiśca haimai rvā pādaśoṃ'śai(k, gh: pādapāṃśaiḥ)rnibandhitā | sahasrāhve (mū: sahasragṅke) śatākhye ca bedrāsrā caikakhaṇḍikā | keṣāṃcittu mate vyaktaliṅge tu chatramastake || 43 ||
liṅgahīne bhavenbhṛtyuradhike vyāghayo bhṛśam | tasmālliṅgānugaṃ pīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ kartṛjīvane || 44 ||
liṅgena pīṭhikākrāntā pīṭhaṃ vā (mū, a, g: pīṭhasthā) liṅgato'dhikam | yadi syāt pīḍyate rogaiḥ kartā rāṣṭraṃ gurūstathā (gh: stadā) || 45 ||
tasmānnyūnādhikau kāryau hari(k: hara)brahmāṃśakāvubhau | ucchrayeṇa triliṅgānāṃ na nyūno nādhiko hareḥ || 46 ||
svāyāmaṃ tvajinaṃ (k, kh: svayāmāntajitaṃ) kṛtvā sārdhāṣṭāṃśaiḥ kajāsanam | munisārdhādhikaiḥ śambhuṃ kuryādāḍhyaṃ (k: dādyaṃ; gh: dārḍhyaṃ) vasorharim || 47 ||
sapādāṣṭāṃśakaistryakṣaṃ cakriṇa maṅgalāṃśataḥ (mū: maṅgalāṃśakaḥ) | pādonāṣṭāṃśato brahmā kāryaṃ cānāḍhyakaṃ kvacit || 48 ||
ekāṃśena harocchrāyaṃ viṣṇumaṣṭāṃśakaistadā | ekaṃ surārcite liṅge brahmā saptāṃśake dhruvam || 49 ||
prasiddhamākaraścānyadgrāhyā varṇasamāśilā | sitādivarṇāvarṇānāṃ (k, g: pītādivarṇa) pīṭhādyā na vivarṇajāḥ || 50 ||
svāṃśa (gh: svāṅga)piṇḍisthitaṃ liṅgaṃ śailadhātvādijaṃ śubham | ratnajā vātha lohairvā viśeṣātkīrtaye'dhunā || 51 ||
mauktike sphaṭike tārī (g: tāyī) (?) pauṣparāge tu tāmrajā | vaiḍūryādyuttame nityaṃ hemajā piṇḍikā varā || 52 ||
pañcadhā vā tridhā vāpi ratnajaṃ vibhajetpunaḥ (gh: purā) | bhāgadrayamathikaṃ vā vinyaset piṇḍikāvaṭau || 53 ||
bhāgatrayeṇa vā dvābhyāṃ pūjābhāgaṃ prakalpayem | mekhalādivibhāgo'syāḥ pūrvavatsamudāhṛtaḥ || 54 ||
liṅgapraveśanimnaṃ tu liṅgasaṃsthānavistaram | na nyūnaṃ nādhikaṃ mānātśobhanaṃ (mū, a, kh: sbatalaṃ; gh: sutalaṃ) śvabhramiṣyate || 55 ||
sabraṇe cānyaje (?) mṛtyurvaktre ca dhanasaṃkṣayaḥ | pīṭhadoṣātkṣayo nāryāḥ kāro kartuṃśca sarvadā || 56 ||
vṛttā cāpi ca (mū: yāpī ca; k, kh: pīṭha) vedāsrā avyaktādau bhavetkramāt | bhuktimuktyubhayaprāptyai anyaḥ (mū, a, g: prāptau anyaḥ) kāmyasya hetave || 57 ||
dharā bhadrā ca yakṣī ca vajrītryasrācha maṇḍalā (mū, a, g: vajrābhā śrāntamaṇḍalā) | padmārdhendugaṇākhyā ca kāmadā śubhamastake || 58 ||
vedāsrā samakoṣṭhā ca dharāsyāddharaṇīpradā | dvimekhalā ca vedāsrā bhadrā yogarddhidāyinī || 59 ||
yakṣī trimekhalā vṛttā mahiṣī gopradāyinī (gh: pradāyika) | ṣaḍasrāyuḥ pradā vajrī mekhalātritayānvitā || 60 ||
tryasrā trimekhalā(k, g, gh: dvimekhalā)yuktā śatruśaṅkocadāyikā (gh: kārikā) | maṇḍalā pūrṇacandrābhā tvarthadā pañcamekhalā || 61 ||
khurābja (g: karābja) karṇikākaṇṭhakarṇikābjadalaśrayaiḥ (mū, a, k, kh, ṅ: jalāśrayaiḥ) | candrāmburuparāmai (k: ke dharā vāme) kāgnidyaṃśaistithi bhājitaiḥ || 62 ||
karṇikātu praveśārdhaṣoḍārdha sakesarā | vṛttā padmapuṭākārā karṇiko bhayacumbitā || 63 ||
putrāyuḥ śrīpradā padmā tvardhendrābhā ca śāntidā | aṣṭakoṇā gaṇākhyātā (mū: khyā tu) muktidā (gh: bhuktidā) syāddvimekhalā || 64 ||
liṅgadairghyapravistārā viṣṇuṃ yāvatsamunnatā | pūrvoktamekhalāgartanālakādisamanvitā || 65 ||
liṅgāstrīṇāṃ prasaṅkhyānaistasya pīṭhe'srayo matāḥ | vistarokchrayanālādi sarbaṃ pūrvoṃditaṃ kramāt || 66 ||
daśadigīśaliṅgānāṃ svāyāmyugasūtrakaiḥ | saṃveṣṭya vartayetpiṇḍīṃ kartuḥ kāmaprasādhikam || 67 ||
aindrīṃ baiścānarīṃ yāmyāṃ naiṝtīṃ vāruṇīṃ tathā | mārūtīṃ dhānadīṃ raudrīṃ vaiṣṇāvīṃ brahmajāṃ sadā || 68 ||
ainghrāṃ sūtraṃ pūro datvā pārścayormatsyayugmakam | sūtramadhye'rdhasūtreṇa matsyān koṇeṣu sarvataḥ || 69 ||
catuḥ sutrīṃ punardatvā sādhayeccaturasrikām | vedāsraṃ piṇḍikākṣetraṃ kuṇḍānāmapi sarvadā || 70 ||
turyāṃśe karṇasūtrārdha gṛhītvā bhrāmya yatnataḥ | madhyānmadhyagataṃ sūtraṃ (k, kh: sūtraiḥ) koṇaṃ saṃveṣdya cāparam || 71 ||
kṣetraṃ kṛtvā śarāṃśaṃ tu kṛtvā cottaratoṃ'śakam | tatsūtradvayasaṃyogātsādhayedvā triparṇikām (mū, a: bodhiparṇikām) || 72 ||
kṣetraṃ catudhā (kh: tu navadhā) kṛtvā tu dyaṃśau ca pārśvataḥ | saṃbhrāmya madhyataḥ sūtraṃ sādhayedardhacandrikām || 73 ||
vibhajya pañcadhā kṣetraṃ bhāgaikaikaṃ pradāya ca | rakṣo'gnisaumyakāṣṭhāsu ta trisūtrya(k, kh: trisatryā)trikoṇikām || 74 ||
saptabhāgīkṛte jhetre (nya(cinhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭho mū. a. g. pustakeṣu nāsti)stbhaikāṃśaṃ bahistataḥ (gh: bahisthitiḥ) | madhyādhasūtrasaṃbhrāntaiḥ piṇḍikā vartulā (gh: vartanād) bhavet || 75 ||
madhyātkoṇe vikārāṃśaṃ tyaktvā vṛtte kṛte sati | turyāsravṛttayormadhye yamandvoḥ sūtrapātanam || 76 ||
tatsūtrā(gh: tatsūtraṃ)bdrahsūtrāntaṃ (gh: sūtrārdhaṃ) tiryavakoṇeṣu sūtrakaiḥ | bhavetṣaḍasrikāpiṇḍī śeṣarekhāvithopanāt (kh, gh: lekhāvilopanāt) || 77 ||
naga bhāgī kṛte kṣetre) bhāgaika erito nyaset | sūtramadhyārdha sabṛttādabjā syāt (g: dabjābhā) pūrvacoditā || 78 ||
navadhā bhājite kṣetre tathāṃśaṃ (kh: tayāṃśaṃ) bāhyataḥ kṣipet | madhyasūtrārdha bhāgena (kh, gh: dvibhāgena) koṇāni hrāsayedatha || 79 ||
jināṃśe bahirekāṃśaṃ hṛtvā (mū, a, kh, g: kṛtvā) koṇārdhalāñchanaiḥ | koṇaiḥ (gh: koṇā) sūtraparicchinnaiḥ kuryādaṣṭāsrikāṃ sadā || 80 ||
aṣṭāṃśe bahirekāṃśaṃ nyastvā koṇādhasūtrakaiḥ | saṃchidyāsrīṃśca saṃchidya kṛtvā tu daśamāstrikam (k, gh: daśabhāṃśikīm) || 81 ||
koṇāntau dvau ca hṛtvāṃśau (mū, a: pūrvāśaiḥ) sūtraṃ sapātya koṇataḥ | kartavyā ṣoḍakāṃśaistu (gh: śaivaṃ) piṇḍikā keśavāśrayā (gh: ścaye) || 82 ||
ṣoḍhā vibhajya ca kṣetraṃ kṛtvaikāṃśaṃ tu vāhyataḥ | pūrvavatyoḍaśaṃśaistu kuryād dvātriṃśadasrikām || 83 ||
caturāsrā bhavedaindrī sā sainyastambhane matā | āgneyī bodhipatrābhā pintarogāgnidāhakṛt || 84 ||
ardhaṃcandrākṛtiryāmyā śatrūṇāṃ kṣayakārikā | trikoṇā rākṣasājāṃ tu deśo(k: dveṣo; gh: doṣo) cchadakarī sadā (gh: tusā) || 85 ||
vārūṇī (gh: vārūṇā) maṇḍalākārā sa cāpyāyanakāriṇī | vāyavyā ca ṣaḍasroktā śatrūccāṭanakārikā || 86 ||
padmākārā parā saumyā dhanapuṣṭipradā sadā | raudrī tvaṣṭāsrikā (g: raṣṭāśrikā) jñeyā muktidā sārināśinī || 87 ||
vaiṣṇavī ṣoḍaśāsrā tu ripumardanakārikā | dvātriṃśadasrikā vāhnī svargākhyāphaladāyinī || 88 ||
rakṣo vīndesvarāntasthā gromeṣu keśavājayoḥ | ardhacandropamā nīlaṃ śeṣaḥ kodaṇḍavadbhavet || 89 ||
svāyudhairlāñchitāḥ sarvāḥ sendunālāḥ svadikasthitāḥ | piṇḍīmāmastakādīnāṃ karotyevaṃ vidhaṃ phalam || 90 ||
bhagamadhye sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ liṅgādho bhagasaṃsthitiḥ | bhagaliṅgāṅkita sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 91 ||
śaktyatho (gh: śaktyantā) (thā) thāraśaktiśca umā syātpīṭharupiṇa (gh: rūpikā) | śivaliṅgaṃ paraṃ taccaṃ tayoryogā(gh: tayoryāgāt)nmahatphalam || 92 ||
viṣṇubhāgāntavistīrṇā tadadhaṃ dala(gh: tadardhadala)nirmītā | dalāṅghrigartikā kūrmoṃ (mū, gh: kūrma) vedāsrā valiṅgartinī || 93 ||
brahmādhocchraya vedāsra ta tridhā vistarekajama (gh: vedāsrā tantridhā vistaraikajā) | caturasraṃ ta(gh: rasrayaṃśataṃ)dgartaṃ syād brahmāṃśa(gh: brahyāṅgaṃ)tu prakalpitam || 94 ||
kvacitliṅgārdhabistārā tadardhe ca(k, kh, gh: tadarthoccā)yugāsrikā | tadpādaśvabhrikā sāvjā grahagartā śilā bhavet || 95 ||
kṛtvā sāṣṭa (k: thāṣṭa) dalāmbhojaṃ madhye patreṣu(su) khātakam | kāryā brahmaśilānyārthi(gh: nyo'rtho)bṛttā tryasrā tu(gh: tryasrānta) sādhane || 96 ||
devapīṭhaṃ tatheśāno vṛṣo brahmaśilāpi ca | ekajaṃ caika varṇaṃ vā śubhametadato'śubham || 97 ||
suniṣpanneṣu liṅgeṣu mānala (kh: nāla) kṣaṇavatsu ca | mūlyaṃ samavadhāryādau vaṇijo daiśikottamaḥ || 98 ||
svaprajānṛpavṛddhyarthaṃ prāgācāryaṃ tu lakṣayet | paścādijādvipāṣaṇḍāṃ stato mūlyaṃ prakāśayet || 99 ||
vīrakramā(gh: vīrakrayā)dgṛhītaṃ sadvarṣā(mū: sadaddhā)paryuṣitaṃ yadā | tadārdhenādhvaraṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sthāpyaṃ suvāsare (mū, a, g: surāsure) || 100 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye pīṭhavartanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo vidhiḥ] || 8 ||
[atha navamaḥ]
triśūlam
dikpatīnāṃ harādīnāṃ śūlādyastrāṇi ca bruve | vedāsre grahabhakte (k, kh, gh: vedāsraṃ grahabhaktaṃ) syānmadhye śūlaṃ tu randhrataḥ || 1 ||
ardhārdhāṃśaistu pakṣābhyāmutpalaṃ (gh: mutpala) mukulākṛtiḥ | tyaktvā (gh: tyājyā) sārdhau dvivistārau ṣaḍbhirdirdhau bhramānmatau || 2 ||
śaṅge dve śūlapārśve ca (gh: tu) tvagasthikali(k, kh: kāla)kopame | tadghṛttau dvyardhadīrdhau ca kartavyau ca suśobhanau || 3 ||
madhye mūlā(mū, a, gh: śūlā)rdhadairghyeṇa tvadho vedyabjamaṇḍitā | vedyadhastāttridhā dairghyāddaṇḍaḥ kāryastrivistara || 4 ||
luptvā rekhāṃ sītaiḥ śūlaṃ rakte daṇḍe kuśeśayam | site rekhā bhaveddaṇḍa aiśyāmeva triśūlakam || 5 ||
vajram(-)
kṛtvā daṇḍaṃ triśūlādho vajraṃ pītaṃ sitāmbujam | madhye śṛṅgaṃ tu pītaṃ vā harite pakṣaśaṅgake || 6 ||
pakṣaśṛṅgaṃ yadā pīta tadāntarharitaṃ bhavet | evaṃ saṃkṣepato vajraṃ khyātamindrasya pūrvataḥ || 7 ||
śaktiḥ(-)
daṇḍādyaṃ prāk triśūlaṃ ca pakṣaśṛṅge yadā kṛte (gh: hrate) | lohitaṃ madhyamaṃ śṛṅgaṃ (k, kh: śūlaṃ) vahneḥ śaktistadā diśi || 8 ||
daṇḍaḥ(-)
dairghyāṃśaṃ jinavatkṛtvā vedādyugmātpravistaraḥ | mūle cāgre ca daṇḍasya kāryo vṛttāgramūlataḥ || 9 ||
muṣṭigrāhe sitatryaṃśāddaṇḍamadhye sitāmbujam | vedādvahiḥsitā rekhā(mū, a: vedhā)kṛṣṇā yāmye yamasya tu || 10 ||
khaḍgaḥ(-)
saptāṅgaṃ caturasraṃ syānmadhyādhoṃśena gañjakam | bṛttāgraṃ pādasaṃveśātkoṇamūlaṃ (kh, gh: kāmamūlaṃ) suśobhanam || 11 ||
tadūrdhve sārdhabhāgena tryaṃśadairghyādbhramātsadā | valkalam khaṇḍacandrābhaṃ tanmadhyordhvadvisārdhata (mū, a, k, kh: madhye'rdha) || 12 ||
antardaṇḍāṃśataḥ (gh: daṇdyaṃ śataḥ) kāryā madhyasthūlaṃ dvayoḥ (kh: tvadhaḥ) kṛśā | tatsame'pyunnataṃ madhye mukhaṃ tanmūlapakṣayoḥ || 13 ||
ardhāṃśapṛthulau gucchau tryaṃśāddārghau kalenduvat | muṣṭiṃ saṃvartayedevaṃ pītaṃ vā sitarūpakam || 14 ||
tanmukhaṃ pārśvayoḥ kuryādbhāgārdho'rdhapravistṛtam (?) | muṣdyucchrayāccaturdhāto dīrghaḥ khaḍgāgrabartulaḥ || 15 ||
dhūmrābhā syātsitā dhārā bhāgārdhavistaraṃ jalam | bhṛṅgābhaṃ tryaṃśasantyāgātkhaḍgo nairṛtarākṣase || 16 ||
paṭṭiśaḥ(-)
paṭṭiśaṃ khaḍgasaṃkāśaṃ caturdhārā(mū: caturdhā vā)samanvitam | prasaṅgādgaditaṃ śastramakṣobhya yoginīpriyam || 17 ||
pāśaḥ(-)
jinabhāgīkṛte nāhe pṛthutvaṃ tattribhāgataḥ | mukhapucchārdhamādyante digdeśairyugamadhyataḥ || 18 ||
madhye rekhādvibhāgānte vṛttavadvāmadakṣayoḥ | bhrāmya dvau dvau dvibhāgābhyāṃ madhyakoṣṭhadvaye budhaḥ || 19 ||
(koṇasūtraṃ (cinhāntargato'yaṃ pāṭha gh. pustake nāsti) bhavettatra madhyarekhāpralopayoḥ | granthirūpaṃ yathā samyak tathā tatparilopayet || 20 ||
agre madhyāṃśake vaktraṃ baddhaṃ (mū: vajraṃ baddhaṃ) bakulasannibham | tadadhoṃśena (kh: 'ṅgena) vaktraṃ syānnāsākṣirasanānvitam || 21 ||
tadadhobhāgamadhyasthādbhrāmayedardhacandravat | tadadhaḥ pārśvayordyaṃśe karṇasūtraṃ dvayoḥ samam || 22 ||
phaṇaso'śvattha(k: phaṇasaṣvabja; kh: phaṇasāṣṭaka)patrābho madhye paṅkajalāñchitaḥ | tryaṃśādho hrāsayetpucchaṃ svāṃśaṃ (gh: svāṃśa) tryaṃśena vāṇataḥ || 23 ||
śeṣarekhāvilopena (gh: lepena) rekhābhirmadhyaśobhitaḥ | sito'hiḥ kṛṣṇajihvāsyo raktākṣaśca suśobhanaḥ || 24 ||
sammukhaḥ sitakālaśca (gh: kolaśca) kvacicchyāmo bhayaṅkaraḥ | vārūṇyāṃ vārūṇaḥ pāśaḥ kartavyo diśi daiśikaḥ || 25 ||
dhvajaḥ(-)
ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ tu viṣkambhaṃ luptvā rāmaṃ tu koṇataḥ | vāyukoṇe'mbutaḥ proktaṃ(k, kh: koṇāmbutatproktaṃ)tryaṃśena tu ca darpaṇam (mū: tadarpaṇam) || 26 ||
tanmūrnimadhyato dyaśāccandrārdha bāṇato bhramāt | candrārdhātkoṇato dyaṃśaṃ lopayejjalata(mū: dyantataḥ)stataḥ || 27 ||
randhrādho gugmatastyaktvā tatkoṇānnavabhāgagān | adho bhūtena vistārāttiryaksūtrāddvirūrdhvataḥ || 28 ||
kvacidrambhādalābhāsā kadalīpatravistarā | taddyaṃśena ṝjuṃ kuryād dhvajaṃ vā kuṭilāhivat || 29 ||
rohitamatsyapucchābhaṃ dyaṃśasaṃveśanātsadā | nairṝtyātpañcaveśena sūtraṃ vinyasya koṇataḥ || 30 ||
bhrāmayetṣaṭpado'rdhena tadadho dyaṃśataḥ punaḥ | īśānātsaptapūrveṇa saptaveśādbhramātpunaḥ || 31 ||
(tadadho (cinhāntargataḥ pāṭho mūlapustake nāsi) dyaṃśataḥ pārśvātsūtraṃ saṃbhrāmayettataḥ | darpaṇātprāgjalaśāṃcca brahmasūtrāhibhāgataḥ || 32 ||)
daṇḍaḥ kṣetrasamaḥ kāryo dyaṃśena vistaro rūṇaḥ | śeṣarekhā (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: śeṣaveśā) vināśena vāyordhvajaśca mārute || 33 ||
śiro(ṅ: śito; k, kh: padmaṃ)darpaṇakhaṇḍendurdhvajaḥ pīto'thavā harit || 34 ||
gadāḥ(-)
nāhamekaṃ (gh: rnāhamarkaṃ) dvidhā kṛtvā vistaraṃ tadbhūtāṃśataḥ | ādyante sambikā dvābhyāṃ vṛttamekena pārśvayoḥ || 35 ||
bhāgaikaṃ pārśvayorluptvā madhye pītaṃ (gh: padmaṃ) sitaṃ jalaiḥ (le) | pītā gadāruṇai rekhā madhyarekhā śukaprabhā || 36 ||
ādyante śṛṅkhalā kāryā madhyarekhā(g, gh: madhyabhāgā)valambinī | kaṭikāṅghrisamā vṛttā catasro rekhikāstathā || 37 ||
pītavarṇena tāḥ (k, kh: sā; g: tataḥ) kāryā haritena kvacitsitā | kuverāstraṃ bhavedevaṃ somakāṣṭhāsthitaṃ sadā || 38 ||
padmam(-)
brahmāstraṃ (gh: brahmāṇḍaṃ) vartayetpadmaṃ sārakesarakarṇikam | suśvetaṃ raktanemyāḍhyamīśendrāntarasaṃsthitam || 39 ||
sudarśanacakram(-)
vedāsraṃ ravibhirbhaktaṃ madhyādaṃśādbhramādbhavet | nābhimadhyāntato'śena (gh: madhyāttu tāṃśena) mekhalā bhramato bhavet || 40 ||
nābhimadhyātpunarbhrāntvā mekhalābahiragnitaḥ | tadvattatparatoṃ'śena bhramāccakraṃ tu vartulam || 41 ||
nābhimadhyāntare rekhāṃ bilupya parivartapet | aṣṭadikṣvārakāstvaṣṭau kkacidvā ṣoḍaśārakāḥ || 42 ||
indīvaradalābhā ca(kh: bhāso)cakrayugmāsu puṣyavat | cakrādhaḥ prāntatattryaṃ(k, kh: madhyato dyaṃśā)śādvivistārādrasabhāgikam (kh: masūrī cāsatonnatā) || 43 ||
tadadho vedavistārā vṛttākhyā tu tathoṃcchrayāt | ekenoccā pravistārā paṭṭikā caturasrikā || 44 ||
rasa bhāgena (g: vasubhāgena) sā kāryā pārśvato ṝju vā kramāt (kh: ṛtuvarjanāt; k, g, gh: ṛtuvatkramāt) | cakrasyāsanamevaṃ tu raśmayaḥ paritastataḥ || 45 ||
mūrdhni tryaṃśātsamucchrāyaḥ pārśvayorardhabhāgataḥ | bhramādabjakalī(kh: karī)prakhyā cakramadhye vyavasthitā || 46 ||
śeṣādvā (kh: śeṣābdhiṃ; gh: śeṣādvīṃ) siddhidīrghāṇi pṛthutvāṃśāṃśavartanāt | aṣṭau saṃkhyāḥ prakartavyāḥ pārśve caivāpare tathā || 47 ||
raśmayo'sṛksitaṃ pīṭhaṃ śeṣerekhā vināśanam | kṛpāṇapāśayorantaḥ sudarśanaṃ harerlikhet || 48 ||
triśūlādīni śastrāṇi saumyamūrdhni śubhāni tu | prākśiraskau (mū, a, g: śirasthau) gadādaṇḍau svabhāgairaṃśasādhanam || 49 ||
īśādiviṣṇuparyantaṃ lokeśānāṃ svakāyudham | jñeyaṃ śūlādicakrāntaṃ taddikkāntibalātmakam || 50 ||
karaṇe'nya (k, kh, gh: kinaṇe'nyat) prakāreṇa trikākhyaḥ (gh: trikākhye) punaranyathā | uktānyastrāṇi bāṇākhyā (dyā) ghaṇṭebhādyatha vakṣyate || 51 ||
ghaṇṭā(-)
aṣṭadhā bhājite kṣetre madhye pārśvād(gh: pārśvau)dvirūrdhvataḥ | bhāgārdhena dalaṃ kuryādvṛttāsraṃ bṛttapaṭṭike (k, kh: pakṣapaṭṭike) || 52 ||
bhāgārdhena śiraḥ sthūlaṃ pakṣayorardhanirgamam | grīvādvā vistarārdhādvā skandhārdhāṃśavinirgamau (maḥ) (mū: skandhāddyaṃśavinirgamaiḥ) || 53 ||
vṛttākāreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ sārdhavedāvatāraṇam | caturbhāgapravistārau (ro) bhāgārdhapakṣayoryutaḥ || 54 ||
karṇasūtreṇa tatkāryaṃ (gh: kāryau) tadadho'rdhārdhaniṣkramāt (gh: tadadho'rdhaviniṣkramāt) | ucchrāyārdhaṃ tu vistārā paṭṭikātritayānvitā || 55 ||
śeṣabhāgavināśena (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: viśeṣeṇa) ghaṇṭā hyevaṃ surapriyā | padmaskandhāddvibhāgena kartavyā lakṣaṇānvitā || 56 ||
hāradhārāvalīyuktā pāśalālū(k: lolūka)kamaṇḍitā | susvarā (gh: susvanā) kāṃsyajā śreṣṭhā svadevāyudhamaratakā (mū: vādyadharāntarā) || 57 ||
vāhanāḥ(-)
vedāsramaṣṭadhā kṛtvā saṃlakṣya vartayetkramāt | gajāśvo'śvataroṣṭrāṃśca tadārohāṃstu tryaṃśataḥ || 58 ||
ekāṃśena (gh: ekāṃśonā) tadūrdhve ca gogavayalulāyakāḥ | bhaveyuḥ paśavo'pyanye mṛgagardabhagaṇḍakāḥ || 59 ||
vyulaghya (gh: vyulaṃdha) gāvyajaśvānastenākṣālakṣamāhikāḥ (gh: stunākṣo lakṣasāhikā) (?) | jalonā vyāghrakapyuṣṭrā lakṣādārjanakastathā (?) || 60 ||
pañcāśonāstathā kāryā babhruśaśakamūṣakāḥ (mū: maśaka) | ṣaḍūnād (gh: ṣaḍūnā grāha) grāhagodhā syānnakramatsyāvadhau (mū: matsyāvarau; g: matsyāvakai) sadā || 61 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vāhanāyudhavartanaṃ nāma navamo vidhiḥ] || 9 ||
[atha daśamaḥ]
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi kālalagnādiniścayam | dvitruṭibhyāṃ lavaḥ prokto niṣeṣo dvilavātmakaḥ || 1 ||
daśapañcanimeṣaistu kāṣṭhoktā kālavedibhiḥ | triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kālaṃ vidyātkṣaṇaṃ triṃśatkalāṃ budhaḥ || 2 ||
kṣaṇairdvādaśabhirjñeyo muhūrtastattvavedibhiḥ | tābhyāṃ nāḍyatha nāḍībhyāṃ kṣīṇābhyāṃ (kh: hīnābhyāṃ) ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥ || 3 ||
ghaṭī catasṛbhistābhiḥ praharaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | tairaṣṭabhirahorātraṃ pakṣastairdaśapañcabhiḥ || 4 ||
tābhyāṃ māsastu māsābhyāmṛtustairayanaṃ tribhiḥ | tābhyāṃ saṃvatsaraḥ proktastaiḥ śataiḥ puruṣāyuṣaḥ || 5 ||
nakṣatre yatra tatrāpi sarvakālaṃ dvipakṣayoḥ | mumukṣoḥ sthāpanaṃ śastaṃ yateḥ kāmārthino bruve (mū, a, g: dhruvam) || 6 ||
prābṛṣi sthāpanaṃ siddhayai bhaveccharadi yogadam | hemante jñānadaṃ liṅgaṃ śiśire sarvabhūtidam || 7 ||
lakṣmīpradaṃ vasante ca grīṣme ca jayaśāntidam | yatīnāṃ sarvakāleṣu liṅgasyāropaṇaṃ matam || 8 ||
uttarāśāṃ gate bhānau liṅgasthāpanamuttamam | dakṣiṇetvayane(mū, a, g: dakṣiṇāśāyane)'pūjyaṃ trivarṣordhvaṃ bhayāvaham || 9 ||
kṣmādigrahaṇavinyāsau padaṣaṭkaṃ dhvajāntikam (mū: dhvajādikam) | kṣayāya bṛddhaye syācca yāmye saumye'pare ravau || 10 ||
kartṛnṛpaprajārāṣṭrasthānanāmamarasya (k, kh: macarasya) ca | ṣaṭṣaṇmāsottarāṃstryabdānmayamatātphalaṃ kramāt || 11 ||
saṅgrahe sthāpanaṃ neṣṭaṃ tathā vai dakṣiṇe'yane | abhicāro bhavettatra sthāpite dakṣiṇe'yane || 12 ||
saṅgrahe sthāpite liṅge vyādhibhiḥ pīḍyate prajā | kumārāḥ saṃprapīḍyante kanyānāśaśca jāyate || 13 ||
sumahāñśastrakopaśca tadārājñāṃ prajāyate | kartuḥ kṣayaḥ sadāśoko gṛhe bhavati dāruṇaḥ || 14 ||
tasmānna sthāpayeddevaṃ saṅgrahe dakṣiṇāyane | śubhārthī na pravarteta devyā mantrādiśāstrataḥ (k, kh: matādi) || 15 ||
pārthivaḥ pālayeddharmaṃ svarāṣṭraśubhakāṅkṣakaḥ | tasmātsthānaṃ guruṃ (mū: sthānagurū) prāpya rakṣaye (kh: rakṣārthaṃ)dābhicārikam || 16 ||
pakṣārdhenaṃ grahasthānāṃ (mū, a, k, gh: gṛhe sthāpyaṃ) yāvaddinakṛduttare | sthāpanaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ śiśirādāvṛtutraye || 17 ||
sa dine sitapakṣe ca sa bārarkṣabibhūṣite | sacandratārakāyoge (mū: vyacandratārakāyoge; k: candratārakayoge tu) sulagnakaraṇānvitate || 18 ||
dvaitadeve (mū: dvaite deve) pratiṣṭhā syānmitre ca sitapakṣake | advaite caiva kṛsṇe'pi mantramūrti prabhedataḥ || 19 ||
dvaitāsiddhāntakī raudrī śatavarṣāṇi tiṣṭhati (k: varṣābhitiṣṭhati) | pāñcarātrārharet miśrā (mū: pañcārātrīharermiśrā) pañcāśadvarṣasaṃsthitiḥ || 20 ||
advaitā auravī sātu vāmadakṣiṇamantrajā (kh: mantritā) | śātābdorvbaṃ tu sā tiṣṭhedvāṇaliṅgaṃ svayambhubat (mū: liṅgāśrayaṃ bhavet) || 21 ||
pratiṣṭhāśabdasaṃsiddhi pratipūrvā ttu (mū: pūrvācca) tiṣṭhateḥ | bahvarthatvānipātānāṃ saṃskārādau pratiṣṭhitiḥ (gh: pratiḥ sthitaḥ) || 22 ||
arthastadayametasya gīyate śāvdikaijanaiḥ | saṃskṛtā dravyasanmantrasaṃskṛtiryā suragya ca || 23 ||
āsīnā cai suptā ca yānasthordhvāntarikṣagā | pratimāṃ pañcabhedaistu pratiṣṭhā pañcadhoditā (kh, gh: coditā) || 24 ||
tāstu pakṣesite kāryādvitīyādau tithiṣvatha | dvitīyāyumati (gh: maviḥ) dadyāttṛtīyā putrasaṃpadaḥ || 25 ||
pañcamī ca śriya nityaṃ saptamī roganāśanam | daśamī bhūmilābhaṃ (k, kh: bhūmivṛdviṃ) ca saubhāgyaṃ ca trayodaśī || 26 ||
nānāvidhaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ (mū: dhanaṃ nūnaṃ; kh: dhiya paraṃ) porṇamāsītithiḥ sadā | ekartuśaṅkarairnandā bhadrā pakṣarṣibhānubhiḥ || 27 ||
jayā rāmāhikāmaiḥ syādriktā vedagrahendrakaiḥ | bāṇadiktithibhiḥ pūrṇā hīnatulyāhitāḥ kramāt || 28 ||
etāḥ śukle'nulomāḥ syurbahule ca vilomataḥ | vṛhaspatirdvipañcāyurbudyo jayadhanāni ca || 29 ||
sampadarkaḥ śubhaṃ śukraścandra śāntiprarohaṇe | karka (gh: karki) vṛṣatulācāpastrīsiṃhagrāhayugmake || 30 ||
matsyaghaṭālimeṣeṣu dineśānāṃ pradhānatā | ṣaḍaṣṭacaturoyāmāccatū rāśikrameṇa tu || 31 ||
puṣya(g: yasya)rohiṇikāhastātprāgāṣāḍhottarā dvije | punarvasvanurādhā ca citrā jyeṣṭhā mahībhuji || 32 ||
dhaniṣṭhāśravaṇā (ṇau) vaiśye yugmabhādrapadāstathā | aśvinī revatī śūdre svātīphalgunikādvayam || 33 ||
caturvarṇye maghā śrīdā mūlārdrābharaṇīmṛgāḥ | ete pravīṇa(mū, a, gh: pravaṇi)lokānāṃ (?) catvāryevāntyaje tathā || 34 ||
jayārogyakarastiṣyo rohiṇī dhanavṛddhidā | hastā siddhipradā liṅge āyurdāṣāḍhayugmakam || 35 ||
punarvasuḥ sukhaṃ dadyādanurādhā tu sampadam | citrātvarthasukhaṃ (kh: tvarthaṃ sukha) nityaṃ jyeṣṭhā rogavināśakṛt || 36 ||
dhaniṣṭhārikṣayaṃ dadyājjñānarddhīḥ śravaṇaḥ sadā | yugmabhādrapradā vṛddhiṃ bahumitrāṇi cāśvinī || 37 ||
revatī puṣṭidā nityaṃ svātī kuryāddhanaṃ bahu | phalgunīdvitayaṃ vṛddhiṃ bharaṇī ripubhedadā (k, kh, gh: ripubhedam) || 38 ||
ārdrā saubhāgyasaṃpattiṃ mūlā (laṃ) ca nṛpasatkriyām | mṛga śāntiprado nityaṃ dhanyā śatabhiṣāntyaje || 39 ||
aśleṣā kṛttikā caiva viśākhā ca śubhapradā | śasto jīvo navarddhīṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadā || 40 ||
budhaḥ ṣaḍadvaya(mū: ṣaḍaṣṭa)ṣṭaturyeṣu diksaptabhū (ṣaḍ)vinā śira(si)taḥ | saptartutriśādisthaḥ śaśāṅko baladastathā || 41 ||
ravirdaṃśatriṭsastho rāhustridaśaṣaḍgataḥ | ṣaṭtristhānagataḥ śastā(mū, a, k, g, ṅ: śreṣṭhā)mandāṅgārakaketavaḥ || 42 ||
śubhāḥ krūrāsva pāpāśca sarva ekādaśasthitāḥ | eṣāṃ dṛṣṭirmunauṃ pūrṇā tvārddhikī grahabhūtayoḥ || 43 ||
pādikī rāmadiksthāne (mū: sthānye) vasvarddhau (k, g: vasvaṣṭau) pādavarjitā | dvitīyā saṃpadākhyā tu caturthī kṣemasaṃjñitā (gh: saṃjñikā) || 44 ||
ṣaṣṭhī ca sādhikā tārā tvaṣṭamī mitranāmikā | navamī cātimitrā syādetāḥ pañca balapradāḥ || 45 ||
prītiḥ saubhāgyamāyuṣmānsukarmāśobhano dhṛtiḥ | vṛddhiḥ siddhirdhravaḥ sādhyo varīyāñchi(mū, a, g: ñchubha)vaśulkakau || 46 ||
brahmendrauca śubhaśceti yogāḥ satsaṃjñakāḥ śubhāḥ | cava ca bālavaṃ cava kaulavaṃ taitilaṃ tathā || 47 ||
garaṃ ca vaṇijaṃ caiva śakuniṃ ca catuṣyadam | nāgaṃ kiṃstughnamarthāya viṣṭihīnaṃ tu pakṣayoḥ || 48 ||
pādanyūna (nā) caturnāḍī (k: pādanyūnaścaturmātro) bhogaḥ syānmīnameṣayoḥ (gh: meṣamīnayoḥ) | vṛṣakumbhau tu bhuñjāte catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥ || 49 ||
makaro mithunaṃ pañca cāpāliharikarkaṭāḥ | pādonāḥ ṣaṭ tulākanye ghaṭikāḥ sārdhapañca tu || 50 ||
kesarī ca vṛṣaḥ kumbhaḥ sthirāḥ syuḥ siddhidāyakāḥ | caraṃ dhanustulāmeṣāḥ prāgyugmaṃ mīnakanyake || 51 ||
karkaṭo makarau'liśca pravajyākāryaṃnāśakāḥ | sthiraḥ śubhagrahairdṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥ śubhāśritaḥ || 52 ||
guruśukrabudharyukto lagno dadyaddhānāyuṣā | rājya saukhya dhanaṃ (kh, gh: balaṃ) putrān yaśā dharmādikaṃ bahu || 53 ||
prathamaḥ (mū, g: prabalaḥ) saptamasturyo daśamaḥ kendra ucyate | guruśukrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhipradāyakāḥ || 54 ||
tryekādaśacaturthasthā (kh: ekādaśa) lagnātpāpagrahāḥ śubhāḥ | ato'nye'niṣṭakāryārthe (mū, a, g, gh: ato'niṣṭakakarmārthe) yojyāstithyādayo budhaiḥ || 55 ||
suyoge śāśvatodharmastārāyāṃ puṣṭijīvitam | sulagne ca mahābhogo viṣuve cepsitaṃ phalam || 56 ||
ṣaḍaśītimukhe puṇye tvayane ca mahātithau (gh: mahattithau) | ṝddhirārogyamaiśvaryaṃ devasthāpanato bhavet || 57 ||
sandhyāgate kulagne ca pratyastamitasugrahe (mū, a, k, gh: saṅgrahe) | durṝkṣe durgrahe (gh: kugrahe) viṣṭau nakṣatre caiva saṅgrahe || 58 ||
durnimitte tathotpāte candrasūryopamardane | eteṣu sthāpitā devāḥ kṣayadurbhikṣarogadā || 59 ||
tasmāddinaṃ parīkṣyādau yajñopaskaramāharet | triṣvekameva (gh: tiṣṭeka) niṣpannaṃ liṅgaṃ tiṣṭhati yacciaram | bhaveddoṣakaraṃ tasmātprā (gh: drīka)vasthāpitaṃ varapradam || 60 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye ṛtvādidinaparīkṣaṇaṃ nāma daśamo vidhiḥ] || 10 ||
[athaikādaśaḥ]
jyeṣṭhaliṅgakrameṇaiva maṇḍapaṃ kārayettridhā | triṃśaddhastādibhiścānyo daśahānyā kvacinmate || 1 ||
hastairdvādaśabhiścānyo dviguṇairmadhyamo mataḥ | triguṇairjyeṣṭha ityevaṃ (gh: jyeṣṭamityevaṃ) kārayedanyathāpi vā || 2 ||
hastāṃstu dvādaśārabhya kramād dvaudvau pravardhya ca | aṣṭāviṃśatiparyantaṃ vidadhyānmaṇḍapānnava || 3 ||
ghano ghoṣo virājaśca kāñcanaḥ kāmarāmakau | suveśo ghargharā dakṣo maṇḍapā nāmato (gh: nāmmatā) nava (mū: daśa) || 4 ||
dhāma(k: dhāmnaḥ sakāśāddhāmapramāṇaṃ sūtrāntaraṃ tyaktvetyarthaḥ)sūtrāntaraṃ kṛtvā kuryādyāgasya maṇḍapam | prāsādasyāgradeśe ca nāsannena ca dūrataḥ || 5 ||
vāstvadhidevatāmiṣṭvā kuryāddhīnādimaṇḍapān | jānumātroddhṛte śalye prāgīśenduplave kṛte || 6 ||
kṣetraṃ tridhobhayoḥ kṛtvā stambhānkoṇeṣu yojayet | vedāsrān vartulān vāpi avakrān yājñikān dṛḍhān || 7 ||
dvādaśaiva tato bāhye madhye (mū: bāhyamadhye) stambhacatuṣṭayam | taccūḍāśalyabandhena yojayed dvārakadvayam || 8 ||
śikhāṅghrikaṃ tribhiḥ kāṣṭhairvalikāṃ tasya copari | ṣaḍbhistu paṭalaiśchannaṃ ghanādi maṇḍapatrayam || 9 ||
kāñcanādikamapyevaṃ tritayaṃ kintu kaṇṭhayuk | aṣṭabhirmarkaṭairyuktaṃ dvārakaiśca tribhiryutam || 10 ||
ūrdhvaṃśaṃ (gh: ūrdhvaṅga) bandhanairbaddhaṃ sallohaiḥ śastadārubhiḥ | aṣṭabhiśchadanaiśchannaṃ suveśāditrayaṃ bhavet || 11 ||
pakṣo(g: akṣo)nnatiḥ pṛthatryaṃśo dviguṇā tacchikhonnatiḥ | upajaṃghāṣṭakī caiṣāṃ vistarākīdṛśamunnatām || 12 ||
vistarārkāṃśamānena bhūmau stambhānniveśayet | tena mānena kaṇṭhaḥ syānmaṇḍapāntaramucyate || 13 ||
dvārocchrayāntaraṃ tyaktvā gṛhaliṅge gṛhāgrataḥ | jayākhyo daśahastaśca vidhātavyo ghanākṛtiḥ || 14 ||
mahārcāyāstuvinyāse bhaveyurmaṇḍapāstrayaḥ | suveśasadṛśāḥ kintu stambhaviṃśativarttitāḥ (kh, g, gh: vardhitā) || 15 ||
kaṇṭhadvayasamāyuktā (kh: sabhoktā vā) dhārakaiḥ pañcabhiryutāḥ | lohakaṇṭakasambaddhakapibhirjinasayutāḥ || 16 ||
suvaddhāśca daḍhāścaiva dvādaśacchadanānvitāḥ (mū: dvādaśābjadalānvitāḥ) | śatārdhahasto vipulaḥ pañcone vibhramo (kh: vipuro) bhavet || 17 ||
catvariṃśatkaro bhūtiḥ kṣetre tatvapade kṛte | saṃyojyāḥ karṇagāṃstambhānityevaṃ maṇḍapatryam || 18 ||
caturasrāñcaturdvārāścatustoraṇabhūṣitāḥ | kartavyā maṇḍayāḥ sarve madhye pīṭhasamanvitāḥ || 19 ||
ekahastaṃ samārabhya yāvadaṣṭakaraṃ kramāt | sāmānyātsarvapīṭhāni kvacidanyamate'nyathā || 20 ||
maṇḍapasya tribhāgena pīṭhaṃ syāccaturasrakam | kūrmaṃ pṛṣṭhonnataṃ madhye dvādaśāṃśasamucchritam || 21 ||
tricatuvyañcahāraṃ vā saptahāramathāpi vā | aiṣṭakaṃ sarvasidhyartha dvaciduktaṃ matāntare || 22 ||
trihāraṃdurjaya caiva caturhāra subhīṣaṇam | pañcahāraṃ viśālākṣaṃ saptahāraṃ sutārakam || 23 ||
avakraṃ śalyahīnaṃ ca manojñaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam | siddhānte bālukāpūrṇa pīṭhaśayyānvitaṃ (gh: savyānvitaṃ) śubham || 24 ||
kuṇḍāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ tāntramaṇḍalabhūṣitam | vastrairnānāvidhaiśchannaṃ maṇḍapaṃ stammasaṃyutam || 25 ||
pīṭhordhva ca vittāna tu kadalībṛnda (gh: vindu) śobhitam | lambapuṣpasrajaṃ kuryātsaghaṇṭācāmarāmvaram || 26 ||
varaganghānvitaṃ cāru digbrajaṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g, ṅ: digdhvajaṃ) kalaśākulam | pītaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ ghūmraṃ śveta śukaprabham || 27 ||
hemābhaṃ sphāṭikaṃ pītaṃ puṣṭhayaṃ cendrādikān dhvajān | navaitāndhavalā (mū: ñchachalān)ñchāntau raudre kṛṣṇānprayojayet || 28 ||
pañcahastā dhvajāḥ kāryā vaipulyena dvihaskāḥ | saptahastāḥ patākāstu viṃśatyaṅgulavistarāḥ || 29 ||
daṇḍahastapraviṣṭāstu dhvajānāṃ pañcahastakāḥ | daśahastāḥ patākānāṃ pañcamāṃśa (mū: pañcahasta) praveśitāḥ || 30 ||
kvacidanyaprakāreṇa dhvajānāṃ mānaminyate | saptabhirdaśabhiḥ kāryā viṃśā yāścakarairdhvajāḥ || 31 ||
kanyase madhyame jyeṣṭhe vaipulyāttu dvihastakāḥ | dvacidaṣṭakarāyāmā vistāreṇa dvihastakāḥ || 32 ||
madhyamāstu tadardhena hīnā madhyārdhato (gh: madhyordhvato) dhvajāḥ | vastrairdṛḍhairnabairnityaṃ devakāryeṣu pūjitāḥ || 33 ||
dhvajairathapatākābhirbhūṣayenmaṇḍapānvahiḥ | tāmrā lauhāśca raupyāśca haimāḥ prāgāditoraṇāḥ (mū, a, kh, g: prasādatoraṇāḥ) || 34 ||
kucandanaṃ laghuṃ śvetaṃ candanāmaradārujāḥ | pūrvādidikṣu vinyasyāstoraṇā bhūtaye kramāt || 35 ||
madhukacūtakāśmīrī palāśāścārthaśāntidāḥ (mū, k: cāthaddhisadāḥ) | vaikaṅkataśamībilvakhādirāḥ śatrunāśanāḥ (kh: nāśakāḥ; gh: vāsye) || 36 ||
nyagrodhaśca palāśaśca udumbaro'tha sidhrakaḥ | aśvatthaścāpi mādhūka plakṣo bilvāṣṭamaḥ kvacit || 37 ||
eteṣāṃ toraṇānyaṣṭau pūrvādyaṣṭāsyamaṇḍape | prāgīśavahnikoṇiṣu pūrvāsyaṃ tritayaṃ bhavet || 38 ||
vāyavye nairṛte vāpi (gh: vāsye) paścimāsyaṃ tu maṇḍape | saumye saumyananaṃ kāryaṃ yāmye yāmyānanaṃ matam || 39 ||
śālakoṭaja (mū: śālakau dhvaja) śākotthāḥ sāralāḥ puṣṭi bhūtidāḥ | nyagroghodumbarāśvatthalpakṣavṛkṣodbhavāḥ śubhāḥ || 40 ||
yatheṣṭametadaprāptau kāryāḥ prāgāditoraṇāḥ | caturasrāstvathāṣṭāsrā vṛttā vā cakranirbraṇāḥ || 41 ||
tajjaṅghe pañcahaste ca tadardhātu lalāṭakam | jaṅghāyāśca lalāṭasya caikahastapraveṣṭanam (kh: hastaṃ praveṣṭitam) || 42 ||
tadūrdhvatastriśūlaṃ ca triṃśatyaṅgalamucchritam | ghaṇṭācāmarasadvastra puṣpasnagrāndha dhūpanaiḥ || 43 ||
saṃpūjyatoraṇān vaktramantreṇa (mū, a, kh: toraṇāyuktamantreṇa) svāsu dikṣu ca | jaṅghādau devatā nyastvā (sya) bhūmau hastau praropayet || 44 ||
jaṅghāsu vasavo hyasyā (kh: nyasya) lalāṭe ca yugādhipāḥ | śṛṅge dvādaśarāśisthāḥ sve sve rūdrārkacakriṇaḥ || 45 ||
āpo dharo dhruvañceti somaścaivānilo'nalaḥ | pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca ete'ṣṭau vasavaḥ smṛtāḥ || 46 ||
kṛte śrīkaṇṭhanāmeśau dvāpare śaṅkaraḥ prabhuḥ | traitāyuge tvanattākhyaḥ kalau svāmī sadāśivaḥ || 47 ||
indrāntakajalendūrnāṃ dikṣu svāsu niveśayet | mīnādīnāṃ ca rāśīnāṃ tritayaṃ tritayaṃ kramāt || 48 ||
sthāṇuṃ śivaṃ paśornāthamugraṃ śarva trilocanam | īśvarāvyaṃ ca rudraṃ śaṅkaraṃ śambhujñakam || 49 ||
maheśvaraṃ mahādevaṃ mīnāditritaye (kh: tritayaṃ) kramāt | viṣṇvarkayoḥ prathiṣṭhāne viṣṇvindradīnprakalpayet || 50 ||
viśvāyanamahā mūrtirvikāśākhyamahābalāḥ | pūrvāditoraṇā dhyakṣaścatvāromī'prakīrtitāḥ || 51 ||
jātabījasarāvaiśca vardhamānaiḥ sasarṣapaiḥ | bahirevamalaṅkṛtya tataścābhyantare punaḥ || 52 ||
aṣṭau ghaṭakapāṭāśca dvārasthāḥ pallavānvitāḥ | suratnau (mū, a, kh: saratnau) ṣaghigarbhāśca saṃpūrṇā gandhavāriṇāḥ || 53 ||
candanaiścarcitā, sthāpyāḥ kaṇṭhe vastrairvibhūṣitāḥ | dīpākṣataphalairyuktā dvāḥ pālāṣṭakamantritāḥ (kh: ṣṭasamanvitāḥ) || 54 ||
śāntaśiśiraparjanyā viśokāpyāyakāmṛtāḥ | rūdrovīra (k: vīta) iti jñeyā aṣṭau kalaśadevatāḥ || 55 ||
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca (mū, a, k, g, gh: ravyaśca) puṇḍarīko'tha vāmanaḥ | pañcamaḥ śaṅku(k, g: śambhu)karṇākhyaḥ sarvanetrastathāparaḥ || 56 ||
sumukhāhna (k, g: sumukhāṅkaḥ) prasiddhaśca tathā vai supratiṣṭhitaḥ (mū: vaidyapratiṣṭhitaḥ) | ekaikabhūtakoṭībhirāvṛtā dhvajadevatāḥ || 57 ||
nandīśaśca mahākālo dakṣo bhṛṅgī caturmukhaḥ (gh: ca durmukhaḥ) | dāraḥ sitāsitaśceti vijñeyā dvārapālakāḥ || 58 ||
maṇḍapasya bahiścūtamālāparivṛtaṃ matam | rambhāṣṭakasamāyukta kṣetrapālāṣṭakanvitam || 59 ||
hetukastripuraghnaśca agnyākhyaścāgnijihvakaḥ | kālaḥ karālikaikāṅghrirbhīmo'ṣṭau kṣetrapālakāḥ || 60 ||
kirātādikathācitraiśchannakāṣṭapaṭaiḥ kaṭaiḥ | baddhadvāratraye tasmin bāhayetpaścimānanam || 61 ||
antyajaścapacādīṃśca tathānyāśramadīkṣitān | praveśayenna (mū: ttu) tatraiva kuryādyāgasya rakṣaṇam (kh: maṇḍapam) || 62 ||
lakṣya(mū, a, k, g, gh, ṅ: lakṣma)snānādikāryārtha vimalaṃ maṇḍapottare | prāsādasya pramāmena sapīṭhaṃ dvicchadānvitam (k: dvikarānvitam) || 63 ||
prāsādottaratorraudyāṃ diśi vā cārurūpiṇam | catuśchadaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ vīraṃ vimalamānataḥ || 64 ||
snānākhyamaṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ snānopaskara bhūṣitam | koṇe dhvajavitānāḍyaṃ kadalīcūtamaṇḍitam || 65 ||
ekatoraṇamekāsyaṃ tanmadhye vedikāṃ śubhām | maṇḍapārdhapratāṇena caturyāṃśasamucchritām (kh, gh: svacaturthāṃśamucchritam) || 66 ||
aiṣṭikīṃ bālukāyuktāṃ saumyanālāṃ dvimekhalām | kurvīta vātha sāmānyaṃ maṇḍape vedikādvayam || 67 ||
ekasyāṃ lakṣaṇoddhāramanyasyāṃ majjanakriyā (gh: mārjanakriyām) | kuryāttantadhyataḥ pīṭhaṃ bhadrākhyaṃ kṣīravṛkṣajam || 68 ||
ṣoḍaśāṅgusabhucchrāyaṃ dviguṇaṃ vistṛtaṃ dṛḍham | vistāradviguṇaṃ dairghyaṃ kanyasānāṃ sadaiva tu || 69 ||
caturaṅgulavṛddhiḥ syādanyeṣāṃ tu kramātkramāt (k: kramo matāt) | pīṭhamānamiti proktaṃ kuṭīmānamato bruve || 70 ||
maṇḍapārdhāpare bhāgo prāgāsyopaskarāya ca | pracchannā dvicchadā kāryā kuṭikā parirakṣitā || 71 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye maṇḍapavidhānaṃ nāmaikādaśo vidhiḥ] || 11 ||

paṇḍitabuddhisāgaraśarmaṇo'dhyakṣatāyāṃ vedācāryapaṃ. dāmodaraśarmaṇā saṃpāditaḥ vedāntaśāstriyapaṃ. bābukṛṣṇaśarmaṇā

muṣṭimānaṃ śatārdhe ca śate vāratnimātrakam | sahasre tvatha hotavye kuryātkuṇḍaṃ karātmakam || 1 ||
dvihastamayute tacca lakṣahome catuṣkaram | aṣṭahastātmakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ koṭihomeṣu (mū: kvaciddhomeṣu) nādhikam || 2 ||
pīṭhavadvartayetkuṇḍaṃ svapramāṇātmagartakam | soṣṭhaṃ samekhalaṃ tacca yathā (kh: tathā) yonivibhūṣitam || 3 ||
kṣetrārkāṃśena tasyoṣṭhaṃ syāttadvedartu bhāgataḥ | mekhalāpṛthutocchrāyā kuṇḍākārā tu mekhalā || 4 ||
kuṇḍatryaṃśapravistārā yonirucchrāyatastathā | kuṇḍārdhena tu dīrghā syātkaṇṭhoṣṭhau (mū, a, gh: kaṇṭhoṣṭhī) bodhipatravat || 5 ||
muṣṭyādikaraparyantaṃ kuṇḍānāṃ yonimekhale | prokte cātha tato'nyeṣāṃ vṛddhirdvyaṅgulikākramāt || 6 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu prakartavyā mekhalaikā ca lāghavāt (kh: meghavat) | atha trimekhalāḥ kāryā yugānalayavāṅgulāḥ (k, kh, gh: parāṅgulāḥ) || 7 ||
uparyuparivistārā dyavaṅgulai (k: tryaṅgulai) kāṅgulonnatāḥ | ṣaḍbāṇambutripa (k, g: dvitri) kṣaistu vistārādaṅgulaiḥ kramāt || 8 ||
dvirāmārṇa (bdhī) ṣuṣaḍbhiśca bāhulyātpañcamekhalāḥ | hastamātre vidhiḥ śeṣe dyavaṅgulāṅgulavardhanāt || 9 ||
madhyasūtrācca saṃbhrāmya vṛttaṃ dyaṅgulake dvidhā | puro vedāṅgulaṃ tatra pakṣasūtradvayaṃ punaḥ || 10 ||
oṣṭhaścāṅgulato nābhiḥ kaṇṭhaścoṣṭhasamaḥ kvacit (mū: samonnatiḥ) | avyaktasthāpane kuṇḍaṃ vṛttaṃ sarvāsu dikṣu ca || 11 ||
bhuktau muktau tathā puṣṭau jīrṇoddhāre viśeṣataḥ (mū: tathaiva ca) | sadā home tathā śāntau aidra (mū: evaṃ; k: ekaṃ) vāruṇadiggatam (kh: lakṣaṇadigbhavam) || 12 ||
vyaktapraropaṇe tvaindraṃ dikṣvaṣṭāsu yugāsrakam | evaṃ svadikṣu dīkṣāyāṃ bhuktimuttyarthasādhane || 13 ||
vyaktāvyaktapratiṣṭhāyāṃ vṛttaṃ vedāsrakuṇḍakam | digvidikṣu prayoktavye bhogamokṣaphalāptaye || 14 ||
śatrudāhakaraṃ kuṇḍamāgneyyāṃ bodhipatravat | śāntau dveṣe (k: śāntodvege) kvacidyāmyāṃ khaṇḍacandropamaṃ matam || 15 ||
kṣayāya rākṣasaṃ tryasraṃ ṣaḍasraṃ vāyavaṃ gatau | padmābhaṃ puṣṭikṛdyākṣyaṃ kvacidapyarthasādhane (k, kh, g, gh: nāśane) || 16 ||
aṣṭāsraṃ bhayakṛdraudraṃ jñānamuktipradaṃ kvacit | evaṃ yathecchayā kuryātkuṇḍānaṣṭau svavittataḥ || 17 ||
aiśānādi(kh: aiśānācca; gh: śeṣānādi)caturdikṣu pañcakuṇḍāni vaktrataḥ | troṇi pūrvāpareśāne kuṇḍakaṃ vāyudiksthitam (gh: svadiksthitam) || 18 ||
vedikātaḥ parityajya triṃśadaṅgulamantaram | madhyamajyeṣṭhayoretatsaptasaptāṅgulādhikam || 19 ||
pālāśīṃ paridhiṃ dikṣu nyasetprāguttarāsrikām | viṣṭarān kuṇḍapārśve tu ṣaṭtriśaddarbhajāṃstathā || 20 ||
vṛttānveṇīnibhā(k, g: karīnibhān)nvāpi srugvṛddhyai pañcameṣagam (gh: mekhalān) | ṣoḍaśāṅguladairdhyaṃ tu ṣaḍekanavadarbhajam || 21 ||
yajñadārūdbhavo vahniḥ sūryakāntamaṇestu yaḥ | dvāvetau bhuktimuktyarthau viprādigṛhato'thavā || 22 ||
utkṛtya kuṭṭanaṃ kuryādvajrarekhāṃ tathāsanam | vāgīśvaryārcanaṃ kuryādvījaprakṣepaṇādikam || 23 ||
saṃhitoktāgnisaṃskāro (mū: hyagnisaṃskāraiḥ)garbhādhānādikaṃ ca yat | prokṣaṇārcanahomaśca ghṛtaśuddhyādipūrvavat || 24 ||
praṇītaṃ ca hṛdā pūjyaṃ(mū: pṛṣṭha)gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt | devīṃ visarjya dikṣvāsyānvidikṣvaṅgāni homayet || 25 ||
svāhākāraṃ tu home tu pūrṇāyāṃ vauṣaḍeva hi (mū: tu) | suvauṣaṭ śāntike kuryādvaṣaḍāpyāyane hitam || 26 ||
svadhā pitṛkriyāyāṃ tu phaṭkāraṃ kṣayakarmaṇi (g: jayakarmaṇi) | vidveṣe hū(/) vaśe hrī(/) (gh: hī(/) ca japārcāyāṃ(kh: rcādau)namastathā || 27 ||
teṣāṃ nāmādigā varṇā mātrā dvādaśabheditāḥ | mātrābhirbhedito(mū: śchedito)hyeko varṇo dvādaśadhā sthitaḥ || 28 ||
brahmaṇāṃ vācakā hrasvā dīrghāḥ syuraṅgavācakāḥ | sānusvaro bhavennetramastraṃ(kh: mantraṃ)visargabheditam || 29 ||
bindunā bheditāḥ sarve dīpakena samanvitāḥ | ante(kh: anya)jātisamāyuktāḥ prayoktavyāśca mantriṇā || 30 ||
evaṃ jñātvā kriyāṃ kuryādvarṇarūpaṃ tadātmakam | ghṛtaṃ tilān yavān kṣīraṃ vrīhīn bhakṣyāṇi dadhyapi || 31 ||
samidhaḥ pāyasaṃ puṣpaṃ kandaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ madhu | saktupiṣyākatakrānnaṃ juhuyānnityakarmaṇi || 32 ||
ghṛtasya kārṣiko homaḥ kṣīrasya madhunastathā | śuktimātrāhutirdadhnaḥ prasṛtiḥ pāyasasya tu (gh: ca) ||
bhakṣyāṇāmakṣamātrā syāllājānāṃ muṣṭisaṃmitam | mālūraṃ roganāśāya lakṣmyarthaṃ ca kuśeśayam || 34 ||
khaṇḍatrayaṃ ca mūlānāṃ phalānāṃ svapramāṇataḥ | paṃcaphalāni(mū: palāni)sūkṣmāṇi annānāṃ grāsakhaṇḍataḥ || 35 ||
prādeśāḥ samidhaḥ sarvāḥ samacchedāstvaganvitāḥ | agranthyasphuṭitāvakrāḥ plakṣavṛkṣasamudbhavāḥ || 36 ||
śrīvṛkṣaḥ khadiraḥ parṇī palāśaśamyudumbarāḥ | vaikaṅkato hyapāmārgaḥ pippalaḥ śāntipuṣṭidaḥ || 37 ||
ākṛṣṭau khadiraḥ śastaḥ saubhāgye madanāhvayaḥ (kh: damanāhvayaḥ) | aniṣṭe janturomāṇi dveṣe śleṣmāntaśigrukau || 38 ||
proccāṭane yakārau (gh: pakārau)ca savisargau ca homayet | taddhūlyā kākapakṣaṃ ca nidhane nimbaśoṇitam || 39 ||
arkaḥ palāśagāyatrīmārgāśvatthamudumbarāḥ | śamī dūrvā kuśā havyā arkādigrahaśāntaye || 40 ||
agneḥ śubhāśubhaṃ vidyādvarṇagandhasvabhāvataḥ | padmarāgendranīlārkaśuddhasphaṭikahemavat || 41 ||
śubho haritapāṇḍustu varjanīyo'śubho'nalaḥ (gh: nalo śubhaḥ) | snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartaḥ (śīkhī santarpitaḥ (mū: saṃpiṇḍitaḥ) śubhaḥ || 42 ||
madhvājyakṣīrabilvārkapuragndhaśca śobhanaḥ | nirgandhaḥ pāṇḍaro rūkṣaḥkṛṣṇāṅgāranibhaśca yaḥ || 43 ||
tathonmārgapravṛttaśca (gh: tastho-) sadhūmo vānalo'śubhaḥ | evaṃ jñātvāprakartavyo (gh: yāge-) homastenāthavā na vā || 44 ||
agnikāryavidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakaḥ | adhivāsanadīkṣāyāmabhiṣeke tathaiva ca || 45 ||
khādiraṃ tu srubaṃ (kh, gh: sruksrurva) kuryātsthūlaṃ cāṅgulamānataḥ | gopucchasadṛśaṃ cāru hastadaghnāvraṇaṃ dṛḍham || 46 ||
agre tu tryaṅgulaṃ vṛttaṃ karṣājyapūrṇapuṣkaram | tatkhātaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ (k: dvyaṅgulaṃ) madhye seturdviyavavistaraḥ || 47 ||
candanadvayakāśmīrīdārūdumbarabodhijāḥ | āmrīvaikaṅkatī baijī srukpālāśyatha śaiṃśapī || 48 ||
ṣaḍtriṃśadaṅgulā dairghyāt (mū, a, k, kh, g: dīrghā) taddaṇḍo rviśadaṅgulaḥ | ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāho vedyaṣṭonnativistarā (k, g: dvedvyaṣṭo-) || 49 ||
tanmadhye tryaṅgulaṃ khātaṃ vṛttaṃ vedāsrameva vā | mekhalābjāṣṭapatrāḍhyaṃ sarpiḥ (k: sandhiḥ) kuḍavasammitam || 50 ||
caturaṅgulakaṃ paścātsaṃsthāpya dvyaṅgulaṃ haret | vedyagrakoṇayoḥ (gh: vedagrahaṇayoḥ) kaṇṭhastvaṅgulaikaṃ tatastayoḥ || 51 ||
vedikātulyakaṃ mūle dairdhyātsaptāṅgulānanam | dvyaṅgulāgrapramāṇaṃ ca gajoṣṭhasadṛśaṃ bhavet || 52 ||
vedyāsyamadhyagaṃ(gh: vedyā madhyamagaṃ)randhraṃ puṣkarāsyaṃ nayetsamam | kaniṣṭhāṅgulivatsthūlaṃ sarpinirgamanāya ca || 53 ||
yugāṅgulo ghaṭaḥkāryo (k: lodyataḥ-) daṇḍamūlasuśobhanaḥ | aṅgulaiśca caturbhiśca daṇḍāgre copavedikā || 54 ||
dvayameva suniṣpannaṃ prakṣālyoṣṇāmbunā tataḥ | tau santāpya kuśaiḥ spṛṣdavā mūlamadhyāgrataḥ kramāt || 55 ||
hṛdayena samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhistataḥ | samunnatatanurdadyātpūrṇāṃ vai (k, g: pūrṇāyāṃ) nābhige ghaṭe || 56 ||
ekaikatattvahomānte kāryā pūrṇāvasānake | tasminkāle pradānaṃ ca gurave deyamādarāt || 57 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye kuṇḍasruksruvalakṣaṇaṃ nāma (vartanāvidhiḥ vi0 pu0) dvādaśo vidhiḥ] || 2 ||
[atha trayodaśaḥ]
yajamānānukūle'hni sambhāre sakale kṛte | pūrṇakumbhādimāṅgalye nimitte pūrvacocite (codite bhū) || 1 ||
vandino gāyakā (gāyanāḥ li0 pu0 pā0) viprāḥ śaṅkhavāditravādakāḥ | maṅgalārthaṃ prayoktavyāḥ śobhārthaṃ ca tathā striyaḥ || 2 ||
vibhave (mū: vistare) sati śaivākhyā brāhmaṇāstu prakīrtitāḥ | na cāyaṃ niyamo hyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ parigrahe || 3 ||
na vedoccāramātreṇa kiñcidatra prasādhyate | utsave maṅgalārthe tu samyagvedasvanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
jyotirjñānaṃ pradhānaṃ syātpratiṣṭhāyāḥ śivāgame | sarvārambheṣu tatpūjyaṃ na vedastatra kāraṇam || 5 ||
śūdro vāpyatha vaiśyo vā brāhmaṇo vātha kṣatriyaḥ | jyotirjñānārthatattvajño daivajño jāyate yataḥ || 6 ||
na jātiḥ pūjyate hyatra śaivajñāne yathā guruḥ | jñānaṃ saṃpūjyate nityaṃ na jātistatra kāraṇam || 7 ||
svaśāstralakṣaṇopetaṃ jyotirjñānaviśāradam | nipuṇaṃ supraṇītaṃ ca pratyayānekadarśakam || 8 ||
hitāhitopadeśajñamekacittaṃ jitendriyam | sra'vastragandhadhūpādyairdaivajñaṃ saṃprapūjayet || 9 ||
tataḥ saṃpūjito vidvāndaivajño lagnatatparaḥ | ghaṭikāśaṅkuyogena pratiṣṭhālagnamādiśet || 10 ||
śivajñānātparaṃ jñānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati | sarvopāyānvitaṃ puṇyaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam || 11 ||
yannasādhyaṃ śivajñāne tadvedeṣu nasiddhyati (mū: na tadvedeṣu) | yannasādhyaṃ tu vedeṃṣu tatsusādhyaṃ śivāgame || 12 ||
yannadṛṣṭaṃ śivajñāne na tadvedeṣu dṛṣyate | lokopacāramātraṃ syādutsavovibhave (mū: -dutsave) sati | nacaitatkāraṇaṃ (gh: caitaiḥ-) vedaiḥ pratiṣṭhāyāḥ śivāgame || 13 ||
ajñānināṃ pravodhāya śreyo'rthaṃ(mū: jñeyojtha/)maṅgalāya ca | devyāmatātsamākṛṣya likhitaṃ leśato mayā || 14 ||
mṛdādhairgomayenātha bhasmanāstrāmbubhiḥ kramāt | śodhayitvā tato liṅgaṃ rathe tvāropya yatnataḥ || 15 ||
lakṣadhārālayaṃ (k, gh: lakṣma-) ramyaṃ nayelliṅgaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | ākarṣayecca nāgāśvairmahiṣairvā bṛṣai ratham || 16 ||
aniṣṭorathabhaṅgādo (mū: aniṣṭe-) habyaṃ ghoraśataṃ (mū: -gataṃ) śubham | avatāryāgataṃ liṅgaṃ syandanasthaṃ prayatnataḥ || 17 ||
śeṣe sthānasthite deve śaṅkhavāditra nisvanaiḥ | aṣṭāṅgasaṃskṛtaṃ cārghaṃ dattvā liṅgaṃ praveśayet || 18 ||
rakṣoghnaṃ tiladarbhāmbudadhyakṣatapayoyavaiḥ | hemapātrādigairetairarghaṃ dadyā dathāṣṭabhiḥ || 19 ||
kartā dadyāttatastvarghamācāryādibhya eva tu | pādaśaucaṃ tata kṛtvā pāduke sthāpayetpunaḥ || 20 ||
dadyātsa caturaṃ pīṭhaṃ tatrasthaṃ śivavaṅgurum | kuṅkumāgurukarpūrairlimpeta samacandanaiḥ || 21 ||
susragdāmasudhūpaṃ ca cāruvastradvayaṃ sitam | mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva hārakeyūrakaṅkaṇau || 22 ||
saratnāṃ mudrikāṃ dadyādratnāḍhyaṃ kaṭisūtrakam | saṃpūjya guruve dadyātpañcadhenūśca (k, kh: -dhunūḥ sva) vittataḥ || 23 ||
yatīnāmadhvare darbheḥsragdāmnā vā vibhūṣayet | gṛhasthānāṃ vidhau samyagvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet || 24 ||
api mūrtidharānpaścāghanegdovastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ | pradhānaśilpinaṃ tadvagdandhapuṣpaistathetarān || 25 ||
sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ datvā vijñāpayegdu (mū, gh: dadyādvijñāpame) rum | bhavatpādaprasādānme kṛtsnaṃ yāgaphalaṃ bhavet || 26 ||
dharmavṛddhirdhruvā loke ācandrārkavasundharam | pādalagno vadetkartā kuru (gh: kuyuḥ) (rve) karmatvadājñayā || 27 ||
punarācamya mantrajño (gh: mantreṇa) vastrapūtena vāriṇā | prakṣālya pāṇipādaṃ ca triḥ pibedambu vītritam || 28 ||
saṃvṛtyāṅguṣṭhāmūlena (ṅ: saṃbhṛtyā) triḥ pramṛjyā (gh: dviḥ prasṛjya) ttato mukham | saṃhitābhistribhiḥ pūrvamāsyamevamupaspṛśet || 29 ||
aṅguṣṭhena pradeśinyā ghrāṇaṃ paścādanantaram | aṅgūṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu cakṣuḥśrotre punaḥ punaḥ || 30 ||
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ nābhiṃ hṛdayaṃ tu talena vai | sarvābhistu śiraḥ paścādvāhū cāgreṇa saṃspṛśet || 31 ||
prāgastreṇa tritālena puṣpaṃ prakṣepayed guruḥ | yāgālayaṃ praviśyātha khaḍgabījaiḥ surecitaiḥ || 32 ||
dikśuddhiṃ vidadhītāśu tato muñcanti guhyakāḥ | bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kuryānmūrtyādisakalīkṛtam || 33 ||
nyāsānte karaṇejyāścayathoktaṃ (k, kh, g: karaṇājñāśca-) saṃhitāntare (?) | dvādaśāṅgulamutsiktaṃ sitoṣṇīṣavidhārakaḥ || 34 ||
bhāvanābhirjaṭābhiśca sitabhasmavidhūlitaḥ | bhavedyajñe sadācāryaḥ śrīkaṇṭharūpadhārakaḥ || 35 ||
śivamantrātmako vyāpī śivaścāhaṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ | ityevaṃ nirvikalpena cetasā cintayetsadā || 36 ||
śivasaṃsthāpane hyevaṃ bhairave bhairavātmakam | yadyadrūpo bhaveddevastattadrūpastudaiśikaḥ (k, g: -rūpo'stu-) || 37 ||
ātmasthaṃ pūjayedīśaṃ paścādargheṣu mantravit | tenārdhavāriṇā prokṣya sarvaṃ puṣpaphalādikam || 38 ||
astreṇa vikirebdrīhīnsthalyādi (ñchalyādi li0 pu0 pā0) vidhnaśāntaye | varmaṇā saṅgahetpaścāccāmarairvātha picchakaiḥ (gh: piñjakaiḥ) || 39 ||
śivakuṃbhaṃ tato nyasya śivamantrāṅga (mū: mantrāṅka) saṃyutam | gandhāmbuphalaratnāḍhyamoṣadhīvastrasaṃyutam (gh: maṇḍitam) || 40 ||
cūtapatrākṣatāsyaṃ ca gandhamālyādipūjitam | aiśyāṃ diśyastrasaṃyuktaṃ sthāpayedambaropari || 41 ||
dhārāṃ dadyādavicchinnāmīśādīśāntaveṣṭanām | vinyasya (gh: nyastvā) kalaśāṃstatra tāṃśca dakṣiṇato'rcayet || 42 ||
suvarṇarūpyatāmrotthairmṛnmayairvā nṛpakramāt | śivādikalaśāḥ kāryā dvarasthāḥ (gh: dvāsthārcā) snāpayettathā || 43 ||
tāni nyasetkarīrāṇi pūrvoktāni ca sāṃpratam | vitānaṃ mañcamāṃśena (gh: māsyena) prāguktairdhvajatoraṇān || 44 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā tu saṃrakṣya liṅgasthānaṃ tato(k, g: liṅgaṃ sthaṇḍilato)vrajet | tatra (mū: tataḥ) pūrvaṃ kṣipetpuṣpaṃ khaḍgena tatra (mū: tattva) saṃsthitam || 45 ||
astreṇa vikiraṃ kuryāttoraṇaṃ (k, kh: suvarṇa) paścimānanaiḥ | indrendviśāgradarbhāśva stṛṇīyādakṣatāṃ śucīn || 46 ||
sadyojātena mantreṇa dadyātpaṭṭaṃ satūlikam | arghaṃ datvā tu vaktreṇa dhūpaṃ vai madhyagena tu || 47 ||
hṛdā protthāpayeddevaṃ guhyena sthāpayecchivam | avyaktādīni liṅgāni prāgindvīśaśirāṃsi ca || 48 ||
kramaśaḥ śvāpaye (mū: śāyayet; kh: sādhayet) ttāni tūlikāyāṃ sadā gurūḥ | mantranyāsaṃ tu tatkuryātsāmānyaṃ (kh: vrataṃ kuryāt) sarvatantragam || 49 ||
oṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya hiraṇyanetrāya (gh: retase) mahātmane śivāya | śivarūpāya hā(/) hau(/) (mū: hā(/) hā/) namo namaśceti mantrayet | hiraṇyaretomantrasthitaye (kh, gh: mantratritaya) liṅgānām | sahasrāṃke śatāṃke (gh: sahasrāhvaṃ śatākhye) ca rekhā utkīrayettataḥ | maṇirekhāṃ kramādyasya yasya (mū: tasya) tāṃ tāṃ vadāmyaham || 50 ||
ekādhikanavatyaṃśamūrdhvatiryak khagāṃśakaiḥ | tyaktvaikaṃ syātsahasrāṃśaṃ (gh: sahasrāsraṃ) liṅgaṃ viṣamasūtrakaiḥ || 51 ||
vṛtte pañcāśadaṃśastu tiryagdvāviṃśatiḥ kvacit | ūrdhvādhoṃśaparityāgātpunarvṛttiṃ dvidhāṃśataḥ || 52 ||
mūrdhni saṃvartayetteṣu sūtrābhyāṃ chatrarekhayā | antarluptvā sahasrāṇi bhavatyantaritaiḥ sadā || 53 ||
umendupiṇḍikā nityaṃ liṅgamīśā divākaraḥ | sahasrāśāvṛto (gh: sahasrāsra yuto) bhānustasmāddaśaśatāvṛtaḥ || 54 ||
sauraṃ sahasre caivaṃ (mū, a, g: sāhasrikāraṃ; gh: saivaikaṃ) syādvrāhmaṃ liṅgaśatāvṛtam | kapālādyairyutairbhinne puṇyakṛtsa mahāghahṛt (k, g: suhṛt) || 55 ||
pañcabhāgodayaṃ kṛtvā tyaktvaikaṃ (gh: ṛkṣaikaṃ) bhāgamūrdhvataḥ | tattvabhāgo'rdhavaṃpātādbhavelliṅgaṃ śatādhikam || 56 ||
pratidhāmasahasrāṇi śatāni bāsthire (k: cāsthire) tathāḥ | calaliṅghaṃ gṛhe'pyevaṃ liṅgabhedādi vā punaḥ (k, g, gh: pāpanut) || 57 ||
madendu (kh: mahendu) kuṅkumāktaistu sūtrakairmānahetave | rekhāmutkirayelliṅge uttame ca yavāṣṭakam || 58 ||
navamāṃśahṛdanyeṣāṃ kuryādyāvatkarāntikam | teṣvanttare'ntaroktaṃ vāniṣṭa (gh: tvariṣṭa) kṛddhastahīnake (k, kh, g: vastrahīnake) || 59 ||
rekhānyāsaḥ samākhyāta (gh: vyāsāḥ samākhyātāḥ) tadardhādavaṭaṃ śubham | samaṃ samatalaṃ tacca manojñaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 60 ||
evaṃ tu yā bhavedrekhā tāṃ protkīrya (k, kh, gh: tāmutkīyaṃ) sukhāvahām | madhyasūtraṃ samaṃ (mū: sūtrasamaṃ) kṛtvā lalāṭādavatārayet || 61 ||
trayaṃśo'rdhe vāthavā pāde lakṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhatastvadhaḥ | grīvāsyāgrāllalāṭā (gh: syāghrā-) cca naivordhvakramaṇācchubham || 62 ||
alakṣyaṃ lakṣyakāryāya jyotirlakṣaṇakarma tat (k, kh, g: lakṣaṇakaṃ matam) | sarvālakṣaṇanāśāya rekhālakṣaṇamucyate || 63 ||
sūtrābhyāmantaraṃ kuryājyeṣṭhasya tu grahāṅgulaiḥ | anyeṣāmaṅgulaikaikaṃ hṛtvainaṃ (kh, gh: hṛtvaikaṃ) sthāpayetkramāt || 64 ||
cetā dīptā pramopā ca dhātrī māyā matī śivā | caṇḍā lakṣmī sumedhā ca maṇirekhā daśoditāḥ || 65 ||
vasubhāgīkṛte rudre tyaktvāṃśatrayamūrdhvataḥ | pañcāṃśe latraṇaṃ (gh: pañcāsallakṣaṇaṃ) jñeyaṃ bhāgaikaṃ tasya cāntaram (kh: cottaram) || 66 ||
ūrdhvaṃ sūtradvayaṃ tyaktvā prāṅmānaṃ pakṣasūtrayoḥ | tiryaṅmadhyasthitātsūtrātpakṣasūtrāvatāraṇam || 67 ||
bhāgadvayāntikaṃ yāvattyaktvādhobhāgasaṅgamam | sadhyāntarārdhakaṃ prānte tvantaraṃ (kh: prāntaṃ vartulaṃ) tasya kārayet || 68 ||
liṅgasya yāddaśo mūrdhā lakṣaṇasyāpi tādṛśaḥ | māmānyāntara (kh: sāmānyottara) liṅgānāṃ cetā syātprathamoditā || 69 ||
kāryā cetāthavā dīptā rekhā hastapramāṇake | tribhakteṃ'śaika (k, kh, g: 'sraika; gh: -'graika) saṃtyakte dvyaṃśaṃ randhraḥ ṣaḍasrake (mū, a, k, gh: randhraiḥ ṣaḍasrakaiḥ) || 70 ||
rāmairdvābhyāṃ yavāsyābhā pakṣasūtraṃ tṛtīyake | dīprākhyā lakṣya (gh: lakṣma) rekhā ca gaditā bhogamokṣadā || 71 ||
dvihastake pramodākhyā tithibhāgakṛtodaye | navāṃśo'rdhaparityakte ṣaṣṭhe bhāge tridhā kṛte || 72 ||
madhyasūtrasya madhyaṃ tu bhramaṇādubhayorapi | yavākārebhanetrābhā pakṣasūtraṃ vinā bhavet || 73 ||
dhātrī trihastake liṅge vibhakte (k, kh, gh: tribhakte) rudrasaṃjñake | tyakttvādho dvyekabhāgaṃ tu dvau caivādho'ṣṭadhā punaḥ || 74 ||
tadūrdhvekena mūrdhā syādruṇaṃ tyaktvā guṇāntikam | tyaktvaikaṃ bhrāmayetsūtraṃ yāvatpṛṣṭhāntamāśrite || 75 ||
catuṣkare bhavenmāyā vikāraharabhājite | ūrdhvaṃ ṣaṭka (k: ūrdhvaṣaṭka) parityāgāddigbhāgalakṣaṇaṃ tathā || 76 ||
ūrdhvaṃ vedāṃśakaṃ (mū: vedāṅgakaṃ) tyakttvā laghubhūtraṃ (k, kh: lambasūtraṃ) tato bhavet | adho bhāgadvayaṃ muktvā saṅgamaḥ pṛṣṭhatastayoḥ || 77 ||
matī (kh: satī) pañcakare liṅge śivāṃśe tithibhājite | agre muniparityakte lakṣaṇaṃ syātphaṇisthite || 78 ||
tattryaṃśe cordhvatastyakte lambanaṃ tryaṃśato bhavet | tryaṃśayo (k, g: dvyaśayoḥ) styaktayoścādhaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sūtrasaṅgatiḥ || 79 ||
eḍḍhastake śivā tatra ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ bhaveddharaḥ | ṣaḍaṃśādūrdhvatastyakttvā kakudbhāge ca lakṣaṇam || 80 ||
tribhāgātpañcabhāgāntaṃ bhāmayetpakṣasūtrake | āgho vihāya (mū: vidhāya) bhāgau dvau melakaṃ syāttayoḥ sadā || 81 ||
saptahastātmake liṅge caṇḍākhyā lakṣaṇaṃ bhavet | pūjābhāge vikārāṃśe rekhādhaḥ saptavarjite || 82 ||
turyāṃśā (kh: tulyāṃśā) lambanaṃ cādho dvyaṃśo vādhaḥ parityajet | yasyottare (k, g: yasyāntare) 'bjikākārā saṅgati pṛṣṭhamadhyataḥ || 83 ||
karāṣṭadaghnake liṅge pūrvavadbhāgakalpite | lakṣmīsaṃjñā matā rekhā lambanaṃ (k: lakṣaṇaṃ) guṇabhāgataḥ || 84 ||
edameva sumedhākhyā lakṣaṇaṃ navahastake | dvibhāge lambanaṃ (mū, a, g: lakṣaṇaṃ) tasya saṅgastvekāṃśavarjanāt || 85 ||
na yojyā lambarekhārdhe viṣṇvaṃśe kasyacinmatam | pakṣasūtre paraṃ kāryaṃ tadadho lambanaṃ haret || 86 ||
kvacijjñānakriyāśaktī vyāpinyau sakalākalau | tasmātsyādviṣṇusamparkaḥ pakṣasūtre'va (kh: sūtre ca) lambane || 87 ||
etāsāmiṣyate mūrdhā chatraśīrṣagajekṣaṇam | chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍe tu bālendvābhe yavopamam || 88 ||
dakṣāṇḍaṃ trapuṣābhe tu trapuṣaṃ candramastake | yaśo rājyaṃ dhanaṃ putraṃ saubhāgyaṃ jīvitaṃ kramāt || 89 ||
dadyurgajekṣaṇādīni ṣaḍetāni śirāṃsyatha | etadvāṇamataṃ proktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sārvaliṅgikam || 90 ||
kvacidrudraratirbhaṅkttvā bhānvaṃśāllakṣaṇaṃ (gh: sādhāṃśā) bhavet | nava vaikaika (mū, a, g: na caivaikaika) santyāgādardhātpādordhvalambanam || 91 ||
aśvatthapatravadrūpaṃ vartayegduhyalakṣaṇam | praṇālasyārdhavistārātpīṭhāvaṭakalendu vā || 92 ||
dve yūke pañcalikṣāśca rekhayorantaraṃ bhavet | rekhāpṛthutvaṃ sāṅghrī tu dve likṣe mūrdhaje tathā || 93 ||
ekāṅgulādiliṅgānāṃ lohajānāṃ kvacinmate | vṛddhirekhā tathā sthānaṃ marmakaṃ cādivarjitam || 94 ||
sthānavṛddhyā bhavetteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ pūrvavadyathā | sūkṣmāṇāmapi liṅgānāṃ trirāśikṛtalakṣaṇam || 95 ||
śubhakṛnmarmasantyāgādanyathā kṛtadoṣadam | digīśānāṃtu liṅgānāṃ svakāmaphalasādhane || 96 ||
nijāyudhasamākārāṃ maṇirekhāṃ vilekhayet | śūlaṃ vajraṃ ca śaktiṃ ca tikṣṇāgraṃ kambukaṃ tathā || 97 ||
daṇḍābjāsisusaṃjñābhaṃ (mū: svasaṃjñātaṃ; g: svaya jñātaṃ) vṛttaṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ gadām (mū, a, gh: tathā) | liṅghavadvartayedrekhāṃ hemasūcyā tvanantaram || 98 ||
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā jyeṣṭhasyaiva trimāṣayā | dvimāṣayā tato'nyasya kanyasasyaikamāṣayā || 99 ||
utkīrayeyurastreṇa śilpijo gurvanujñayā | snigdhā samā ca gambhīrā ṛjvī sarvārthadā bhavet || 100 ||
sthūlā vakrā kṛśā bhinnā rūkṣāyurarthanāśanī | śastramāmantrya śastreṇa vilikheddakṣiṇena tu || 101 ||
pūrayenmadhusarpibhyāṃ svanetreṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ | avyaktānāṃ sthirāṇāṃ ca brahmarekhāvidhistvayam (gh: vidhiḥ svayam) || 102 ||
aiśāne (neśāne li0 pu0 pā0) bāṇaliṅge ca ratnajānāṃ calātmake | sarvameva śirasthatvamīśānasya hi lakṣaṇam || 103 ||
pūrvamantreṇa (kh: maṇḍala) saṃsiddhaṃ bāṇaliṅgasya lakṣaṇam | svakāntimaṇiratnotthalakṣma vā dhātuje (k, kh: lakṣme vā pātraje) kvacit || 104 ||
calānāṃ ca sthirāṇāṃ ca vyaktānāṃ netrasaṃskṛtiḥ (mū: mantrasaṃskṛti) | aṅgulādyekaikaśaḥ (k, kh, gh: dyekakeśaḥ) syādyūkā hastavṛddhitaḥ || 105 ||
rekhāpṛṣṭhārdhagarte'rcādvau (g: gartāṃdvā) netronmīlanaṃ kvacit | saumyābhayā pradātrī ca vīrā hṛṣṭā prabodhikā || 106 ||
hāsyā kāruṇikā kāma yogasthā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ | krūrā kruddhā karālā ca bhīṣaṇā vikṛtādbhutā || 107 ||
ūrdhvādhograsinī bhītā ghorādīnāṃ tu dṛṣṭayaḥ | netratribhāgamadhye tu tārakākhyaṃ prakīrtitam || 108 ||
tārātṛtīyabhāgena jyotirāsāṃ prakalpayet | nordhvaṃ nādho natiryagvā na nyunādhikavibhramā || 109 ||
na binduśakalā (gh: kalaśāḥ) rūkṣā dṛṣṭisyācchubhadāyiti | saumyā dvādaśa (kh: ṣṭādaśa) vṛddhyarthaṃ snigdharekhāsudṛṣṭayaḥ || 110 ||
vṛttākṣā rākṣasādyāśca teṣāṃ krūrādidṛṣṭayaḥ | lakṣaṇodgharaṇe dadyādghenuṃ ca gurave sadā | jñātvaivaṃ (kh: kṛtvaivaṃ) vidhinā samyak tatastānyadhivāsayet (k, g, gh: snānādhivāsanam) || 111 ||
vasateradhipūrvasya bhāve lyuṭ (gh: ghñ) pratyaye kṛte | adhivāsana ityeṣa (k, g: ityevaṃ; gh: vāsadhighohyeṣa) prayogaḥ siddhimeti ca || 112 ||
gūrvādisahito vāso rātrau niyamapūrvakaḥ | etasyārthau (gh: etasyārtho) nipātānāmanekārthatayā mataḥ || 113 ||
astreṇābhyakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyenābhimantrayet | nareṇārghaṃ (navenārvaṃ) pradadyācca pādyaṃ cājātakena tu || 114 ||
vāso liṅgāya guhyena ajātena vilepanam | pañcamena srajaṃ dadyāddhūpaṃ vai dakṣiṇena tu || 115 ||
purūkundurūlohaiśca sarjacandanavānaraiḥ | śrīvāsasaralābhyāṃ ca khaṇḍadhūpaiśca dhūpayet || 116 ||
hṛdā deyaṃ pavitraṃ tu pradīpaṃ madhyamena tu | naivedyāni tṛtīyena anuktaṃ hṛdayena tu || 117 ||
chādayedvastrayugmena guhyamantreṇa daiśikaḥ | mūrdhni nidrāghaṭaḥ sthāpyo rudrajaptaḥ supūjitaḥ || 118 ||
kapilā bandhayetpañca arogāḥsupayasvinīḥ | caturdvāreṣu ceśāne tatkṣīreṇa caruṃ śrapet || 119 ||
caruṃ prāśya svapettatra vihite dantadhāvane | gurūmūrtidharaiḥkartāsahitaḥ kuśasaṃstare || 120 ||
susvapne siddhiranyatra juhuyānmadhyagaṃ guruḥ | dvitīye'hni kṛtasnānaḥ karyā patnyanvito vratī || 121 ||
guruḥ samūrtipaiḥ snāto vastrābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | kṛtamaṅgalanirghoṣairdevasnānādikaṃ caret || 122 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye lakṣaṇoddhāravidhikathanaṃ nāma trayodaśo vidhiḥ ] || 13 ||
[atha caturdaśaḥ]
śivaḥ sarvagataḥ sūkṣmaḥ svayamutkarṣate'khilam | sphuṭamācāryarūpeṇa mantraśattyā (g: mantreṇa sa) carācaram || 1 ||
sarveṣāmapi varṇanāmavatīrṇaḥ kaleśvarāt (k, g: varāt) | anugrahāya lokānāṃ gurutvaṃ syācchivecchayā || 2 ||
ayutairdvijavedaśaiḥ samayī tatsamo bhavet (kh: mācaret) | tadayutaiñca putrāhva (kh: patrāṅka) staistāvadbhiñca sādhakaḥ || 3 ||
daśabhistu sahasraistairācāryaḥ śivaśāsane | tebhyo dānārcanairbhaktyā (gh: bhūkatvā) phalaṃ syādvāsukerma (k, g: vādyakarma; kh: vāstukarma) tāt || 4 ||
sakalīkaraṇāṃ kṛtvā deve (mū: vede; k, kh: dehe) hyarghādikaṃ ca yat | tatañcābhyukṣaṇaṃ liṅge arghapūṣpākidhūpanaiḥ || 5 ||
tailenābhyaṅgayelliṅgaṃ dūrvākāṇḍaśatena ca | guhmena (kh: śuddhena) svayamācāryaḥ pañcātkartā kulaiḥ saha (gh: kulena ca) || 6 ||
tatkālamaṅgalaṃ gītaṃ gāyantyo 'vidhavāḥ śubhāḥ | dadyāttāsāṃ guḍaṃ dhānyaṃ paryaṭaṃ (gh: parvpaṭaṃ) lavaṇaṃ kvacit || 7 ||
tatastvavidhavā cāṣṭau sarbalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ | savyāpasavyasūtreṇa saṃspṛśeyuḥ kuśena vā || 8 ||
svapayanti (k, gh: snapayanti) punastāstu nirmatsyanti punaḥ punaḥ | vidhinā snapanaṃ (g: apayanti) pañcādācareddaiśikaḥ svayam || 9 ||
mṛtsāgomayagomutrabhasmadugdhairyathākramam | pañcagavyena daghnā vā madhunā pañcavalkalaiḥ || 10 ||
aṣṭasaptārkanāgāṃśaira (kh: nāgāṅkaiḥ) gnisaptavikārakaiḥ | nakhāgni (kh: navāgni) pañcabhiḥ snānaṃ palāśai (kh: palārdhe) rekahastake || 11 ||
nānāphalairathāṣṭābhiḥ puṣpāṇāṃ ca śatena ca | snāpayedguhyamantreṇa rudrairvā hṛdayena vā || 12 ||
yavagodhūmajaiñcūrṇairbilvacūrṇaistathāparaiḥ | udvartya snāpayetpañcātsvacchena gandhavāriṇā || 13 ||
sarvauṣadhipalenāpi ratnatoyena śaktitaḥ | tathā kāñcanatoyena gośṛṅgasalilena ca || 14 ||
dhānyodakena cecchātastato gandhodakena ca | sitavastreṇa deveśaṃ parimṛjya (mū, a: parityajya) sugandhinā || 15 ||
etalliṅge'nyadarcāsu snānaṃ syādbhāskare mate | svaiḥ svairmantrairharādīnāṃ miśrāṇamapi sarvadā || 16 ||
jalena pañcagavyena pañcabhirmadhuraistathā | mṛtkaṣāyauṣadhībhiśca dhāgryā tīrthadhunījalaiḥ || 17 ||
sāgarodakaratnāmbugandhapuṣpaphalodakaiḥ | mahāsnānena diksnānaiḥ snāpyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kramāt || 18 ||
astrādbhirdhūlirsaśuddyai prathamaṃ snāpayecchivam | kṣīraṃ gostāmravarṇāyā īśena bhāgapañcakam || 19 ||
śuklāyā dadhi ca grāhyaṃ caturbhāgaṃ nareṇa ca | kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ gośca aghoreṇāgnibhāgikam || 20 ||
gomūtraṃ nīlavarṇayā guhyena dvayabhāgakam | kṛṣṇayā gomayaṃ khasthamajena sarvadā (mū: sampadā) śuci || 21 ||
madhyendrayamayakṣāmbudiksthe tāmrādipātrage (mū: pātrataḥ) | śivenaikattvamāloḍya pañcabhirvātha kāpilam || 22 ||
kuśāmbunārdhabhāgaṃ ca sādākhyenābhimantritam | ebhistu paṃcabhiryuktaiḥ snānamarcādiśodhanam || 23 ||
payodadhighṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ khaṇḍaiḥ syātpañca mādhuram | īśānavaktraghorāhvaguhyājātākhyamantritaiḥ (gh: -kaiḥ) || 24 ||
valmīkagirigaṅgāditīrajebhahradoddhṛtāḥ | vṛṣaśṛṅgasamutkhātāḥ pavakāśrayasambhavāḥ || 25 ||
nṛpadvārācaturmārgamṛtsābhiśca viśuddyati | ajena kṣālanātpṛthvīkramatastu kalāvatā || 26 ||
bakulodumbarāśokavaṭabodhitvacāṃ jalaiḥ | kavoṣṇaistu tṛtīyena snānaṃ ṭaṅkakṣatāpaham || 27 ||
ṛddhivṛddhisahā (mahā bhū0 pā0) siṃhīkanyācchinnā bahuprajā | nidigdhikā balāmūlaiḥ snānaṃ guhyena doṣahṛt || 28 ||
tvakpatramustanāgāhvatoyagranthyādibhiḥ (-prajñādibhiḥ) saha | dhātryā snānānmahītyakte (gh: vyakte) sadyojātena śuddhyati || 29 ||
sugandhiśālipiṣṭena gāyatryā mantritena ca | samudvartya mahādevaṃ tīrthotthaiḥ snāpayejjalaiḥ || 30 ||
ajāgandhiprayāgaśca (kh: prayogācca) kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ tathā | puṣkaraṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ ca varūṇaṃ tathā || 31 ||
etattīrthāmbususnānānnareṇa tvagvi (g: deśatvayi) śuddhyati | jāhnavī yamunā kauśī sarayū śoṇanarmadā || 32 ||
kāverī gaṇḍakī sindhu (mū: caiva) strisrotā candrabhāgikā | saptagodāvarītyetāḥ puṇyanadyo mahājalaiḥ || 33 ||
snānātpunanti carcānāṃ viśveśaṃ (gh: viṣṇavaṃśaṃ) guhyamantrataḥ | kṣārakṣīradadhisnehekṣurasodasurodakāḥ || 34 ||
svādugarbhodakāśceti jñeyāstvaṣṭau ca sāgarāḥ | eteṣāmambubhiḥ snāyyaṃ sparśaśuddhyai (mū: snānātsparśaśuddho) nareṇa tu || 35 ||
puṣparāgaṃ ca vaidūryaṃ vajraṃ caiva samauktikam | sphāṭikaṃ padyarāgaṃ ca rājāvartaḥsuvidrumam || 36 ||
nilaṃ marakataṃ caiva karketanaṃ suṭiṭṭibham (gh: ṭiṭibham) | etadratnodakaiḥ snānaṃ mahābhūtikaraṃ param || 37 ||
aghoramantrapūtaistu liṅgarupaviśodhakam | karpūrāgurukastūrīkāśmarīcandanādikaiḥ || 38 ||
jātīlavaṅgakarkolai ścaturjātasugandhikaiḥ | snāpayedgandhatoyena ajātenābhimantritam || 39 ||
gandhadoṣavināśāya dharā (kh: parā) bramhaviśuddhaye | puṇḍarīkābjamālūranīlaraktotpalārkajam (gh: -kam) || 40 ||
mālatītagarāśokahemacacpakamallikāḥ | sahakārāśvamāraṃ ca punnāgabakulāni ca || 41 ||
karṇikāroḍrakahlāraṃ kundaṃ kumudayūthikā | pāṭalādroṇanepālī (k, kh: remālī) kuśakiṃśukasiṃhikāḥ || 42 ||
kadambaṃ cātimuktaṃ ca kuṭajaṃ nāgapuṣpakam | mṛdukundābjapatrī (k, kh: mucukundā-) ca vṛṣarṣibukapuṣpakam || 43 ||
ebhiranyaiḥ pavitraiśca snānaṃ śabdaviśuddhikṛt | bilāmramocanāraṅga panasaṃ nālikerakam || 44 ||
kakko (ṅko) lāmalakaṃ drākṣā jātīphalaparupakam | dāḍimodumbaraṃ jambū karjū(/)raṃ (gh: vekṣuraṃ) tālabimbakam (mū: bilvakam) || 45 ||
prācīnāmalakaṃ pīlu kapitthaṃ bakulaṃ tathā | vadarībījapūraṃ ca kava (k, gh: kara) mardaṃ satindukam || 46 ||
pūgādikaṃ yathālābhamīśānāghoramantritam | phalasnānamidaṃ pupyaṃ karturicchāphalapradam || 47 ||
toyekṣvāmrarasairvāpi brīhyādyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ saha | tilagodhumasugdādi yavadhānyapriyaṅgubhiḥ || 48 ||
pūrvoktamṛttikāgandhaṃ kusumauṣadhisaṃyutam | pañcabrahmodbhavairmantrairmahāsnānaṃ śubhapradam || 49 ||
kadambapallavāsyena kumbhenendraṃ narānvitam | saśālmalena cāgneyaṃ hṛnmantrai snānamuttaman || 50 ||
jambūpatravaṭā yāmyaṃ snānaṃ cāghoramantrataḥ | sāśokena tu rakṣojaṃ śikhamantrānvitaṃ varam || 51 ||
āpyaṃ (mū: snāpya) bodhidalāsyena snānaṃ cājātamantritam | cūtāsyena tu vāyavyaṃ snānaṃ varmasamanvitam || 52 ||
saumyaṃ vaṭacchadāsyena snānaṃ vāmābhimantritam | sabhasmabilvapatrāsyasnānamaiśaṃ śiro'nvitan || 53 ||
nāgapatrānanasnānamā (gh: snānaṃ sā) nantaṃ netramaṇḍitam | brahmapatravatā brāhmaṃ sakuśena samanvitam || 54 ||
bherīśaṅkharavaistūryaiḥ kāhalādhvanibhiḥ kalaiḥ | varastrīmaṅgalodgītaiḥ snāpayedvṛṣabhadhvajam || 55 ||
tato nirmatsya (2) cāstreṇa hṛdā vāca (k: tvāca) mayecchivam | arghaṃ dattvā tu vaktreṇa vastreṇākarṣayejjalam || 56 ||
yathā śive tathaivārke viṣṇvādau ca samācaret | snānādi svaisvakairmantraiñcaturmṛtsnāspvihādhikāḥ || 57 ||
kuśamūlodbhavakroḍapadyagoṣṭhamṛdastvimāḥ | nāne pūrvoktamṛtsnāñca śastā dvādaśaviṣṇubhiḥ || 58 ||
dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṣṭabhiḥ kṛmbhai snātyaṃ navādibhiḥ (k: narādibhiḥ) | calārcāsu prayatnena sthāvare dvīguṇaṃ kramāt || 59 ||
naivedyaṃ tailapātraṃ ca snānavastraṃ śalākikam | dattvā tu śilpināmarcābhimantrya tato'rcayet || 60 ||
evaṃ pakvamṛdādīnāṃ liṅgānāṃ dravyapañcakam | citrādilepya (k: -lekhya) pustānāṃ darpaṇasnānamiṣyate || 61 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye tridhāliṅgamnānaṃ nāma caturdaśovidhiḥ ] || 14 ||
[atha pañcadaśaḥ]
lohādidhātu (mū, g, gh: ṛtu) liṅgāni pratyekaṃ bhautikāni tu | śabdātsparśācca rūpācca rasādgandhācca vai kramāt || 1 ||
svabījodbhāvanodghātairekādi kramapañcakaiḥ | viśodhya khādibhūtāni tato mūrtiṃ tu kārayet || 2 ||
nyasedvarṇātmakānnudrānnavyaktādi (g: -ktāni) trirūpake | pañcabrahma tato'ṅgāni kalāḥ sarvāḥ śivasya ca || 3 ||
tato vastraṃ ca gandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpakam | naivedyaṃ pūrvavaddadyādrocanāṃ mūrdhamantritām || 4 ||
añjanaṃ naitramantreṇa darpaṇaṃ puruṣeṇa tu | chatramīśānadevena cāmaraṃ naramantrataḥ (gh: mantritam) || 5 ||
evamiṣṭvā mahādevaṃ maṇḍapaṃ saṃpraviśya ca | bālukā vikiretpīṭhe tṛṇakeśādivarjitāḥ || 6 ||
ananta pūjayetpīṭhe hṛdā ca dhyānapūrvakam | prāgagrāṃstṛṇuyāddarbhānajātenottarāgrakān || 7 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ vinyasenkhadvāṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitām | dharmādicaraṇāñchambhośtathādharmādigātrakān || 8 ||
tacchādane tu tūlyabjaṃ cintyaṃ (kh: śilpa) vāmādikesaram | vidyeśvaradalaṃ tatra maṇḍala (kh: maṇḍapaṃ) trayakarṇikam || 9 ||
iḍāyāṃ jalasaṃsthāyāmutthāpyeśaṃ rathaṃ nayet | sunimittaiḥ śubhairvādyairmaṅgalaiḥ stutivācakaiḥ || 10 ||
vitānacāmaracchatrairvidhṛtaiḥ śobhanairdhvajaiḥ | agre bhṛṅgāradhārāśca mucchadbhirgurubhiśtathā || 11 ||
āpyadvārapraveśaśca yāgasthānaṃ maheśvaram | talpe prākśirasaṃ nidrākumbhaṃ tacchīrṣake nyaset || 12 ||
śatajaptamadhoreṇa tato devaṃ prapūjayet | thāṇuśca nīlakaṇṭhaśca mahādevaḥ śivastathā || 13 ||
rudraśca śaṅkaraścaiva nīlalohitasaṃjñakaḥ | īśāno dhanado bhīmastryambakaḥ pārvatīpatiḥ || 14 ||
dvādaśaite'tra (mū, a, k, g: tu) saṃpūjya mārgādau yoganāyakāḥ | dīpairgandhaiśca puṣpaiśca dhūpaiścaiva yathākramam || 15 ||
naivedyairvividhaiḥ puṇyaiḥ (gh: puṣpaiḥ) pāyasādyaistu khāghakaiḥ | lopikā (k: kāyikā) npūrikānpūpā (gh: pūpai) nmaṇḍalakānmodakāndadhi || 16 ||
laḍḍūkānbaṭakānphenān guḍakṣīraṃ guḍaudanam | parpaṭaṃ (mū: paryaṭaṃ) ghṛtapūraṃ ca khaṇḍavartisitaudanam || 17 ||
nānābhakṣyāṇi divyāni phalāni vividhāni ca | khaḍgottamastathā mantrī (gh: śastrī) vāgu (g: bāṇa) lyopaskaraṃ śubham (?) || 18 ||
tāmbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ sahakārasamanvitam | saharuṃ (kh: saphalaṃ) sthitipātraṃ ca madhupātraṃ patadgraham (k: tadguham; g: draham) || 19 ||
śaṅkhamuṇḍi (k: vaśu; kh, gh: vuṇḍaṃ) stathā śuktiṃ mañcikoparisaṃsthitam | yadanuktamihadravyaṃ peṣaṇyādi (kh: praveśyādi; gh: peśinyādi) ca yadgṛhe || 20 ||
tatpradadyādaśāṭhyeta ghoramantreṇa yatnataḥ | tataḥ śīrṣonnate puṇye geḍḍuke (k: gaṇḍuke) ca suśobhane || 21 ||
śayirtu sthā (kh: svā) payelliṅgaṃ piṇḍikāsahitaṃ prabhum | abhyajya madhusarpibhyāṃ dadyātsiddhārthakānbahūn || 22 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ mūrtimāśritya vinyasenmantranāyakam | dukūlai raktavastrairvā devaṃ saṃchādya rakṣayet || 23 ||
mahāpāśupatāstreṇa tato mūrtidharānyajet | dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṣṭau ca nṛpādīnāṃ yathākramam || 24 ||
sādhakāstu vinācāryai putrakāḥ sādhakairvinā | samayī putrakābhāve sarvābhāve svaṃyaṃ guruḥ || 25 ||
vidyeśvararān ganeśāṃścarlakeśān bhairaveśvarān | vidyeśān muktikāmān bhūktyarthaṃ ca gaṇeśvarān || 26 ||
p 32> sādhanārthe tu lokeśānadvaite bhairaveśvarān | mūrtiśattyanvitāścaistvetā mūrtyadhidevatā ṣajet || 27 ||
kṣmāvahniyajamānārkayvindavo'thakham | mūrtayastu samākhyātā mūrtiśānavacmi sāṃpratam || 28 ||
śarvaḥ paśupatiścogro rudro bhavastathaivaca | īśāno devadevaśca (mū: stu) bhīmo mūrtyadhidevatāḥ || 29 ||
dhārīkā dīptiratyugrā (mū: matyugrā) jyotsnā cetā balotkaṭā | dhātrī vibhvī ca vikhyātāḥ samāsānmūrtiśaktayaḥ || 30 ||
anantīśaśca sūkṣmaśca śivottamaikalocanaḥ | ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca (mū, a, g: śrīkhaṇdaśca) śikhaṇḍakaḥ || 31 ||
umā caṇḍī gaṇādhyakṣo mahākālo'tha nandikaḥ | bhṛṅgīśaśca vṛṣaścaiva saṇmukhāntā gaṇeśvarāḥ || 32 ||
asitāṅga rūruścaṇḍaḥ krogha unmattakasmatathā | kapālī bhīṣaṇaśceva saṃhāro bhairaveśvarāḥ || 33 ||
itareṣāṃ kvacicchastre caturdvaikakramānmatāḥ | catvāro'jātakādyākhyā viṣṇarudrau tatheśvaraḥ || 34 ||
vimalo'tha viśālaśca sārasvato mahāmukhaḥ | lelivāsura (k: hāmbara) śāstā ca phaṇyāśī (mū, a, g: phayyāśī) kuṇḍadevatāḥ || 35 ||
brāhmyādyā mātaro loke indrādyā lokapālakāḥ | prasiddhāḥ sarvaśāstreṣu śāstre'sminpūrvacoditāḥ (gh: citāḥ) || 36 ||
daivajñaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ceṣṭvā praviśedyāgamaṇḍapam | āhṛtya sarvasambhāramācāryo mantravigrahaḥ || 37 ||
śivaṃ praṇamya vijñāpya brahmāṅgakṛtavigrahaḥ | dikṣu vidikṣu saṃsthāpya mūrtimānsujitendriyān || 38 ||
prāṅmukhodaṅmukhānsamyakkuṇḍasthāneṣu vai tataḥ | prāgādyanukrameṇaiva mantrametānpravācayet || 39 ||
palaiḥ ṣaṣṭyuttame liṅge madhyādyardhārdhavarjanāt | homapātraṃ tathā hyarghaṃ daśanyūnaṃ nṛpakramāt || 40 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmrajaṃ vāpyasaṃbhavāt | ājyapūrṇaṃ tathā pātramaikaikasya pradāpayet || 41 ||
viṣṭarāṇyarghapātrāṇi samiddarbhendhanāni (gh: nādi) ca | gandhapuṣpopahārāṃśva sruksruvau lakṣaṇānvitau || 42 ||
pṛthaṅnivedayetteṣāṃ mūrtipānāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | sitāmbaradharāḥ sarve sitacandanacarcitāḥ || 43 ||
