sitamālyānvitā (kh: citā) hṛṣṭāḥ svamūrtigatamānasāḥ | tāniṣṭvā svarṇavastrādyaistatastāṃstu samādiśet || 44 ||
japetpāśupataṃ prāgvai aghorāstraṃ ca dakṣiṇe | khādakaṃ paścime caiva khuri (gh: khari) kāstraṃ tathottare || 45 ||
svāsanasthā jitadvandvāḥ sarvasaṃbhārasaṃyutāḥ | śāstrasadbhāvakarmajñāḥ kuṇḍasaṃskārapūrvakam || 46 ||
ekatantrodbhavairmantrairjanayeyuḥ (mū, a, k: -mantro-) śivānalam | evaṃ tu mūrtipāḥ sarve kṛtvā sthaṇḍilatarpaṇam || 47 ||
dadyuḥ pūrṇāhutiḥ pañcātsthāpakena samanvitāḥ | sthāpakaśca śirodeśe pūrvasambhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ || 48 ||
sitoṣṇīṣa dharo maunī sitavastrānulepanaḥ | ekacitto jitakrodhaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ || 49 ||
kuṇḍasaṃskārapūrvaṃ tu (k, g: saṃpūrṇaṃ) śivāgniṃ janayetsudhīḥ | janite tarpite vahnau dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ || 50 ||
santarpyāsanavaktrāṅgaṃ (kh: vajrāṅgaṃ) mantragrāmaśeṣataḥ | tiryagūrdhvāgamotthairvā prāguktavidhimantrataḥ || 51 ||
siddhimuktipradā mantrā guptyuktāḥ sarvakarmaṇi | dhātuḥ śabdaniṣedhārthaṃ syānmatriguptabhāṣaṇe || 52 ||
maunayuktaḥ sadā mantraṃ japettaddhyānasaṃyutaḥ | nyāsane homakārye tu upāṃścādi ca daiśikaḥ || 53 ||
mūrtipairastrajāpaiśca vinā (mū, g: sadā) saṃsthāpite hare | savighno jāyate yāgastasmānmūrtidharānyajet (gh: nyaset) || 54 ||
trayorakṣaṇahetvarthaṃ rañjanārthamadhīmatām | krūraśabdaniṣedhārthaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ sadaiva tu || 55 ||
vedaśāstrārthatatvajñānmṛdupāṭhāñjitendriyān | svaśāstralakṣaṇopetānbrāhmaṇānsusamāhitān || 56 ||
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ kuryāttānsvastivācakān | caturdikṣubahiḥ paścādācāryastānniveśayet (sanni-) || 57 ||
bahvacānprāgdiśi sthāpya yāmye cātharvaṇāṃstathā | paścime vājasaneyāṃśchandogānuttareṇa tu || 58 ||
svadikṣu sthāpayitvā tāndevyā matānusārataḥ | samādiśya tato viprānnadyuktāndvā pradarśanāt || 59 ||
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānīṃ ca nāsadāśīṃ ca vājikam (k: nam) | vṛṣākapiṃ ca maitraṃ ca bahvṛcaḥ paścime japet || 60 ||
devabrataṃ ca puṃsāma jyeṣṭasāma rathantaram | bhāruṇḍāni ca sāmāni vāmadevaṃ tathaiva ca || 61 ||
uttarāṃ diśamāsthāya chandogastu japetsadā | rudraṃ puruṣasūktaṃ ca ślokādhyāyaṃ ca śukriyam || 62 ||
brāhmaṇānmitramaitraṃ ca adhyuryuḥ pūrvato japet | atharvāṅgirasaṃ (gh: gratharvaśirasaṃ) caiva skanda (mū: skandha) sūktaṃ tathaiva ca || 63 ||
kṣurikaṃ (k, kh: khurikaṃ) nīlarudraṃ ca garbhopaniṣadādikam | kālīṃ karālikaṃ rudraṃ yāmye cātharvaṇo japet (nāyamaskākaṃ dvārapālaniveśanakramaḥ sūktapāṭhakramaśca kramo'yaṃ matāntaraviṣayakamiti) || 64 ||
liṅgodbhavaṃ tadaṅgāni pavitraṃ gaṇapāṭhakam | stotramantravidaścānye japeyu(kh, gh: paṭheyu)rdakṣiṇe sadā || 65 ||
tataścārghaṃ tu datvā vai ālabheta gurūḥ śivam | padākhyaṃ brahmaṇā cāpi (mū: ṇo vāpi) svakalādyakṣarānvitaiḥ (k, kh, gh: piṇḍairvā svakalānvitaiḥ) || 66 ||
nyasya (nyāstvā, li0 pu0 pā0) dhyāyettato mantrī (kh: mantraṃ) jīvabhūtaṃ navātmakam | jvaladagnisamākāraṃ visphurantaṃ samantataḥ || 67 ||
puryaṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ sadaiva mantranāyakam | sarvaṃ śuddhyati tenaiva jagasthāvarajaṅgamam || 68 ||
adhaḥ śaktiranantākhya kālāgnirnarakāstataḥ (mū: navakāḥ-) | avicī rauravaścaiva mahāraurava eva ca || 69 ||
rasātalaṃ ca pātālaṃ mahātalaṃ gabhastikam | nitalāhvaṃ varāhvaṃ ca ābhāsākhyaṃ ca saptamam || 70 ||
bhūrlokaśca bhuvaḥ svaśca maharloko janastapaḥ | satyamūrdhvakramā hyete (kh, gh: dete) brahmā viṣṇustato (gh: tathā) haraḥ || 71 ||
dvisaptabhuvanānyantardigrudraśatasaṃyutam | brahmāṇḍaṃ (g: brahmāntaṃ) caṇḍarūpaṃ syāccaturāsyo'dhidaivatam || 72 ||
śatakoṭyuchrayaṃ mānāttatsarma yojanaiḥ pṛthu | urvitattvaṃ samākhyātaṃ jalādidviguṇaṃ (kh: digguṇaṃ) kramāt || 73 ||
kṣmāmbutejomarutkhāni gandhaśca rasarūpakau | sparśaḥśabdaśca pañcaiva tanmātrāṇi yathākramam || 74 ||
nāsājihvākṣicarmāṇi śrotrabuddhīndriyāṇi ca | gudaṃ guhyaṃ karāṅghī ca savākka (mū, a, gh: sarvān) rmendriyāṇi ca || 75 ||
manobuddhirahaṅkāraḥ satvādi ca guṇatrayam | pumān rāgaśca vidyā ca niyatiśca kulāntakaḥ (mū: kalāntakaḥ) || 76 ||
māyā caiva tathāvidyādhīśvarākhyaḥ sadāśivaḥ (k: stathā śivaḥ) | śaktiścebhyaḥ parastācca śivākhyaḥ paramo'vyayaḥ || 77 ||
śiktistho viśvabandhuśca (gh: bandhaśca) mantraiḥ śuddhaḥ (mū: siddhaḥ) śivaṃ vrajet | pañcabhūtaṃ ca tanmātraṃ buddhiḥ karmendriyaṇi ca || 78 ||
manobuddhirahaṅkāraḥ prakṛtirguṇasaṃyutā | caturviṃśatitattvāni prakṛtirvāmakarṇagāḥ || 79 ||
tvaksaṃsthaḥ puruṣaḥ prokto rāgākhyaḥ snāyujālake | (asau cāpacihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kha. pustake nāsti) māṃse'vidyā samākhyātā niyatirhṛdaye sthitā || 80 ||
kalākoṣe'srake (gh: kope-) kālo māyā prāṇeṣvavasthitā | vidyā coṣṭhasthitā (gh: gatā) nityamīśvaro bindusaṃsthitaḥ || 81 ||)
nāde sadāśivo jñeyaḥ śaktisthā indhikādayaḥ | pañcaviṃśacca tattvāni piṇḍīkāyāṃ sthitāni tu || 82 ||
vidyārājena śuddhyanti tadūrdhve niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ | mantrabhūtaṃ śivaṃ tatra vinyasetsiddhimuktaye || 83 ||
tritattvamātmatattvādyaṃ vedāsrādyamajādike | nyasya tu bhāvayedvyāptiṃ śivarūpaṃ ca yatparam || 84 ||
dharādipuruṣaṃ yāvadvidyāntāṃ ca dharādikam (mū: vanādikam; kh, gh: rāgāvikam; k: dhanādikam) | īśvarādiśivāntaṃ ca tritayaṃ (kh: tritatvaṃ) homayetkvacit || 85 ||
hute'ghore sahasre vā brahmāṃśaṃ ca sevayedguruḥ | śivakumbhāmbunā tadvattadūrdhve ca harestanum || 86 ||
tadūrdhve ca hunedrudraṃ siktvā darbhaiḥ spṛśetkramāt | pañcabrahma ca digdhavya(digvācya, mū0 pā0)mekādiśatapañcakam || 87 ||
aṅgāni daśamāṃśena homayettatkalāḥ kramāt | varṇarudrādividyeśāṃllokeśān gaṇanāyakān || 88 ||
hemenāpyāyanaṃ kṛtvā śrapayetpūrvavaccarum | (cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mū, g, gh, pustakeṣu nāsti) susvinnaṃ nāpi dagdhaṃ ca śaivairmantraiḥ prasādhitam || 89 ||
śivakumbhe tathā deve dattvātha juhuyāccarum | pūrṇāhutiṃ śivenāto yāgasya paripūrtaye || 90 ||
kartṛgṛhītajapyācca pūrṇāṃ dadyāttu daiśikaḥ | tasminkāle gurau dānaṃ dadyādvittānusārataḥ (gh: nurūpataḥ) || 91 ||
gorhemakhuraśṛṅgiṇyāḥ śataṃ vārdhaṃ tadardhakam | dakṣiṇārdhena (gh: ṇendreṇa) hastena punarhomaṃ pradāpayet || 92 ||
tataḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti bahurūpaśate hute | prāyaścitte tathā vighne mahāstraṃ homayettataḥ || 93 ||
iti kṛtvā vidhiṃ samyaktato devaṃ prabodhayet | rātrau mahotsavaḥ kāryaḥ śaṅkhabheryādinisvanaiḥ || 94 ||
gāyanairnartakaiḥ śiṣṭairnandidhoṣaiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ | nayettāṃ śarvarīṃ sarvāṃ yatistotraravaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 95 ||
eka (kh: evaṃ) tripañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vādhivāsanam (kh: vāpi vāsaram) | suśobhitaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā vastradhvajavitānakaiḥ || 96 ||
cāmarairhemadaṇḍaiśca chatrai raukmābjadaṇḍibhiḥ (mū: daṇḍabhiḥ) | annādyaiḥ pūritaṃ sarvai rathamāropayecchivam || 97 ||
yajettūryaninādena dīpadarpaṇasaṃyutaiḥ | padmāṅkaiḥ (gh: padmākaiḥ) kalaśaiḥ śubhrairgītaiḥ pāṭhairanekaśaḥ || 98 ||
veṣṭayennagaraṃ vāpi puraṃ vā dhāma vā śanaiḥ | rathaṃ sthāpya valiṃ dadyād guhyakebhyo muhurmuhuḥ || 99 ||
gacchelliṅgapuraḥ kartā sagotro daiśikāgrataḥ | prasādāgre ca saṃsthāpya liṅgasyārthaṃ pradāpayet || 100 ||
homayedvāstunāthāṃśca tattva (mū: tadvat) saṃsthitamānasaḥ | prāguktalakṣaṇaṃ tatra paścātkūrmaśilāṃ nyaset || 101 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye'dhivāsanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo vidhiḥ] || 15 ||
[atha ṣoḍaśaḥ]
prāsādaṃ prokṣayetsarvamastrajaptena vāriṇā | tadgarbhaṃ sūtrayetpaścānmadhyasthāna yathāpnuyāt || 1 ||
garbhakarṇāyataṃ sūtraṃ kṛtvā bhāgacatuṣṭayam | tadekāṃśapramāṇena madhye kūrmaśilāsthitiḥ || 2 ||
na madhye sthāpayelliṅgaṃ naiva madhyaṃ parityajet | madhyasthaṃ hanti kartāraṃ brahmavedhā nasaṃśayaḥ || 3 ||
tasmādośaṃ samāśritya tatthitiḥ sūtramānataḥ | dvāraṃtu saptadhā kṛtvā madhyekāṃśaṃ rathaṃ (k, kh: rasaṃ) punaḥ || 4 ||
saumye dvau dakṣiṇe dvyaśaṃ (g: tvaṃśaṃ) tyaktvā tatsūtramānataḥ (kh: ntasūtrasaṃsthitiḥ) | pratyakṣaṃ mantrasānnidhyamācandrārkaṃ prapūjya ca (kh, gh: te) || 5 ||
subhikṣaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ vijayaṃ rāṣṭravardhanam | sarvasatva (kh: sandhi) śubhaṃ kuryādīśadiksaṃsthitaḥ śivaḥ || 6 ||
nṛpāṇāṃ tu hitaṃ prācyāmāgneyyāmagnijīvinām | dhvajānāṃ (?) rākṣasāśāyāṃ vāyavyāṃ nṛtyagītinām || 7 ||
kauveryāṃ godvijādīnāṃ kārukāṇāṃ vidikṣu ca | aiśānīmāśritaṃ saukhyaṃ yajamānaḥ kulaiḥ saha || 8 ||
madhye tu mriyate kartā na ca madhyātpracālayet | madhyātpracālitaṃ liṅgaṃ bhaveddoṣāvahaṃ yataḥ (pahaṃ) || 9 ||
kauveryāmāśrite liṅge kartṛduḥkhaṃ dvijavyathā | aindryāṃ tu mriyate rājā kṣatriyāṇāṃ vyathā bhavet || 10 ||
yāmyāyāṃ ca viśāṃ pīḍā vāruṇyāṃ śudrajanmanām | tapasvināmathaiśānyāṃ nair(-)ṛtyāṃ rāṣṭravibhramaḥ || 11 ||
āgneyyāmagnitaḥ pīḍā vāyavyāṃ taskarādbhayam | yathā praveśayelliṅgaṃ tatphalaṃ yattaducyate || 12 ||
praviṣṭe cāṣṭame bhāge brahmabhāgasya bhūtale | śāntiśreyaskaraṃ liṅgaṃ kartṛsthāpakaśilpinām || 13 ||
liṅgasya niścitā pūjā tathā pādapraveśane | tribhāgasya praveśe tu modante sarvadehinaḥ || 14 ||
pañcabhāgapraveśe tu kartṛsthāpakaśilpinām | prajā cārdhapraveśe tu vardhante sacatuṣpadāḥ || 15 ||
samastabrahmabhāgasya praveśe sthāpakādayaḥ | kartā ca bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ prāpnuvanti mahatsukham || 16 ||
tato (mū: tathā) niveśayelliṅgaṃ sunirvighnaṃ (kh: sanīviṣṭaṃ) yathā bhavet | cālite tu mahadduḥkhaṃ khaṃ sphuṭite dravyasaṃkṣayaḥ || 17 ||
vakre tu hīyate pūjā bhrānte tu kalaho rujā (?) | saśabde rāṣṭrabhaṅgaḥ syātpraṇate vyādhisambhavaḥ || 18 ||
viśīrṇe sarvanāśaḥ syātkampite rāṣṭravibhramaḥ | eṣāṃ tu sambhavaṃ jñātvā doṣāṇāṃ (mū, a, k, kh, g: śeṣāṇāṃ) mūrtipaiḥ saha || 19 ||
vijñāpyeśaṃ tu santarptha sthaṇḍile daiśikottamaḥ | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā ekaikasya tu sambhave || 20 ||
aghoreṇa śivenānte pūrṇāṃ datvā tataḥ śubham | sthāpyamānaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ sthitaṃ vā madhyataḥ śubham || 21 ||
dvāraṃ (mū: dvāḥ) samaṃ tribhāgonaṃ (k, kh: tribhāgena) madhyato liṅgamucchrayam | jyeṣṭhādīnāṃ tu veśmānāṃ dehalīsamasūtrataḥ || 22 ||
jñātvaivamādyaśaktyā tu kūrmākhyā pūrvanirmitā | rasakūrmānvitā yojyā tadūrdhve cāparāśilā || 23 ||
brahmaśilāpramāṇena khātakaṃ pūrvaśodhitam | iṣṭvā rājaśilāṃ tatra śaktimantreṇa vinyaset || 24 ||
anantākhyāparāśaktirvijñāpyasanadhāriṇī | śivājñayā tvayā devi sthātavyamihasarvadā || 25 ||
vyāptirdhyānāśrayo bhūtvā samatvaṃ sarvagaṃ param | sāvaṣṭambhaṃ sthirādhvānaṃ (mū: dhyānaṃ) liṅgaṃ sañcintya vinyaset || 26 ||
oṃ vyāpini namo'nante śāśvate susthire dhruve | amale (kh: acare; gh: amare) sakalādhāre hrī(/) la(/) hrī(/) tiṣṭha cāmba he (mū: cāsure) || 27 ||
iti (ityayaṃ pāṭhaḥ likhitapustakeṣu nāsti) brahmaśilāropaṇamantraḥ |
udaṅmukho'sramantreṇa prokṣayecchivavāriṇā | śvabhrapracchādanaṃ vasraṃ kṛtvā (k, kh: hṛtvā) śvabhraṃ viśodhayet || 28 ||
darbhairūllikhya saṃprokṣya śivena śivavāriṇā | vilipya candanenādau dhūpayitvā śilātalam || 29 ||
sahiraṇyena hastena nyasedratnānyathecchayā | svadigīśena mantreṇa hṛdā vā praṇavena vā || 30 ||
pañcavaktreṇa vā nyasya vidyeśvareṇa vā kvacit | gavyapāyasasaṃmiśragugguludrava (gh: dravya) lepitāḥ || 31 ||
ratnādhārāḥ purā kāryā ratnādisthāpanaṃ tataḥ | mate mate'nyathā jñātvā svekchayā vā nyasedguruḥ || 32 ||
vajramauktikavaidūryaśaṅkhasphaṭikapuṣpakam | indranīlaṃca sunīlaṃ pūrvādikramato nyaset || 33 ||
vidrumaṃ mauktikālābhe rājāvartaṃ ca vinyaset | vaidūryasyāpyalābhe tu nīlaṃ vā padmarāgakam || 34 ||
vajraṃ sūryāṅkakaṃ nīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ sumauktikam | puṣpakaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca vaidūryaṃ prāgdiśāditaḥ || 35 ||
sunīlasya yadālābhastadā marakarta nyaset | aprāptau padmarāgasya (k, kh, gh: puṣparāgasya) saugandhikaṃ matāntarān || 36 ||
hematāmramayoraṅga (gh: vaṅga) tātāraṃ ghoṣasīsakam | nirupyaitāni vinyase (gh: sannyase) dindrādīśāntagocarāt || 37 ||
haritālaṃ śilāṃ caiva añjanaṃ (gh: añcanaṃ) cābhrakaṃ tathā | kāśīvamatha sindūraṃ mākṣikaṃ gairikaṃ nyaset || 38 ||
gandhakaṃ cāñjanābhāve sindūrasyathā (k, kh: sya ca) pāradam | saurāṣṭrī māthikālābhe gairikasya tu rocanām || 39 ||
tālaṃ śilāṃ ca kāsīsaṃ mākṣikaṃ sūtrakaṃ nyaset | sauvarṇaṃ gairikaṃ gandhaṃ bhṛṅgaṃ (mū: bhṛṅga abhrakamityarthaḥ) pūrvādikaṃ kvacit || 40 ||
brīhigodhūmahavyāṃśca māṣamūdgayavāṃstathā | nīvārāścāpi śyāmākānpūrṇadyāṃśca niveśayet || 41 ||
godhūmāśca yavāścaiva tilamudgaulikāḥ kramāt | syāmākānsarṣapāṃ (mū: māṣakāṃ) ścaiva brīhīṃścāpi tathā (mū: tato) nyaset || 42 ||
māṣān brīyerabhāvena mudgasya caṇakānnyaset | sidhārthaṃ ca vinā karṅguśyāmākā bhāvataḥ kapim (kapi stṛṇadhānyaviśeṣaḥ) || 43 ||
candanaṃ candanaṃ raktaṃ ladhūka (laghukaṃ = aguruḥ) cāñjanaṃ nyaset | uśīraṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ ca sahāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ kvacit || 44 ||
sahāṃ ca viṣṇunāmāṃ ca lohitaṃ candanaṃ ladhu | candanaṃ sāri vākuṇṭha (mū: kumbha) muśīraṃ śaṅkhapuṣpikām || 45 ||
sadyojātādibhirmantraiḥ ratnalohāni dhātukān | bījāni cauṣadhīraṣṭau kumbhayitvā nyasenkramāt || 46 ||
rasendro madhyato deyaḥ sarvairetaiḥ samanvitaḥ | dravyādhike mahādoṣo guñjāmādhaiḥ karakramāt || 47 ||
ratnādī (g: vasādī) nāṃmasaṃpūrṇā (?) sasūtraṃ cādipañcakam | nyasedvajraṃ tathā (gh: tadā) hema tālaṃ tavān sahāṃ kramāt || 48 ||
daradaṃ pāradābhāve vajrābhāve tu kāñcanam | hemābhāve nyasettāraṃ gairirka tālakaṃ vinā || 49 ||
yavābhāve tilāndadyā (kh: śreṣṭhā) llājjakaṃ sahāṃ vinā | nyasetsarvaṃ gurusvekaṃ rasendraṃ vāpyasambhave || 50 ||
kūrmakṣmāṃ merumukṣāṇaṃ padmaṃ vā lakṣaṇānvitam | eṣāmekatamaṃ madhye nyasenbrahmaśilāvaṭe || 51 ||
śilāścabhracatuḥ ṣaṣṭhibhāgāt karṇāvaṭaṃ pṛthu | nimnavyāsārdhatastasya daleṣvaṣṭasu (mū: dalāveṣṭaṃ sva) madhyataḥ || 52 ||
hemaṃ tāmraṃ ca tāraṃ ca kūrmaṃ prāglakṣaṇānvitam | haimīṃ vā rupyajī pṛthvī meruṃ saurarṇajaṃ sadā || 53 ||
vṛṣabhaṃ tārajaṃ haimaṃ tāmraṃ vā lakṣaṇairyutam | padmamaṣṭāyasaṃ nyasya haimaṃ tārajameva vā || 54 ||
hastamātrasya liṅgasya kūrmādyamaṃśa (k: māṣa) mānakam | śeṣāṇāṃ kramavṛddhīnāṃ bāṇamatānnavāntikam (kh: -nyavā-) || 55 ||
mṛttikāṃ parvatāgrotthāṃ sarito vā taṭodbhavām | rajataṃ ca yavāṃścaiva kūrmeṇa saha vinyaset || 56 ||
samaṃ dvārekṣaṇaṃ śastaṃ (gh: śāstraṃ) rāṣṭre rājyajayā (kh: bhayā) vaham | tatra saṃsthāpite liṅge yajamānaḥ pravardhate || 57 ||
kāñcanaṃ sarvabījāni pṛthivyā saha vinyaset | tasyāṃ vyavasthite rudre prajā nityaṃ pramodate || 58 ||
madhukaṃ cākṣataṃ caiva tvañjanaṃ (mū, a, g: puñcanaṃ) meruṇā saha | śrīkāmastu nyasenmadhye deva (kh: deśa) vṛddhyarthameva vā || 59 ||
godhūmakaṃ caṇaṃ (kh: godhūmaṃ kāñcanaṃ) sarpirdvūrvāṃ gorocanāṃ tathā | gośṛṅgamṛttikāṃ caiva vṛṣeṇa saha vinyaset || 60 ||
mahokṣaṃ vinyasenmadhye dvārādiksaṃmukhaṃ samam | tatra praropite (mū, a, g, ṅ: prabodhite) deve cāturvarṇyaṃ ca vardhate (kh: nandate) || 61 ||
hāṭakaṃ kṛśarāṃścāpi padmena saha vinyaset | tasminvyavasthite nāthe śrīvṛddhiścaiva sampadaḥ (kh: ñcirasaṃpadaḥ) || 62 ||
athavā padmarāgaṃ tu kāñcanaṃ pāradānvitam | dravyāṇāmapyalābhe tu teṣāmekatamaṃ nyaset || 63 ||
ratnanyāso mayākhyātaḥ saṃprāpyaḥ prāptito yathā | evaṃ dravyāṇi sarvāṇi vividhaṃ (mū: niviḍaṃ) sanniveśya ca || 64 ||
rasena gugguloḥ pañcātsaṃskṛtena vileyayey | śilāsamāni randhrāṇi kṛtvā netraṃ tathopari || 65 ||
varmaṇāstreṇa saṃrakṣya digīśebhyo baliṃ kṣipet | samācamya kṛtanyāso juhuyādasinā śatam || 66 ||
śilāsūtracyutiśchidre niṣedhāya śivena vā | vāstospatiṃ tato hutvā pīṭhaṃ śvabhraṃ nirūpayet || 67 ||
kṣīradārukṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ pīṭhaśvabhre niyojayet | niḥ sandhiḥ suḍṛḍhaṃ tacca vidadhīta prayatnataḥ || 68 ||
paścādarghaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dadyālliṅgeṣu bhāvitaḥ (gh: bhāvikāḥ) | tataḥ suyantritaṃ daṇḍe badhnīyādvālatantunā || 69 ||
tūryamaṅgalanirghoṣairyatnādutthāpayocchivam | vandivṛndaravaiḥ stotraiḥ śobhanaiḥ śakunairbhṛśam (mū: śaṅkalaiḥ-) || 70 ||
yajamāno vrajettatra vṛtaḥ sarve svakairjanaiḥ | mūrtipaiḥ śilpibhiḥ sārdhamanulagnaiḥ śive tadā || 71 ||
tadagrato gururgacchetsugṛhītārghabhājanaḥ | dvāradeśāgate liṅge ardhaṃ datvā praveśayet || 72 ||
dvārabandhaṃ vinā dvārādaspṛśan taṃ praveśayet | dvārabandhānvite dhāmni nabhaseva tadūrdhvataḥ || 73 ||
yatnātpraveśayedgarbhaṃ (g: lliṅgaṃ) yathā kuḍyaṃ na saṃspṛśet | digvyomasparśanātkuryāttaddiśyuktāṃ ca dakṣiṇām || 74 ||
hema tāmraṃ lulāyaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ muktāṃ suvastrakam | śaṅkhaṃ dhenu(/) gurordadyādindrādispṛṣṭidoṣahṛt || 75 ||
bhadrapīṭhe tataḥ sthāpyo dvāragarbhāntare prabhuḥ | ardhaṃ datvā hṛdāsthāpya (mū: hṛdotthāpya) muhūrte sadguṇe guruḥ || 76 ||
liṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ tathā kaṇṭhaṃ jalādhāraṃ yathākramam | vinyasettūryaśabdena nimitte viṣuve sthite || 77 ||
aṅguṣṭhamucchritaṃ (gh: mutsṛtaṃ) kṛtvā muṣṭiṃ badhvā tu dakṣiṇām | piṇḍikāyāṃ nyaselliṅgamaṅguṣṭhena spṛśedguruḥ || 78 ||
umāmaheśamantrābhyāṃ sandhānaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣiṇām | śivomāmantrayogena sandhānaṃ bhūtikāṅkṣiṇām || 79 ||
āsanaṃ ca punardeyamabhisandhānakāraṇam | mūrtyādyaṅkāvasānaṃ tu punarevaṃ tu vinyaset || 80 ||
svatantravihitairmantrairāsanaṃ tatra vinyaset | mūrti śaṃbhuṃ (k, kh, g: mūrtīśaṃ tu) tathāṅgāni paramīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 81 ||
niro (mū: nibo) dhanājña (khya) yā mudrā saṃhitoktavidhānataḥ | rudrādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sthāpanaṃ tathvataḥ (k: ca tataḥ) kramāt || 82 ||
āsanaṃ mūrtiḥ śambhuśca pakṣāṃstrīṃśca tritattvataḥ | ātmavidyāḥ śivaṃ caiva bhāvayedanupūrvataḥ || 83 ||
anantādyāḥ śikhaṇḍāntā āsanasthāśca ye smṛtāḥ | vidyāṅgai (mū, kh: vidyāṅkai) ścaiva saṃyuktā ātmatattve vyavasthitāḥ || 84 ||
śaktayañca smṛtāstisraḥ pañcabrahmasamanvitāḥ | vidyātattve sthitā hyete sādhikāre vidurbudhāḥ || 85 ||
śaktidvayaṃ śivāṅgaśca śivatattvaṃ samāśritāḥ | tritattvavyāptirākhyātā panthānaḥ (g: adhvānaḥ) ṣaḍvidhāstviha || 86 ||
śataikakoṭivistāraṃ nojanaistatsamocchrayam | brahmāntaṃ (kh: brahmāṇḍaṃ) pārthivaṃ tattvaṃ jalādidviguṇaṃ kramāt || 87 ||
śaktyādiśaktiparyantaṃ pañcadaivādhidaivatam | triṃśatpañcādhikaṃ tattvaṃ sanmārgaṃ pīṭhamaiśvaram || 88 ||
dhyātvā liṅge paraṃ (mū: liṅgadharaṃ) śambhuṃ pañcabaktraṃ trilocanam | bhujaistu daśabhiryuktaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam (kh, gh: dhāriṇam) || 89 ||
candrārdhakṛtamūrdhānaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam | gaṇairdevaistathā siddhaiḥ stūyamānaiḥ samāyutam || 90 ||
tataḥ paramasadbhāvamīśānaṃ bindurūpiṇam (mū: rūpakam) | sadyolātena saṃcintya vāmadevena vinyaset || 91 ||
dehī dehe yathā yogaṃ dravyaṃ bhogīva (mū: ca) saṅgatam | bodhakriyāniviṣṭaṃ tu jñeyaṃ jñānāśritaṃ smaret || 92 ||
nādamadhye sthito bindurbindumadhye sthito dhvaniḥ | dhvanimadhyagatā tārā tārāmadhyagateḥ śaśī || 93 ||
śaśīmadhyagataṃ sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmamadhyagato raviḥ | ravimadhyagataḥ śāntaḥ śāntamadhyagataḥ śivaḥ || 94 ||
sūryendubimbayoryadvaddekī (mū: devī) bhūtāmṛtā kalā (kh: matīkalā) | atrāpi ca tathā smṛtvā dṛkkriyāṃ sa (k, kh: kriyāṃśaṃ) nniveśayet || 95 ||
praguṇe kriyamāṇe tu dikprānte (gh: digbhrānte) calanaṃ yadi | tadā digdevatāhomaḥ kāryā śāntiśca doṣahṛt || 96 ||
yasyāṃ diśi calelliṅgaṃ tasyāṃ śāntiṃ ca kārayet | anyathā tu bhavedghoraṃ kartṛrāṣṭravirūpakam || 97 ||
tasmāttadvāharna dadyādindrādīnāṃ yathāsthitam | gajaṃ chāgaṃ lulāyaṃ ca dāsīṃ matsyaṃ mṛgāvikam || 98 ||
vṛthaṃ pratyagrataḥ samyaktanmūlyaṃ (mū: sūtraṃ) vātha śāntaye | pakṣasūtraṃ tato dadyādṛjvarthaṃ lambasūtrakam || 99 ||
punarnacālayelliṅgaṃ yadīcchechreya ātmanaḥ | calile śabdite bhrānte praṇate svasthite kramāt || 100 ||
grāmahṛdrāṣṭrahṛccaiva rogado bhraṃśavṛddhikṛt | śvabhrarandhraṃ ca (kh, gh: sandhiṃ ca) sampūrya (kh: sampūjya) kṣīralohamalaiḥ (mū: le---tmalaiḥ) śubhaiḥ || 101 ||
sikatāpaṅkabālaiśca (gh: patkarālaiḥ) śaṅkhacūrṇa (kh: śaṅkhamūla) samanvitaiḥ | tataḥ śāntighaṭāmmobhiḥ snānaṃ mūrtidharāḥ svakam || 102 ||
prakurvanti tataḥ paścādācāryaḥ snāpayecchivam | toyakṣīradadhikṣaudraghṛtatoyāntarātmakaiḥ || 103 ||
ambhaścatuṣpalaiḥ pūrṇaṃ gaḍḍūkaṃ (gaḍḍūkaṃ=bhṛṅgāre jalapātrabhede iti śabdaratnāvalyām) hemajādikam | mugdā (k, kh: muṅgā) dyaṅgulamātrasya calasya sthāpane hitam || 104 ||
śeṣāṇāṃ cāṅgulaṃ vṛdyā vṛddhistripali (mū, a: pala) kāmbubhiḥ | hastamātre sthire liṅge gaḍḍūkaṃ prasthasammitam || 105 ||
anyeṣāṃ karavṛddhyā syādvṛddhiraṣṭapalaiḥ kramāt | abhyaṅgasnāpanaṃ ca syānmahāsnānaṃ ca śaṅkare || 106 ||
pañcaviṃśatibhiścaiva śatārdhadvisahasrakaiḥ | palaiḥ kramācca (mū: kramāṇi) liṅgānāṃ calasthiradvirū (gh: trirū) piṇām || 107 ||
kṣmādiśaktyantatattveṣu tattvatattveṣu ye sthitāḥ | surādayo'pi ye cānye (kh: cāsya) samānadeśagāstathā || 108 ||
adhikārapāda (kh, gh: pade) śuddhiḥ paramīkaraṇe layaḥ | sthānabhāga (gh: bhoga) sthitāṃ teṣāmadhaścopari madhyataḥ || 109 ||
sthānaṃ (kh, g: snānaṃ) kṛtvā nyasenmantrān yathātmani samīhitam | āsanādyaṃ yathāśāstraṃ vaktraṃ kaṃ (kh, gh: vaktrāṅgaṃ) ca kalāvṛtam || 110 ||
icchāśaktiṃ nyaśedvṛtte mūrtiṃ vidyāṅgarsayutām | kriyāhvāṃ pīṭhamadhyasthāṃ jñānāhvāṃ (gh: jñānākhyāṃ) tadadhaḥ punaḥ || 111 ||
snānaṃ vidhivaddevānāṃ (gh: vidhi ca devānāṃ) sānnidhyasya tu kāraṇam | sarvamantrādisaṃyukto lokānugrahakāmyayā || 112 ||
atra liṅge mahādeva bhava sannidhimānsadā | sūryācandramasauyāvadyāvattiṣṭhati medinī || 113 ||
tāvattvayātra deveśa sthātavyaṃ svecchayā prabho | evamuktvā śivājñāṃ tu mantramūrtau maheśvare || 114 ||
prāṇadarpāgnisaṃhārakṛdbhū (gh: hṛbhdū) myambucalātmakam | rūdrendubindunādākhyaṃ jīvabhūtaṃ śivaṃ nyaset || 115 ||
(li (ayaṃ cāpacihnāntargataḥ pāṭha kha pustakenāsti) ṅgamūrdhni karaṃ nyasya śivamaṣṭaśataṃ japet | tena sānnaidhyamāyānti vaktrāṅgāni punarnyaset || 116 ||
dikṣu cordhvādivaktrāṇi śaktīḥ pīṭhe tu vinyaset |) aghoraṃ hṛdayaṃ dhyātvā vinyaseddhṛdayaṃ tataḥ || 117 ||
puruṣaṃ tu śivaṃ tasya (gh: śirasyasya) śiraḥ sthāne vicintayet | śikhā īśānadevena śikhābhūtaṃ vicintayet || 118 ||
(cāpāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ gh pustake nāsti) kavacaṃ vāmadevaṃ tu dhyāyedguhyādi sarvataḥ |) sadyojāpaṃ nyasedastraṃ haste śūlādikaṃ punaḥ || 119 ||
dvaitādvaitāstu ye mantrā vāgyuktā tā (k: śaktyāntān) (stā) nnirodhayet (mū: nibodhayet) | mudrā śaktīśvarī yā tu pāraṃparyakramāgatā || 120 ||
tāṃ pradarśyātmabhāvena prayogastu gurau sthitaḥ | tābhyāṃ svavasthitā (gh: syācca sthitā) mantrā ācandrārkaṃ śivājñayā || 121 ||
dvaite nirodhanaṃ kuryānmṛtyañjayena varmaṇā | advaite'ghoramantreṇa svahṛdayena vā bhavet || 122 ||
ajātādyāstu yā mudrāḥ pañcānukramataḥ sthitāḥ | tābhireva spṛśelliṅgaṃ piṇḍikā sahitaṃ guruḥ || 123 ||
āhvānāsthāpanā śambho nirodhā niṣkurā (kh, gh: niṣṭhurā) tathā | praṇāmā pañcāmīmudrāsyānāṃ pañcamukhī kramāt (mū: mukhakramāt) || 124 ||
piṇḍikā tu jaganmātā liṅgaṃ tātaścalācale (gh: liṅgāntāntaścarācare) | saṃyogaḥ śivagauryoryaḥ pratiṣṭhā sābhidhīyate (gh: pragīyate) || 125 ||
dharmārdhakāmamokṣārthaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam | sthāpanejyājapadhyānaiḥ śivādvai labhate sadā || 126 ||
prākkartākhyeśvarāntaṃ (mū: śvarākṣyaṃ) ca liṅgaṃ tatpratimāpi vā | durgāyāmīśvarī bhānāvādityo mādhavo harau || 127 ||
pratiṣṭhitaṃ yadā liṅgaṃ tadīśāśāsthitau guruḥ (k, g: sthāpita śivadaiśikaiḥ) | japetpāśupataṃ divyaṃ sarvasaṃpūrti (gh: saṃpūrṇa) kārakam || 128 ||
gurorastrāmbunā (kh: mbhasā) snānaṃ kartuḥ sivaghaṭāmbunā | bhūṣaṇādīn gurordatvā kartādyāccarukaṃ tataḥ || 129 ||
evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ vasudhānyadhanāvaham | rāṣṭre subhikṣamārogyaṃ kuryāccaurādi (kh: caurāri) nāśanan || 130 ||
rājā vijayamāpyoti svasamī (sumantrī) svaprajābalam (?) (gh: susatrī suprajābalā) | sthāpakasya sadā vṛddhirye ca tatropajīvinaḥ (kh, gh: yoginaḥ) || 131 ||
oṣadhyo dhenavo vṛkṣyastadyuktā māhiṣā vṛṣāḥ | śilpinaḥ karmakartāraḥ sarve yānti śivālayam || 132 ||
śivamantrātmakaṃ liṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ śivadaiśikaiḥ | bhuktimuktipradaṃ jñeyamanyathā tu viparyayaḥ || 133 ||
dadyādvastraṃ sragaṃ gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ naivedyadīpakau | devāya lepanaṃ bhūṣāṃ bhojyaṃ dānaṃ ca sammatam (gh: santatam) || 134 ||
turye'hnī śivayogibhyo dvijādibhyaśca yatnataḥ | tataścaṇḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ sthāpayedvidhinā guruḥ || 135 ||
pāpaghno madhunā lepo rajanyā pittaroganut | rocanayākṣirogaghnaḥ phalijyāṃ (mū: kalinyā) ca priyaṅkaraḥ || 136 ||
tilānāṃ ca pitṛprītyai ripughnaḥ padmakesaraḥ | nāgapuṣpaṃ subhikṣāya saptāhaṃ ca phalaṃ kramāt || 137 ||
arghaṃ snānaṃ tathā pūjā aṣṭame'hani śaṅkare | candanāgurukapūrakuṅkumādyaiśca lepanam || 138 ||
bahurūpeṇa mantreṇa vastraṃ dhūpaṃ (kh: puṣpaṃ) pavitrakam | ajena (k, kh: añjanaṃ) rocanāṃ caiva darpaṇaṃ puruṣeṇa tu || 139 ||
īśānena tu puṣpāṇi mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ tathā | kaṭakaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca paṭṭabandhaṃ ca yadbhavet || 140 ||
chatra (mū, a, g: sūtra) dhvajavitānāni cāmaraṃ puṣpadāmakam (k: darpaṇādikam) | kvacittenaiva guhyairvā sarvāṇyetāni dāyayet || 141 ||
evaṃ sapūjitaṃ kṛtvā devadevaṃ tadeśvaram (g: maheśvaram) | praṇamya daṇḍavadbhamau śanairgacchetpradakṣiṇam || 142 ||
purataḥ punarāgatya vijñāpyo bhagavānharaḥ | sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vāpi ajñānājjñānataḥ kṛtam || 143 ||
tatsarvamātmanā sārdhaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam | tasminkāle pradātavyā dakṣiṇā śivayogine || 144 ||
ācāryāyottamā deyā sādhakāyāṅghrivarjitā | putrakāyārdhato deyā samayibhyaśca pādikā || 145 ||
athetaravratibhyaśca pādikaiva hi dakṣiṇā | yathāśakti dvijātibhyo dadyāddānaṃ yathāvidhi || 146 ||
sthapatiṃ kārukāṃścaiva dīnāndhakṛpaṇādikān | tauryikāngāyakānnartṛnnādyena tu toṣayet (kh, gh: tarpayet) || 147 ||
rātrau mahotsavaṃ kuryācchaṅkhatūryādinisvanaiḥ | ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā saptarātramathāpi vā || 148 ||
daśāhaṃ ca prakurvīta mahāntaṃ ca paricchadam | śāsanādyaṃ yatīśābhyāṃ dadyādvittānusārataḥ (kh, gh: rūpataḥ) || 149 ||
sarvasamaṃ sahasrāhvaṃ (mū, k, g: srāṅkaṃ) dvidhā datvādhvapaṅktigam (mū: svapaṅkti; kh: ṣṭapaṅkti) | pumādibhyo divāśuddhiṃ vidyādi tacchatāvṛtam || 150 ||
sahasrāhve śatāhve ca liṅge bhinnādhvakaṃ (mū: ṣkakaṃ; g: ṣṭakaṃ) purā | cetasaḥ (k, kh: cetaḥ saṃ) sthāpanaṃ kuryātpratiṣṭhā pūrvavatsthirā (mū: sthirā) || 151 ||
daśamāṃśe kṛte kṣetre tanmadhye'śacatuṣṭayam | yugabhāgāścaturdikṣu luptvaikaikaṃ tu koṇataḥ || 152 ||
evaṃ sahasrakoṇāni (kh, gh: koṣṭhāni) kuryādekādhikāni tu | sthāpyāni teṣu liṅgāni tatsaṅgayābhirvidhānataḥ || 153 ||
pūrvavatteṣu yāgaḥ syālliṅgeṣu trividhātmasu | hīnānāṃ tu vidhiśvāyaṃ jyeṣṭhānāṃ sthitipūrvakam || 154 ||
lakṣaṇoddharaṇaṃ kṛtvā ratnādikaṃ (g: ratnodakaṃ) nyasettataḥ | tatrānayenmahāliṅgaṃ yantrayogena buddhimān || 155 ||
aṣṭāsraṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā dvayorante ca vartulam | madhye cāṣṭārasaṃyuktaṃ dṛḍhakāṣṭhena maṇḍitam || 156 ||
saṃsthāpya musalīprāntau stambhasthaṃ randhrayordvayoḥ | liṅgādīni dṛḍhairvadhvā carmajaidṛḍhatantubhiḥ || 157 ||
tataścā (k: tatastaṃ; kh, gh: paścāttat) karṣayecchīghramārakān (mū: mākarād) bahubhirjanaiḥ | kharametatsamākhyātaṃ yantramutthāpanāya ca || 158 ||
suvṛtta (mū: svavṛtta) sthūlakāṣṭhāṃśamusalīdvitayaṃ tu vā | musalyantāduraḥ (kh: puraḥ) kāṣṭhavedheṣu viniyojayet || 159 ||
dhūḥ (kh: triḥ) pṛṣṭhe kāṣṭhapaṭṭaṃ tu yojayellohakaṇṭakaiḥ | syātpaṭṭaśakaṭaṃ tvevaṃ bṛhalliṅgādikarṣaṇe || 160 ||
dhūrnāsārandhrayoścarmarajjubhyāmāmayedvṛṣam | dhavamālūrabilvādyairanyairvā dṛḍhadārūbhiḥ || 161 ||
śivikākhye catuṣkāṣṭhe yantre dve ghaṭayed dṛḍhe | brahmasthāne (gh: viṣṇusthāne) drutaṃ liṅgaṃ kīlakaistāḍitaṃ (mū: stholitaṃ) dṛḍhaiḥ || 162 ||
tanmantrabhyāṃ samutthāpya śilāpārśve'tha vinyaset | ratnādhārordhvato (mū: dhārārdhato) nyasya kāṣṭhapaṭṭaṃ samaṃ hṛḍham || 163 ||
tatra viśrāmayelliṅgaṃ tataḥ śvabhre kṣipecchanaiḥ | saumyāṣṭakaṃ vibhidyārghairdigvidigyojitaistataḥ || 164 ||
vastrairāveṣṭitaṃ ślakṣṇairiṣṭakāveṣṭitaṃ bahiḥ | bālukāpūritaṃ kṛtvā jalādhāraṃ nyasettataḥ || 165 ||
tatsikateṣṭakāṃ kṛtvā (g: dhṛtvā) snāpya mantrānnyasettataḥ | pūjāṃ homaṃ ca jāpyaṃ ca kuryādbalyādi pūrvavat || 166 ||
calaliṅgaṃ dvidhā kāryaṃ pṛthakpīṭhaikapīṭhakam | cāndraṃ vibhinnapīṭhaṃ tu sauryaṃ cābhinnapīṭhakam || 167 ||
sve sve kṣetre mahīvāybormantranyāsaṃ tu liṅgayoḥ | rasairvajrauṣadhībhiśca pṛthakpīṭhaṃ tu yojayet || 168 ||
dhyātvā jñānakriyāśaktiṃ liṅgapīṭhai yathākramam | itthaṃ sthiraṃ calaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpyaṃ yāgapūrvakam || 169 ||
vyaktāhvasthāpanaṃ vakṣye pañcabhedaṃ matāntare | ūrdhvāsīnā ca suptā ca yānasthā cāntarikṣagā || 170 ||
āsāṃ netrakriyāpūrvaṃ snānādhivāsanaṃ tataḥ | homaṃ ca rathayātradi svamantraiḥ pīṭhapūrvakam || 171 ||
saptabhāgīkṛte garbhe brahmasthānaṃ tu madhyataḥ | rakṣaḥ sura (rakṣo'sura li0 pu0 pā0) manuṣyāṇāṃ madhyatoṃ'śaiḥ kramāttribhiḥ || 172 ||
manuṣyasurayormadhye tvarcāṅghrī sthāpayetsadā | rakṣoṃ'śe sthāpanaṃ neṣṭaṃ dhanāyurdhānyanāśanāt || 173 ||
kuḍyalagnā na kartavyā svasthānasyā tu bhūtidā | kuḍyena saha saṃyuktā yajamānaṃ vināśayet || 174 ||
tatra brahmaśilāṃ nyasya pīṭhapṛṣṭhārdha (kh: pṛthvardha) vistarām | sadardhamucchṛyaṃ tasyā navagarbhābjasaṃyutām || 175 ||
pūrvavadratnavinyāso diṅmantreṇetareṇa tu | ūrdhvārcā tejasā yojyā āsīnā varuṇena tu || 176 ||
śayitā pārthivenaiva yānasthā cāntarikṣagā | vāyunā sthāpayetprāgvaid dvaite'dvaite nirodhanam || 177 ||
parivārānvitā devā dharādyānvyāpya saṃsthitāḥ | kṣmādipumāvadhau brahmā kādimāyāntake'cyutaḥ || 178 ||
vidyāntāgnyādike rūdraśceśo calā (balā) dibinduke | sādākhyaḥ khādinādāntaḥ śaktītyādiparāvidhiḥ (gh: nvyādiparāvadhi) || 179 ||
apsaro yakṣarakṣāṃsi vidyādhṛdahikinnarāḥ | bhūtavetālaśākinyo grahanakṣatrarāśayaḥ || 180 ||
samudrāḥ kṣetrapā nadya (kh: palādyā) ṛṣirbrahmā digādayaḥ | urvītattve sthitāḥ śodhyā (kh: sādhyā) jarāyujodbhijāṇḍajāḥ || 181 ||
kṣoṇī kālaḥ sadā jñeyo vārī saṅkaṇottamaḥ | pradyumno vahvitattvasthāstvaniruddhaḥ samīraṇe || 182 ||
brahmā vyoma samākhyāto mano nārāyaraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | dhīrviṣṇuḥ kasarī garso vāsudevaḥ pumānmataḥ || 183 ||
matsyaḥ kūrmo vahāhaśca narasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ | rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca buddhaḥ kalkī dharāditaḥ || 184 ||
kvacidbhūḥ keśavaḥ prokto nārāyaṇo jalādhipaḥ | mādhavo vahnitattve tu govindo marutātmakaḥ || 185 ||
viṣṇurviyatsamākhyāto mano vai madhusūdanaḥ | buddhistrivikramo jñeyo garvo ca vāmanaḥ sadā || 186 ||
avyaktaḥ (gh: avyakte) śrīdharaḥ khyāto hṛṣīkeśaḥ pumānmataḥ | padmanābhaḥ sadāśaktirdāmodaraḥ sadeśvaraḥ (kh: maheśvaraḥ) || 187 ||
kṣmāmbubahnimarutkhāni manobuddhirahaṅkṛtiḥ | avyaktaḥ puruṣaḥ śaktiḥ parorkā dvādaśa kramāt || 188 ||
mitraścaiva tathā viṣṇurvaruṇaḥ (gh: jiṣṇu) sūrya eva ca (kh: sūryasaṃjñakaḥ) | sahasrāṃśuśca dhātā ca tapanaḥ savitā tathā || 189 ||
gabhastiraviparjanyasraṣṭāntāstattvanāyakāḥ | etattattve (kh: etettattva) sthitā rudrā mārgādikārtikāntagāḥ || 190 ||
tryakṣaścomāpatiḥ sthāṇurnīlakaṇṭhaścaturthakaḥ | mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ || 191 ||
īśāno dhanado bhīmo dvādaśaite tu viśvapāḥ | tathoktā navadurgāśca ambikādigaṇāśca ye || 192 ||
hariharārdhanārīśā ye cānye rudramūrtayaḥ | yoginyo vividhākārāstathānye pūrvacoditāḥ || 193 ||
uparyupari te sarve sthitāstattvādhvagāḥ surāḥ | parivārānvitāḥ śodhyā māyā (gh: mayā) tattvāvadhau matā || 194 ||
dharātattvādividyāntā dvātriṃśadātmatattvajāḥ | vidyāṅgāni ca vidyeśāḥ saṃsthāpyāścātmatattvataḥ || 195 ||
tisraḥ śaktaya īśaśca pañcabrahmāṇi (gh: brahmāṇi; mū: tu) tatra ca | sthāpayejjñānatattveṣu (k, gh: śaktidvayaṃ) śivatattve śivātmakāḥ || 196 ||
śivatattve (gh: sayojanaṃ) śivāṅgāni sadākhyaṃ śivatattvagam | pratitattvaṃ surāṇāṃ tu sthāpanāṅgani lakṣayet || 197 ||
mūrtirnāma ca mantraśca sopacāraśca śodhanam | tattvasaṃśodhanaṃ (mū, a: bodhanaṃ) caiva sthāpanaṃ rodhanaṃ (kh: bodhane) kramāt || 198 ||
bhogāvāhyadhikārau ca layaśca paramīkriyā | daityādīnāmathānyeṣāṃ dvādaśāṅgāni ropaṇe || 199 ||
sadāgamārthatattvajñaḥ śānto labdhopadeśakaḥ | sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi jñānavāṃstārako guruḥ || 200 ||
saṃsārasāgare ghore pratiṣṭhāvartmanaukayā (mū: dharmanaukayā) | tārayitvā nayetkartṛniṣṭadevasya yatpuram (k, kh: satpuram) || 201 ||
adhvānaṃ yo najānāti nāsau jānāti dīkṣitum | pratiṣṭhāṃ na ca devānāṃ tasmātsyādadhbavidguruḥ || 202 ||
vīrabhadramataṃ dṛṣṭā likhitaṃ hitakāmyayā | dviśaktigarbhagānāṃ tu sthāpanāyākhilaṃ guroḥ || 203 ||
mūrtibhedātkriyāmantraphalānāṃ bheda iṣyate | dvaitādvaitaṃ tathā miśramajñānācca viparyayaḥ || 204 ||
vyaktāvyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ dṛgunmīlanapūrvikā | kāryā sā pūrvavatkṛtsnā avyaktake'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ || 205 ||
brahmavasvartubhaktaṃ vā ardhaddhitrīśabhāgikam | veśanaṃ caikavaktre tu ardhaṃ sarvaṃ trivaktrake || 206 ||
dvayaṃ sarvaṃ caturāsye (gh: caturasraṃ) ṣaṭ pañca vā trivaktrake | catuḥ sahāsamastaṃ vā pañcānane kvacinmatam || 207 ||
tatpārśve yojayetpiṇḍīṃ caturasrāṃ dvikhaḍinīm | avyaktākhye (gh: suvyaktākhye) tathā kāryā tryaṃśādhikajalāśravā || 208 ||
liṅgaṃ praseśayetpīṭhe pīṭhaṃ vā (k, kh: pīṭhe'rcā) liṅgapārśvayoḥ | sthāpya saṃsthāpya susthāpya pratiṣṭhoktā tridhā (kh: kriyā) kramāt || 209 ||
vidhiniṣpāditaṃ samyaṅmitravatsaukhyadaṃ bhavet | duṣprayuktaṃ punastattu śatruvadbhayakṛdbhavet || 210 ||
tasmātsamyakpravijñāya sthāpanaṃ sukhakṛnmatam | anyathā karmavaiguṇyādubhayoraśubhapradam || 211 ||
dvijairbauṃddhairmagairnagnaiḥkaulairlākula (mū: lokula) kārakaiḥ | liṅgaṃ vā śilpibhirnyastaṃ punaḥ saṃskāramarhati || 212 ||
mukhaliṅge sahasrāhve śatāhve vyaktasaṃjñake (gh: śatākhye'vyaktake) | avyaktākhye (gh: suvyaktākhye) sthirārcāyāṃ caṇḍakḷptiśca vakṣyate || 213 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye tridhā liṅgaropaṇaṃnāma (śabdo'yaṃ likhitapustakeṣu nāsti) ṣoḍaśo vidhiḥ] || 16 ||
[atha saptadaśaḥ]
caturthe'hni kṛtasnāno yajamāno yajetsadā | gurūrmūrtidharān sarvāngandhādikanakāmbaraiḥ || 1 ||
tataḥ śivatanurbhūtvā ardhakumbhāstrarakṣaṇam | kṛtvā prāgvadguruḥ sarvaṃ liptapīṭhe puraṃ nyaset || 2 ||
prārdhacandravatkṛtvā jaladvāreka (kh: dhāraika) śobhitam | sitājāṣṭadalopetaṃ madhye karṇikayānvitam || 3 ||
dvihastaṃ kanyase liṅge hastadaghnāmbubhāgike | karṇikāṃ kesarānsandhiṃ dalāgrānmadhvataḥ kramāt || 4 ||
pītena karṇikā kāryā haritaṃ pañcapuṣkaram | sitalohitapītāni kesarāṇi kramājjinaiḥ || 5 ||
śvetapatrāṇi rekhā ca raktakṛṣṇāntarāṇi ca | site tu mekhalādvāre anyeṣāṃ karavṛddhitaḥ (asya ślokārdhasya kh pustake bhinnaḥ pāṭho vartatesite tu śvetapatrāṇi raktakṛṣṇottarāṇi ca iti |) || 6 ||
tato nirmālyamākṛṣya caturthe'hni kṛtaṃ (kh: sthita) ca yat | aiśānyāṃ tadvyavasthāpya (k: tadava-) naivedyaṃ ca visarjayet (gh: visarjya ca) || 7 ||
pañcasvādubhirāsnāpya gandhādyaiḥ pūjayecchivam | toṣito (gh: yojito) 'vidhavodgītai (mū: dhavāgītai) rmaṅgalaistūryanisvanaiḥ || 8 ||
yajeyurarūṇaiḥ sūtrairveṣṭitaiḥ (gh: veṣṭhite) sammatādibhiḥ | tato vijñāpayedīśaṃ caṇḍeśeṣṭyai gurūstadā || 9 ||
tatra caṇḍeśvaraṃ dhyātvā svavaktrāṅgapradīpitam | yajedgandhādibhirhomastatkuṇḍe syācchataṃ śatam || 10 ||
devī hyāgarbhapuṃstvāni (mū.: hyāgaccha puṃstvāpi) sīmantaṃ jātanāma ca | niṣkrāntyannaśikhākarmavratodvāhamukhāṅkakaiḥ (mū.: sukhāṃśakai) || 11 ||
vāgīśvarīṃ ca vidyeśaṃ hutvā saṃśraṣayeccarum | pañcabhirbrahmābhiḥ sāṅgaiścaṇḍādīn juhuyāttataḥ || 12 ||
prasādagarbhamānena kṛtvādau (kh: dvau) caṇḍaveśma ca | caṇḍeśvaraṃ vyavasthāpva aiśānyāṃ jagatībahiḥ || 13 ||
śivatejaḥ samudbhūtaṃ raudraṃ krūraṃ bhayāvaham | śāsanaṃ mūrtivaktrāṅgaṃ yajeccaṇḍaṃ vidhānataḥ (gh: vidhānavat) || 14 ||
jñānaśaktipadairmantrairhuṃ phaṭkārasamanvitaiḥ | caṇḍopapadasaṃyuktaiḥ prāgvaccaṇḍeśvaraṃ yajet || 15 ||
dhyāyenna vāmbudābhāsaṃ caturvaktraṃ caturbhujam | tryakṣaṃ candrajaṭājūṭaṃ dīptāsyaṃ phaṇikaṅkaṇam || 16 ||
śūlaṭaṅkodyataṃ hastaṃ kamaṇḍalvakṣamālikam | mahoragopavītaṃ ca prapannārtivināśanam || 17 ||
kṛtvā prāṇairyathātmasthaṃ caṇḍaṃ (kh: svasthaṃ) tatra niveśayet | ādhāraśaktipadme tu samayādiniyāmakam || 18 ||
śivārcācarū naivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ laṅghanaṃ (mū: lakṣaṇaṃ) srajām | pradānaṃ dīkṣitasyāpi śivājñayā nivāritam || 19 ||
adyārabhya tvayā caṇḍa stheyaṃ yāvaddharastviha | jñānato'jñānato vāpi nyūnādhikaṃ kṣamasva me || 20 ||
tvametatsannidhau (kh: tvameva-) tiṣṭha śivārthaparirakṣayā | nirmālyavartanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradattaṃ hi śivājñayā || 21 ||
lehyacoṣyānnapānāditāmbūlaṃsragvilepanam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ tyaktvā vastrārthabhūṣaṇam || 22 ||
diśāṃ baliṃ tato dadyādācāryāya ca (mū: yaiva) dakṣiṇām | dhenumekāṃ (mū: dhenvātmakaṃ) vṛṣaścaikaṃ khuraśṛṅgasamanvitam || 23 ||
purūṣaḥ siddhiyukto'pi dānalaṅghanabhakṣaṇāt | nirmālyasya patet kṣipraṃ dvaitaliṅge vidhistvayam || 24 ||
snānaṃ pūjā tathā homo bhāskare'hni caturthake | tejaścaṇḍasya yāgaśca sarvaḥ syātpūrvavadvidhiḥ || 25 ||
dvaitātmake cale liṅge vinā caṇḍaṃ tu pūrvavat | tannirmālyaṃ kṣipedapsu garbhe cāgnau visarjanam (gh: vivarjanam) || 26 ||
dvyāsyaṃ ca pañcavaktraṃ ca tadvatsuvyaktakaṃ ca yat | rāṣṭropadravasiddhyarthaṃ tatsthāpyaṃ guhyadeśataḥ || 27 ||
śmaśāne vṛkṣamūle vā aṭavyāṃ hradasannidhau | abhrāvakāśe nagāgre (kh: bhrācakāse nagāgreṣu) svāśāyāṃ phaladāyakam || 28 ||
digliṅgaṃ cāhitāsraṃ (mū: tāmraṃ) ca guhāyāmaihikārthakṛt | svārthamantrasthitistena caṇḍeśo na sthireṣvapi || 29 ||
viṣṇoścaturthikā snānaṃ pūjā caiva viśeṣikā | (vi (cārpā cihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ kha pustake nāsti) ṣvaksenaṃ yajedabje homadānādipūrvavat || 30 ||
paṭapustakavahnīnāṃ nāgayakṣendrayoginām | gaṇavargāmbikānāṃ ca nanirmālyaṃ śive yathā ) || 31 ||
vidyāntamaihike (k, kh, gh: bimbā-) liṅge nirmālyaṃ caṇḍavarjite | purī sāgaradaityādyā ṛṣidigdevatāgrahāḥ || 32 ||
apyete dvaitadharmasthā na nirmālyaḥ śubhapradāḥ | dīkṣāsthāpanayāgotthaṃ (mū: yāgāthaṃ) nirmālyaṃ naiva doṣakṛt || 33 ||
svayaṃbhūrbāṇaliṅgaṃ ca mahadbhiḥ sthāpitaṃ ca yat | dvaitādvaitānī tānyatra sāmānyani ca siddhaye || 34 ||
kṣetrapālo'ṣṭaliṅgaṃ ca dattātreyaśca bhairavaḥ | mārtaṇḍaścetyathādvaite nirmālyaṃ caṇḍavarjitam || 35 ||
sveṣṭaliṅgagataṃ pūtaṃ puṣpādisiddhidaṃ hi tat | sveṣṭaṃ na darśayelloke advaite vidhikalpitam || 36 ||
ahaitāste tu vijñeyā vāmadakṣiṇamantrajāḥ | divyatoyādikaṃ teṣāṃ snāne'rghe tarpaṇe hitam || 37 ||
tasmai sveṣṭāya yaddattaṃ caruvattannasaṃśayaḥ | naivedyaṃ bhrātṛputrāṇāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca dāpayet || 38 ||
prāśitena ca tena syātpāpanāśo'ṇimādikāḥ | siddhirlabheta no citraṃ liṅgasannihitaṃ yadā (gh: sadā) || 39 ||
anena vidhinā siddhā brahmopendrādayaḥ surāḥ | jayadrathādayo'pyanya ityāha bhagavāñchivaḥ || 40 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye caṇḍeśvarasthāpanaṃ nāma saptadaśo vidhiḥ] || 17 ||
[athaṣṭādaśaḥ]
sthāpayennāma (gh: ttāṃ sa) mantraiḥ svairaṇḍajodbhijjarāyujān | nayanonmīlanādyeṣāṃ pūrvavatsakalaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
tyajantyapūjitaṃ mantrā (ntraṃ) (mū: mantrai) rātnaṃ lauhaṃ ca śailajam | dārumṛjjaṃ kramānmāsaṃ pañcamaṃ (mū: māsātpañcapaṃ) cāhavarjanāt || 2 ||
lepyacitrāgamānāṃ ca dhāraṇābhirviśodhanam | snānādi mānasaṃ kāryaṃ tathā ratnaśilādikam || 3 ||
netronmīlanamityādi pūrvavaccāsanādikam | nimrabukusumaiḥ pūjā yayā citraṃ na naśyati || 4 ||
toraṇaṃ rūpakākṣīṇi (kh: kārkāṇi) sthānaṃ pūjāhutiṃ (mū: hnutiṃ) balim | kṛtveṣṭvā vāstunaścādau (gh: nṛṃścādau) ratnāni viniveśya (mū, kh: ratnādini niveśya) ca || 5 ||
diṅmātreṇa gramātpañcāttoraṇaṃ pariropya ca | vasūṃ (mū: vastraṃ su) ñca stambhayornyasya dineśāṃsta (mū: rnyaseddiśāṃ tadva) dudumbare || 6 ||
śailālīnāmathānyeṣāṃ stambhādīnāmayaṃ vidhiḥ | śule'pyavaṃ yajantyaṅgaṃ yuktā daṇḍe ca dīpanī (?) || 7 ||
aṣṭapatre site padme kārṇikākesarojvale | ekadvitrikare pūjyaḥ śivavadbhagavānguruḥ || 8 ||
mūrtivaktrāṅasaṃyuktastataḥ śivaśataṃ japet | aghoraṃ paścimāsyaṃ vā hotavyaṃ japasaṃṅkhyayā || 9 ||
saumyāśāyāṃ nyasenmuktau pūrvato bhūktihetave | veṣṭitaṃ vastrayugmena yogamīṭhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ varam || 10 ||
tatrānantamatheṣṭvādau tato'nyaṃ vā (k, kh, gh: nyasya) guruṃ svakan | tanmantratattva (k, kh: tanu) māvāhya ananyeśaṃ guruṃ (mū: svakaṃ) yajet || 11 ||
grāhyāvaṅghrī ajātena nyasetpīṭheṃ (ṭhaṃ) saguhyakam | tatsānnidhyaṃ tvaghoreṇa deyaścārgho nareṇa tu || 12 ||
īśānena srajā (kh: sama) bhyarcya hṛlliṅgaṃ mudrayānvitaḥ | paṭāvṛtakarastiṣṭhecchivavat sa guruḥ (mū: svaguruḥ) svayam || 13 ||
nānālaṅkāravastrādyaiḥ kartā taṃ pūjayedgurum | mukuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalairhāraiḥ keyūraiḥ kaṭakai (kh, gh: kaṅkaṇaiḥ) stathā || 14 ||
mekhalābrahmasūtraiśca nūpuraiścāṃgulīyakaiḥ | nānāprakāravāsobhiriṣṭvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām || 15 ||
rājāno maṇḍalaśreṣṭhaṃ (g: jyeṣṭhaṃ) viṣayaṃ maṇḍalādhipaḥ | viṣayādhipatirgrāmaṃ kṣetraṃ grāmādhipastathā || 16 ||
mattebhayugalaṃ tasmai satsu varṇavibhūṣitam | aṣṭau hayānmahāvegānnukmābharaṇabhūṣitān (kh, gh: māṇḍatān) || 17 ||
gosahasraṃ payoyuktaṃ hemabhāraṃ suśobhanam | dāsān dāsīḥ subhakṣyāṃśca śayanaṃ cāmbaraṃ varam || 18 ||
chatracāmarabhṛṅgāraṃ vyajanaṃ pādukāṃ tathā | gṛhopaskaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktipūrvaṃ nivedayet || 19 ||
nṛpādīnāmidaṃ dānaṃ tadardhārdhaṃ krameṇa tu | vittānurodhato'nyeṣāmaṣṭāṃśena (gh: maṃśāṣṭena) guruṃ prati || 20 ||
bhrātṛputrakalatraiśca bandhubhṛtyajanaiḥ saha | nivedayettathātmānaṃ tato vijñāpayedgurum || 21 ||
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvadharmaparāyaṇa | adya me saphalaṃ janma yatsaṃsāramahārṇavāt || 22 ||
uddhṛto'haṃ tvayā nātha kleśitastvaṃ kṣamasvaṃ me | tatastu sthāpako hṛsṭo yajamānena pūjitaḥ || 23 ||
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ phalaṃ kartre dadāti sakalaṃ tataḥ | dīkṣasthāpanayāgānte parvaṇyabhyāgate tathā || 24 ||
mantralābhe ca siddhau ca viśuddhā syātśubhe kṣaṇe | asaṃpūjya guruṃ mohānmūrtipānatha jāpinaḥ || 25 ||
naiva tatphalamāpnoti sthāpakasya hi tadbhavet | sarvaṃ saduṣkaraṃ (k, kh: supuṣkalaṃ) kāryaṃ mahāpuṇyajigīṣayā || 26 ||
anyathā na bhavetpuṇyaṃ doṣa eva tu jāyate | nirdravye hanti kartāraṃ mantrahīne tu daiśikam || 27 ||
dānahīne tu taddharmaṃ tadrāṣṭraṃ cānnahīnake | dhenuhīne tathaivāyuḥ prajā vai puṣpahīnake || 28 ||
brīhihīne tathā śasyaṃ homahīne tu varṣaṇam | putraṃ yāge ca nirvastre pramadā dhūpahīnake || 29 ||
gandhahīne bhavedrogastejohṛddīpahīnake | niṣpatāke prajā hanti balihīne tathā kulam || 30 ||
dāridryaṃ hemahīne syāttasmātpūrṇavidhau phalam | pratiṣṭhārthaṃ prakalpyādau dravyaṃ yacchuci śāśvatam || 31 ||
tadyugāṃśaṃ vibhajyātha kṛtvārdhaṃ liṅgasadmani (gh: dharmaliṅgasanmanī) | tryaṃśena sthāpanaṃ tatra caturthāṃśaṃ punastridhā || 32 ||
sthāpakāya tu tatraikaṃ dānārthaṃ tu dvitīyakam | tṛtīyaṃ bhojanādyarthaṃ kartā dharmāya kalpayet || 33 ||
anyāyārthairbalairvāpi saṃpratāryāpi kārayet | yāgakāleṣu datvā ca arthe nāpratipādanam || 34 ||
sūcyāsye narake tiṣṭhetkartā hyācandratārakam | yāgasyopaskaraḥ pūto gurorgrāhyaḥ sa maṇḍapaḥ || 35 ||
snānākhyaḥ śilpinastadvadupaskarasamanvitaḥ | yaddravyaṃ liṅga (gh: yalliṅgagarbha) bhogyaṃ ca dhāmagarbhe niveśitam || 36 ||
taccaṇḍeśāya dātavyamarthaṃkoṣaṃ (k, kh: kāmaṃ) ca pālayet | guruyāgavidhiḥ proktaḥ siddhaliṅgavidhiḥ sthitaḥ || 37 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye toraṇāstambhagrahapūjā (gh: gurupūjā) jarāyujādi bhūtādi (k, kh: śabdo) sthāpanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo vidhiḥ] || 18 ||
[athaikonaviṃśaḥ]
ye rudrā liṅgarūpeṇa sthitāste sarvasiddhidāḥ | lokānugrahahetvarthaṃ svayaṃ bhāvātsvayaṃbhuvaḥ || 1 ||
svayaṃbhūliṅgavadbāṇaliṅgaṃ bhuktyai ca muktaye | sahasraphalamanyasmāddadyātsthāpanapūjanāt || 2 ||
śrīśaile kālikāgarte liṅgādrau kanyakāśrame | kanyātīrthe ca nepāle mahendre cāmareśvare || 3 ||
sthitāni bāṇa (mū: cātha) liṅgāni śivatattvakṛtāni ca | saritpravāhasaṃsthānaṃ bāṇaliṅgasamākṛtiḥ || 4 ||
yadanyadapi boddhavyaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvasukhāvaham | yātrāvantyatha bhogyānī (gh: gāni) mantravanti sphuranti ca || 5 ||
tāni mantrabalāllakṣmīḥ svayamevopabhuñjate | tathānyaiḥ sthāpitānyatra ṛṣidevaiḥ suroragaiḥ (kh: gaṇaiḥ) || 6 ||
siddhidāni svatantrāṇi bhogādyāni srayanti (kh, gh: ḍhyāni) ca | sphuṭitādini vaktrā (krā) ṇi na duṣṭānyarthasiddhaye || 7 ||
grahaṇaṃ bāṇaliṅgasya sthāpanaṃ cocyate'dhunā | snātairupoṣitairbhaktaiḥ śivayāgakṛtai (gh: yāge kṛte) rbhṛśam || 8 ||
vijñāpayettato devaṃ mamānugrahahetave | svecchayāgaccha bāṇeśa yatra sthānaṃ (gh: sthāne) mayepsitam || 9 ||
tatrānīyādhivāsaṃ ca kuryātsnānādi pūrvavat | juhuyāddakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ vyāhṛtiṃ vā śivasya tu || 10 ||
svecchayā vā (mū: dhvā) vibhūtyarthaṃ śodhyo no (kh: svadhyāno) vā vimuktaye | mūrtilakṣaṇasūtrāṇāṃ pūrvādyā (kh, gh: pravādyo) bhramaṇādikaḥ || 11 ||
vidhinoktastathāpyatraḥ sānnidhyaṃ nityameva hi | nityodayāni liṅgāni śuddhāśuddhodayāni ca || 12 ||
āsane saṃsthitaṃ no vā śaktisthaṃ mūrtisaṃsthitam (mū: yutam) | calaṃ sthiraṃ vibhūtyarthaṃ sthāpyaṃ citsannidhānataḥ || 13 ||
caturthīhoma caṇḍeśo (kh: candreṇo) viśeṣo'dhvā na vidyate | mantrasādhanayogeṣu sādhakaiḥ su (kh, gh: saṃ) pratiṣṭhite || 14 ||
vidhiḥ syātpūrvajo yadvattadvadanyatra (mū: pyatra) vā bhavet | prāksaṃskṛte'thavā bāṇe (mū: tyātha bāṇena) punareva vidhiḥ svakaḥ || 15 ||
mantranyaste'thavā dvaite'dvaite vā syānnasaṅkaraḥ | tatra nyāso hī yo liṅge tena tatsannidhānavat || 16 ||
liṅgārohe kṛte cetthaṃ yukte'nyasminsa pūrvavat | tathāpi tatra sānnidhyaṃ kartavyaṃ daiśikaiḥ sadā || 17 ||
hutvāghorasahasraṃ ca madhunāktairudumbaraiḥ | tatastu daiśikān pañca bhojayetsiddhikāmyayā || 18 ||
tāḍanāmasinākṛṣṭimiḍayā muṣṭinā graham | dvaite'tra vidhinā (g: mantra binā) kṛtvādvaite mantraṃ praropayet || 19 ||
advaitadvaitasaṃrohe svamantrānna parityajet | abhyāgatastathā (gh: gato yathā) pūjyaḥ svāṃśasthaḥ siddhikṛdbhavet || 20 ||
dhāmagarbhaṃ tu sūtraṃ tu tyaktvā bhūmyagrataḥ pūrā | vṛṣasya maṇḍapī kāryā (maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ iti sādhu pāṭhaḥ) prāsādagarbhamānataḥ || 21 ||
tatrāropya vṛṣo yatnātsambhāre sakale kṛte | utkīryājyādhivāsyātha (mū: vāsārthaṃ) snānaṃ pūjāpipūrvavat || 22 ||
tritattvaṃ juhuyādbrahmavṛkṣotthasamidhaḥ kramāt | secyaḥ saṃpā (gh: sapā) tatoyena nyasedratnādikaṃ tataḥ || 23 ||
tato vṛṣaṃ nyasetpīṭhe tattve sthiracale sthite | vṛṣabhadhvajamantreṇa mūrtyaṅgāni paraṃ tathā || 24 ||
nākālamṛtyurno vyādhirnopasargabhayaṃ jane (janaiḥ li0 pu0 pā0) | rājā ca vijayī tatra yatra samyag (mū: śasya) vṛṣasthitaḥ || 25 ||
vṛṣo dharmastu devasya guṇo jñānakriyātbhakaḥ | dhatte ca samvidaṃ yasmā (mū: saśridaṃ yasmā; kh: saṃvidheḥ syā) ddharmastenocyate budhaiḥ || 26 ||
kṛtādhivāsanaṃ vastraprāvṛtaṃ mālyabhūṣitam | muhūrte maṅgale sthāpya dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnute (mū: saṃyutam) || 27 ||
śṛṅgārka (mū: śṛṅgārga) saṃyutaṃ prāgvad vyomādityāgrato bhavet | tārkṣyo'pyevaṃ svamantreṇa vāhanānyaparāṇyapi || 28 ||
iti devānāṃ vāhanasthāpanam
yajamānānukūle'hni sambhāre vihite'khile | yajedgurvādikaṃ kartā sthāṇḍilaṃ ca tato guruḥ || 29 ||
nandyādidṛkkriyā snānaṃ pūjā homaṃ ca pūrvavat | bhāgasparśaṃ ca śuddhiṃ ca vidadhītākhilaṃ kramāt || 30 ||
dvāradeśāttataścādha iṣṭvā vāstunaraṃ sudhīḥ | ratnādi pūrvavannyasya (nnyastvā li0 pu0 pā0) rudraṃ hutvā ca śāntaye || 31 ||
suvastrāveṣṭitadvāraṃ śivāstradigghaṭairvṛtam (mū: ryutam) | tanmadhyānmadhyamunmucya kiñciduttarato nyaset || 32 ||
yavarakṣoghnabilvāni (mū: cihnāhvā; g: cihnāṅkā) phalinī gadatantrikā | tilābrīhiśca (mū: homaṃ ca) rogaghnaṃ rocanāṃ ca sahāṃ tathā || 33 ||
gośṛṅgebhara (hra) dotkhātamṛtsnā dūrvā dadhīni ca | varavastrodare badhdvā rakṣaṇārthamudumbare || 34 ||
dehalyāṃ śākhayormūghni (gh: rvyomni) ātmavidyā śivaṃ nyaset | saptasaptāhutistatra tattve tattve tu (kh: tri) homayet || 35 ||
sthiraṃ caivāprameyaṃ ca bodhākhyaṃ nityasaṃjñakam | vyāpinaṃ cāvināsaṃ ca tṛptāhvaṃ juhuyātkramāt || 36 ||
nandyādipratihārau ca anyāṃścātra vinirmitān | svanāmabhiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya pūrṇaṃ datvā diśāṃ balim || 37 ||
guruṃ mūrtidharaṃ (gh: bhṛtaḥ) kārūn pūjayecca svaśaktitaḥ | kartā tu dvārivaktre syāddigvyome (k: digghāme) ca bhavecchubham || 38 ||
iti dvārasthāpanam |
atheṣṭvādau (mū: ndrādau) jape (kh: yaje) drudraṃ hutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatam (k, g: śubham) | gurvādau dakṣiṇāṃ datvā indrādīnāṃ baliṃ tathā || 39 ||
dhāturatnauṣadhībījairlohaiḥ sarvaiḥ puroditaiḥ | vastrabaddhairyutaṃ kṛtvā sudine tattvasaṃsthitaḥ || 40 ||
dadhisarpiṣpayaḥ kṣaudrapāyasaiḥ paripūrya ca | dhāmagarbheṃśukāghrāte nyaseddhṛtpadmavad ghaṭam || 41 ||
praṇavādhāraśaktyabjamūrtibhūtaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyaset | sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmraṃ vā bhūtyapekṣayā || 42 ||
gandhāktaṃ gandhavatpuṣpamālālaṅkṛtakaṇṭhakam | cūtāśokavaṭāśvatthadalabhūṣitavaktrakam (kh: cakrakam) || 43 ||
kṛtarakṣaṃ (k: raktaṃ) vidhāyāṇuṃ (mū: yāsra; k, kh: yāṇḍaṃ) tattvamāhṛtya yojayet | yadvidhānamupādānaṃ vyaktisthānaṃ parāparam ( mū: sthānamavāpatum) || 44 ||
sarvātmanā (mū: gurvātmāna) mabhinnaṃ tatsandhāyāṇuṃ vidaṃśakāt (mū: tvadmi daṃśakān) | gṛṇhīyātprāṇaśaktyaiva śivājñāṃ saṃprabodhayet || 45 ||
saṃhṛtya kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā sthitvā kiñcidacintakaḥ | utkīlya (mū: unmīlya) hu(/)phaḍāvasthaṃ sphurannārātanūpamam || 46 ||
dvādaśāntātsamādāya recakena ghaṭe nyaset | tatrābhi (gh: tatrāha) vādakaṃ dehaṃ nyasettasadguṇa (gh: taguṇa) bodhakam (k, g: rodhakam) || 47 ||
kalādidhāraṇīprāntaṃ sveśvaraṃ (kh: śekharaṃ; g: mekhalaṃ) svapadāṇubhiḥ | oṃ kalāyai (g: tuṅgalāyai) namaskṛtya tathaiva ca kalābhṛte || 48 ||
diśā na yojya śeṣādhva (mū: śeṣārthaṃ) prayogastattvadarśinā | daśanāḍī daśaprāṇāḥ karaṇāni tadīśvarān || 49 ||
nyasedviśeṣatasteṣāṃ nāmāni tānyataḥ kramāt | iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathā bhavet || 50 ||
gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pūṣā caiva yaśā (mū, a, k, kh, g, gh: yathā) tathā | alambuṣā kuhuścaiva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtā || 51 ||
daśaprāṇavahā hyetā nāḍayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca || 52 ||
nāgaḥ kūrmaḥ kṛkākhyaśca devadatto dhanañjayaḥ | vākpāṇipādaśiśnāni sapāyūni kriyāgaṇāḥ || 53 ||
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣījihvā nāsā cittaṃ ca tīvrajāḥ | agnīndropendraturyāsyavibhrāntāḥ patayaḥ kramāt || 54 ||
khadigvāyvarkavārīndrāśvininiśākarāstathā | patayo dhī (gh: hī) ndriyāṇāṃ tu yojyāḥ pūjā (mū: pūjyā) viśeṣataḥ || 55 ||
vikārapūrakatvena māyākālaniyāmike | sva (mū: su) sādhyasādhakatvena prerakatvena mantrayoḥ || 56 ||
yojyaḥ sahāṇubhirdevo (kh: sadā nṛ-) vyāpakatvena dhīmatā | tadaṅgāni tataḥ sarvaṃ nirundhyādrodhamudrayā || 57 ||
hutvā sānnidhyameteṣāṃ vidhicchidraṃ nivartayet | tataśca vedikābandhaḥ kaṇṭhamāmalasārakaḥ (mū: sāmalasāvakāḥ) || 58 ||
vedikācaturasre tu (mū: rasreṇa) vidyeśānmūrdhni ceśvaraḥ | kumbhe sadāśivaṃ nyasya śaktiṃ ca grahacūlake || 59 ||
sarvatattvātmakaṃ dhāma tattattvaṃ procyate kramāt | dharāmbho'gnimarudvyoma bhūtānāṃ (kh: cūḍānāṃ) kramataḥ sthitiḥ || 60 ||
dhāraṇaiḥ saṅgrahe pāke vyūhe svāsthe (mū: hāsye) ca dhāmni tu | dhūpapuṣpasthito gandho raso naivedyatastathā || 61 ||
rathakārye (gh: rakṣākādye) sthitaṃ rūpaṃ sparśo masṛṇakarkaśe | śabdastauryādikastatra śukāghrā nāsikā sadā || 62 ||
piṇḍikā rasanā tasya mañjarīvedike dṛśau | tvaksudhājālakaṃ śrotre cāgnī tasyā (kh: vāgnī taṃ pakṣa) kṣanāsikā || 63 ||
karau mūle sthitaḥ pādaḥ pāyustatra rasānanaḥ (mū: daśānana) | caṇḍadravyasamo vacca (gh: gavyāgamo) upasthaḥ pīṭhanālakaḥ || 64 ||
sthāpanāmbupari (mū: dyupari) srāvo manaḥ sūtraprakalpane | niścayaḥ syādahaṅkāro buddhistadvyavasāyake || 65 ||
(cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mūla, ga pustakayornāsti) varṇake ca guṇā jñeyāḥ prakṛtiśca guṇākṛtiḥ (kh, gh: tadākṛtiḥ) | kāraṇaṃ puruṣo hṛtstho rāgastatrādiśaktigaḥ || 66 ||
vidyā vivecane hyatra niyatirniyame smṛtā | preraṇe (k, kh: pūraṇe) ca kalā tatra kālasaṅkhyā vayasthitā || 67 ||
māyātattvā (gh: tatrā) tmanaikatve vidyā prāsādagocare | śivāyatanavijñānaviveko vidyayeśvaraḥ || 68 ||
adhiṣṭhāne'dhidaivatye samāptau ca sadāśivaḥ | sāmarthye dhāraṇāśaktirbahiradhyātmike'dhvani || 69 ||
vyāpakatvācchivo hyevaṃ proktaḥ (kh: prāpta) prāsādarūpakaḥ | piṇḍikā jagatīkhyātā prāsādo liṅgamiṣyate || 70 ||
tayoḥ kāryā pratiṣṭheti śambhunā bhāṣitaṃ kvacit | trīn devāṃśca kramānnyasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān || 71 ||
jaṅghā skandhā tu mūrdhnyante videhaṃ ca tadūrdhvataḥ | sthirākhyaṃ bhavasaṃjñaṃ ca dāravaṃ juhuyātpunaḥ || 72 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye bāṇaliṅgādi yānadvārahṛtsaṃsthāpanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 19 ||
[atha viṃśatiḥ]
īśānaṃ grahacūlaṃ vā kalaśaṃ vātha mūrdhani | sthāpayedvidhinā samyak dhvajalkṛptimato bruve || 1 ||
nānāprakāramīśānaṃ mate mate ca tadyathā | cūlyaṃ (laṃ) kumbhaṃ dhvajaṃ cātra lakṣaṇāni vadettathā || 2 ||
(pāpāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ ka pustake nāsti) mūlaliṅgasamaṃ kuryādīśānaṃ tanmayā (mū: tadantā samayā) kṛti | śailotthaṃ śailaje dhāmni devehyevā (gh: hyaṃ vā) kvacinmate || 3 ||
amalāsāravistārāt ṣaṭtriṃśattithibhāgataḥ | tryaṃśāntryaṃśā (gh: tryaṃśāśā sā) ttribhāgonādīśasyānāhavistarau || 4 ||
liṅgātribhāgahīnaṃ syādīśānaṃ vā surārcitam | mervādīnāṃ (kh: sarvādīnāṃ) pradhānānāmanyeṣāṃ (mū: manyathā) liṅgavadyathā || 5 ||
dārūtthe (kh: dāruke) dārujaṃ viddhi tviṣṭikāsambhave tathā | grahacūlaṃ (k, g: cūḍa) tu śailaṃ vā veṣṭitaṃ kalaśena vā || 6 ||
tatsthaulyaṃ daśamāṃśena dhāmamastakavistarāt | caturasrāṣṭakaṃ vṛttaṃ trisamaṃ liṅgadairghyavat || 7 ||
grīvāvyāsārdhadairghyaṃ vā sthaulyaṃ nāhāṅghribhāgataḥ | liṅgavaccākhilaṃ kuryādbāhye vā ghaṭaveṣṭitam || 8 ||
kaṇṭhavyasārdhavistīrṇaṃ devyā mate'tha bhāskare | dhāmaiṣvāṃśācca (mū: dhāme'ṣṭāṃśā; kh: dhvaṃśācca) bāṇākhye saptāṃśād dvyaṃśato'ṇḍakāt || 9 ||
pārśve dhāmaṣaḍaṃśācca vyāsaṃ vyāsāddvidhocchrayam | ṛtvarka bhājitaṃ kṛtvā kalaśaṃ vartayedbudhaḥ || 10 ||
pādonāṃśādadhaḥ paṭṭī ṣaḍaṃśena tu vistarā | bhāgaikena ca kumbho'sya kumbhapaṭṭī tu pādataḥ || 11 ||
sacūlā (kh, g, gh: cacūli) tryaṃśavistārā tvardhāṃśena samucchritā | madhyadvyaṃśācca (gh: sva) koṇaṃ ca adhyaṣṭāṃśocchrayāsthitau || 12 ||
yāmyakoṇād dvibhāge tu yāmye skando bhavetkramāt | anyakoṇādyugāṃśasthe yāmyādho vṛttamābhramāt || 13 ||
tathaiva bhrāmayetsūtraṃ kalaśasyottarāṃśataḥ | tataścordhvaikabhāgena grīvā dvibhāgavistarā || 14 ||
kapolau yugavistārau bhāgārdhāṃśocchrayobhavet | tadūrdhvo'rdhāṃśataḥ kālaḥpadmaṃ dvivistarocchrayam || 15 ||
ghaṭapārśve murā (gh: ṣurā) māṃśairlohanimnāyatāścalāḥ | sacūlyādūrdhvataḥ padmo ghaṭāsyaṃ cāmrapallavi || 16 ||
yāgālayādisambhārasnāne yā gurudakṣiṇā | ratnanyāsādi homaśca mantranyāsādi pūrvavat || 17 ||
brahmarekhāṃ vineśādi tadādhāraśilopari | brahmājyārdhānta (mū: ṣuddhānta; k, kh: rdhājānu) viṣṇūrdhvaṃ sthāpayenmantra (mū, a: mata) bhedataḥ || 18 ||
īśānaṃ saṃpraveśaṃ ca brahmāṃśaṃ vedavatkṛte | dvyaṃśaṃ tryaṃśaṃ samastaṃ ca jyeṣṭhādikramataḥ kvacit || 19 ||
ratnajaṃ vātha dhātūtthaṃ sūkṣmaliṅgaṃ yathecchayā | prakṣipya kalaśāḥ kāryāḥ kvacidīśādi yatnataḥ || 20 ||
trinetracaṇḍikā (k, kh: candrikā) dhāmnoḥ śūlena parirakṣitaḥ | viṣṇudhāmni ca cakreṇa anyeṣāṃ svāyughairapi || 21 ||
liṅgonmanyātha śūlaṃ ca ghaṭābjo (mū, a: śvetābjo) pari vinyaset | vāmā jyeṣṭhāhvayā raudrī svaśaktitrayakalpitā || 22 ||
dvātriṃśadaṅgulaṃ jyeṣṭhe madhye hīne'ṣṭahānitaḥ (mū, a: hīnake) | haimaṃ raupyamayojamvā prāgvatsaṃsthāpya (k, gh: saṃsnāpya) mantrataḥ || 23 ||
jñānākhyecchākriyāhvābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ kalpitaṃ kvacit | karīraṣaṣṭhabhāgena cakraṃ syātsama (kh: sa ca) vartulam || 24 ||
jīvadairghyasamo daṇḍastatthaulyaṃ tajjināṃśataḥ | cūliketaradevānāṃ sthāpanīyāḥ pramāṇataḥ || 25 ||
devanāhādbhaveddairghyaṃ sthaurlyaṃ tadaṣṭamāṃśataḥ | indīvaradalābhā sā svabījaiścūlikā sadā || 26 ||
itīśānakalaśagrahacūlīyūpa (k, g, gh: yudha) sthāpanam ||
dhvajaṃ vinātra yā kīrtiḥ sā rakṣobhirgrahādibhiḥ | gṛhyate sakalā nityaṃ dānahomādibhiḥ saha || 27 ||
yathā suphalito (ṅ: yuḥ phalito; svaḥ phalito ityādi pāṭhaḥ) vṛkṣo rakṣyate hi phalārthibhiḥ | tathā dharmaphalārthāya dhāmavṛkṣadhvajena tu || 28 ||
tasmāttatra dhvajaḥ sthāpyo vidhinā mānasaṃyutaḥ | nānāgamānusāreṇa leśatastaṃ vadāmyataḥ || 29 ||
prāsādapādavistārastadardhārdhāṃśataḥ (kh: ṅgataḥ) kvacit | dhāmno dviguṇadairghyaḥ syātsārdhārdhāttatsamo dhvajaḥ || 30 ||
dvihastavistaro vātha bhūmiṃ pārṣṇimathāpi vā | kvacinmate tadardhānyathā prāpsyatvadhoditaḥ (mū: prāptyātha coditaḥ) || 31 ||
svadairghyaṣoḍaśāṃśena kvaciduktaśca vistarāt | sarvārthaśāntaye śuklaḥ kāmārthe dikpatiprabhaḥ || 32 ||
svavāhanāṅkita (mū, a: nvitaṃ) ścordhvaṃ kiṅkiṇīcāmarairyutaḥ | svadevarūpakaiścitraḥ svaśaktyā śobhitaḥ kvacit || 33 ||
mañjaryāstryaṃśato daṇḍastatpādonārdhataḥ kvacit | itthaṃ grahartu (kh, gh: indragrahe tu) hasto vā kramājjyeṣṭhādiko bhavet || 34 ||
vaṃśavṛddhikaro vaṃśo dharmārthau (k, kh, ṅ: dharmārthe) śālasaindurau | uktāṅghri pañca tatkāryaṃ tvaśubhau śeluśigrukau (mū, a, ṅ: śirbhkau) || 35 ||
bhaṅge cāropyamāṇe tu karturmṛtyurbhaveddhruvam | śāntihome kṛte saukhyaṃ dakṣiṇāsyena (mū: dyena) nānyathā || 36 ||
prāsādapṛṣṭhadeśe ca ūcuḥ kaiściddhvajāśrayam (mū: ucurdhvajāśrayaṃ kvacit; kh: uccacchavidhvajāśrayaḥ) | aiśāne vā pradeśe ca mārute vānyathāpare || 37 ||
śikharasya śarāṃśena caturthena guṇena vā | utta (mū: ukta) mādidhvajādhāraṃ mastakārdhena vā kvacit || 38 ||
pūrvavanmaṇḍapādi syātsnānenajyā (mū, k, gh: snāneṣu) dhvajayaṣṭiṣu | hemādi (mū a, kh, g, gh, ṅ: homādi) ratnavinyāsa āsanaṃ prākkrameṇa tu || 39 ||
mūrtibhūrtaṃ nyaseddaṇḍaṃ sakalīkaraṇaṃ tataḥ | dhvaje tu niṣkalaṃ tadvattathai (gh: tatrai) vāṅgāni yatpunaḥ (gh: ṣaṭsu ca) || 40 ||
ātmavidyāṃ nyaseddaṇḍe śivatattvaṃ dhvaje tathā | bhuvaneśānpunastatra vighnanāśāya siddhaye || 41 ||
ātmavān śāṃbhavān śāntān (gh: śāktān) svāyudhodyatavigrahān | samyāgdhyātvā (kh: jñātvā) tu tānsarvāṃstatastvāropayedguruḥ || 42 ||
dhvajamantrāstramantreṇa yojayitvā nyasetkvacit | aghoramatha śaivaṃ vā yadvā pāśupataṃ mahat || 43 ||
prakhyātamaiśvare śāstre vighnasaṃghāta (kh: saṃpāta) nāśanam | gandhādi brahmamuṇḍena dadyādvidyādhipena vā || 44 ||
puruṣṭutena (mū, ṅ: ṣṇutena) naivedyaṃ balikarma hṛdaiva tu | dhyāyetsūryasahasrābhaṃ pralayāmbudanisvanam || 45 ||
pradīptadaśanaprāntaṃ prakāśamukhakandaram | tryakṣaṃ taḍillātajihvaṃ dīptabhrūśśrumūrdhajam || 46 ||
sarpopavītaśūlāsiśaktimudgaradhāriṇam | caturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ sphuraccandrārdhaśekharam (kh, ṅ: digambaram) || 47 ||
devadānavarakṣogradarpitānāṃ vimardanam | dhvajasyārohaṇaṃ kuryādupacāraṃ ca daiśikaḥ || 48 ||
mantraiḥ phaḍantagaiḥ sarvairhṛdayādivibhāgaśaḥ | dhvajāgre tu gururlagna iṣṭamantraṃ japaṃstadā (mū: japettadā) || 49 ||
pradakṣiṇātrayaṃ kṛtvā kartāraṃ sanniyojayet | yajamānastato lagno bhāryāputrakulaiḥ saha || 50 ||
pariveṣṭya tridhā dhāma praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ | yathā vidhūyate vātairdhvajaḥ prāsādamastake || 51 ||
tathā kartā tyajetpāpaṃ saptajanmārjitaṃ kṣaṇāt | rāṣṭre śāntirjayī rājā sukhinyaḥ syuḥ prajāstathā || 52 ||
susūtayastriyo dharmaḥ subhikṣārogyameva ca | hemalakṣapradānācca puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ dhvajāt | jīrṇoddhāre kṛte karturdhvajānte maulikaṃ phalam || 53 ||
iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye īśānādidhvajaniveśānākhyānaṃ nāma viṃśovidhi || 20 ||
athaikāviṃśaḥ
atha jīrṇāṃśca duṣṭāṃśca liṅgādīṃśca (g: dīnāṃ) surojjhitān | āśrayantīha satvāni bhūtavetālarākṣasāḥ || 1 ||
mahābhayakarā nityaṃ subhṛśaṃ krūrarūpiṇaḥ | kurvanti doṣasaṅghyātaṃ yatra rāṣṭreṣu te (g: pure) sthitāḥ || 2 ||
mahotpātaṃ dharānāśaṃ camūbhaṅgaṃ parābhavam | durbhikṣaṃ dāruṇaṃ rogaṃ prajānāśaṃ daridratām || 3 ||
udvegaṃ ca vivādaṃ (g: viṣādaṃ) ca vitāśaṃ cātmajārthayoḥ | pīḍā gobrāhmaṇādīnāṃ rājño duḥkhaṃ kuśīlatām || 4 ||
pratāpasatvahāniṃ ca lobhamohādiyuktatām | śatruvyasanapīḍā ca cintā ca mahatī bhavet || 5 ||
duṣṭaliṅge sthite rāṣṭre prajā prājño na śobhanan | tasmāduddharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vidhinā mantrapūrvakam || 6 ||
vidhiṃ vinoddhṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ mantrahīnaistvadaiśikaiḥ | rāṣṭraṃ pittena saṃpīḍya bhūpamucchādaye (k: mutsādaye; kh: munmādaye) ddhruvam || 7 ||
tasmādrājā svarāṣṭreṣu liṅgādyuddhārayeddrutam | gobrāhmaṇaprajānāṃ ca svarāṣṭrasya ca vṛddhaye || 8 ||
jīrṇoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā śāstreṣu bhāṣitam | sunakṣatre dine yoge sadvāre kartṛśobhane || 9 ||
yāmyāyāmathavaiśānyāṃ kuryātprāguktamaṇḍapam (kh: maṇḍalam) | pracchannaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ramyaṃ jaladvāraika (kh: dhāraika) toraṇam || 10 ||
rambhācandana (gh: bandhana) mālyāḍhyaṃ vitāna (kh: vimāna) dhvajasaṅkulam | pūrvavadvedikāṃ ramyāṃ śivakumbhāstrarakṣitām || 11 ||
gurumūrtidharānsamyagiṣṭvādau kanakāmbaraiḥ (mū, a: ndrādau kalaśāmbaraiḥ) | bālukāpūrite pīṭhe sthaṇḍile pūjayeddharam || 12 ||
śivaliṅgadharānpañca bhojayed ghṛtapāyasai || 13 ||
arkopendrādike viprānaṣṭau santarpayedbhṛśam | dakṣiṇāṃ vittato dadyād brūyuḥ śaṃ rāṣṭrabhūpayoḥ || 14 ||
sahasraṃ juhuyād ghoraṃ mahāstraṃ vātha daiśikaḥ | trisvādūktaistu (ṅ: dvikṣestu) yajñāṅgai (gh: yajñāṅgo) dūrvāṃ kuṇḍe tu vartule || 15 ||
guruḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāttasmai kartā ca (kh: kartārtha) dhenukām | mūrtibhṛdbhyastato dānaṃ bhūtadigdevatābalim || 16 ||
raudrīṃ śāntiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vijñāpya ca maheśvaram | labdhānujño (kh: natvānujño) mahādevātkuryālliṅgādikoddhṛtim || 17 ||
tatpuṣpāstreṇa saṃtāḍya vadeśa (da) straṃ (k, kh: tatsthaṃ) śivājñayā | yadatra saṃsthitaṃ satvaṃ tyaktvā cānyatra yātu tat (k: yāntvataḥ) || 18 ||
śivājñaivaṃ pradattāto (mū: ttā te) tyajettatvaṃ mahāstrataḥ | tato'bhiṣicya liṅgādyamastrajaptena (mū: mantraṇajaptena) vāriṇā || 19 ||
sthāpako yajamālasya hemajaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ kare | utthāpane prabadhnīyādityuktaṃ śambhunā kvacit || 20 ||
baddhvā svarṇākhya (gh: varṇākṣa) pāśena liṅgaṃ pāśupatena ca | vṛṣayoḥ kakude (di) baddhvā varmaṇā bālatantunā || 21 ||
hemakarṣajasīreṇa (gh: sāreṇa) madhvaktenottarāmukhaḥ | īśāśādīḥ kramātsarvāḥ khādakena guruḥ khanet || 22 ||
tārasārottame bhāvādanyasmin māṣavarjanāt | pāśasīrayugaṃ (kh: sārayuta) kuryādbalavantau tathā vṛṣau || 23 ||
vṛṣau ca khurikaiḥ preṣya nandī śaṅkharaveṇa tu (?) | jarjaraṃ calitaṃ bhagnaṃ (kh: rugṇaṃ) sphuṭitaṃ vajradūṣitam (mūu, a g: dhvajadūṣitam) || 24 ||
mahādoṣānvitaṃ dagdhaṃ vikalāṅgaṃ kṛśaṃ ca yat | sthūlaṃ vā durniviṣṭaṃ ca yacca pīḍākaraṃ bhuvi || 25 ||
sthāpitaṃ vikalairdravyai stathonmānādivarjitam | eṣāṃ kuryāccikitsāṃ ca vyāghitasyeva bheṣajam || 26 ||
teṣāṃ lekhye ca bhede ca chede coddharaṇe (kh: chedanoddharaṇaṃ) tathā | kriyamāṇe na doṣo'sti mantravarjitayā (tatā) yataḥ || 27 ||
liṅgaṃ pīṭhaṃ śilāmarcāṃ vyomatārkṣyādikaṃ vṛṣam | pakvamṛcchailaratnotthaṃ kṣipedvāmena nityake || 28 ||
dārūdbhavamaghoreṇa dahecchivāgninā ghṛtaiḥ | lohaṃ sarvaṃ viniṣpāṭya punastatraiva vinyaset || 29 ||
dagdhaṃ maṇimayaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ tejasāśmavadutsṛjet | lepyaṃ citraṃ paṭaṃ pustaṃ saṃskṛtya cāgninā (mū, kh: dhāmni vā) kṣipet || 30 ||
patitotpāṭitaṃ vakraṃ saridbhītānyamantrajam | aduṣṭaṃ vidhinoddhṛtya sthāpayedyāgapūrvakam || 31 ||
yathā na spṛśati dvāraṃ tathā liṅgaṃ praveśayat | brahmaśilādikaṃ sarvaṃ sthāpayetpūrvavatkramāt || 32 ||
prākpramāṇaṃ tadākāraṃ prāgdravyeṇa vinirmitam | liṅgādi cāparaṃ sthāpyamadhike vā phalaṃ bahu || 33 ||
liṅgapīṭhālayārcānāṃ kṣitauṃ yāvatsthitirbhavet | tāvatkalpasahasrāṇi tatkartā tatpure vaset || 34 ||
pārthivānāṃ phalaṃ cedaṃ (kh: caivaṃ) dāravāṇāṃ tato'dhikam | (cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mūla ga gha pustakeṣu nāsti) dviguṇaṃ cāśmajānāṃ ca sīsakānāṃ tato'dhikam || 35 ||
dviguṇaṃ trapujānāṃ ca ghoṣajānāṃ tato'dhikam | dviguṇaṃ rītijānāṃ ca sulvajānāṃ tato'dhikam || 36 ||)
dviguṇaṃ tārajānāṃ (gh: caśmajānāṃ) ca hemajānāṃ tato'dhikam | dviguṇaṃ ratnajānāṃ tu ratnādhikye'dhikaṃ phalam || 37 ||
sthāpayecca (gh: sthāpayedaṅga) śataṃ hutvā (ṅ: gatvā) cālayecca sahasrataḥ | ghoreṇa vā mahāstreṇa dviguṇaṃ dhāmacālane || 38 ||
sukhaduḥkhasthitānāṃ tu liṅgādicālanāddhruvam | tvaritaṃ mriyate jantū rauravaṃ ca mṛto vrajet || 39 ||
īśānaṃ vā ghaṭaṃ cūlaṃ dvāraṃ hṛdaṅghrikādikam | jīrṇādhāmni (kh: jīrṇoddhāra) kramātsarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā haret || 40 ||
prāsādamantradehaṃ tu khaḍge nyastra prapūjayet | dārupaṭṭāvṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tu ghaṭayedgṛham || 41 ||
pūrvavatpadamāropva dvārādiṃ ca dhvajāntakam | siddhe dhāmnyaṅgasaṃyogaṃ kuryādākṛṣya khaḍgataḥ || 42 ||
jīrṇamuddhṛtamāropya prāyaścittāya homayet | acchidrapūrṇatā yena syādaghoraśatena tu || 43 ||
kṣamayecca praṇamyeśaṃ tvadājñayā mayoddhṛtam | liṅgādi sthāpitaṃ (sthāpakaṃ) yacca tatkṣamasva mamopari || 44 ||
rājñaḥ kartuḥ prajānāṃ ca śāntirbhavatu sarvadā | asmākaṃ śilpināṃ cāpi suprīto bhava he bhava (gh: tava) || 45 ||
tataḥ kartā praṇamyādau daṇḍavadbhūtale gurum | taṃ khaḍgaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ dhenuṃ dadyātsopaskarau vṛṣau || 46 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccayeṃ jīrṇoddhāravidhikathanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 21 ||
[atha dvāviṃśaḥ]
advaita (mū, ṅ: advaite) devatābhyastu kāryaṃ maṇḍalatarpaṇam | ekahastaṃ samārabhya aṣṭahastāvadhikramāt || 1 ||
vīthikādvārakoṇāḍhyamekābjaṃ dvārakairyutam (kh: mekākṣaṃ gātrakai) | lokapālāyudhopetaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sārvadaivikam || 2 ||
devamudrānvitaṃ divyaṃ khyātaṃ mudrālayāhvayam | yaccatuṣkoṇagāḥ śaṅkhāḥ śrīvatsākhyaṃ herestu tat || 3 ||
pūrvoktapaṅgajairyuktaṃ karṇikā pṛthugātrakam | padmārghapṛthuvīthīkaṃ vīthyardhaṃ kaṇṭhakādimat (kh, gh: kaṇṭa-) || 4 ||
padmasūtrasamaṃ dvāraṃ guṇarekhābahirmatam | athānyannavadurgādi navanābhaṃ taducyate || 5 ||
dvātriṃśadacchake (kh, gh: daṃśake) kṣetre madhye'bjaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥ | gātrakaṃ (k, kh: gātraṃkaṃ) vīthikādvābhyāṃ dikṣu padmāṣṭakaṃ tathā || 6 ||
mekhalaikāṃśato bāhye dvābhyāṃ kaṇṭhakapolakau | padmamānaṃ (mū: mālaṃ) bhaveddvāramekena prativāraṇā || 7 ||
vaiṣṇave bhairave yāge yoginī sthāpane tathā | maṇḍalaṃ navanābhākhyaṃ (mū, a: bhāgākhya) putrāyurdhanavṛddhidam (kh: vardhanam) || 8 ||
śālicandanagodhūmayavairvā cūrṇitaiḥ sitaiḥ | gairikeṅgudasindūrai raktamiṣṭa (kh: siktha) kayāthavā || 9 ||
pītaṃ tālema vā śāliharidrācūrṇaikairbhavet | marmurai (kh: sumurai) rarciraṅgāraistuṣairvā dagdhakaiḥ śitim (mū: śitaiḥ || 10 ||
kṛṣṇaikāṃśena pītābhyāṃ haridrābilvapatrakai | sitābhyāmasitāṃśena aikyaṃ syāddhūmra (gh: dhūma) varṇakam || 11 ||
pūrayenmaṇḍalaṃ varṇairetaiḥ saṃśobhate yathā | na hīnā nādhikāvakrā kāryā rekhā suśobhanā || 12 ||
hināyāṃ putranāśaḥ syādadhikāyāṃ mahāgadaḥ | vakrāyāmarthanāśaḥ syād vyastasthe varṇake ripuḥ || 13 ||
mumukṣoḥ sthāpane'dvaite dīkṣāyāṃ maṇḍalaṃ matam | aśeṣaguṇadaṃ tasmātsthaṇḷiṃ vālukāmayam || 14 ||
atha (g: aṣṭa) tāpasaveśmārthaṃ prāsādakaraṇāya ca | tayoḥ sthānāni puṇyāni kathayāmi mahītale || 15 ||
nagendre kulaśaile ca kṣetropakṣetrake tathā | sandohe nimnagākūle siddhakṣetreṣu (gh: sthāneṣu) sarvataḥ || 16 ||
himabaddhemakūṭādrī niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ | mālyavāñśṛṅginīlau ca ṛkṣaśceme'drināyakāḥ || 17 ||
malayo vijayaḥ sahyaḥ pāriyātro'rbudastathā | śrīśailaścaiva vindhyaśca mahendraśca kulācalāḥ || 18 ||
prayāgaḥ kāśikākolā cāṭṭahāsā jayantyapi | caritraikāmrakaṃ devīkoṭṭaṃ kṣetrāṇyathāṣṭa ca (k, g: ṇyathācaraḥ) || 19 ||
kāśmīramarupāṭalyastumulailā (mū, k, kh, g, ṅ: tadyamailā) pustathā | virajaścairuḍaḥ (mū: rutaḥ) puṇḍra ścopakṣetrāṇyamūni ca || 20 ||
kubjikojjayinīpṛṣṭāparastīrā (mū, kh, ṅ: parastrī raṃ) ṅku śādrikau | māyāpuryatha jālākhyamete sandohasaṃjñakāḥ || 21 ||
narmadā yamunā gaṅgā godāvarī punaḥ punā | pañcanadyatha sindhuśca sarasvatyaṣṭanimnagā || 22 ||
śrāvastī kīkaṭo lāṭaḥ kurukṣetrojjihānakāḥ | antarvedī pratiṣṭhānaṃ yājñiko deśa iṣyate || 23 ||
dāruvanaṃ śmaśānaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā | karavīro mahākālaḥ saugandhyupavanaṃ (kh: paraṇaṃ) vanam || 24 ||
vaṭaikaliṅgādityādi sthāpitānāṃ ca sannidhiḥ (gh: sannidheḥ) | bāṇasvayaṃbhuliṅgānāṃ padmakhaṇḍataḍāgayoḥ || 25 ||
vadaryāśramatīrthāni dhunīnāṃ saṅgamastathā | siddhadevālayo grāma nagaraṃ kheṭakaṃ puram || 26 ||
pattanaṃ ratikṛddeśaḥ sāmānyagirinimnagā | puṇyasthānamathānyacca siddhasthānānyamūni ca || 27 ||
deśeṣveteṣu kurvīta yati (gh: yadi) devādikāśramam | gṛhṇīyādbhūmimādau tu śāsanena krayeṇa vā || 28 ||
noparodhadbalādvāpi na caiva prāksaridvahā | ādau kurmādyateḥ sthānamīśādīnāṃ tato yataḥ || 29 ||
na tāpasāḥ sureśasthā vaseyuścenmaṭhādhipāḥ | maṭhamāśritya ye liṅgamarcayanti kubuddhayaḥ || 30 ||
lolupāste samākhyātā na mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti te | yadīcchennarakaṃ gantuṃ putrapautrādibhiḥ saha || 31 ||
tadekāhaṃ praphurvīta maṭhāpatyaṃ (kh: mānayanti) śivālaye | īdṛgjñātvā (mū: īdṛṅmatvā) yathākāmaṃ sthāpayetsacarācaram || 32 ||
atha bhūmiparīkṣārthaṃ grāhyāgrāhyaṃ vadāmyaham | indrāgniyamarakṣo'mbuvāyvīndvīśa (k, kh, gh: vāyvarthīśa) plavā mahī || 33 ||
kramātkuryācchriyaṃ (g: cchivaṃ) dāhaṃ mṛtyuṃ rogaṃ daridratām | ripurmānaṃ sukhaṃ ca syānmadhyamā sarvataḥ plavā || 34 ||
devasya vipulo bhogo nejyā nāśaśca (kh: na jñā nāśaśca) vajrabhīḥ | bhaṅgaḥ pīto'rtha ijyā (mū: iṣṭa) syātpūrvādervasudhāplavāt || 35 ||
madhyaplavā kulaṃ hanyādityuktā bhūḥ śubhāśubhā | kramādagniriporbhītiḥ kalirarbhaka (mū: vacchaka) saṃkṣayaḥ (gh: sajñakaḥ) || 36 ||
strīcalā strakṣayo vṛddhiḥ śāntiḥ prāgādikūpataḥ | nadīpraveśitā (kh: ṣṭitā) śastā pūrvādi paścime'pi vā || 37 ||
yāmye vā nottarasyāṃ ca na caivodaka (k, gh: caikodaka) saṃyutā | na dakṣiṇasthau vanādrī ca paścime vā vana (mū: vācanaṃ) śubham || 38 ||
dhāmavāpyau ca saumye ca aiśānyāṃ ca sarovaraḥ | vaṭaḥ prācyāṃ yamāśāyāṃ yajñāṅgo bodhirabdiśi || 39 ||
plakṣaścottarataḥ śastaḥ samastā vyastakā amī | jayantīdāḍimīśyāmāpunnāgāriṣṭapādapā || 40 ||
yatratatrasthabhāgāṅge (mū: śubhāśārgo) gṛhabhuvyapare śubhāḥ | bahudarbhavatī viprā kṣatriyā ca śarākulā || 41 ||
snigdhadūrvānvitā vaiśyā śudrāsośīrakāśikā | phalapuṣpavatīsnigdhā snigdhagulmoṣadhīdrumāḥ || 42 ||
p 102> gāvo'tha mānuṣāśvā vā ramante yatra nityaśaḥ | ekavarṇā ghanā tulyā yamāmbudiśi connatā || 43 ||
vistīrṇā sādṛḍhā śastā śubhagandhātmagandhikā | candanāgurukāśmīracandrābjotpalacampakāḥ || 44 ||
pāṭalānāgajātyaśca mallikāmadirāsavāḥ | śālībhamadadadhyājyadugdhānyetatsugandhinī || 46 ||
pṛthagdhā miśragandhābhūścāturyarṇyeṣu bhūtidā | grīṣmakāle ca yā śītā uṣmaṇā śiśire'nviyā || 47 ||
prāvṛṣyubhayasaṃsparśā sā dvijādi (k, kh: dvijāti) sukhāvahā | mṛdaṅgaveṇuvīṇā ca (gh: vīṇābda) dundubhyādiśubhasvanā (mū: śubhātmanā) || 48 ||
vibhūtikāriṇī kṣoṇī (k: yā tu) cāturvarṇyasya sarvadā | śvetāprajā (k, gh: grajā) hyagandhā ca raktā rājyāśiṣodvahā (mū: miṣo vṛṣā) || 49 ||
pītā vaiśyā tathā kṣārā śūdrā kṛṣṇā malodvahā | guḍā (mū: śubhā) bhayānamranimbānāṃ svādādviprādijāmahī (kh: sā mahī) || 50 ||
śāntirjayaṃ dhanaṃ cāyuḥ kramāddadyāddvijāditaḥ (kh: titaḥ) | āṣāḍhā kṛttikā jyeṣṭhā tathā śatabhiṣā ca bham || 51 ||
varuṇāgnīndravātāśca kramāttu devatāḥ (mū: ttaddevatā) smṛtāḥ | svajāti brāhmaṇī vāpi yathālābhaṃ ca gṛhyate (mū: pūjyate) || 51 ||
varjanīyā vasātailavartigandhā (ṅ: yujyate) ca yā kṣitiḥ | raktāṅgāraśilāyuktā (k: randhrā-) kṛmikīṭavatī ca yā || 52 ||
nimnā gartānvitā rūkṣā soṣaracchidrakardamā | seṣṭakācitikeśāsthibhasmavalmīkaśarkarā (k, kh: jarjarā) || 53 ||
vāmāvartajalādiksthā saṅkīrṇa na praśasyate | bahvāpadbahuvarṇā ca vajrāgnihyaricauradā (mū, ṅ: ṣairadā) || 54 ||
na tasyāṃ vasatī śarma na dharmo nātmajo dhanam | yoṣidduścāriṇī tatra rujo rājabhayaṃ bhavet || 55 ||
śivakharāśvanādāḍhyā bhinnabhāṇḍanibhasvanā | kākakaṅgoṣṭraśabdā vā sarvaiṣāmasuravāvahā || 56 ||
sadaivoṣṇā sadā śītā karkaśā vāṣpaśaṅkulā | drāgambha (mū, k, ṅ: prāgambhaḥ) śoṣikā neṣṭā dhanāyughnī saśilpikā (kh: samalpikā) || 57 ||
khāte ca karamātre ca pāṃśubhiḥ paripūrite | nyūnā samādhikā jñeyā hīnamadhyottamā kṣitiḥ || 58 ||
āpūrya gartamambhobhirgate padaśate tataḥ | syustri (mū, a, k, ṅ: muṣṭi) dvyekāṅgulahrāsāddhīnamadhyottamā bhuvaḥ || 59 ||
gartasthānānnisiśvetaraktapītāsitatviṣām | puṣpāṇāṃ mlāyate yatnā (gh: yatno) ttasya sā bhūrdvijāditaḥ (kh: titaḥ) || 60 ||
āmakumbhāsyagandhājyapūriteṣu (mū, k: tekhva) śarāvake | dvijādīnāṃ sitādyāśca jvalitāvartayo niśi || 61 ||
prāgādivaktramantraisthā (stā) iṣṭasthāne samāvṛte | nirvāpyaḥ (mū: nirvāntyaḥ) prajvalantyaśca svajātisukhaduḥkhadā || 62 ||
proktalakṣmakramābhāve yathāprāptiparigrahaḥ | varṇasaṃpādanaṃ kṛtvā svaiḥ svairjātīsamasvaraiḥ (mū, gh: tīśaśambarai) || 63 ||
parīkṣyaivaṃ bhuvaṃ yatnād vāhayitvā vaped yavān | sapta pañca trirātre syāddhīnādi (k, kh: dviśādi) rohaṇātridhā || 64 ||
hitā dvijāya vedāsrā rājño'ṣṭāsrāyatā (mū, gh, ṅ: ṣṭāṃśāyatā) mahī | vaiśyāya ca ṣaḍaṃśāsrā śūdrāya hyāyatā śubhā || 65 ||
pṛthudviguṇadīrghā ca chinnakarṇādvikoṇikā | vakrā (mū, gh, ṅ: vajrā) rdhendudviko (k, ṅ: triko) ṇābhā vṛttā ṣaṭkoṇikā ca yā || 66 ||
yānakṣayaṃ bhayaṃ vipre strīputradhananāśanam | mṛtyurvyādhistathā pāpaṃ kramāddadyātpalaṃ mahī || 67 ||
gosūryāsyāttriśūlābhā sūryākārāhi vajrikā (kh, gh: varjikā; g: pṛṣṭhābhā) | śakaṭā dvipa (gh: dvija) pṛṣṭhābhā diṅmūḍhā ca karoti vai || 68 ||
prajānāśaṃ priyāsvāsthyaṃ (mū, gh, ṅ: svāmya) rogaṃ naiḥsvaṃ śirorujam | śokaṃ ca sarvanāśaṃ ca sarvalokakṣayaṃ kramāt || 69 ||
pañcāsrā bodhipatrābhā gṛdhragodhoṣṭra (k, kh: gāvoṣṭra) sannibhā | yavapipīlikāmadhyā dundubhīpaṭahodarī || 70 ||
mīnabhūdārapṛṣṭhābhā karikoṣṭhasamā ca yā | nānādoṣakarā hyetāḥ sarveṣāmeva varjitāḥ || 71 ||
dhanyā tvanyā kumārī ca pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitā | prāgvidhānena sā grāhyā yadi nopahatā bhavet || 72 ||
śvapacāntyajanīcairvā kravyādbhiḥ paśupakṣibhiḥ | yā sevitā sadā pṛthvī koṣṇā (k: koṣo) sṛgvajradūṣitā || 73 ||
bhasmeṣṭakāsthipāṣāṇaśarkarāpāṃśusaṃyutā | api grāhyā (k: grāhya) guṇāḍhyā sā gṛhadhāmnoḥ suśodhitā || 74 ||
śatadhā vāhayitvā tu hemaphālairhalairmahīm | śuddhyarthaṃ sthāpayettatra māsān pañca ca (k, ṅ: pañcaiva) gokulam || 75 ||
tataḥ pravāpayedbrīhīn yājñiyā(/)śca tilādikān (kh: ḍhakān) | pakvaśasyena saṃskṛtya ghaṭayeddhāma (kh: vāsa) veśmanī || 76 ||
evaṃ viśodhitāṃ bhūmiṃ samīkṛtyopalepayet | tataḥ prasādhayetkāṣṭhāṃ gṛhādīnāṃ taducyate || 77 ||
tiṣyavedhena tu prācīṃ citrāsvātyantareṇa vā | mīnayogena kauberīṃ dhruvayogena cānayet || 78 ||
viṣuve nirmalākāśe tadbhūmau maṇḍale kṛte | nyasettanmadhyataḥ śaṅkuṃ khādiraṃ dvādaśocchrayam || 79 ||
ṣaḍaṅgulapariṇāhaṃ parito rudrarekhitam | tacchāyāyāḥ praveśena paścimāṃ diśamaṅkayet || 80 ||
prācīṃ ca nirgame tasyāstatra sūtraṃ ca vinyaset | mīnayogyāṃ tathā yāmyāṃ saumyāśāṃ ca prasādhayet || 81 ||
catuṣkoṇāni diṅmadhyāt kṣetrasyaivārdhasūtrataḥ | vedāsraṃ ca catuḥsūtraṃ pātatastatra siddhyati || 82 ||
prāgāsyāṃ daśadhā nāḍyo (mū: nānyo) bhūtvā (?) nāmāni ca bruve | śāntā yaśovatī kāntā viśālā (kh: vilāsā) prāṇavāhinī || 83 ||
matī vasumatī (mū, ṅ: satī vargasatī; k, g: matī bahumatī) nandā subhadrā ca manoramā | uttarāsyāṃ daśānyā ca ekāśītyaṅghrikārikā || 84 ||
hariṇī suprabhā lakṣmīrvibhūtirvimalā śriyā | jayā jvālā viśokā ca smṛtaitā sūtrapātataḥ || 85 ||
īśādyaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ dikṣu yajedīśaṃ cayaṃ jayam | śakramarkaṃ tathā satyaṃ bhṛśaṃ vyomaṃ ca pūrvataḥ || 86 ||
havyavāhaṃ (mātariśca iti pāṭhe sādhu.ḥ) ca pūṣāṇaṃ vitathaṃ saumyameva ca | kṛtāntamatha gāndharvaṃ bhṛṅgaṃ mṛgaṃ ca dakṣiṇe || 87 ||
pitaraṃ dvārapālaṃ ca sugrīvaṃ puṣpadantakam | varuṇaṃ daityaśoṣau ca yakṣmāṇaṃ paścime sadā || 88 ||
rogāhi (gh: vegāhi) mukhyabhallāṭaṃ somadiśya (somāhira iti pāṭhe sādhuḥ) ditiṃ ditim | navāntapadago brahmā pūjyo'nye dvipadaṅghrikāḥ || 89 ||
brahmeśāntarakoṣṭhasthamāpākhyaṃ tu padadvaye | tathādhaścāpavatsākhyaḥ kendrāntare tu ṣaṭpade || 90 ||
marīcikāgnimadhye tu savitā dvipadasthitaḥ | sāvitrī tadadho dvyaṅghre vivasvān ṣaṭpade tvadhaḥ || 91 ||
pitṛbrahmāntare dvisthamindraṃ mitraṃ tvadho jayam | varuṇabrahmaṇormadhye mitrākhyaṃ ṣaṭpade yajet || 92 ||
roga (gh: vega) brahmāntare nityaṃ dvisthaṃ ca rudradāsakam | tadadho dvyaṅghrikaṃ (k, kh: ṅghrigaṃ) yakṣmāṃ ṣaḍsu (k, kh, gh: ṣaḍsthaṃ) saumye dharādharam || 93 ||
carakī skandavaidāryau kandarpaḥ pūtanā tathā | jambhapāpapilīpicchān yaje (k, g: nyase) dīśādibāhyataḥ || 94 ||
ekāśītipadaṃ veśma maṇḍapaśca śatāṅghrikaḥ | pūrvavaddevatāḥ pūjyā brahmāntāḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśake (kh, ṅ: śātmake) || 95 ||
marīciśca vivasvāṃśca mitraḥ pṛthvīdharastathā | daśakoṣṭhasthitā dikṣu tvanye ceśādikoṇagāḥ || 96 ||
daityamātāharau khāgnī mṛgākhyāpitarau tathā | pāpasaṃjñānilau devā sārdhasārdhāṅghrisaṃsthitāḥ || 97 ||
pratyekaṃ balimantrāśca marmavedhādivañcanam | devavāstuvidhau sarvaṃ vakṣye śalyoddhṛti kramāt || 98 ||
nagarāṭṭālaharmyādi toraṇagrāmayościtiḥ (k, kh: sthitiḥ) | stambhapūjādi (mū: pūrādi) vāstūktaṃ bhinnaṃ kvacicca kūpavat (mū, ṅ: rūpavat) || 99 ||
yatyāṅghrikaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa yathākramam | sadigviṃśatkaro dairghyātsaptaviṃśativistṛtaḥ || 100 ||
śivāśramaḥ śikhākhyasya (ṅ: śivākhyasya) caturhīnaḥ sadobhayoḥ | rudradviguṇitaṃ nāhātpṛthujyotirvinā tribhiḥ || 101 ||
syādgrahadviguṇaṃ dairghyāttithayaścaiva vistarāt | sāvitrasyālayaṃ kuryādyeṣāṃ pṛthu digaṃśataḥ (kh, ṅ: digantaram) || 102 ||
kujaḥ (gh: kuḍyaṃ) pṛthūpajaṅghoccā kuḍyaṃ tattriguṇo (kh: dvguṇo) cchrayam | kuḍyasūtrasamā vīthī vīthībhedādanekadhā || 103 ||
kuvendraṃ (k, kh, ṅ: tadendraṃ) pañcavīthībhirvīrāṃ vīthīṃ vināgrataḥ | śrījaya (kh, ṅ: śrīkuśa) spṛṣṭhato hīno bhadrograṃ (k, kh, ṅ: rudrograṃ) pārśvayorvinā || 104 ||
garbhapṛthusamā vīthī tadardhārdhena vā kvacit | vīthyardhenopavīthyāḍhya (mū: thyādya) mekadvitripurānvitam || 105 ||
yatīnāṃ gṛhametaddhi khyātaṃ gocarabhedataḥ | sāmānyānyaṃ gṛhaṃ (gh: nyadgṛhaṃ) vacmi sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmadam || 106 ||
ekadvitricatuḥśālamaṣṭaśālaṃ yathākramam | ekaṃ yāmyaṃ ca saumyāsyaṃ dve cetpaścātpuromukham || 107 ||
catuḥśālaṃ tu saṃmukhyāttayorindrenduyuktayoḥ | siddhārthamambuyāmye ca indrāpye (kh: indrākhya) yamasūryakam || 108 ||
prāksaumyasthe ca daṇḍākhyaṃ (kh: chavidaṇḍākhyaṃ) prāgyāmye vātasaṃjñakam | āpyendau gṛhacūlyākhyaṃ kācāhvaṃ yāmyasaumyayoḥ || 109 ||
siddhārthe dhanasaṃprāptirmṛtyuḥ syādyamasūryake | daṇḍākhye rājato daṇḍo vātākhye kalahaḥ sadā || 110 ||
gṛhacalyāṃ dhanaṃ naśyetkāce jñātiviruddhayaḥ | vinā saumyaṃ hiraṇyākhyaṃ triśālaṃ taddhanarddhikṛt (mū, a, ṅ: hṛt; kh: tadbahiḥ kṛtaḥ) || 111 ||
pūrvaśālāvihīnaṃ syātsukṣetravṛddhidāyakam | yāmye hīne bhaveccūlī (mū: cchūlā) triśālaṃ vittahṛtparam || 112 ||
pakṣaghnaṃ (k: yakṣamaghnaṃ) jalahīnokaḥ sutaghnaṃ bahuśatrukṛt | indrādikramato vacmi (mū: vahni) dhvajādyaṣṭau gṛhāṇyaham || 113 ||
prācyāṃ vyāmiśramāvāsa (mū: śrusāvāsa) magnau bhasmamahānasam | yāmye rasakriyāśayyā varma (varcaḥ) śastrāṇi rakṣasi || 114 ||
dhanabhuktvambuveśmāpye śasyagandhau ca mārute | saumye dhanaṃ paśūn kuryādīśe dīkṣāsurālayam || 115 ||
svāmihastamitaṃ veśma vistarāyāmapiṇḍakam | dviguṇaṃ hastasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvāṣṭāṃśairhṛtaṃ tathā || 116 ||
taccheṣo yaḥ sthitastena vāyasāntaṃ (ṅ: vāvyāntaṃ) dhvajādikam | tapaḥ pakṣāgnivedeṣu rasādyambarato bhavet || 117 ||
sarvanāśakaraṃ veśma madhye cānte ca saṃsthitam | tasmācca (mū, gh: tatsyācca) navame bhāge śubhakṛnnilayo mataḥ || 118 ||
tanmadhye maṇḍapaḥ śastaḥ samo vā dviguṇāyataḥ | prāgāpye cenduyāmye vā haṭṭa (k: haste) evaṃ gṛhāvalī || 119 ||
ekaikabhavanāsyāni dikṣvaṣṭāṣṭakasaṅkhyayā | īśādiditikāntāni phalānyeṣāṃ yathākramam || 120 ||
bhayaṃ nārīcalatvaṃ ca jayo vṛddhiḥ pratāpakaḥ (kh: prabhāvakaḥ) | dharmaḥ kaliśca naiḥsvaṃ ca prāgdvāreṣu yathākramam (k, gh: ṣvaṣṭakaṃ dhruvam) || 121 ||
dāhaḥ sukhaṃ suhṛnnāśo dhananāśo mṛtirdhanam | śilpitvaṃ tanayaḥ syācca yāmyadvāraphalāṣṭakam || 122 ||
āyuḥ prāgrājya (k, kh, gh: prābrājya) śasyāni dhanaśāntyarthasaṃkṣayaḥ | śotharogaśca (mū, k, gh: śoṣaṃ rogaṃ ca) pāpaṃ ca jaladvārātphalāni ca || 123 ||
rogo (k, kh: rogā) madārtimukhyatvaṃ cārthāyuḥ kṛśatāmatiḥ | mānaśca dvārataḥ proktamuttarasyāṃ diśi kramāt || 124 ||
dārviṣṭakāśmamṛjjaṃ vā jālālakavibhūṣitam | cārvībhistabhmamālābhiḥ kapāṭaiḥ sārgalairyutam || 125 ||
kṛtvaivaṃ tāpasaṃ sthānaṃ vāstudevāṃśca pūjayet | homena (ṅ: doṣa ca) tarpayetsarvān maṇḍape purato guruḥ || 126 ||
tataścārghāmbunāsicya (kh: secyaṃ) sadvārābhyantaraṃ gṛham | veśmasaṃsthāpane kāle guruṃ santoṣya bhaktitaḥ || 127 ||
diśāṃ baliṃ bahirdatvā yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ tataḥ | gṛhopaskaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ dattvā śayyāsanādikam || 128 ||
yatiṃ saṃsthāpayettridvyekavarṣaṃ vārdhakaṃ tataḥ (ṅ: tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam) | sveṣṭadevālayaṃ kuryāttallakṣaṇamathocyate || 129 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye maṇḍapayatyādigṛhasthāpane dvāviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 22 ||
[atha trayoviṃśaḥ]
prācyādāpyānta (k, kh, gh: dyāpanta) māvāsāsuracchāyā bhavedyadi | bhayaṃ dāhaṃ rujaṃ (mū: bhava) mṛtyurnaiḥsvaṃ kuryātkramātsadā || 1 ||
dvyucchrāya (g, gh: dhruva) dviguṇaṃ sūtraṃ tyaktvā kuryāttu saumyataḥ | jagatyekaṃ pṛthurvāpi (kh: pṛthgvāpi) kecitprāhuḥ surālayam || 2 ||
yavamānātpradhānādau prāguktastrividhaḥ karaḥ | teṣāṃ madhye bhavedekaḥ karturicchāvaśena tu || 3 ||
caturviṃśatibhiścānyaḥ prakṛto'ṅguṣṭhakairmataḥ | pañcahasto'thavā kāryaḥ ṣaṭcaturaṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
sarvāṇyetāni (gh: va hi) vāstūni samahastaiḥ pramāpayet | viṣamaistu na (mū: mastena) mādhyāni māghyadoṣo mahānbhavet || 5 ||
aṅgula sārdhamardhaṃ vā pādonaṃ satribhāgikam | āya (kh: āpa) doṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ dāpayettatra buddhimān || 6 ||
sāravannirvraṇaṃ śastamṛjuṃ cāṅgula (mū: caivāti) vartulam | tryaṅgulaṃ pariṇāhena jinasaṅkhyāṅgulāyatam || 7 ||
mūlarekhātrayopetamagrerekhādvayānvitam | hastadārusamāsena vyākhyātaṃ vāstusādhanam || 8 ||
caturhastapramāṇokto dhanurhastordhva (k, ṅ: daṇḍotha; gh: daṇḍordhva) sādhane | sahasraṃ dhanuṣāṃ krośo gavyūtirdviguṇaṃ smṛtam || 9 ||
gavyūtidviguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ yojanaṃ parisaṅkhyayā | ekaṃ daśaśataṃ jñeyaṃ sahasramayutaṃ punaḥ || 10 ||
niyuta prayutaṃ vidyādarbudaṃ nyarbudaṃ tathā | vṛndaṃ kharvaṃ nikharvaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ vai padmasaṃjñakam || 11 ||
samudro madhyamantākhyaṃ parākhyaṃ paramaṃ tathā | parārdhaṃ sarva (kh, gh: meva) mākhyātaṃ daśavṛddhyuttarottaram || 12 ||
evametāni coktāni saṅkhyāsthānāni sūribhiḥ | purasya sarvato dikṣu sabāhyābhyantareṣu ca || 13 ||
dvāre dvāre caturdikṣu śriyaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tathā | kuryādabhimukhāvaitau grāmasna nagarasya ca || 14 ||
prākāra (k: prāsāda) parikhābāhye kāryāḥ prāsādakalpanāḥ | dhanuḥ (kh: punaḥ) śate'thavā kāryaṃ (k, gh: sārdhe) tathā dhanuḥ śatadvaye || 15 ||
sarvatrābhimukhāḥ śastā na praśastāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ | prākpratīcyāgato madhye vaṃśo dakṣiṇasomataḥ || 16 ||
ubhayoḥ pārśvataḥ kāryāḥ prāsādā vaṃśavarjitāḥ | paścime prāṅmukhāḥ śastā aindryāṃ (gh: aindrāḥ) paścimasaṃmukhā || 17 ||
udagdakṣiṇagāścānye prāṅmukhāḥ paścimānanāḥ | nottarābhimukhāḥ śastāḥ kadāciddakṣiṇāmukhāḥ || 18 ||
kintu daitya (k, kh: caitya) sabhāmuktyā (mū: yuktā) mātṛpakṣavināyakān | dṛṣṭvā devyāmataṃ hyeta (mū, k, gh: matāddhyeta) dākṛṣya parilekhitam || 19 ||
prāguktasthānake divye yatra yasya surasthitiḥ | tadādau kīrtyate sthityai kurtuḥ kīrtiśubhecchayā || 20 ||
vivṇvindra (k, ṅ: viṣṭvindra) bhānavaścaindre āgneyāṃśe'gni (kh: yāmāgni) bhāskarau | hanūmadbhūtavetālamātṛkālāstu dakṣiṇe || 21 ||
pitaro bhadrakālī ca daityarakṣāṃsi rākṣase | samudrā varuṇo nadyo viśvāmitro'psaro (k, g, gh: śmaro) jale || 22 ||
vāyuḥ kātyāyanī nāgāḥ satī (ṅ: gāsatī) bhāsyaśca mārute | saumye skando viśākhaśca sthāpyā yakṣā grahāstathā || 23 ||
īśāne bhairavā rudrā madhye brahmā caturmukhaḥ | purādyabhimukhā devāḥ śubhāḥ svasthānasaṃsthitā || 24 ||
parāṅmukho vinā sthānānnadīdevāśrayeṇa vā | kṛte devaṃ likhetsaumyaṃ tatkuḍrye purasammukham || 25 ||
yathā pure tathā grāme pattane nagare sadā | sthāpyā dhāmajagatyāṃ tu prāsādāṅgeṣu devatāḥ (mū, ṅ: svadevatāḥ) || 26 ||
śamya (gh, ṅ: śasyā) śokāmramālūrāḥ śubhāḥ syuścottarasthitāḥ | kaṭukaṇṭakinastiktāḥ piśācākhyādipādapāḥ || 27 ||
akṣīriṇaśca ye cānye śāstraduṣṭāśca bhūruhāḥ | prāsādasya samīpasthāḥ sarvadoṣāvahā nṛṇam || 28 ||
rakṣobhūtaiḥ samākrāntā duṣṭapakṣisamāśritāḥ | aśakta (gh: asak) cchedane teṣāṃ ropayetkṣīriṇo'ntare || 29 ||
nāgakesarapunnāgajambīrāriṣṭadāḍimāḥ | nāraṅganārikelau ca panasāśca sacampakāḥ || 30 ||
