jayantī ketakī kubjabījakau (gh: kundabījako) mātuluṅgakaḥ | saralonandikāvartatālāgastyatimuktakāḥ || 31 ||
kramukaḥ karavīraśca pārāvatādijātayaḥ | ebhirantaritāḥ krūrā bhūruhāḥ syuḥ sukhapradāḥ || 32 ||
diksthānaniyamaḥ proktaḥ surāṇāṃ saviśeṣataḥ | śivasya niyamo nāsti prāsādakaraṇaṃ prati || 33 ||
anādiḥ sarvagaḥ pūjyo dikṣu sarvāsu bhaktitaḥ | mumukṣoryatra tatreśo dadyānmuktiṃ tu helayā || 34 ||
digbhedānkāmināmiṣṭamaiśādi phalamucyate | pātālakhecarīsiddhiḥ śatrudāhaśca śāntayaḥ || 35 ||
ripūcchāda (tsāda iti pāṭhāntaram) ścirāyuṣṭvaṃ koṣaḥ puṣṭipradaṃ kramāt | grāmādīśendravahnisthāḥ paścimāsyāḥ surāḥ śubhāḥ || 36 ||
dakṣiṇādyuttarāntāśā (mū: rāśāsu) saṃsthitāḥ prāṅmukhā hitāḥ | adhikaṃ vā samaṃ hinaṃ pūrvāyāmādibādhakam || 37 ||
prāsādādi na kartavyaṃ kuryāccenmṛtyumāpnuyāt | ubhayodviguṇocchrāyā kuryāttyaktvāgrataḥ kṣitau || 38 ||
pṛṣṭhataccobhayornāhaṃ tatpādāgraṃ ca pārśvayoḥ | bhinnanābhau vidhiścāyaṃ na doṣo'bhinnanābhike || 39 ||
koṇādi dhāmnya (kh, g: dhānya) doṣāya nāyakasyāṅgabhūtataḥ | evaṃ bāṇamatājjñātvā harisūryādi ropayet || 40 ||
svayambhūrbāṇaliṅgāntāṃ rudrakādhā (mū: ntarudrabādhā) nacāparaiḥ | svayambhūte sahasraikaṃ mahadbhiḥ śatapañcakam || 41 ||
kṣetraṃ śataikahastaṃ syālliṅge narapratiṣṭhite | sthāvare kṣetramityevaṃ jagatyantaṃ yaterbhuvi | tatrotpannaṃ hi nirmālyaṃ mṛte jantau vimocanam || 42 ||
yajamānānukūle'hni sunimitte samāhitaḥ | praviśya bhūmiṃ tāṃ dhīmānudagīśānagocare || 43 ||
paṭāvṛte sugupte tu parīkṣayecca yatnataḥ | dhānyakambuphalairyuktaṃ candonena sucarcitam || 44 ||
vastrakaṇṭhaṃ dṛrḍha śastaṃ ratnauṣadhyambupūritam | nyasettatra ghaṭaṃ divyaṃ tūryamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ || 45 ||
arghyādi (k, g: avyādhi) vidhinā tasmin viśvakarmamate'rcayet (k, kh: karmāṇamarcayet) | paraśuṃ muṣṭilāṃ sūtraṃ kīlakāṃśca taduttare || 46 ||
sthāpayitvā tu saṃsnāpya pūjayecca yathākramam | punnāgaśastavṛkṣotthāḥ kīlakāḥ ekajātayaḥ || 47 ||
sudṛḍhā yājñikodbhūtā vṛttā vā caturasrakāḥ | aṣṭāṅgulapraveṣṭena śaṅkavaḥ (mū, a, ṅ: śaṅkaraḥ) karadīrdhakāḥ || 48 ||
vedāsraṃ sādhayettatra sūtrapātena pūrvavat | śaṅkuṃ niveśayettasminnāja (kh: nnaja) gatyāḥ krameṇa tu || 49 ||
madhusarpidadhikṣīdairliptamūlāḥ sacandanāḥ | suvastrairveṣṭitāḥ sarve sudhūpenaiva dhūpitāḥ || 50 ||
sālaktakatrisūtrāśca sitaiḥ puṣpaiśca pūjitāḥ | adhomūlordhvagāgrāśca ṛjurūpāḥ suśobhanā || 51 ||
analādiṣu koṇeṣu tāḍayellohamudgaraiḥ | kīlakān grāhayitvā (mū, ṅ: prāhayitvā) vai gacchedagnidiśaṃ prati || 52 ||
śuklāmbaradharo dhīmānācāryaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sthitaḥ | dakṣiṇena samutthāpya vāmahastena muṣṭinā || 53 ||
gṛhītvā kīlakaṃ bhūmāvavakraṃ dhārayedṛjum | tāḍayaṃśca japenmantraṃ prāṅnimittāni lakṣayet || 54 ||
oṃ viśantu bhūtale nāgā lokapālāśca kāmadāḥ | asmin gṛhe tu tiṣṭhantu āyurbalakarāḥ sadā || 55 ||
oṃ skrī(/) krī(/) hrī(/) hū(/) svāhā (mantro'yaṃ mūlapustake nāsti | oṃ maṃ vaṃ hrī(/) hū(/) svāhā kha ṅa | oṃ krī(/) hrī(/) phaṭ svāhā ka pā0 |) |
iti bāṇamate kīlakāropaṇamantraḥ ||
ghātāṣṭakaṃ svayaṃ dadyāddaiśiko mantravigrahaḥ (k, g: vittamaḥ) | tataḥ pradhānakārūkastāḍayecca viśedyathā || 56 ||
hataṃ tanna (k, g: hatatattvā; kh: tadantaṃ) viśedbhūmau tadā tanniṣpattiriṣyate | praviśecceddrutaṃ sarvaṃ kartustatrāśubhaṃ tadā || 57 ||
bhinne hanyātsutaṃ (kh: tmaja) bhāryāṃ karturnāśaśca bhaṅgataḥ | śanaiḥ śanairadho gacchetkāryasiddhiṃ vinirdiśet || 58 ||
aindryāṃdipraṇate śaṅkau bhayaṃ (kh, gh: dhanaṃ) dāho daridratā | bhayamarthakṣatīrogaḥ sukhaṃ mānaṃ kramādbhavet || 59 ||
kīlakaḥ kuñcito mūrdhni prahāreṇa bhavedyadi | āyuḥ putrārthavṛddhiḥ syāccyute hastādbhayaṃ mahat || 60 ||
kauśaṃ vā vālvajaṃ mauñjaṃ śāṇaṃ cārdhāṅgulaṃ śubham | sūtraṃ niveśayacchaṅkau yathā tanna vimuñcati || 61 ||
mukte ca mriyate putraśchinne kartā vinaśyati | tasmātsugranthitaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇena tu veṣṭayet || 62 ||
caturasrīkṛte kṣetre baliṃ kīleṣu dāpayet | āgneyyāṃ tanmukho bhūtvā mantramuccārayedimam || 63 ||
oṃ agnibhyo'thasarvebhyo ye cānye tasmāśritāḥ | baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi puṇyamodanamuttamam (mū, ṅ: sarve gṛhṇantu mantritāḥ) || 64 ||
(cāpāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mū, a, k, kh, pustakeṣu nāsti) nair(-) ṛtyādhipatiścaiva nair(-)ṛtyāṃ ye ca rākṣasāḥ | baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi sarve gṛhṇantu mantritāḥ || 65 ||
oṃ namo vāyurājebhyo ye cānye tatsamāśritāḥ | baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi puṇyamodanamuktamam (mū, a, ṅ: gṛhṇantu puṇyamodanam) || 66 ||
oṃ rudrebhyaśca sarvebhyo ye cānye tatsamāśritāḥ | baliṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchāmi gṛhṇantu sumanotsukāḥ || 67 ||
sarve gṛhṇantu vai hṛṣṭā svāhākārāntayojitāḥ | dhruvādi dīpitā mantrāḥ kumbhayitvā nivedayet || 68 ||
evamagnyādayo devāḥ krameṇānena pūjitāḥ | tarpitāstuṣṭamanaso bhavanti karmasiddhidāḥ || 69 ||
iti deva matāt kīlakāropaṇamantrāḥ |
snāyūtthaṃ carmajaṃ vāpi sūtraṃ kaiṭamathāśubhe | kaṭukaṇṭakiśākhoṭakalikākhyāśca (kotthāśca ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ) śaṅkavaḥ || 70 ||
tataścānantare vāstuṃ samāvakraṃ (mū, a, k, kh, ṅ: vāstusamācakraṃ) yajettataḥ | nādhikaṃ sukhadaṃ karturdoṣā ete sadādhike || 71 ||
vairaṃmārī (mū: nārī) vināśaśca mṛtyurogo'rthanāśanam | pravāstastaskarādbhītiḥ prāgādyādhikasūtrataḥ || 72 ||
evaṃ jñātvā tu sūtrāṇi hemnā ratnena vā likhet | raupyeṇa vā nirarthānāmartha (kh: māṣa) vṛddhayai dvijātitaḥ || 73 ||
śastrāyo'sthiradāṅgāraśṛṅga (k, ṅ: gṛhe) dārviṣṭakāśmabhiḥ | tṛṇairvā (mū: tūṇairvā) likhite vāstau doṣā ete bhavanti ca || 74 ||
mṛtyuśca bandhanaṃ daṇḍo dāhaḥ kṣayo'rthanāśanam | caurādbhayamathocchāda (kh: tsāda; gh: malācchāda) iṣṭahānirgadaḥ kramāt || 75 ||
pādenoccāṭanaṃ lekhā (mū: śeṣā) dapasmāraṃ nakhena ca | ajinena bhavedvyādhistasmāddhemnā likhetsadā || 76 ||
tacca sraga (k, kh: tatra gatvā) kṣatairvāstumiṣṭvā dhāmantu sūtrayet | tatkāle lakṣayecchalyaṃ viśeṣeṇa taducyate || 77 |
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye sthānadeśayāga (gh: vedasthānavegayāga) lakṣaṇanirṇaye trayoviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 23 ||
[atha caturviṃśaḥ]
śalyoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāmprataṃ dhāmasadmanoḥ | lipte susaṃskṛte sthāne tanyamāne (g: tatpramāṇe) ca sūtrake || 1 ||
tanmadhye'nte samīpe vā satvānāṃ darsanaṃ yadi | kīrtanaṃ (gh: kīrtitaṃ) vā dhvanirvā syādyadi vā sūtralaṅghanam (mū, a: lakṣaṇam) || 2 ||
tadā vai tatra śalyaṃ tu vidyādyatra gṛhī sthitaḥ | mahāmarmāsthiśalyena bhayaṃ karturmahadbhavet || 3 ||
asthisthaṃ bhidyate (mū: vidyate) kuḍyaṃmaśubhaṃ kurūte sadā | tasmādākarṣayecchalyaṃ tadbhavaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ || 4 ||
mārjārasūtralakṣyādi (k, kh: laṅghādi) tadasthi rāsabhasya vā | khareṇa kharajaṃ nābhyāmuccāṭaḥ syātprabhorbhayam || 5 ||
śvāsthiśalyaṃ śuno nityamudvegastena jāyate | ajāvibhyāṃ gavāsthi syāttayorvāsthi suniścitam || 6 ||
gavāsthnā cātidāridryaṃ gopīḍā chāgalāsthitaḥ | āvikādbaddhināśaḥ (kh: buddhināśaḥ) syādaśvajaṃ bhekajaṃ gavā || 7 ||
vājijācca gavāṃ nāśo dharmārthau bhekajātsutaḥ (k, g, gh: nmudaḥ) | aśvena māhiṣaṃ vidyā (mū, gh: vindyā) dgajenoṣṭrodbhavaṃ tathā || 8 ||
tajjāmaśvatareṇāsthnā tribhirduḥ śīlatā bhavam | jambukāsthi lulāyena mṛgarkṣābhyāṃ (k, kh: gājābhyāṃ) tadaṅgajam || 9 ||
tribhiḥ paropajīvitvaṃ vārāhaṃ śivayā ruje | vyāghrāsthi śūkareṇa syāttena daṣṭe (k, kh: daṃṣṭre) riporbhayam || 10 ||
vyāghreṇa hastijaṃ śalyaṃ daurbhāgyodvegakṛcca tat | murmuraṃ (kh: mutsaraṃ) karabheṇātha pāṇḍarāṅgasapāṃśukau ( kh: pāṇḍuroga sapāṇḍukaiḥ) || 11 ||
narau (mū, ṅ: navau) dṛṣṭvā tuṣāṅgārabhasmapāṃśūṃśca lakṣayet | bhasmāṅgāreṇa dāhaḥ syātpravāsaḥ pāṃśunā drutam || 12 ||
tuṣeṇa dhānyanāśaḥ syādyaja (gh: śaśca yaja) mānagṛhe sadā | sūtre santānya (kh, gh: tāḍya) māne tu vyomno viṣṭhāprapātataḥ || 13 ||
gṛhasyādho (sthādho li0 pu0 pā0) nidhānaṃ syādvāstvaṅge tatpramāṇataḥ | vṛṣabheṇa nidhānaṃ ca gomūtrādrajataṃ viduḥ || 14 ||
suvarṇaṃ tatpurīṣeṇa dhanaputraṃvivṛddhidam | śiśunā hasite dhānyaṃ gṛhasyādhaḥ (sthādhaḥ li0 pu0 pā0) sukhāvaham || 15 ||
tanmūtreṇa tu kūpaḥ syānmaraṇaṃ tena jāyate | śvamūtreṇa ca rītiḥ syādvaṅgaṃ (mū, gh, ṅ: vaṃśaṃ) tadviṣṭhayā sadā || 16 ||
ajāvikāmalāttāmraṃ rītikātyartha (mū: dyartha; kh, gh: nyartha) nāśakṛt | vṛṣadaṃśamalādvaṅgaṃ hastasthadhana (k: stridhana; kh: strīdaśa) hānidam ||17 ||
śuktisaṅkīrtanācchuktiḥ sukhaśāntipradāyikā | śāntadiggajarjācca kartuścādho nidhiḥ sthitaḥ || 18 ||
yatkakupsaṃsthitaḥ sūryastisro duṣṭāstadādikāḥ | śāntāstu phaladāśeṣā drekkāṇoccagrahodayāt || 19 ||
pakṣīṇāṃ śāntadiksthānāṃ nidhirmadhuravāsitāt | kravyānmṛgavihaṅgānāṃ kīrtanātsyāttadasthi ca || 20 ||
eteṣāmasthito mṛtyuryadi noddhriyate tu tat | mūṣikeṇākhujo mūrdhā saputradhananāśakṛt || 21 ||
tadbhavaṃ babhrugodhābhyāṃ te ca bandhuvipattide | sarpāsthi sarpato jñeyaṃ tallakṣmīdhananāśadam (kh: balanāśanam) || 22 ||
kūrmeṇa kūrmajaṃ śalyaṃ vidyādyāgapravṛddhikṛt | śaṅkhācchaṅkhāsthi kāmārthaṃ kuryādviṣāṇajaṃ viduḥ || 23 ||
gośṛṅgeṇa dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ mṛtyuḥ syānmāhiṣeṇa tu | aiṇenākṣigadānmṛtyurāyasāllohajaṃ sadā || 24 ||
vṛṣadaṃśasya mūtrācca tena bandhaśca niḥ svatā | keśeṣṭakāśmanāṃ śabdāddarśanāttadbhavaṃ matam || 25 ||
bhayaṃ syādiṣṭakāśmabhyāṃ taccūrṇābhyāmanirvṛtiḥ | keśena duḥkhajīvitvaṃ tṛṇātparṇācca tadbhavam (kh: tadbhayam; k, g: tadvṛtam) || 26 ||
vyāghistārṇena bālānāṃ parṇātparopajīvitā | nṛśalyāt strīcalatvaṃ syādbrahmahatyā na saṃśayaḥ || 27 ||
ṣaṭpañcāśattu śalyāni sattvānāmiṅgitena ca | tanmadhye dvādaśeṣṭāni śeṣāṇyaniṣṭakṛnti ca || 28 ||
ārambhe śakunātpraśnācchabdātkaṇḍūyanādapi | śilpino yajamānasya tvanyeṣāṃ tanniyoginām || 29 ||
vijñeyaṃ liṅgataḥ (mū, ṅ: dadhataḥ) śalyaṃ (g: puṇyaṃ) yāstudehe na saṃśayaḥ | yannāma yasya śabdaśca (k, kh: śalyaśca) śṛṇuyāttattadātmakam || 30 ||
nirvikāro yadā pṛcchecchabdādirahito'thavā | niḥ śalyā tu tadā bhūmiḥ kathitavyā ca daiśikaiḥ || 31 ||
vāstvaṅge saṃsthite śalye bhavetkarturaśobhanam | tasmāttaduddharecchalyaṃ tacca tasmiṃstaducyate || 32 ||
śiraḥ kaṇḍūyane śalyaṃ mūrdhoṃtthaṃ stanamātrataḥ | putrāṇāṃ maraṇaṃ tena bandhubhiḥ syādviyogitā || 33 ||
bhrūpṛṣṭhe hema vā kācaṃ (kh: kāmaṃ) śubhāśubhakaraṃ bhavet (kh: karatrayāt) | netrakaṇḍūyanānmuktā śrādā tadaṅgamānataḥ || 34 ||
mukhasaṃsparśanātkāṣṭhaṃ mūrdhoṃdbhavamathāpi vā | tābhyāṃ hastadvayena syāddāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ kramāt || 35 ||
dantāddantaṃ tribhirhastaistena syātphalasaṃkṣayaḥ (gh: vāhanakṣaya) | vidrumaṃ hema tāraṃ vā karṇakaṇḍūyane bhavet || 36 ||
tanmānātsaṃsthitaṃ śalyamārogyaśubhaśāntikṛt | grīvāyāṃ sparśane graivaṃ śṛṅkhalā vātha lohajā || 37 ||
vṛṣadaṃśakaraṅkaṃ vā taduddharetkaradvaye (gh: traye) | bhavaṃ (k, kh: graivaṃ) mṛtyupradaṃ śalyaṃ bhāryāghnī śṛṅkhalā tathā || 38 ||
mārjārapañjareṇa syādvināśaḥ putrabhāryayoḥ | aṅgaspharśādbhavedāṅgaṃ tanmānādbahurogadam || 39 ||
phalake phalakaṃ (kh: hastalakṣaṇajaṃ) vidyāttanmānādarthanāśakṛt | kakṣābhyāṃ kṛṣṇalohaṃ tu tanmānādduḥkhadaṃ bhṛśam || 40 ||
bāhau tajjaṃ parāṃ bhūtikārakaḥ kaṇṭhamātrataḥ | dakṣiṇe ca kare pṛṣṭhe kapālaṃ vātha mṛnmayam || 41 ||
kaṭimātreṇa kartunnastana (gh: kartestutena) putrasya ca kramāt (?) | vāmahaste ca saṃspṛṣṭe khaṭvāpādastadaṅgataḥ || 42 ||
jānumātrādadho'vaśyaṃ (g: 'raṇyaṃ) dhanastrīnāśakārakam | pārśvakaṇḍūyane vidyānnarārdhena tu pāṃśulīm || 43 ||
netrarogo bhavettasya udvegaśca muhurmuhuḥ | udare paśuśalyaṃ syātkaṭimātre'tiśokadam || 44 ||
hṛdaye hṛdbhavaṃ cādhaḥ kṣuttṛḍdaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ | pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhajaṃ śalyaṃ śaukaraṃ vātha kūrparam || 45 ||
tanmānāddveṣakṛlloke śaukarādāmayo mahān | kaṭiṣpṛṣṭenāyaḥ kaṇṭho dvikarādho'rthanāśadaḥ || 46 ||
sphicostrapu ca tanmānā (k, kh, g, gh: mātrā) tkaṭirogapradaṃ tu tat | śepha (k: meha) sparśāvrilohotthaṃ karādhaḥ pramadāpaham || 47 ||
ūrdhvorūrūdbhavaṃ vātha dārūjaṃ sardhahastataḥ | strīduḥśīlorujācchalyāddāruśalyāddhanāpaham || 48 ||
jānunorjaṅghayoḥsthūṇā bhaṇḍikāṃ (mū: bhānukā) nāpitasya (gh: vāpi tasya) vā | hastamātrādadhaḥ syāttu mṛtyurjaṅghāśca bandhunām (kh: bandhamān) || 49 ||
nāpitopaskarā (mū, ṅ: pakṣavā) dduḥkhaṃ dāridryaṃ parajīvanam | jaṅghāsparśāttadasthi syādadhaścaikādaśāṅgulāt || 50 ||
(cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mū, a pustakayornāsti) tena ca syādvadhaḥ karturmṛtyuḥ paścānnasaṃkayaḥ | gulphābhyāmaścapādaḥ syādadhastvaṣṭādaśāṅgulāt || 51 ||
tenārthapaśunāśaśca pravāso duḥkhajīvitam | pādasparśādgajāsthi syātkaṇṭhaśālmalameva ca || 52 ||
dvādaśāṅgulamānāttatpravāsamṛtidaṃ kramāt | rītī (mū: sthiti) citramayo'ṅguṣṭhānmṛdā (kh, gh: khaṭī) vā barhi (mū, kh: bahi) citritā || 53 ||
ṣoḍaśāṅgulato'dhastātkramācchokeṣṭanāśanam | tryaṅgulībhirhayāsthi syādgomṛtiḥ sārdhatālataḥ || 54 ||
kāṃsyaṃ kaniṣṭhayārthaghnaṃ jñeyamaṣṭāṅgulādadhaḥ | carma pādatalādrukmaṃ bhavedaṣṭāṅgulaiḥ sadā || 55 ||
pārṣṇikaṇḍūyane tālātkapālābhre ca duḥkhade | gātrāṇāṃ sparśanādvidyānnānāśalyāni buddhimān || 56 ||
(cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭha, mūlapustake nāsti) sikatābhasmalohāsthimaṇimuktādi vāstugam | bahvaṅgasparśanānnityaṃ śalyāni vividhāni ca || 57 ||
tāni talliṅgamānena tatphalāni ca (gh: tataḥ phalāni) pūrvavat |) śālyānivikṛtaḥ kartuścatvāriṃśacca sapta ca || 58 ||
teṣu pañca śubhānyūcurdvicatvāriṃśadanyathā | khanyamāne bhuvo garte labhyante vāstuno yadi || 59 ||
hemavidrumatārāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca | maṇimuktātha (mū: muktāśca) gośṛṅgaṃ śaṅkhaśuktī sadaiva tu || 60 ||
sajīvāvatha nirjīvau bhekakūrmau śubhapradau | tadā sarvārthasiddhyarthaṃ sthāpayecchūbhra (ṅ: cchatra) madhyataḥ || 61 ||
utkhāte naramātre tu gṛhe śalyaṃ na doṣakṛt | toyāntikaṃ sthitaṃ śalyaṃ prāsāde doṣadaṃ nṛṇām || 62 ||
tasmātkhādhārikīṃ bhūmīṃ khanettoyāntikaṃ budhaḥ | kvacidrudrasahasre tu hute doṣo na jāyate || 63 ||
suradhāmasame garte bāṇaliṅgālaye śate | hute śalyairna doṣaḥ syājjānvadho (gh: dyātvadho) yāgamaṇḍape || 64 ||
vāstoḥ parigrahe cādau padasaṃsthāpane tathā | bhittinyāse viśeṣeṇa yajedvāstuṃ trikālikam || 65 ||
sadvāre śobhane lagne sadṛkṣendubale śubhe | garta (mū, gh" garbha) pramāṇataḥ samyagliptenādyānvite same || 66 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye śalyoddhāranirṇaye caturviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 24 ||
[atha pañcaviṃśaḥ]
yajamānaḥ śucirdhīraḥ sitavastravilepanaḥ | ācāryaḥ sthapatiścaiva daivajño'pi guṇānvitaḥ || 1 ||
sarvān sitāmbarānetān yajamānastu pūjayet | sthapatirviśvakarmā tu daivajño nandikeśvaraḥ || 2 ||
sa eva bhūtale vidvān śrīkaṇṭhaḥ sthāpakaḥ svayam | pūjayitvā tu tānsarvāṃstoṣayitvā kṣamāpayet || 3 ||
parikarmakarā ye'pi te'pi pūjyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ | hiraṇyavastradānena vāgbhirvā tāṃstu toṣayet || 4 ||
tataścācamya vidhivadācāryaḥ śilpibhiḥ (gh, ṅ: śilpinā) saha | yajñadravyāṇi saṃhṛtya viśedbhūmiṃ samāhitaḥ || 5 ||
uttarābhimukho bhūtvā sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ | ātmapūjāmarghapātraṃ kṛtvā dravyāṇi śodhayet || 6 ||
astrajaptaiḥ kuśairvidvānastreṇollikhya sarvataḥ | siñcayedambhasā bhūmiṃ tathā gandho (kh; gaṅgo) dakena ca || 7 ||
gandhatoyākṣatairmadhye kṛtvā vedāsramaṇḍalam | surūpāṃ pramadārūpāṃ śuddhālaṅkārabhūṣitām || 8 ||
tanmayāṃ tāṃ tridhāvasthāṃ dhyātvā saṃpūjayenmahīm | sarvadevamayaṃ vāstupuruṣaṃ tatra pūjayet || 9 ||
tato vilipya tatkṣetraṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ | ghaṭikāśaṅkuyogena nakṣatradarśanena vā || 10 ||
yatnānnirūpya daivajño viśuddhaṃ lagnamādiśet | lagnavelāvirodhena sūtraṃ bhūmau prapātayet || 11 ||
śriyā yaśovatī kāntā supriyā vimalā śivā (mū, a, kh, ṅ: śriyaḥ) | suśobhā bhānukī cetāḥ prāṅmukhyo navanāḍikāḥ || 12 ||
dhanā dhānyā (gh: dhanyā) viśālā ca sthirā drutāsavā niśā | vidrumā vibhavetyetā uttarāsyā navoditāḥ || 13 ||
aṣṭāṣṭakapadaṃ kṣetraṃ karṇasūtradvayānitam | kṛtvā yajeddharādīnāṃ nava (mū, a: bhava) tyardhaṃ divaukasām || 14 ||
padārdhe tvīśvare caiśyāṃ yajedghṛtplutākṣataiḥ | toyotpalaiśca parjanyaṃ jayaṃ piṣṭa (gh: yajeddiṣṭaṃ) patākayā || 15 ||
ratnairindraṃ raviṃ dhūmrairvitānena yajedgurum | godhūmādyairdvayoḥ satyaṃ bhṛśaṃ māṣo (gh: māṃso) danaistathā || 16 ||
vyomākhyaṃ pakṣimāṃsaiśca evaṃ prāgdiśi devatāḥ | agnyadhaḥ koṣṭhake vahniṃ (mū, g: bāhuṃ) paiṣṭakottha śruveṇa vā || 17 ||
pūṣāṇāṃ ca yajennityaṃ hemnā ca vitathaṃ dvayoḥ | kṣaudraṃ gṛhakṣatāyātha caṇakānnaṃ yamāya ca || 18 ||
gandharvāya dvayorgandhān bhṛṅgāya khagajihvikam | koṣṭhakā (gh: koṣṭhārdhe) ddakṣiṇe dadyānnīlaṃ yavaṃ mṛgāya ca || 19 ||
dadyātpitre tilānnaṃ ca nandine dantadhāvanam | sugrīvāya dvayoryāvī puṣpadantāya darbhakam || 20 ||
padmaṃ pracetase dadyādasurāya surāṃ dvayoḥ | ghṛtāmbu ketave dhānāḥ paṅkaverddhe tu (kh, gh: vetra) paścime || 21 ||
maṇḍājyaṃ vāyave tvardhaṃ nāgāya nāgakesaram | dvayoḥ khādyāni mukhyāya mudgānnaṃ yakṣapāya (mū: apūpānnaṃ kṣayāya) ca || 22 ||
somāya pāyasakṣaudre śālakaṃ liṅga (mū: mālūkaviga) yordvayoḥ | dityai lopīmadityai ca pūpā (kh, ṅ: sūpā) nardhe'tha saumyataḥ || 23 ||
āpāya ca payaḥ koṣṭha īśādhastvīśakoṇataḥ | tadadhaḥ koṣṭhake dadyādāpavatsāya vai dadhi || 24 ||
marīcaye balirdeyā catuṣpādeṣu laḍḍukaiḥ | agnyadhaḥ koṣṭhake nityaṃ sāvitryai (kh, g: savitre) ca kuśāmbhasā || 25 ||
tadadho guḍapūpādi (kh, gh: pūpāni) sāvitre'tha pradāpayet | vivasvate'ruṇāṃ dadyāccandanaṃ caturaṅghriṣu || 26 ||
rakṣo'dhaḥ koṇakoṣṭhe tu indrāyānnaṃ niśānvitam | indrajayāya tasyādho ghṛtānnaṃ koṇakoṣṭhake || 27 ||
catuṣpade pra (kh, gh: ṣpadeṣu) dātavyaṃ mitrāya guḍapāyasam | vāṭvadhaḥ koṇadeśe tu rudrāya pakṣimāṃsakam || 28 ||
tadadhaḥ koṇakoṣṭhe tu yakṣāyārdraṃ palaṃ tathā | mahīdharāyamāṣānnaṃ samāṃsaṃ caturaṅghriṣu || 29 ||
madhye catuṣpadasthāya brahmaṇe tilataṇḍulāḥ | etānvastrādibhiśceṣṭvā tato rakṣo'ṣṭakaṃ kramāt || 30 ||
gartādbahiratheśādau yajedrakṣo'ṣṭakaṃ budhaḥ | carakīṃ māṃsasarpibhyāṃ skandaṃ kṛsarapāyasam (mū, gh: yāsṛjā) || 31 ||
raktapadmairvidārīṃ (gh: viḍālīṃ) ca kandarpaṃ ca palodanaiḥ | pūtanāṃ palapittābhyāṃ māṃsāsṛgbhyāṃ ca jambhakam || 32 ||
pittāsṛgasthibhiḥ pāpaṃ pilipicchaṃ srajāsṛjā (kh, ṅ: sṛjāsṛjā) | rakṣomātṛgaṇeśebhyaḥ piśācādi eva ca || 33 ||
pitṛbhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyo baliṃ dadyātprakāmataḥ | abhāvādbhaktamāṃsena (kh, ṅ: bhakṣamāṣeṇa) etānājyākṣatena vā || 34 ||
lājairaśāṭhyato (kh: sādhyato) vāpi kuśapuṣpeṇa vā yajet | asantarpyāpyaniṣṭvaitān prāsādādīnnakārayet || 35 ||
aniṣpattivināśābhyāmubhayordharmadharmiṇoḥ | purotpanno mahāvīryaḥ sarvabhūtabhayāvahaḥ || 36 ||
devairyo nihito (g, gh: nihate) bhūmau sa vāstupuruṣo mataḥ | yāvadūrvīsthirā loke tāvadvāstunaraḥ sthitaḥ || 37 ||
saṃhāre tu layaṃ yāti devairgrahādibhiḥ saha | sarveṣu vāstukāryeṣu pūjayedvāstunāyakam || 38 ||
tenāsau vartate nityaṃ tadupāyaḥ śivājñayā | vistāro'sya samantācca śatakoṭistu yojanaiḥ || 39 ||
sthitaḥ kṣmāmakhilāṃ vyāpya yajetsaṅkalpya tattanum | īśakoṇe śirastasya aṃśo bāhuśca pūrvataḥ || 40 ||
kūrparo jānumāgneye yāmye jaṅghāṅghrirākṣase | upabāhūruhastaśca pārśvaścaivāgnideśataḥ || 41 ||
evamevāpasavye syātsomānilāmbunair(-)ṛte | caturasrasthistvevaṃ vāstunātho mahītale || 42 ||
yadākāraṃ bhavetkṣetramuttānaṃ sa tadākṛtiḥ | kuḍyādirohaṇe kāle mūrdhādīni na pīḍayet || 43 ||
īśarakṣaḥ sthitaṃ sūtraṃ mūrdhānaṃ tasya lakṣayet | jalādindro gaṇā (kh, g: galā) darkaḥ sugrīvātsatyago mataḥ || 44 ||
bhaumātsomo yamādbhallo gandharvācca bṛhaspatiḥ | etadvaṃśa (mū, a: ttvaṃśa) gatā nāḍya upavaṃśagatāsvimāḥ || 45 ||
gṛhakṣatājjalādhyakṣo gaṇottamānniśākaraḥ | bhallāṭādbhāskaraṃ yāvanmahendrādyamadevatā || 46 ||
upavaṃśagatā nāḍyo devasthitirathocyate | mūrdhni ceśāditī nityamāpodityau ca netrayoḥ || 47 ||
āpākhyo vaktradeśasthastvāpavatso gale tathā | jayo giristardaśasyau somādyāḥ pañca bāhugāḥ || 48 ||
vāme cendrādayaḥ pañca rudro yakṣopabāhugau | sāvitrī savitā tadvadupabāhau karau hṛdi || 49 ||
dharādharo marīciśca stanayorubhayorapi | nābhau brahmā sthito nityaṃ pārśvayorjaṭhareṣu (mū, a, ṅ: jaṭharasya) ca || 50 ||
sthitau mitravivasvantau vāstorindrajayo gude | śephasīndrasuhṛtkhyātaḥ pāpādyāḥ sapta paṅktigāḥ (mū, a: pañjikāḥ) || 51 ||
jānvādijaṅghayoḥ sarve brahmādyāḥ sapta dakṣiṇāḥ | pitumṛśau (mṛgau) ca (mū: pivyamṛṣiśca) pādasthau ityuktā (mū: ityetā) vāstudevatā || 52 ||
kathyante tvadhunā vāstormarmopamarmasandhayaḥ | mūrdhāsyahṛtstanaunābhirmahāmarmāṇi pañca ca || 53 ||
pādamadhyopamarmāṇi śeṣarekhāstu sandhayaḥ | vaṃśopavaṃśarekhāḥ syuḥ śūlaṣaṭkamathāśaniḥ || 54 ||
catukaṃ ca catuṣkoṇe laṅgūlaṃ ca padordhvataḥ | īśāgnipitaro vāyuḥ sadā śūleṣvavasthitāḥ || 55 ||
āpavatso'tha sāvitrī jayadāsaścatuṣkagāḥ (gh: catuṣṭagā) | biddhe marmaṇi mṛtyuḥ syātputrāṇāmupamarmaṇi || 56 ||
sandhau mitrārtha (kh: mitrāṇi) hāniśca vaṃśe vaṃśakṣayastathā | upavaṃśe bhavetpīḍā garbhanāśastriśūlake || 57 ||
ṣaṭke ca bahuvairitvaṃ catuṣke vāhanakṣayaḥ | lāṅgūle ca śirorogaṃ devavedheṣu pīḍanam || 58 ||
mūrdhni karturvināśaḥ syāttasmādetān vivartayet | padātṣoḍaśabhāgena śiromānamihoditam || 59 ||
arkadigvasubhāgaiśca vaṃśādīnāṃ bhavetkramāt | sthūlamānamidaṃ proktaṃ sūkṣmamānamihocyate || 60 ||
ekāṅgulaṃ samārabhya tvekaikayavahānitaḥ | somataḥ pūrvato vāpi sūtrasañcālanātkamāt || 61 ||
kuḍyastambhādivinyāse vedhadoṣo na jāyate | jñānato'jñānato vāpi marmavedho yadā bhavet || 62 ||
aghoraśatahomena tadā śāntiḥ prajāyate | ityuktā vāstupūjātra gṛhaprāsādayoḥ sadā || 63 ||
īśaśceśānarudro'sau parjanyo meghanāyakaḥ | tvaṣṭuḥ suto jayantākhyo mahendro devanāyakaḥ || 64 ||
sūryaścāditiputraśca satyo dharmādhipo mahān | vṛṣaḥ skando (kh; nṛpaskandho; g: bhṛśa. skando) nabho vyoma vahni (gh, ṅ: tvagni) rvaiśvānaro mataḥ || 65 ||
pūṣā (mū, a, gh: pūrvā; kh: prathā) tu pṛṣadevastu dadhīcirvitathastathā | gṛhakṣataḥ kujaḥ (g: kajaḥ) khyāto yamaḥ kālaśca rocanaḥ (gh: ścarācare) || 66 ||
viśvāvasuśca gandharvo bhṛṅgīśo durbalo gaṇaḥ | mṛgaḥ (mū, a, g, gh: yamaḥ) svasā mṛṣā tṛṣṇā pitā syādrākṣasādhipaḥ || 67 ||
dauvārikaḥ smṛto nandī sugrīvaścaṇḍabhairavaḥ | puṣpadanto gaṇaśreṣṭho varuṇaśca jalādhipaḥ || 68 ||
daityāmātyo bhavecchukraḥ śoṣaḥ keturudāhṛtaḥ | pāpo manda iti khyāto vego vāpuśca kīrtitaḥ || 69 ||
nāgaśca vāsukiḥ prokto mukhyanāmā bṛhaspatiḥ | bhallāṭo yakṣarājāsau somaścandro'mṛtātmakaḥ || 70 ||
samākhya (kh, gh: ṛgākhyaḥ) śvarako vaidyaḥ suramātā (gh: surāmbā cā) ditirbhavet | daityamātā ditiścoktā āpaścaiva himācalaḥ || 71 ||
āpavatsa umādevī marīcī brahmajottamaḥ | savitā cāparo hyarkaḥ sāvitrī brahmapatnikā || 72 ||
vivasvānaryamā khyāta indrasuhṛdupendrakaḥ | indrajidrakṣasaḥ (mū: indradāsaḥ) putro mitro bhānustṛtīyakaḥ || 73 ||
rudradāsaḥ pracāṇḍākhyo yakṣmākhyaḥ somarudrakaḥ | dharādharo hyanantaḥ syādbrahmā caturmukho mataḥ || 74 ||
paryāyo'yaṃ murāṇāṃ tu yaḥ proktaḥ pārameśvare | so'trokto na (gh, ṅ: sotroktena) ca rakṣādyāḥ pūrvoktāste hi (kh, ṅ: te'pi) rākṣasā || 75 ||
kādihāntairdha (gh: ntordhva) rārūḍhairbinduyuktairharādiśān | āpādīllokamātrastairyajedbrahmadhruveṇa (gh: sthairjaye-) ca || 76 ||
dīrghāṣṭakaika (gh, ṅ: kaikṣlāṃ) bindvāḍhyaiścarakyādyāṃśca rākṣasān | praṇavādinamo'ntaistānsvāhāntānbalikarmaṇi || 77 ||
pādone (kh, ṅ: pādena) pūrite khāte padamādau nyasetkvacit | na kevaleṣṭakāśmādyai kevalaiścalanaṃ yataḥ || 78 ||
bhūkampānmārutādvatha vātaśaṅkābhayaṃ bhavet | mṛdvāluke (mū: ddaruke) ṣṭakāśmābhi prāktasmātpūrayecca tat || 79 ||
mṛdāṣṭāṅgulayāpūrya hastān pūrāśmabhistataḥ | ambhasāplāvya vākocya (gh: koṭya; kh, g, ṅ: vākopya) hastipādaistu yājñikaiḥ || 80 ||
dairghyāttrivedavasvaṃśairvyāsa (mū: vyoma) dalāvaṭaṃ kramāt | kapūrṇaśakaṭānkuryātsamorvī (ṅ: samauṣvī) sūtrakāṣṭhakaiḥ || 81 ||
nītvā pādonnatā tacca (mū: nnatātvaṃ) tato vāstuṃ yajetpunaḥ | samopaliptake śvabhre taddvārāgre ca maṇḍape || 82 ||
kadalīcūtamālāḍhye toraṇadhvajaśobhite | vidhinā hemavastrādyairgurvādīnsudine yajet || 83 ||
śivakumbhāstra (mū, ṅ: mbhāstu) dikkumbhāṃstanmadhye sthāṇḍilaṃ tathā | śivamiṣṭvā tato havyamiṣṭakuṇḍe (gh: muktakuṇḍe) yathāvidhiḥ || 84 ||
vāstudevāṃstathāghoraṃ pāśupataṃ ca homayet | sadrātnoṣadhayo dhātubrīhipāradasaṃyutān || 85 ||
vastrakaṇṭhānvitān kumbhānnyaseddhemādikān kramāt | (cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mū, a, g, gh pustakeṣu nāsti) anantaṃ madhyato nyasya nidhīṃścāṣṭau tataḥ kramāt) || 86 ||
caturo'gnyādikoṇeṣu aindrādau (mū: aindryādau) caturo'parān | padmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathā || 87 ||
mukundanandanolāṃśca śaṅkhaṃ cetyaṣṭa vai nidhin | oṃ kārādyānnamo'ntāṃśca madhyaścāntān yathākramān || 88 ||
nyasedgururnidhīnetān punastāṃścalayenna tu | nyasya (nyastvā li0 pu0 pā0) śilāṣṭake devān kvacidaṣṭa (mū: diṣṭa) tanuṃ śivam || 89 ||
kumbhāṣṭake nidhīśāṃśca sannirudhya (kh: ruddha) padaṃ nyaset | naveṣṭakā (mū: na ceṣṭakā) śilā vāpi koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramāt || 90 ||
siṃhāṅkitāścatasraśca dharmādyaṅghryādikānnyaset | tatrānyāḥ pañca padmāṅkāstāsvekā (mū: dyekā) madhyadeśataḥ || 91 ||
ādhāraśaktisaṃjñāśca dharmādyānprāgdiśāditaḥ | śarvādyā bhīmaparyantāḥ śilāṣṭakeṣu devatā || 92 ||
svanāmādyarṇa (mū, ṅ: varṇa) mantraiśca snānapūjādipūrvakān | pītatvāntāṅghrirūpāṃśca dharmādyāṃśca (gh: rmādisyā) vṛṣādikān || 93 ||
sthiramāsanamadhvānaṃ (gh: madbāṇaṃ) dhyātvā sragbhiḥ prakalpayet | anyatroktāḥ kvacitkumbhāḥ śilāścāpyatha pañca ca || 94 ||
nyaset prāṅmadhyato'śmānaṃ (kh: manāt) tataścāgnyādi koṇataḥ | padmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ makaraṃ kacchapaṃ tathā || 95 ||
śaṅkhaṃ ca pañcamaṃ ceha (kh, ṅ: caiva) svasaṃjñābhirnidhīnnyaset | prāsādaṃ sūtrayitvā tu kuṃḍyavistaramadhyataḥ || 96 ||
karṇasūtrasame sthāne śilānyāsavidhirmataḥ | caturasrāḥ śilāḥ kāryāḥ samantātkarasammitāḥ || 97 ||
vistarasya (kh: rastu) tribhāgena bāhulyena samucchritāḥ (kh: samucchritā) | aiṣṭakāstvaiṣṭake kāryāḥ śaile śailāḥ śilāḥ śubhāḥ || 98 ||
nandā bhadrā jayā riktā pūrṇākhyā pañcamī matā | akṣatairvedikāṃ kṛtvā (mū, a, kh: vedikā kāryā) tasyordhve viniveśitāḥ || 99 ||
āgnepyādiṣu koṇeṣu nandādyā avatārayet (kh: tānayet) | tūryamaṅgalanirghoṣairnimittaiḥ śobhanaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 100 ||
prathamaṃ sthāpayennandāṃ śarīraviṣuveṇa tu | anyāḥ krameṇa nyastavyāḥ svadiksthā mantriṇā tataḥ || 101 ||
samakarṇāḥ sthirāḥ kṛtvā snāpyāḥ pūjyāḥ krameṇa tu | astratoyena prathamaṃ mṛttikādyaiḥ punastu taiḥ || 102 ||
snāpayitvā śilāstāstu hemavarṇāḥ śuśobhanāḥ | vidyārūpāstu tā dhyātvā parituṣṭāḥ smitānanāḥ || 103 ||
āvāhya sthāpayenmantrī vidhinā mantravāriṇā | sudṛḍhai (g: suvṛtaiḥ) mṛnmayaiḥkumbhairvittāḍhyairhemanirmitaiḥ || 104 ||
vastreṇa toyamuddhṛtya candanena vilepayet | vastrādyaiḥ (mū, a, kh, g, ṅ: vastrādi) pūjanaṃ kṛtvā naivedyaṃ sannivedayet | kṛtvaitannāmamantreṇa śilāṃ mantrī (gh: mantraiḥ) prasādhayet || 105 ||
oṃ nande nandinī pusāṃ tvāmatra sthāpayāmyaham | atra tvaṃ tiṣṭha saṃhṛṣṭā yāvadācandratārakam || 106 ||
āyuḥ kāmaṃ śriyaṃ nande dehi tvaṃ sarvadā nṛṇām | asmin rakṣā sadā kāryā prāsāde yatnatastvayā || 107 ||
oṃ bhadre sarvadā bhadraṃ puṃsāṃ hitāvahā sadā | āyurdā kāmadā devi śrīpradā sarvadā (kh: svāminaḥ śrīpadā) bhava || 108 ||
oṃ jaye sarvadā hyatra tiṣṭha tvaṃ sthāpitā mayā | nityaṃ jayāvahā devi svāmini śrīpradā bhava || 109 ||
oṃ rikte riktadoṣaghne siddhimuktiprade śubhe | sarvadā sarvadoṣaghne tiṣṭhatvamīśarūpake || 110 ||
oṃ pūrṇe tvaṃ mahāvidye sarvasandohalakṣaṇe | sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇamevātra prāsāde kuru sarvadā || 111 ||
teṣāmupari vinyasyāḥ śilāḥ pañca krameṇa tu | śivājñayā niropyāstu (mū, a, g, ṅ: nobodhyāstu) nandādyā liṅgavatsadā || 112 ||
evaṃ prasādya nandādyā madhye kūrmaṃ yajetsudhīḥ | kāryoṃ'smin kumbhavinyāse śivavinyāsavadvidhiḥ || 113 ||
ratnalohastathā dhātubījauṣadhisapāradaiḥ | kṣiptvaivaṃ kumbhagarbheṣvaṣṭau vā pañca (gh: kumbha) nidhīnnyaset || 114 ||
nyastavyādhāraśaktiśca śilāsūpari (kh, ṅ: mupari) pūrvavat | sādhidevāśca (kh: so'pi devo'pi) buddhyantaṃ pīṭhabandhā (mū: vasma) vasānataḥ (?) || 115 ||
kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ rātrau datvā digrakṣasāṃ balim | gurvādibhyo'śanaṃ dānaṃ datvā kāryopajaṅghikā || 116 ||
śikharārdhātpṛthustryaṃśāccopajaṅghoṃttamocchrayaḥ | madhyamo'ṅghrivihīnastu jyeṣṭhārdhenādhamo mataḥ (kh: nārdhamānataḥ) || 117 ||
brahmopendrārkadevānāṃ bhavejjyeṣṭhopajaṅghikā | aghamā cetareṣāṃ tu śivasya tu yathecchayā || 118 ||
madhye śvabhraṃ parityajya liṅgārdhaṃ viṣṇuvistaram | śilā kūrmādikāryāya paritaḥ saṃprapūrayet || 119 ||
pīṭhamadhye site padme'rkasurā (gh: svarā) dyarṇabheditaiḥ | mūrtimūlāṅgabhūte ca dhyātvā vāstuṃ yajetpunaḥ || 120 ||
samopajaṅghikāṃ kṛtvā jagatīyāvadeva hi | tūryamaṅgalaśabdena prāsādaṃ tatra sūtrayet || 121 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye vāstupūjāpadasaṃsthāpanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 25 ||
[atha ṣaḍviṃśaḥ]
tridvyaṣṭartu (mū, a, ṅ: tryeddhetuṃ; kh: tryavīvṛtta; gh: tryarthatu) guṇaḥ syuśca prāsādā liṅga (kh, ṅ: dālliṅga) mānataḥ | ardhena liṅgadairghyeṇa bhittayo vistṛtāḥ kramāt || 1 ||
ṣoḍaśāṅghrau (gh: śāṃśī) kṛte kṣetre vedāṃśairgarbhamadhyataḥ | tadaṃśatulyavīthyastu syurarkāṃśaistu bhittayaḥ || 2 ||
pañcaviṃśatikāṅghrau vā madhyaikāṃśena piṇḍikā | tadgarbho'ṣṭābhiraṃśaiḥ syādvikārāṃśaistu bhittayaḥ || 3 ||
miśrārcāvyaktaliṅgānāṃ tridvisārdhadvi (kh: sārdhāṅghri) bhāgikaiḥ | kaniṣṭhādikramādgarbhaḥ kvacidbhittestu vardhanam || 4 ||
ṣaḍviṃśa (kh, gh: triṃśa) tpadaviṣkambho viṃśatyaṃśaistu bhittayaḥ | garbhavyomasya cārkeṇa pīṭhī madhye yugāṃśataḥ || 5 ||
bhittivistaramānena liṅgaṃ dairghyeṃ (kh, g: : liṅgadairghyaṃ) bhavetkvacit | dviguṇaṃ tat kvacitproktaṃ prāsāde rasabhājite || 6 ||
dhāmatulyātha pādonā cārdhena jagatī tridhā | jyeṣṭhādyā nirgamā jñeyā nemī tatpādavarjitā || 7 ||
sa jagatyā paraṃ (kh, gh: tyātparaṃ) chandaṃ kramaḥ (gh: brūmaḥ) ṣaṭtriṃśa (kh, gh, ṅ: viṃśa) daṃśakaiḥ | yugāṅghrermadhyato garbhaḥ syāttadekena piṇḍikā || 8 ||
ravibhāgena kuḍyāni bhramāṇāttu nakhāṃśakaiḥ | aṣṭāviṃśatibhirbhittiḥ sā syāt stambhakumārikā || 9 ||
dṛḍhāsāraiścaturdikṣu maṇḍapastriṃśadaṃśakaiḥ | catuḥ stāmbhāśca tanmadhye dvādaśa syuḥ kumārikāḥ || 10 ||
tisrastisrastu koṇeṣu stambhau cāgre kumārike | pārśvayo ragratā vāpi kuryādāsārasaṃyute || 11 ||
sabhittiḥ koṇabhittirvā tvabhittirapi cāparaḥ | sakoṇastambhasaṃyukto maṇḍapaśca tridhā mataḥ || 12 ||
tadvaccatuṣkikāḥ (tuṣṭikā li0 pu0 pā0) kāryāḥ pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhatastridhā | dvādalāṃśaistu tān sarvān prāsāde cottamodike || 13 ||
ṣaḍbhāgau rathakaṃ madhyaṃ tribhiścoparathau tathā | vedairanu (gh: stanu) rathau kuryādbhūtaikena (kh: bhūtakoṇaiḥ) tathānyataḥ || 14 ||
madhyādekadvirāmāṃśaiḥ pravelātparitaḥ kramāt | jagatīmaṃśato dhṛtvāveṣṭanāṃśaṃ tu lopayet || 15 ||
rasāṃśairbalabhī sthāpyā caturdikṣu ca madhyataḥ | vidikṣu koṇadhāmāni vasvaṃśairmaṇḍapaiḥ saha || 16 ||
bhāgaikaṃbāhyato datvā (g: dadyāt) śeṣamadhyāṃśakān bhavet (kh, g: haret) | samasūtrāṅkake chede samabhāgādvivartayet || 17 ||
jagatyā bhramaṇāyāśca maṇḍapasya ca bhittiṣu | cāru surālayastambhabalabhīśikharāṇi ca || 18 ||
kuḍyaṃ (kh: kuṭāśca) ca puṣkaraṃ caiva rūpakaṃ patravallikām | taddevasya kuthaṃ (mū, a, g, gh: kathāṃ) vāpi ghaṭayeyuḥ śuśilpinaḥ || 19 ||
jñātvā jñātvā ca tadbhagānamuktān vṛddhibhittibhiḥ | vāstumānamiti khyātaṃ liṅgamānamathocyate || 20 ||
liṅgadviguṇito garbhastadardhānmadhya āsanam | pīṭhārdhāṃśa (mū: rdhācca) tadaṃśābhyāṃ dvābhittyośca vistaraḥ || 21 ||
bhitteryoṃ vistaro bāhyajaṅghātantusamucchritā | mañjarī tu dvibhāgābhyāṃ mañjaryardhena nāsikā || 22 ||
nāsikārdhaṃ (gh: kordhvaṃ) tu yaccārdhaṃ tena skandho bhavetsadā | pañcāṃśaistatpṛthutvaṃ ca tathordhvastryaṃśakairgalaḥ || 23 ||
kapolāmalasārau ca bhāgārdhārdhavinirgamau | tryaṃśa (gh: dvyaṃśā) rdhāṃśadvibhāgārdhaiḥ kramādgrīvādikocchrayaḥ || 24 ||
kapolaṃ vedikātulyamīśāno liṅgamānataḥ | dhāmārdhātbhramaṇa kāryā tadardhena ca bhittayaḥ || 25 ||
pradakṣiṇāgrato dhāmno dviguṇo maṇḍapaḥ sadā | maṇḍapārdhapramāṇena purato mukhamaṇḍapaḥ || 26 ||
mukhākhyamaṇḍapārdhena karaṇīyā catuṣkikā | catuṣkikāgrato nityaṃ jagatī dhāmamānataḥ || 27 ||
jagatyardhapramāṇena koṇadhāmāni (gh: dhāmādi) vartayet | tatsamā balabhī diksthāḥ svamānamaṇḍapānvitāḥ || 28 ||
tatropajaṅghikārdhe (kh, gh: kordhve) tu padapīṭhaṃ vivartayet | prāsādaturyabhāgena tryaṃśairvā tatsamucchrayam || 29 ||
ṣaḍaṅgā (gh: ṣaḍaṃśā) dhikadhāmnastu vistārastasya kathyate | taducchrayaṃ haraṃ kṛtvā sādhāṃśe khura (gh: kṣura) paṭṭikā || 30 ||
sāṅghridvābhyāṃ bhavetkumbhaḥ pādena kumbhapaṭṭikā | dvibhāgābhyāṃ bhave (gh: tathā) tkaṇṭhastadagreṃ (gh: ṣaḍ) 'śaṃguṇaṃ bhavet || 31 ||
ekena galapaṭṭī syād dvitīye valitāṅkikā (kh, gh: ṅkitā) | tṛtīyenopapaṭṭī tu tapāṃśā (kh: tathāṅgā) ccaturasrikā || 32 ||
pādonāṃśena haṃsākhyā tatpādenārdha (gh: nordhva) paṭṭikā | taddhyaṃśamaṣṭadhā kṛtvā taiśca padmaṃ vivartayet || 33 ||
ekāṃśena praveśaḥ syāt ṣaḍaṃśe (gh: ṣaḍaṅge) nāravindakam | karṇikā śaśibhāgena vistārāccādhunocyate || 34 ||
jinīkṛte tu pīṭhārdhe madhthe rathakamaṣṭabhiḥ | tanmadhye tu dvibhāgābhyāṃ praveśo gṛha (g: graha) hetave || 35 ||
praveśaḥ punaraṃśe ca madhyasthe rathake sadā | evameva tu jaṅghāyāmañjaryā vedikāvadhiḥ || 36 ||
jaṅghikāmūlamadhye tu (kh: madhyeṣu) balabhīṃ vartayecchubhām | prāsādaśikharaṃ vāpi brūyāmuparathādikān || 37 ||
nagairuparathaṃ kuryānnavāṃśaiḥ koṇabandhanam | pīṭhādyabjāntamucchrāye praveśaśca nigadyate || 38 ||
khurapraveśamardhena kumbhamekāṃśatastathā | ardhena paṭṭikāṃ kuryāddvābhyāṃ kaṇṭhapraveśakam || 39 ||
kaṇṭhapraveśa (kh, ṅ: paṭṭārdha) śaniṣkāsā tathā balitapaṭṭikā | ardhāṃśena tadūrdhve tu kāryā caivopapaṭṭikā || 40 ||
tatsamā nirgamenāpi paṭṭikā caturasrikā | tryāṅghripraveśo haṃsa (gh: dvyaṃśa) statpaṭṭyardhapraveśataḥ || 41 ||
nirgamāṃśena (kh: māṅgena) padmasya prāksārdhāṃśapraveśanam | sandhipatrānvitaṃ (kh: ṅkita) padmaṃ vidadhīta suśobhanam || 42 ||
ardhāṃśaveśanāddhāma karṇikoparisasthitam | śilotthaṃ padapīṭhaṃ syādevaṃ dārviṣṭakāmaye || 43 ||
pṛṣṭhārdhadviguṇā jaṅghā jaṅghādviguṇamañjarī | taducchrayaṃ grahaṃ kṛtvā jaṅghā tanmadhyato guṇaiḥ || 44 ||
rasāṃśarmañjarī kāryā tadardhācchukanāsikā | vedibandhavaraṇḍā (mū, a: vavaṇḍā) dinnigadāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || 45 ||
jaṅghikārdhapṛthau sārdhajināṃśairdhāṃśakairbahiḥ | ucchraye dhāmaturyāṃśāttasminnidrāṃśakekṛte || 46 ||
taddvyaṃ (mū, a: tardhye) śābhyāṃ ca kurvīta paṭṭikāṃ caturasrikām | sārdhatrayeṇa kumbhaḥ syāttadardhe kumbhapaṭṭikā || 47 ||
ṛtubhāgātmakaṃ caitatkathitaṃ khurasaṃjñakam (gh: saṃjñitam) | bhāgārdhena tu kaṇṭhaḥ syātkalaśaśca guṇāṃśataḥ || 48 ||
tatpaṭṭikārdhabhāgena vedāṃśaḥ (gh: vedāṃśaiḥ) kalaśo varaḥ | praveśāccaikataḥ kaṇṭhāścārdhe (mū: sārdhe) nirgamapaṭṭikā || 49 ||
caturasrāṃśataḥ paṭṭī kumbhasya pādacendrataḥ (kh: candrataḥ) | kumbhapaṭṭī tu pādena kupālyā dyaṃśataḥ sthitā || 50 ||
evaṃ vivartayeyuśca śilpinaḥ śāstravittamāḥ | tribhiḥ khurādibhiryuktaṃ vedībandhābhidhānakam || 51 ||
vedībandhacaturthāṃśādbadurmiḥ (?) (g: dudvartiḥ) syāttadūrdhnataḥ | kṛteṣu triṣu bhāgeṣu pādonāṃśātpraveśikān || 52 ||
pādānnirgamapaṭṭī ca kumbhanirgamabhāgataḥ | bhāgena caturasrākhyā paṭṭikā sārdhataḥ sthitā || 53 ||
eṃko dvābhyāṃ sapaṭṭiḥ syādbāhyatryaṃśapraveśataḥ | khuṃrakumbhavatī jaṅghā jyeṣṭhānāṃ pādamānataḥ || 54 ||
dhāmārkāṃśācca jaṅghordhve (kh: jaṅghārdhaṃ) kartavyā lambinī budhaiḥ | yāvaccinnavakāṃ vāpi patravalyāthavā varā || 55 ||
tilakāntaraśobhāḍhyā muktāhārāvalīyutā | caturthāṃśaśca jaṅghordhve vibhajya vasubhāgataḥ || 56 ||
dhṛtvaikaṃ sadadhaḥ paścannavaghā tattu kārayet | tatrārdhena praveśākhyaṃ paṭṭikāṃ tu vi (kh: bhuvi) vartayet || 57 ||
tathā niṣkāśikārdhena bhāgena caturastrikā | pādonāṃśena haṃsākhyā (kh; hastākhyā) paṭṭī tatpadato bhavet || 58 ||
tribhirbhāgairvaraṇḍākhyā kaṇṭhapaṭṭītu bhāgataḥ | tatpaṭṭī pādataḥ kāryā pādonāṃśena nirgamā || 59 ||
tatra trikaṭapaṭṭī syāt tryaṃśairvedāsrikāṃśataḥ | bhāgamekaṃ tridhā kṛtvā praveśaścaika bhāgataḥ || 60 ||
kaṇṭhasūtraḥ samaḥkāryo dvitīye nirgamā tathā | paṭṭikā tu prakartavyā dvitīyenopanirgamā || 61 ||
balitaṃ dvyaṃśapādonātpādāttatpaṭṭikā bhavet | balitāhvaṃ tribhi (kh: ṅkāstribhi) rbhāgairgrahāṃśaistu kaṭirbhavet || 62 ||
eko bhāgo rasāṃśaistu tatrakaṇṭho dvibhāgataḥ | kaṇṭhasūtrādviśetkaṭho bhāgāttatpaṭṭikordhvaḥ (mū: kārdhataḥ) || 63 ||
bhāgena haṃsaniṣkāśo dvibhāge caturasrikā | bhūmerjaṅghānitambau ca kīrtitau tvaṣṭṭa śāstrataḥ || 64 ||
vasubhāgāgrapādaṃ tu vedyardhāṃśaṃ (g: rdhaṃ sa) prakalpayet | tadadhaḥ sārdhapakṣāṃśaṃ vistāreṇa tu kārayet || 65 ||
tatra sārdhāṃśataḥ skandha taccheṣaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśakam (kh: śātmakam) | vedyāḥ kaṭyāśca madhyāṃśā (kh: dhyāṅgā) ccaturaḥ pādavarjitān || 66 ||
kṛtvā (mū: hatvā) vikārabhāgāṃśca kaṭyūrdhvaṃ skandhakāvadhiḥ | ekaikena tu bhāgega viśetkaṇṭhaka (kh, ṅ: kaṃ kaṇṭha) sūtrataḥ || 67 ||
koṇapiṇḍyādi (mū, gh: piṇḍyahi) vistārānnavamenodakāntaram | bhavedanurathaḥ ṣadbhiḥ saptamenodakāntaram || 68 ||
madhyarathordhvamaṣṭāṃśairevaṃ vidyājjināṃśakaiḥ | bhūḥ (mū, ṅ: bhūḥ) kaṭiskandhayormadhye pañcātriṃśadbhirābhajet || 69 ||
navāṃśaiścocchritā prāgbhūḥ śeṣāstvekaikahānitaḥ | koṇānurathakādīnāṃ vṛttapraveśa ucyate || 70 ||
pratyekaṃ (mū, gh: patraikaṃ) bhūmikāveśo bāhyārdhena bhavetsadā | tadvaccaturthabhāgena praveśo'nurathasya ca || 71 ||
evaṃ saṅkocayet (g: ṅkāraye) prājño madhyasthaṃ rathakaṃ sadā | luptvā bhāgān bhuvāṃ svāṃ svāṃ sarvāsāṃ ca yathākramam || 72 ||
kṛtvendrāṃśāttato bhūmiṃ prathamāṃ vartayedbudhaḥ | pādonadvyaṃśataḥ kumbhastatpaṭṭī pādato bhavet || 73 ||
kaṇṭhārdhena tathā paṭṭī pārśvayorubhayorapi | pādonadyaṃśato madhye puṭākhyaṃ vṛttagarbhakam (kh, ṅ: gartakam) || 74 ||
tadgarbhapārśvayostryaṃśādantahayau ca kīrtite (kh, gh, ṅ: kirtyate) | kumbhopame ca te kārye churikāpakṣayostathā || 75 ||
vedāsrā paṭṭikā kāryā pādahīnā tu kumbhikā | pādena kumbhapaṭṭī tu cārdhena galapaṭṭikā || 76 ||
kaṇṭhapadmārdhato jñeyā bhāgena caturasrikā (mū: raṣṭikā) | kumbhārdhena tathā paṭṭī kaṇṭhastatpaṭṭīkārdhataḥ || 77 ||
ṣaḍbhāgeṣvevamevaṃ tu vartayetkoṇayoḥ sudhīḥ | pādonadvyaṃśato madhye puṭaśvabhraṃ vivartayet (mū, ṅ: varjayet ) || 78 ||
pārśvayormekhale vṛtte tryaṃśaiḥ (g: dvyaṃśai) pūrṇenduśālikām | trikaṇṭhakocchrayaṃ dvābhyāṃ pakṣayostatra vartayet || 79 ||
candraśālāyamadhyordhveṃ tryaṃśaiḥ śikharikā tathā | aṅghrī tad (mū: aṅghrīna; gh: adyūbha) dvyaṃśato madhyaṃ (gh: mastaṃ) lavalīphalavadbhavet || 80 ||
tanmūrdhni cāṅghriṇā paṭṭī praveśaḥ paṭṭikārdhataḥ | nirgamākhyā parāṃśena (gh: parārdhena) caturasrāṃśato bhavet || 81 ||
kumbhapaṭṭīṃ ca bhāgārdhādbhāgārdhārdhena (mū: rdhe pra) sādhayet | tanmadhye tilakaṃ kāryamevaṃ tryaṃśairvaraṇḍikā || 82 ||
evaṃ manvaṃśataḥ prāgbhūścatasro'nyāstithikramāt | rūpaṃ koṇarathasyaivaṃ vakṣye coparathaṃ tvataḥ || 83 ||
ṣaṣṭibhāgocchrayaṃ kṛtvā tatrāṃśāścaturasrikā | kumbhaikenārdhataḥ paṭṭī kaṇṭhaścārdhāṃśatastathā || 84 ||
bhāgamekaṃ tridhā kṛtvā kaṇṭhapaṭṭyaṃśato bhavet | vṛttapaṭṭī ca niṣkrāntā bhāgabhāgena kalpayet || 85 ||
tadvatpārśve ca niṣpādyaṃ śikharīmadhyadeśataḥ | aṃśe gartālakaṃ tajña tatpārśvayorguṇāṃśataḥ || 86 ||
vijñeyā tuharī prājñairbhāgocchrayā śikharyatha | ūrdhvādhastilakākrāntā madhyasthānordhvataḥ sthitā || 87 ||
pārśvayośca tuharyāstu kartavye vedikārike | caturbhāgaiścaturbhāgaiḥ śeṣānyāścandraśālikā || 88 ||
tisṛbhi (kh, ṅ: triṃśati) stisṛbhiḥ kāryoḥ samucchrāyo mahīkramāt | evaṃ pañcadaśākhyātāḥ pañcabhūmīnduśālikāḥ || 89 ||
madhyarathaka (kh: madhye rathasya) vistāraṃ sārdharamāṃśakairbhajet | sārdhena madhyatastatra rathakārdhaṃ samudgatas || 90 ||
rathārdhabhāgaveśena dvyaṃśataḥ pārśvatastathā (mū: sadā) | ṣaṣṭibhāgasamucchāyaṃ kuryādardhenduśālikām || 91 ||
tatraikāṃśena vedāsrā kumbhākhyāścaikabhāgataḥ | kumbhapaṭṭīṃ tathā kaṇṭhamardhena parikalpayet || 92 ||
dvidhā vibhajya bhāgaikaṃ kaṇṭhapaṭṭyatha kumbhikā (gh: vṛttikā) | (cāpacihnāntargato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ mū, a, kh pustakeṣu nāstu) caturasrā tathā kāryā bhāgabhāgena nirmitā || 93 ||
tatra madhye puṭārdhaṃ syātpādona dvyaṃśamucchritam | khaneśca tilakopetaṃ tadbāhye'rdhenduśālikā || 94 ||
vṛttarūpā tu sā kāryā sārdhadvābhyāṃ samucchritā |) tanmadhye śikharī dvyaṃśā ucchritātimanoramā || 95 ||
pārśve trikaṇṭhakaṃ ramyaṃ dvyaṃśatastatsamunnatam | tatpārśvārdhārathe'pyevaṃ kartavyārdhendaśālikā || 96 ||
tadvadvaraṇḍakādanyadvartayedvedabhāgataḥ | uparyupari ca trīṇi ekaṃ (mū, a, kh, g, ṅ: evaṃ) bhūsūtratulyataḥ || 97 ||
pañcabhūvedikāntā ca (mū: kāṃ tāvat) kāryā candrārdhaśālikā | madhyarathasya karmedaṃ vedikādyamathocyate || 98 ||
prāguktavedikocchrāyaṃ sārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu kārayet | pādātpraveśapaṭṭī syānnirgamā paṭṭikāṅghritaḥ || 99 ||
haṃsapaṭṭī tu bhāgena pādonā ca kapotikā | pādena caturasrāsyātsā garbhārdhapravistarā || 100 ||
vedyāścoparibhāgastu vistāttryaṃśako mataḥ | haṃsākhyāntārdhasūtrācca ṣaḍvibhāgastaducchrayaḥ || 101 ||
tatrāṃśādgalavistāraḥ kapolanirgamāṃśataḥ | kapolādaṃśaniṣkāśādamalāsāravistaraḥ || 102 ||
pakṣīśoccā bhavedgrīvā tadasraikaṃ guṇaṃ bhajet | ardhena galapaṭṭī ca upapaṭṭyaparārdhataḥ || 103 ||
vṛttākhyā tattva (kh, gh: tanu) bhāgena tatpārśvā (g: tatpaścā) ccaturasrikā | dvābhyāṃ cāmalasārākhyaṃ parito vṛttamucchritam || 104 ||
vikāradalasaṃyuktaṃ tadūrdhvaikaṃ guṇaṃ (kh, gh: yugaṃ) bhajet | ekena caturasrā syād dvābhyāṃ haṃsakapotikā || 105 ||
kapola (gh: kapāṭa) ghaṭanāṃśena bhavedevaṃ tu mastakam | anyārthe (kh: kanyārdhe) 'pyevamevaṃ tu prāsādaṃ ghaṭayed dṛḍham || 106 ||
prāsādapṛthupañcāṃśādamalākhyaṃ tribhāgataḥ | sabhūtāṃśaistribhiḥ kāryo ghaṭastaddviguṇocchrayaḥ || 107 ||
aghoro dakṣiṇe sthāpyaścottare vāmasaṃjñakaḥ | pūrvatonāñjale (gh: ñjalai) rvājo jaṅghāṅgadvāstathaiva (mū: tvāttathaiva) ca (?) || 108 ||
śikharārdhe'pyavasthāpyāḥ surāśca rathamadhyataḥ | kvacidbhairavanāṭyeśagauryarko dakṣiṇāditaḥ || 109 ||
śikharaṃ bhūṣatedetairindrādyairvā svadiksthitaiḥ | pūrvoktodgamapṛṣṭhāghrā (kh: pṛthvāsrā) tajjaṅghāmadhyato mukham || 110 ||
bhavejjyeṣṭhādikaṃ tacca tadūrdhveṃ pūrvavatkaṭiḥ | tatkaṭyardhasamucchrāyaṃ pravibhajyāṣṭabhāgataḥ || 111 ||
tattryaṃśairvartayetprāgvadrathakānekabhūmikān | tryaṃśakaiścandraśālāṃ dvayaṃśato madhyataḥ puram || 112 ||
tatrasthaṃ jīvarūpaṃ ca ghaṭayetsundaraṃ budhaḥ | pārśvayoścandraśālāyāstrikaṇṭhaṃ (mū: kaṇṭha) dvyaṃśato bhavet || 113 ||
pṛṣṭhataścandraśālāyā bheryekena tu vartulā | madhyārdhe (gh, ṅ: madhyordhve) candraśālāyāstvaṃśāścinnarakaṃ matam || 114 ||
ekena śikharaṃ cordhveṃ tilakākārakaṃ ca tat | evaṃ tatpārśvataḥ kāryāścārdhenduśālikādayaḥ || 115 ||
vāstubhūṣaṇamaśmotthamuktamanyāni ca bruve || 116 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye talacchandavāstubhūṣaṇākhya sāmānyapañcarathakaprāsādavartanā nāma (nāmeti pāṭhaḥ likhitapustakeṣu nāsti) ṣaḍviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 26 ||
[atha saptaviṃśaḥ]
athānyathā surāvāsāñjyeṣṭhādīṃstrīn yathākramam | rathakernavasapteṣusaṅkhyairarkamatād bruve || 1 ||
mañjaryā mūlavistārairbhavennavatibhāgike | randhrādi vasusaptāṃśairmadhyārdharathako grahaiḥ || 2 ||
sapādaikaikabhāgena jalamārgo viśetsamam | rathakāḥ sārdhacatvāraścatvāraśca chalāgamāḥ || 3 ||
nava tryaṃśo (kh: navatyaṃśo) cchrayāttasyā mañjaryā manubhi (kh: maṇubhi) rmahī | tataścaikaikasantyāgāt ṣaḍaṇḍaṃ nava (g, gh: nnannava) bhūmikāḥ || 4 ||
vedikāṃ bāhyataḥ kṛtvā candraśālādi bhūṣitāḥ | vidyādharāmarairyuktaṃ syādevaṃ jyeṣṭhakhadrumaḥ || 5 ||
vistāre ṣaṣṭibhāgāḍhye manibhiḥ koṇabandhanam | upākhyaḥ sāṅgribāṇena munibhi (gh: saptabhiḥ) ścāṇukaṃ bhavet || 6 ||
munibhīrathakārdhaṃ syāt sapādāṃśaiḥ kramādviśet | jalāntaraṃ tribhirevaṃ jalārdhaṃ tvekameva (kh: tvevameva) tu || 7 ||
rathāḥ sapta bhuvaḥ sapta sapta tryaṃśo (kh: tyaṃśo) cchraye kṛte | kāmāṃśaiḥ prathamābhūmirekaikahrāsayogataḥ || 8 ||
āsaptabhāgataḥ kāryā mahyaḥ (g: sapta) sapta suśobhanāḥ | candraśālādi pratrāḍhyā pūrvavadvedikā bahiḥ || 9 ||
ekonadaśamāṃśāstu kṛtvā vistarato budhaḥ | bhūtāṃśena tu koṇaḥ syādvedenoparathastathā || 10 ||
madhye cāṇu (g: cāru; gh: cātha) ratho bāṇaiḥ pādonāṃśāṃśakairbahiḥ | evaṃ śeṣārdhakaṃ kāryaṃ pañcabhūrathakānvitam || 11 ||
śatārdhāṃśocchrayaṃ kṛtvā ravibhiḥ prāktanī (kh: prokṣaṇī) mahī | rūpanāśātkramādanyā vasvantāḥ pañcabhūmayaḥ || 12 ||
vedāsravṛttayormadhye tatkṣetraṃ yugabhāgikam | kṛtvaikenatu saṃveśamādyaḥ koṇaratho bhavet || 13 ||
madhyārdharathako dvyaṃśaḥ praveśātpratiṣidhyati | pañcamī rathakairdhāma tathānyadbhūta bhāgataḥ (gh: gaśaḥ || 14 ||
bhavetsaptarathānyasyastu (mū, gh: ḍhyastu) tathaiva rasabhāgikaiḥ | ekaikena praveśastu dvābhyāṃ madhyardhago rathaḥ || 15 ||
evaṃ navaratho jyeṣṭhaḥ prāsādaḥ śaṅkaroditaḥ | vistaro vedyadhoḥ yaḥ syāttathā mañjarikocchritiḥ || 16 ||
etau tithyaṃśato bhaktau jyeṣṭhā madhyā harāditaḥ (kh, gh: rāṃśataḥ) | adhamo navabhāgaiḥ syātsthūlāmadhyakṛśāstridhā || 17 ||
vistārārdhonnatā jaṅghā madhyame pādavarjitā | tatulyā kanyase dhāmni śikharaṃ dviguṇaṃ triṣu || 18 ||
arkapuṣpā yavākārā tathā dīpaśikhopamā | sārdhadviguṇapādonā triguṇā mañjarī tridhā || 19 ||
jaṅghāvistarasārdhatrisūtrakairbhramaṇādbha (bha) vet | jaṅghārdhārdhasthite (g: sārdhastate) sūtre vṛttaṃ kaṅkaṭanācchubham || 20 ||
hīnāḥ syurlakṣaṇairhīnāstrirathāstrivarāḥ kvacit | teṣāṃ koṇadvayaṃ bāṇairekaikena jalacyutiḥ || 21 ||
sā vistārasamaśvabhrā dhāmabhiḥ parimaṇḍitam | madhyaratho (') hi bhāgena kāryo viṃśatibhāgikaḥ || 22 ||
triṃśadbhāgasamucchrāye rudrāṃśaiḥ prathamā mahī | anyā diggrahabhāgaiḥ syādbhūmikā pūrvavadvarā || 23 ||
prāsādo liṅgataḥ svāṃśo brahmādyāste'tra ca trayaḥ | caturaṣṭāsravṛttāśca tadbhedāścāpare trayaḥ || 24 ||
vedāsradīrghakāccāsrādaṣṭāsrā (gh: 'ṣṭāsro) tṣoḍaśāsrakaḥ | vṛttāvṛttāyataḥ (kh, ṅ: dvṛttādayaḥ) ṣaṭsyustannāmāni vadāmyataḥ || 25 ||
virājāhvo (mū, a, ṅ: jāṅko) yugāsraśca dīrghaḥ sa eva puṣpakaḥ | aṣṭāsraḥ syāttripiṣṭākhyaḥ (kh, ṅ: viṣṭākhyaḥ) ṣoḍaśāsro himāṃśukaḥ || 26 ||
vṛtto'rkaḥ satu (mū: sapta; kh: syatu) dīrghaḥ syānmaṇikākhyaśca paścime | etebhyo'ṣṭādaśānye syuruttamādyāstu (gh: dyāṃśca) vacmi tān || 27 ||
kāliṅgā nāgarā lāṭā varāṭā drāviḍāstathā | gauḍā iti ca ṣoḍhaite prāsādāśca sarekhakāḥ || 28 ||
latinaḥ kuṭṭinaścaiva śekharī (kh: khecarī) cakriṇastathā | gāndhāro bhaumajaścāpi prāsādāḥ ṣaṭ smṛtāstvime || 29 ||
dhāmanā balabhī strī ca sthitikṛcca napuṃsakam | avyaktavyaktamiśrāṇāṃ liṅgāṇāṃ syātkramādgṛham || 30 ||
jyeṣṭhaṃ sārdha (gh: ṣṭhāśārdha) dvayocchrāyaṃ madhyamaṃ cāṅghrivardhitam | triguṇāṃ cādhamaṃ caitat (gh: caiva) sapādaṃ savitānikam (gh" mānikam) || 31 ||
ṣaḍḍhaṃ ca dviguṇocchrāyaṃ bāṇaśāstre prakīrtitam | uttamādikaraiśca syādekaikasya tridhā gatiḥ || 32 ||
haimaṃ raupyaṃ mahārcā ca liṅgaṃ gāndhāragaṃ śubham | hīnapravyātmakaṃ neṣṭaṃ krūraṃ mānādhike sthitam || 33 ||
tasmānmānāṅghrichandāsyaṃ nāthārathakabhūmikā | vṛttaśṛṅgenduśālākhyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ daśadhocyate || 34 ||
śatārdhātpañcahānyā syurdaśahastāttato (gh: hastonnatā) nava | gāndhāraśuddhadhāmāni liṅgametatpramāṇataḥ || 35 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśāṃśa (gh: śata) ścatustyāgāccaturhastāvadhikramāt | ete navati (mū: navani) vandhārāḥ prasādā liṅgamānataḥ || 36 ||
merumandarakailāsavimāno bhadrako (kh, ṅ: rudrako) bhavet | śrīvatsokapa (mū: strovatso rūpa) nandākhyāstvete vairājajā nava || 37 ||
balabhī vajrapadmaśca valayāṅko haristathā | vṛṣebhahasatārkṣyāntāḥ kramātsyurnavabhedataḥ (kh: bhavedataḥ) || 38 ||
balabhīcchandakaṃ dhāma jyeṣṭhaṃ puṣpakasambhavam | vajrastripiṣṭapaścandrātpadma'rkā (gh: padmārkau) dvalayo hariḥ || 39 ||
maṇikā (mū: maṇikād) vṛṣabho nāgo haṃsatārkṣyauṃ navaiva tu | aṣṭādaśa pradhānācca prāsādāstūbhayātmakāḥ || 40 ||
etadaṃśodbhavāścānye vakṣyante bhedataḥ kramāt | mālyāvānmalayaścaiva supārśvo merurambhavāḥ || 41 ||
merumandarabhinnaḥ syāddhimavāṃścārumūrtikaḥ | vimānamandarābhyāṃ (g: ṇḍalābhyāṃ) ca bhinnaḥ śrīparvato bhavet || 42 ||
samudgakaḥ (kh, g: muṅgakaḥ) samākhyātaḥ kelāso mandarā (g: maṇḍalā) nvitaḥ | latā ghaṇṭā (mū: latāyāśca) vibhānau ca vimānādbhavataḥ (kh: vidyā) sadā || 43 ||
bhadrādbhavenmahābhadro nalinaḥ sarvabhadrakaḥ (mū: tā mukhaṃ) | śrīvatsādvardhamānākhyo mālā śrīvatsasaṃjñakaḥ || 44 ||
nandirvṛddhiśca khādhārastṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | śālāgṛhaṃ viśālaṃ ca brahmamandiramandire (kh: maṇḍale) || 45 ||
bhuvajaṃ śikhikā (mū: śivikā) veśmaprabhavo valabhībhavāḥ | ardhagṛhaṃ kuṭīrākhyaṃ sthitikṛcca gṛhādhipāt || 46 ||
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ svastikaḥ khaḍgaḥ kuliśaḥ svastiko gadā | cakraṃ svastikasaṃjñācca vijayaḥ sapta (kh, ṅ, gh: sasta) vajrajāḥ || 47 ||
padmānmahāravindaṃ syātkumudotpalakau trayaḥ | dundubhī mukulī cakramuṣṇīṣī śaṅkhasaṃjñakaḥ || 48 ||
drumavṛkṣoghaṭaśceti saptaite valayānujāḥ | ṛkṣako bhūṣaṇaścaiva bhūdharaḥ śrījayastathā || 49 ||
pṛthvīdharo vṛṣotthācca catuṣaṣṭiprabhedataḥ | prāsādā bāṇaśāstroktāstvetadbhedo'tivistaraḥ || 50 ||
dvātriśacca sahasrāṇi catuḥ śatayutāni ca | uktāni bhedabhinnāni dhāmnāṃ vai pārameśvare || 51 ||
caturvaktrasya liṅgasya caturasraścaturmukhaḥ | prāsādo brahmaṇo'pyukto natvanyeṣāṃ kadācana || 52 ||
sarverṣā vibudhānāṃ ca liṅgasya (g: vidhasya) trimukhasya ca | ekadvāro yugāsraśca prāsādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 53 ||
ekavaktrasya liṅgasya pratimā yā bhavasya ca | vṛtto maheśvarasyoktaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ na kasyacit || 54 ||
caturmukhasya liṅgasya caturdvārastathā paraḥ | prāsādo vartulaḥ proktaḥ īśvarasya na kasyacit || 55 ||
ekavaktrastathāṣṭāsro viṣṇoścaiva bhavasya ca | caturdvāraḥ punarayaṃ bhavasya brahmaṇastathā || 56 ||
caturasrāyatā ye ca tathā vṛttāyatāḥ pare | ekadvārāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve prasādā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ || 57 ||
muktā liṅgaṃ maheśasya tathā ca kamalāsanam (?) | sarvāsāṃ pratimānāṃ tu prāsādāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ || 58 ||
ucyante padasaṃsthāśca śreṣṭhāṣṭādaśa vāmagāḥ (kh: dhāmagā) | karasaṅkhyāṃ dvidhā bhattṅkā mervādīnāṃ ca kārayet (?) || 59 |
harāṃśaiśca bahirbhittirdaśāṅgai (kh, g: daśāṃśai) randhrakārikām | rudrāṃśaiśca krauḍabhittiṃ grahā(/)śaiḥ suśiraṃ tathā || 60 ||
navabhāgaiśca pīṭhārdhaṃ śeṣāṃśāñcaivameva hi | itthaṃ meruḥ śatāṃśaḥ syānmandarā (g: maṇḍalā) diśca kathyate || 61 ||
bāhyapīṭhaṃ (kh, gh: bāhyakuśvaṃ) tamobhittirgarbhapīṭhārdhameva ca | bhāgaikaikaṃ kramāttyaktvā evamānandanādbhavet || 62 ||
athāhibhājite kṣetre śaphayugmanakhāṃśakaiḥ (kh, gh: tmakaiḥ) | yugairbhittiścaravaṃkuḍyaṃ (ṅ: saṃkuḍyaṃ) garbhapīṭhaṃ tapena tu || 63 ||
kuḍyamandhārikābhittirbhramaḥ pīṭhaṃ bhavetkramāt | dvārtriṃśajjinabhūpāṣṭacandrāśaiśca navāṃśake || 64 ||
catuḥ ṣaṣṭipade kṣetre madhye pīṭaṃ yugāṃśakaiḥ | suśiraścārkabhāgaiśca viṃśadṛkṣaiśca bhittayaḥ || 65 ||
dantajinavikārāṃśādbāhyacchandodgamaḥ (kh: bhramaḥ) kramāt | parito ghaṭanāttatra na kāryā kuḍya pīḍanā || 66 ||
sārka (kh: arkai) śatāṃśakaṃ kṣetraṃ kṛtvā tiryagguṇāṃśakam | karṇasūtrāṇi koṇeṣu koṇādrāmāṃśakaṃ (gh: mārdhakaṃ) haret || 67 ||
bhūtāṃśaiḥ piṇḍikā kāryā grahabhūtāgnilopanāt | randhrāddhi rāmabhāgaiḥ syādrathaṃkāṇāṃ vyavasthitiḥ || 68 ||
madhye kāmartubhāgaiśca nirgamastasya tatra ca | paritaśca caturdikṣu karmādyā rathakā nava || 69 ||
sārdhadviguṇa āpā (kh: stvāpā) dāducchrayastasya tu kvacit | nitambaskandhayormadhye dviśatābhyāṃ vibhajya ca || 70 ||
kāryādyābhūrnakhāṃśaiśca tyajeccaikaikamanyataḥ | candraśālānvitāpyevaṃ yāvatṣoḍaśabhūmayaḥ || 71 ||
kvacidviṣamabhūruktā (mū: rūkṣā) rathakā viṣamā yathā | catuḥ śṛṅgānvitā (kh, gh: ṅkitā) nāsāścatasraḥ śikharārdhagāḥ || 72 ||
vedikābhūḥ kaṭiḥ kaṇṭhaḥ kapolāmalasārakaḥ | pūrvavatsaśalaṃ merorvedāsyaśataśṛṅgiṇaḥ || 73 ||
yāmyendrenduśukāṅghryeṣu (kh: graṣu) herambādityamaṅgalāḥ | taddvāramānato'nyasya liṅgaṃ navakaraṃ tathā || 74 ||
śukanāsāgrataścordhvaṃ siṃhaḥ syādvikṛtā (kh: vivṛtā) nanaḥ | prāggrīvanirgamārdhena dairghyaṃ siṃhasya kīrtitam || 75 ||
tattribhāgocchritaṃ tasya tattulyaṃ vistaraṃ smṛtam | vistarocchrāyamānena kartavyo mastakocchrayaḥ || 76 ||
tattribhāgocchritā (gh: tthitā) grīvā śukanāsārdha (gh: sordhva) madhyataḥ | prāggrīvanirgamenaiva nāsāgraṃ tasya nirgatam (mū: nirgamaḥ) || 77 ||
siṃhaḥ pipīlikāmadhyastvapāṅgakṛtapucchakaḥ | bṛhatkaṭirbhahoraskaḥ kartavyaḥ kesarānvitaḥ (atra keśarānvitaḥ iti likhitapustakeṣu tālavyaḥ pāṭhaḥtasya ke śīryate iti vigrahe sādhuḥ |) || 78 ||
lelihānordhvakaṇṭhastu svapīṭhopari saṃsthitaḥ | grīvādhārā bhavedvedī prāsādārdhapravistarāt || 79 ||
vedikopari karṇeṣu siṃhāḥ syurvikṛtānanāḥ | svamānavistārāyāmā mastakanyastapucchakā || 80 ||
vedivyāma (kh, gh: vyāsa) tribhāgena dairdhyaṃ teṣāṃ prakīrtitam | siṃhāḥ svalakṣaṇepetāḥ kartavyāḥ kesarāvintāḥ || 81 ||
vedyupari tathā dikṣu catvāro nararūpiṇāḥ | lambanena samāyuktāścandraśālāsamāsrakāḥ || 82 ||
digvedairaṭasarogātrividyābhṛdgraha (kh: bhūgṛha) kinnaraḥ | mātṛbhirgaṇavidyeśairbhuṣayennavarbhūmikāḥ || 83 ||
garbhāśmamañjarījaṃ yattena pātabhayaṃ bhavet | tasmātkuryādapāṃ mārge dve dve randhrai mahīkramāt || 84 ||
meruḥ |
kṛtvā caturaśītyaṃśaṃ koṇātsārdhadvayaṃ tyajet | rāmāṃśaistatra piṇḍī syādṛtuvedayamāṃśakaiḥ || 85 ||
praveśanirgamau tatra madhye bhūpendrabhānubhiḥ | niṣkrāntirdiśadiśyaiva navaiva rathakā matāḥ || 86 ||
kaṭivedyantarasthāne dvyekaṣaṣṭiyutaṃ śatam | kṛtvāṣṭādaśabhirbhūḥ syādanyaikaikaṃ vinā kramāt || 87 ||
bhuvaścaturdaśaivaṃ syuḥ puṣkarāpāśrayānvitāḥ | caturdvāraṃ caturnāsaṃ vicitrakuharairyutam || 88 ||
prāguktavedikākaṇṭhamastakaiḥsaṃyutaṃ śubham | daśonaśataśṛṅgaṃ ca vidadhyānmandaraṃ sudhīḥ || 89 ||
mandaraḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃśake kṣetre caturaṃśāstu (kh, ṅ: sśāṃśa) koṇataḥ | guṇaṃ rūpaṃ tadagre ca (kh, ṅ: bhūḥ) tiryagvahniṃ vināśayet || 90 ||
vedenoparathaṃ sthāpyaṃ guṇacandrānalāṃśakam | tadvalluptvā (kh: llabdhvā) ntare madhyārdharathaṃ sthāpayejjalaiḥ || 91 ||
koṇādārabhya śeṣārdhamevamevaṃ tu vartayet | śikharaṃ dvyucchrayaṃ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kaṭyūrdhva (mū: kaṭyartha) mādivat || 92 ||
kṛtvā sā (gh: kṛtāṃśā) ṅghriśataṃ saikaṃ prathamābhūrnṛpāṃśataḥ | śeṣaikaikaparityāgādarkabhūmīsamucchrayam || 93 ||
caturnāsikavaktraṃ ca candraśālāmarānvitāḥ (mū, ṅ: parānvitam) | aśītiśṛṅgasayuktaṃ kailāsaṃ ghaṭayedvaram || 94 ||
kailāsaḥ |
manu (kh: mantra) dvidhākṛte kṣetre rudrahṛdviṃśadāśrutiḥ | trikṣayādvāmataḥ koṇastayostambhastanukṣayāt || 95 ||
uparathaṃ jalāṃśena ratha tryaṃśena madhyataḥ | itthamevāparārdhaṃ syāccatu (mū: ca catu) rdikṣu samantataḥ || 96 ||
śṛṅgastambhānugairmadhye śikharaiḥ sendusālakaiḥ | sakapāṭārgalairvedaghaṭairnāga (mū: ghaṭanāṅga) gavākṣakaiḥ || 97 ||
kṛtvā pañcanavatyaṃśaṃ (mū, a: tyūrdhvaṃ) prāgbhūḥ kaṭyūrdhvamindrataḥ | tadūrdhvaikaikasaṃhrāsātkartavyā bhūmayo daśa || 98 ||
bhūmaṃ dhāmā rathāḥ pañca valabhīlāñchitau rathau | kuharāṇi surairmadhye rathake syurvimānakau || 99 ||
ardho ghaṭakapāṭaistu parasparasamīkṣakaiḥ | dvāraikāṣṭa (gh: kāṅghri) samādyeśaḥ (?) saptatibhirviṣāṇakaiḥ || 100 ||
vimānam |
śakradviguṇite kṣetre ṣaḍbhistanmadhyato rathaḥ | bhāgaikaikena saṃveśāttryaṃśaiścoparadhau matau || 101 ||
dvābhyāmanurathaḥ kāryaḥ koṇabandho guṇātmakaiḥ (kh: ṇāṃśakaiḥ) | sāndhāraścaturāsyaśca vedāṅghro bhramaṇānvitaḥ || 102 ||
sakūṭaśṛṅga saptārciścandraśālānvitai rathaiḥ | vidyādhārākulai ramyairbhadraḥ syāt ṣaṣṭiśṛṅgavān || 103 ||
bhadraḥ |
bhūmau bhūmau kuṭī dvau dvau tatra kāṣṭhādhipā daśa | bhadrabhāgairmahābhadraḥ proktaḥ sopānaśobhitaḥ || 104 ||
mahābhadraḥ |
bhadravattala (mū, a, kh, ṅ" vartala) cchandena samo'dhastādvivartitaḥ | upariṣṭādvimānāṃśaḥ (mū, a, ṅ: nātma) kramato merumandarau || 105 ||
kailāso nandanoyuktaḥ śrīvatso bhadrasaṃjñakaḥ | sarvātmā śikharaiḥ kāryaḥ sarvatobhadrako yataḥ || 106 ||
saptabhūrathakaiyukto vedāṅghryāsyairbhramānvitaḥ | sapuṣkakaraścaturdikṣu cāru catuṣkikānvitaḥ | caturghaṭasamopetaḥ sopānavalabhīyutaḥ (kh, gh: mukhaḥ || 107 ||
sarvatobhadraḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃśake kṣetre trityāgā (kh, ṅ: trivṛtyā; g: tribhāgā) tkoṇavartanam (mū, a, g, ṅ: vartulam) | tadvatpiṇhyambu (mū, aṅ: piṇḍāmbu) nopākhyaḥ śareṇānurathaḥ sadā || 108 ||
madhyārdhe'gnibhiranyatra tvevaṃ saptaratho'dhikaḥ (kh: rcikaḥ; gh: rvikaḥ; ṅ: rdhikaḥ) | kūṭānvitenduśālā syāda digdvārāṅghryāsyako rucaḥ || 109 ||
rucakaḥ |
daśāṃśetu (mū: anu) kṛte kṣetre madhye ca rathakastribhiḥ | sārdhenānurathau kāryau koṇaścaiva dvibhāgataḥ (gh: ratho koṇaṃ koṇaṃ caiva vibhāgataḥ) || 110 ||
rathāḥ pañcabhuvaścaikāṅghryā catuḥ śikharāṇi ca | ratho dhāmāṅkito bhūśca kuharīmadhyago rathaḥ (gh: rave) || 111 ||
kuhareṣu narā nārya siṃhavyāghrebhapakṣiṇaḥ | bhṛgādayaḥ sahe (kh: sade) tyevaṃ śrīvatsaḥ syāddhareḥ priyaḥ || 112 ||
śrīvatsaḥ |
caturasraśca sāndhāro bhadra (kh: rudra) gatistribhūmikaḥ | siṃhaskandho'malāsārairyuktaḥ kāryo gṛhādhipaḥ || 113 ||
gṛharājaḥ |
indrāṃ (kh: nidraṃ) śake kṛte dhāmni koṇāḥ syājjalahānitaḥ | dvābhyāṃ cānurathau kāryau vedāṃśairmadhyamo rathaḥ (gh: go raveḥ) || 114 ||
ekāṅghriḥ saptabhūmiśca pañcarekhenduśālikaḥ (gh: rathenduśālikam) | nānāsurākulo ramno (mū, a, ṅ: varmyo) nandanaḥ suranandanaḥ || 115 ||
nandanaḥ |
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye sāndhāranavaprāsādavartanā nāma (nāmeti pāṭhaḥ likhitapustakeṣu nāsti) saptaviṃśo vidhiḥ] |
[athāṣṭāviṃśaḥ]
vedāṃśe sāṅghri (kh, gh: sraścāṅghri) dīrghe ca nakhāṃśaiḥ śaiṣagarbhiṇi | pārśvayoḥ pañcabhirbhitiḥ pṛṣṭhe'gre syācca sarvataḥ (kh: sārdhataḥ) || 1 ||
daśabhāgī (kh, gh: māṃśī) kṛte kṣetre madhye cārdha (gh: cordhva) ratho mataḥ | upākhyo'nurathaḥ koṇaścaturardhāṃśataḥ (kh, ṅ: rdhāṃśatataḥ) kramāt || 2 ||
tanupakṣāgnisaṃveśāccheṣa evaṃ puro'pare (gh: pure pure) | pārśvārdhe rudrabhāge syānmadhyāttryaṃśai (kh: graṃśaiḥ) ryugairjalaiḥ || 3 ||
rathātiratha (gh: nuratha) koṇāni tvekaikenodakāntaram | valabhīcandraśālāsyā catu (gh: vadyā catu) rnāsāsyasaṃyutā || 4 ||
grahocchritā (gh: tthitā) guṇairjaṅghā tryaṃśasthāḥ saptabhūmayaḥ | bherīnduśālikā dvābhyāṃ meruṇā (gh: mekena) śikharonnatiḥ || 5 ||
dairghye kṛtvā vikārāṃśaṃ vistāre ravi (kh: ca tri) bhāgikam | kaṅkaṭāṃśaṃ tu saṅkocya śikharaṃ dakṣabhāgataḥ || 6 ||
ūrdhvasūtraprasapātātstrīdhāmā śrīpuṭopamā | mervādyābhāḥ kvacitkāryāḥ ṣaṭsiṃhāḥ kumbhamastakā || 7 ||
vedāsrādaṣṭadhā bhaktyā (bhaktvā iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ) dadyādākṛṣya ṣoḍaśa | dviṣaṭkapārśvayoryojyaṃ dvau dvau prāṇārthamagrataḥ || 8 ||
garbhamarkairmayaḥ prāha tathānye jinanāśanāt | vedārthai (gh: garbhārkai) rnāsikā kalpyā vedāsryā (gh: dāsyā) ghrācalasyake (kh, c: valabhya) || 9 ||
valabhī |
bāhye cāṣṭāsrake vajra (mū, gh: vaktra) stvekāṅghryāsyeṣu bhūmikaḥ | garbhavṛtto'rthavedāsro aṣṭāṃśo vā surādhipe || 10 ||
vajraḥ |
daśanāsro (gh: nāsyo) bhavetpadmaṃ ṣoḍaśāsra kvacinmate | vṛtto vābjena saṃyuktaḥ ṣoḍaśārdha (gh: śordhva) dalena ca || 11 ||
tadvatsandhidalopeto garbhavṛttaḥ suśobhanaḥ | ekadvāraikanāsaśca padmanāmā surālayaḥ || 12 ||
padmam |
vedāsrakoṇasūtrārdhādaṣṭamāṃśonnato bhramāt | vṛttaḥ san valayāhvaḥ syātparito valayānvitaḥ || 13 ||
valayāntarapatrāṇi kaṅkaṭānāṃ tu garbhavat | vedīgalāmalāsāraṃ (mū, kh, ṅ: sārdhaṃ) pūrvavannāsikāṃ vinā || 14 ||
valayaḥ |
yugāsre ghrāsame kṣetre nyāsāddhṛ (gh: sārdhaṃ) ttasya bāhyataḥ | madhye vṛttonnato'grāsyaṃ (gh: togrāghraṃ) siṃhairaṣṭabhiranvitaḥ || 15 ||
karṇa (kh, gh: skandha) koṇe yugāṅghryāsyaiḥ (gh: sthaḥ) karikumbhavidāribhiḥ | prāsādaḥ siṃhasaṃjño'yaṃ narasiṃhāmarapriyaḥ (gh: homa'marapriyaḥ) || 16 ||
siṃhaḥ |
sāṅgri (mū, a: svāṅghri) vṛttāyate kṣetre jaṅghā stambhānvito bhavet | nāsāgarbhaśca vedāsrau pañcabhūmyucchrayo vṛṣaḥ || 17 ||
vedāsrātkoṇamṛtrācca karīṣvaṃśe mato bhramāt | pṛṣṭhe vṛtto'rdhakoṇāsra (kh, gh: dvikoṇāgro) garbhavattuṅganāsikaḥ || 18 ||
gajaḥ |
ṣoḍaśāṅghrau kṛte kṣetre vṛttagarbhe śukāghrayā (kh, ṅ: ghrayoḥ) | jaṅgayā ca vimānasya kaṭyā bhadrāhvayasya ca || 19 ||
śrīvatsasya ca mañcaryā haṃso bhavatī lāñchitaḥ | tattulyakaṭidhāmabhyāṃ pārśvayoḥ satatordhvayoḥ (kh, ṅ: tatadvayoḥ) || 20 ||
brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayed dvyaṃśe (kh, gh: dvaṃśedvyanta) dvyaṃśāyorhariśaṅkarau | kartu (gh: kāntā) ricchā vaśādanyo nyastavyo vā śubhapradaḥ || 21 ||
haṃsaḥ |
yugāsreṣvaṣṭa (kh, gh: pṛṣṭha) pādāsre nasāpakṣau ca (mū: pañcaiva) garbhavat | jaṅghā stambhavatī kāryā tuṅgāghrā (mū, a: tuṅgāgrā) pakṣasaṃyutā || 22 ||
garbhaḥ ṣaḍasrakastārkṣyaḥ sakuṭāḥ (mū: śaktayaḥ) pañcābhūmayaḥ | sasaryaṃ kaṭikaṇṭhāsyaṃ viṣṭiṣṭe (gh: ṣṇviṣṭe) tviṣṭakāmaye || 23 ||
bhramaṇā kaṇṭhapāśākhye (kh, ṅ: maṇḍapasyākhya; gh: sasyākhye) catuṣke koṇadhāmabhiḥ | dikṣu sarve balabhyādyāḥ sopānajagatīyutāḥ || 24 ||
tārkṣyaḥ |
vistāradviguṇocchrāyo jaṅghaikāṃśe napuṃsakam | ūrdhve cārdhena haṃsaḥ syādgarbhatulyā tu vedikā || 25 ||
śikharairdikṣu saṃyukta galakāmalasārakam | śeṣārdhena ghaṭopetaḥ (kh: ghaṇṭāntena) ṣaṇḍhasya gṛhakṛtyavat (kh, gh: kṛtyatha) || 26 ||
sthitikṛtā (t) |
nāgayakṣāsurādināṃ triyugmaikakarā matāḥ | kakṣapuṭopamāsre tu grīvāmastakabhūṣitaḥ || 27 ||
itarā hīnāhīnalakṣaṇaḥ |
mervādi (kh, ṅ: sarvādi) garuḍānteṣu nāgarīvartanoditā | nāgarīsadṛśī lāṭī kintu sā dārunirmitā || 28 ||
adhikaiḥ karmabhirjaṅghācandraśālādharāsu ca | pramāṇānnāgarīṃ kṛtvā (g: dhṛtvā) vārāṭīṃ kīrtitā budhaiḥ || 29 ||
sapatravarṇikāstambhapaṭṭibhṛ (gh: paṅktidhṛ) dyatra jaṅghikā | mekhalāntarapatrāṇi drāviḍī sā nigadyate || 30 ||
sapādatriguṇocchrāyairvimānīkaṭimekhalāḥ | prāsādapādaniṣkāśāsyapaṭṭavakulīyutā (mū: matā) || 31 ||
kālindī gauḍikātulyā pañcikā (kh, gh, ṅ: meñcikā) pādacandrikā | ityuktā kiñciduddeśātsthūlarūpeṇa śāstrataḥ || 32 ||
nāgarīmadhyadeśe tu saukhyadāvartinī matā | vārāṭyādyāḥ svadeśe (kh: vāstudeśe) tu anyeṣvanyā ca duḥkhadā || 33 ||
miśrakā bahusaṅkīrṇā naiva kāryā subhārthinā | śuddhā (kh: śubhā) eva tu kartavyāḥ prayatnena matāntare || 34 ||
jñātvā jñātvā vidhāsyanti (mū: vidhātavyāḥ) kārukāḥ sūkṣmakarmabhiḥ | prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ nāsādvāramathocyate || 35 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye liṅgamānaprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo vidhiḥ] || 28 ||
[athaikonaviṃśaḥ]
vedāṅghrekāṅdhrya (gh: kārya) hīnāṅghyā prāsādāstrividhā matāḥ | garbhānugarbhasūtrārdhā (gh: trādvā) nāsāvistaracoditāḥ || 1 ||
pañcadhā nirgamastasyā utta (mū, a, ṅ: dutta) mādiprabhedataḥ | yugartuvasukāṣṭhāṃśairgarbhasyārdhena mānataḥ || 2 ||
rathaiḥsapteṣu vāmādyā (mū, ṅ: vāmājyā; kh, gh: rāmādyā) bhūmikā viṣamairyutāḥ | toyāntarasamopetā bhāgaiḥ prāsādavattridhā || 3 ||
śikhārārdhocchrayāḥ kāryāścandraśālā vibhūṣitāḥ | patrāṅkurādi (mū: ṅgulādi) śṛṅgādyā bherīcicchurakā (gh: cchivukā) nvitāḥ || 4 ||
taccūḍā tilakopetāstadūrdhve haribhūṣitāḥ | saṃskṛtya sthāpanāyeddevāṃścandragarbhe tu pūrvavat || 5 ||
navāṃśānmadhyato'gniḥ syādbhramādbherī guṇakṣayāt | aṣṭādaśāṃśa (mū, ṅ: daśāsra) santyāgatparidhau śukanāsikā || 6 ||
arthadhāmāgrato dvāra madhyataḥ samadiksthitam | sarvakāmaprasidhdyarthaṃ pūrvameva tu kārayet || 7 ||
paścimaṃ (mū, ṅ: pārśvarśā) siddhimūttyarthaṃ saumyaṃ śāntyarthapuṣṭidam | krūrakarmaṇi yāmye ca tathā kuryādvidakṣu tat (g: ca) || 8 ||
ekadvitrimukha liṅga prāgeva dvāramiṣyete | prāgbhrāmā (mū, a: ggrāmā) dyādi saumyastu sa (gh: myanta tva) vyaktāvyaktayorapi || 9 ||
surādagnāndrasarvārthe liṅgārcāyā (gh: nte liṅgārcyayo) stu vāruṇe | cāmuṇḍā bhairave yāmya (kh, g: bhāsyaṃ) dvāraṃ yāmyendudikṣu vā || 10 ||
caṇḍyaśca bhadrakālyāśca saumye caindre'tha vāruṇe | kuryād dvāraṃ caturdikṣu brāhmavedāsyaliṅgayoḥ || 11 ||
digvidiksaṃsthitāḥ sarve pūrvāparānanāḥ śubhāḥ | digvalabhīnduyāmyāsyātkoṇadhāmācca saṃukhāḥ || 12 ||
dhāmamānātridhā dvāraṃ jaṅghāṃ vistarabhāgataḥ | turyarasāhi (mū: rasādi) bhāgena jyeṣṭhamadhyādhamaṃ kramāt || 13 ||
rudrāntādviṣṇuparyantātkeśavāntācca (mū, gh: vārdhācca) tatpṛthu | ekadvitrikarādīnāṃ dvāraṃ syālliṅgamānataḥ || 14 ||
kanyasaṃ cottame dhāmni madhyamaṃ madhyame sadā | uttamaṃ kanyase dvāraṃ garbhamānādathocyate || 15 ||
tricaturbhūtabhāgena jyeṣṭhamadhyamakanyasam | hīnādīnāṃ bhaved dvāraṃ garbhakaṇṭha (kh, gh: karṇa) vibhājite || 16 ||
piṇḍikākoṇavistāraṃ kṣudre dhāmni kvacinmatam | ucchrayo dviguṇo dvārādanyathāvāsaṃ ucyate || 17 ||
aṅgulaiḥ śataṣaṣṭyādyairdaśahānikrameṇa tu | dvārāṇi daśa siddhāni catvāryagrāṇi (mū, a, g: bhrāṇi) teṣu ca || 18 ||
trīṇyatra (kh: ṇbhra) madhyamāni syustrīṇyeva kanyasāni tu | ucchrayārdhena vistāra ucchrayo vā tridhādhikaḥ || 19 ||
diṅnāgādyaṅgulairvāpi dvāraṃ śubhakaraṃ kramāt | ucchrayārdhena vistīrṇā śākhā viṣamasaṅkhyayā || 20 ||
tatsamo dviguṇo'ṣṭonaḥ prathamodumbarasya ca | śākhāpṛthutvamaṅnyūnaṃ dalaṃ bāhukayormatam || 21 ||
trīṣvadrigrahasaṅkhyābhiḥ śākhābhirdvāramiṣṭadam | mahārcādhāmni keṣāñcidrudraśākhānvitaṃ matam || 22 ||
vistāraṃ nakhavatkṛtvā bāhalyaṃ tithibhājitam | daṇḍaśākhā rasāṃśena tamākhyāśrama (gh: traya) bhāgikā || 23 ||
bhūtabhāgena rūpākhyā tvandha (mū, a, gh, ṅ: tvanu) kārī tanuḥ sthitā | marīcī yugmataḥ kāryā mūlākhyā viṣapeṇa tu || 24 ||
daṇḍadviśatimā (kh, gh, ṅ: ti sā) dvau dvau sārdhamevaṃ (kh: meke) ca sāyakaiḥ | sarvāndha (mū, ṅ: nu) kārikāveśo mūlaśākhāsamo bhavet || 25 ||
triśākhadvāram |
triṃśadaṃśasya vistāra (kh, gh: pravistāro) dvṛddhibhāgāddalaṃ tayoḥ | vibhajya dvārabāhyā ca bhūtā syāddaṇḍaśākhikā || 26 ||
pṛthutvenāndhakārīndoḥ praviṣṭā (mū: pratiṣṭhā) ntarasāṃśataḥ | khalva (mū: khalu) śākhāścaturveśā (mū: rvedāt) tsārdhāmbuvistareṇa tu || 27 ||
pādonavistarā kāryā cāndhakāryāntaveśanāt | dvipraveśātpṛthutveśo stambhaśākhābhavediyam || 28 ||
ṣaḍveśā (mū, a, ṅ: kharveśā) dandhakārī ca pādonāṃśapravistarāt | aṃsādbhī (gh: aṃkhaso) rūpaśākhādyāḥ (gh: khāyāḥ) pṛthutā viṣaṣeṇa tu (?) || 29 ||
pādonāṃśena vistārā dhvāntākhyaṃ (mū: krāntākhyaṃ) tu praveśataḥ | sapādadvyaṃśavistārā marīcīṣupraveśataḥ || 30 ||
patraśākhāsu (mū: kheṣu) vistārā bāhalyenārkabhāgataḥ | śobhānurūpataḥ kāryāḥ paṭṭikādyāstu śilpibhiḥ || 31 ||
pañcaśākhādvāram |
aśītyardhāṃśavistārā bhaveddakṣaṃ tathā dale | daṇḍāndhakārikānāma (gh, ṅ: nāga) śāntākhyā rūpaśākhikā || 32 ||
andhārī patraśākhā syād dhvāntākhyāstambhaśākhikā (gh, ṅ: nāmikā) | andhakārī tu rūpākhyā cāndhakārī marīcikā || 33 ||
nāmāśā (kh, gh: nāsāsrāṃ) mūlaśākhāntaṃ kramādbhāgānnadho mataḥ (mū: nnibodhata) | sārdhabhūtāṃśasārdhaikayugaikasārdhavāribhiḥ || 34 ||
tayā (kh: tapo) mbubhavasārdhadvitanupakṣaikaturyakaiḥ (kh, gh: tūryaikapakṣakaiḥ) | bāṇāṃśānmūlaśākhā ca daṇḍāddatupraveśanam || 35 ||
guṇartuyugabāṇākhyaiḥ kramātsaptanavāṃśakaiḥ | śākhāṅge (mū: śākhāṃśa) paṭṭikā kāryā śobhārthe ca vicakṣaṇauḥ || 36 ||
saptaśākhādvāraṃ |
dalāgnyaṃśātu rudrāṃśātpāśaḥ (kh, gh: vyāsaḥ) kāryaḥśatārdhataḥ | daṇḍānukārikā nāma (kh, gh: nāga) dhvāntākhyāstambhaśākhikā || 37 ||
andhakārī mṛṇālākhyā tvandha (kh, gh: syādandha) kārī varuthikā (kh, gh, ṅ: ca rūpikā) | dhvāntākhyā patraśākhā ca tathāndhakārikā punaḥ || 38 ||
stambhāndhākhyā ca rūpāhvā (mū, ṅ: pāṅkā) tvandhakārī marīcikā | patraśākhā kramātkāryā sārdheṣusārdhacandravat || 39 ||
yugaikapañcarūpāṇi vedaikayugasaṃjñakaiḥ | tanuturyaśaśāṅkākhyabāṇaikajalasaṅkhyayā || 40 ||
bhavāśvinau ca vedaistu daṇḍārdviśatiṣaḍdvikaiḥ (mū: paṭṭikaiḥ) | sārdha (mū, ṅ: sārka) pañcāmbu (mū: ñcāṅga) sapteṣumunirandhrāṇi rudrakaiḥ || 41 ||
mūlaśākhāsamāveśātsarvāndhakārikāsu ca | śākhāṃ saṃkṣepayitvā tu jñeyā rācī (kh, g, gh, ṅ: cārī) tu paṭṭikā || 42 ||
navaśākhādvāram |
vibhajya pṛthubāhulye ṣaṣṭyaṃśairmuniṣaḍguṇaiḥ | daṇḍāndhakārikānāgatamastambhāndhakārikā || 43 ||
patranāmāndhakārī ca rūpākhyā dhvānta (mū: dvāra) nāmikā | nāgāndhakārīkāhvaṃ ca stambhāndhakārikā punaḥ || 44 ||
patratamāṅkikā rūpā tvandhakārī mṛnālikā | andhākhyā tu marīcyaṅkā mūlaśākheti kīrtitā || 45 ||
sārdhabhūtaistu sārdhaikayugaikapakṣa (kh, gh, ṅ: pañca) candrakaiḥ | vedaikasārdhairvedaistu bhavāmburūpa (kh, gh: tapa) turyakaiḥ || 46 ||
candravāritapāmbhobhirekānvitanuyugmakaiḥ | sārdhāmbunā sthitirjñeyā śākhādvārikayoḥ kramāt || 47 ||
bhūtapakṣartuturyāṃśaiḥ sapteṣuvasuṣaṭkaraiḥ | arkendrābhyāṃ praveśaḥ syādgāndhārīṇāṃ tu pūrvavat (kh: mūlavat) || 48 ||
śākhaikādaśadvām |
śākhocchrayacaturthāṃśe pratīhārau tvadhaḥ sthitau | jāhravīyamune cāpi tatpārśve bhāravāhikā || 49 ||
cārvībhiḥ patravallībhirmithunaiḥ kinnarādibhiḥ | vidyādharaiśca śobhāḍhyaiḥ saghaṭairnāga (mū, kh, ṅ: pāṭalāṅga) yugmakaiḥ || 50 ||
śeṣaṃ svastikamālābhiḥ śrīvatsābjopalāntajaiḥ (kh, gh: ṇḍajaiḥ) | śobhayadyatnataḥ śākhāstadhanayaiśca suśobhanaiḥ || 51 ||
śrīryakṣeśo gaṇeśo vā vyākhyārudro'tha mṛtyujit | prathamodumbare (?) sthāpyāḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitāḥ || 52 ||
brahmaviṣṇe (ṣṇva) tare rudro dvayantaśvebhānano guhaḥ | grahāśca mātāro vevyo nādyavyāpārasaṃsthitāḥ || 53 ||
tasyopari vyavasthāyyāḥ śilpinodumbare (?) kramāt | lalāṭaṃ śobhanaṃ cordhvaṃ nāgadantānvitaṃ dṛḍham || 54 ||
śākhāpṛthusamau kṛtvā taducchrayasamau (gh: pṛthra) munī | dvārocchrayārdhapādena karapādadvayena vā || 55 ||
hīnāpañjī bhavenordhvamu (gh: bharaṇordhva) jyate nāgabhāgatha | śatārdhāṃśā (kh: rdhāṅgā) dhikaṃ kṛtvā parvaṇī rāmabhāgataḥ || 56 ||
khurakā yama (kh: padma) bhāgena stambhīcaiva dvibhāgataḥ | tribhirguṇagiritryaṃśairdvi dvibhāge khuradvayam || 57 ||
andhārī tanubhāgena ṣaḍbhāge khurajaṅghikā | pañcāṃśena (mū: ṅgena) guṇādhānaṃ vikārāṃśaiśca muṇḍakam (gh: aṇḍajam) || 58 ||
skandhamālākhyavedāṃśaiścūlikaṃ yugalāṃśataḥ | kāryaścaturyamāṃśaiśca dehalī vyāghrapaṭṭikā || 59 ||
dvāraṃ sunirmitaṃ (kh: munimitaṃ) kṛtvā prāsādaṃ kuḍyamadhyataḥ | sarva (mū: sa ca) vedhavināśāya kiñciduttarato nyaset || 60 ||
doṣāḥ kṣayādayaḥ syuśca dvāre vedhā (mū, a, g, gh, ṅ: vedā) nvite sadā | tasmāttadvarjanānārthāya gurorjñātvaṃ (kh: rājñā) taducyate || 61 ||
gṛhaviddhe sadā rāgo dhīnāśaścatvareṇa tu | rathyā (mū, gh: ratha) viddhe pravāsaḥ syāccatuṣpathena rūkṣatā || 62 ||
trivartmanā (kh: carmaṇā) śiraḥ śūlaṃ śṛṅgāṭena (gh: ṭe ca) mahadbhayam | vṛkṣeṇa vittanāśaśca (gh: stu) stambhena parabhṛtyatā || 63 ||
toraṇena bhaveddveṣo bhogapaṭṭyā tvaherbhayam | koṇena rājadaṇḍaḥ syād vibhramo dvāraśākhayā || 64 ||
dhvajena dhananāśaḥ syāt khanīgartena śūnnatā | śatrorbhayaṃ ca kūpena devabiddheba bandhanam || 65 ||
vāpībiddhe tvapasmāraḥ paṅkeneṣṭavināśanam (mū: dam) | bhasmanā paśunāśaḥ syādvardhamānena govyadhā || 66 ||
sutanāśastvapākena cuhlībiddhena niḥ svatā | vaktreṇa ca suhṛ (gh: cakrena vasu) dogastvālindaśravaṇena bhīḥ || 67 ||
sabhābiddhena dāridryamudakena dhanakṣayaḥ | rathabiddhe bhayaṃ kṣaudraṃ (gh: kṣudraṃ (kṣudrābhirmakṣikābhiḥ kṛtamityarthaḥ) śvabhreṇātha sutakṣayaḥ || 68 ||
chāyābiddhena dāridryaṃ toyabhāṇḍena durmatiḥ | kaṇḍanyā (kuṇḍalyā) dhananāśaḥ syācchilābiddhe rujā tathā || 69 ||
tasmādvedhaparityāgaṃ kuryātkartuḥ śubhecchayā | uccaprākāradānena tacchedoddharaṇena vā || 70 ||
tadbhūmidviguṇatyāgādvedhadoṣo na jāyate | śalyasthā vāthavātyuccā kartāraṃ hanti dehalī || 71 ||
nīcā cayotthitā (kh: yoṣitaṃ; ṅ: yosthitaṃ) nūnaṃ dhana (gh: dhanaṃ) vistarahīnikā | liṅgārdhocchayanī kāryā sārcāyāṃ pīṭhikocchrayā || 72 ||
lobhaḥ kopo bhavecchoko dvāre mānavivarjite | adhaśca vistṛte dvāre ruk syāt strīvātha cañcalā || 73 ||
dadyādrūkṣā (kh: kukṣyā) marya madhye strīsvāmyaṃ vā pṛthūrdhvataḥ (g: pūrvavat) | kṣayaṃ pipīlikāmadhyaṃ kulaghnaṃ śaṅkhakaṇṭhakam || 74 ||
vaktraṃ gomahiṣīṇāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ ca kṣayapradam | bhinna śākhe kṣayodvāre digbhrānte sthānavibhramaḥ || 75 ||
purāṇanava (g: vana) saṃyukte dāridyaṃ bahubhartutā | jarjare viparīte vā dhananāśaḥ sadā nare || 76 ||
vyādhicchidrānvite kubje kaliḥ syāt puṃsaśabdake | svayamudvāṭite tadvat pīḍitāhitatā (g: dvitatā) nanāt || 77 ||
unmādaḥ kulahṛnmṛtyurmūladvārātphaphaṃ kramāt | dvāra (kh: vāma) biddhaṃ tyajedveśma kulakṣayabhayātsadā || 78 ||
sāmānyavedha ityukto gṛhaprāsādayormayā | bedhyabedhakayorvāstvostyaktvā dviguṇamantaram || 79 ||
yatheṣṭaṃ sakalaṃ (gh: kalaśa) kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ yacchubhaśāntikṛt | sarveṣāṃ śubhadā yāśca dvārādīnāṃ ca tā bruve || 80 ||
dvārdairdhyavistarau yau ca sāṅgalau karasaṅkhyayā | tāvekīkṛtya saṃchindyāttrīṣvadryaṣṭābhireva vā || 81 ||
jñānaṃ vāso kṣayaścārgnerbhūtāyāna (gh: yonā/) guṇāñśṛṇu | sthairyamāpyāyanaṃ dīptirgamo mādhyasth (gh: madhyastha) yameva ca || 82 ||
suhṛddhanaṃ paśucayaḥ prāgrājyaṃ (gh: prāvrājyaṃ) kāmikācyutiḥ | viṣādaśceti cādryaṃśe phalaṃ saptasu (gh: sapteṣu) dehinām || 83 ||
taccheṣo yastu te'rcāyāstadādyaṣṭāntakāḥ sadā | viṣamāḥ śubhadāstatra samāścāniṣṭakarmasu || 84 ||
dhvajasiṃhavṛṣebhākhyā dikṣu prācyādiṣu sthitāḥ | dhūmaḥścā ca kharo dhvāṅkṣaḥ samā ete vidik sthitāḥ || 85 ||
dhāmaścārdhāsa (gh: tryardhāṃśa) nādīnāṃ dhvajādyā ye (g: nyāya) guṇāstvime | strī (kh, gh: śrīḥ) saubhāgyasutāyurdo dharmavṛddhikaro (kh, gh, ṅ: prado) dhvajaḥ || 86 ||
jayārogyārthamitrādi sarvasiddhikaro harīḥ | strīputrārthān vṛṣo dadyādaśeṣasukhadaḥ (gh, ṅ: śubhadaḥ) karī || 87 ||
rogatāpāgnido nityaṃ dhūmaḥ sarvārthanāśanaḥ ( gh: śakaḥ) | vyādhimṛtyupradātoktaḥ sārameyo'rthagotrahṛt || 88 ||
śeṣoccāṭanavidveṣaviyogavadhadaṇḍadaḥ | kṛśatāraukṣyadāridryaṃ sarvāniṣṭakaraḥ kharaḥ || 89 ||
patnosutacamū (kh: śubha dasu) dravyasaṃpadāyuḥ kṣayapradaḥ | śokamohakalivyādhibandhādikṛcca vāyasaḥ || 90 ||
yavau dvau caturo vāpi yavānaṅgulameva vā | āyāṃśca yojayejjñātvā syādāyaścottamo yathā || 91 ||
kṛtvaivaṃ sthāpayed dvāraṃ prāguktavidhipūrvakam || 92 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye devadvārasthāpanalakṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo vidhiḥ] |
[atha triṃśaḥ]
vāstuyāgaṃ purā kṛtvā maṇḍapasya puroditam | padapīṭhordhva (kh, g: ṭhārdhataḥ) taḥ kāryaṃ vedībandhādi dhāmavat || 1 ||
prāsādavalabhīstambhairbhūṣayedbāhyabhittiṣu | itareṣāṃ ca karmādyairnottamānāṃ samaṇḍapaiḥ || 2 ||
tadvatsārdhaśca pādonād (mū: pādānāṃ) dviguṇo vātha maṇḍapaḥ | stambhāddhinādayaśca syuḥ sapta (saptā li0 pū0) viṃśatirevahi || 3 ||
ṣaṭstambhāstatra ca śreṣṭhāḥ kathyante nāmarūpataḥ | rucakākhyaśca vedāsrastvaṣṭāsro vajrasaṃjñakaḥ || 4 ||
ṣoḍaśāsro'tivajrākhyo daśanāsraḥ pralīnakaḥ | manthāno (mū, a, ṅ: santāno) vedaṣaṣṭyāsro vṛtto manmathanāmakaḥ || 5 ||
dvādaśāṅgulavistāro dvārocchrāyasamucchrayaḥ | sāmānyaḥsthambha ityeṣa (kh: tyevaṃ) yojanīyastu kanyase || 6 ||
caturaṅgulavṛddhyā syād vardhante vistareṇa ca | prāsādamānapādonāt stambhocchrāyaḥ kvacinmataḥ || 7 ||
padmāṅkitā (g: ṣaḍveṅkitā; g: ṣaḍdvyaṅkitā) mbupatrāsyakumbhairbhāradharaistvadhaḥ | madhye hārāvalībhiḥ syuruparyamalasārakaiḥ || 8 ||
stambhātstri (mū: mbhāstri) kaṭipatraiśca mahāsāraistvaliṅgakaiḥ (kh: lindukaiḥ) | jaṅghālaṃbanyadhobhāgāducchrayānmaṇḍapo bhavet || 9 ||
caturaṣṭayutaistambhairitareṣāṃ tu maṇḍapaḥ | sāmānyātsarvaśāstreṣu ye proktāstān vadāmyataḥ || 10 ||
susūtraścāpabhadraśca siṃho dvipadasaṃjñakaḥ | karṇikāraśca haryakṣaḥ (kh: hanyākhyaḥ) sugrīvo maṇi (kh, gh: māna) bhadrakaḥ || 11 ||
mānavo nandanaścaiva tāpaśca śatru (mū, ṅ: śatryu) nandanaḥ | śuśīlaśca viśālaśca yajñabhadraḥ śrutīśvaraḥ (gh: dharaḥ || 12 ||
vāstusaṅkīrṇako nāmnā viṣamākhyastathāparaḥ | śrīvatsaśca jayaścaiva jayabhadro'tha buddhibhṛt || 13 ||
kauśalyaḥ puṣpanandākhyaḥ suvrataḥ puṣpabhadrakaḥ | puṣpakānta iti khyātāḥ sapta (saptā li0 pu0 pā0) viṃśatimaṇḍapāḥ || 14 ||
dvādaśādidvivṛddhyā syuścatuḥ ṣaṣṭyavasānataḥ | stambhakramāt kaniṣṭhādyā uktāḥ śāstrānusārataḥ || 15 ||
sudṛḍhaiḥ śobhanaiḥ sthāpyāḥ śilākāṣṭhādibhirvaraiḥ | tanmadhye cordhvatastadvadekadvitrivimānakāḥ || 16 ||
kāryā grīvāmalāsārakalaśaiśca samanvitāḥ (kh, ṅ: ṅkitāḥ) | tryasravṛttārdhacandrābhavasvasraṣoḍaśāsrakaḥ || 17 ||
rājyasiddhiripūcchādasutadravyapradaḥ kramāt | sarvāṇyetāni dadyācca phalāni caturasrakaḥ || 18 ||
maṇḍapalakṣaṇam |
pūrvataśca vṛṣo nāmāgneyyāṃ ca (mū, g: nāmā ca) nāyakesarī | valabhīchandako yāmye nair(-)ṛtyāṃ garuḍaḥ smṛtaḥ || 19 ||
śrīvṛkṣakastathāpyāṃ syādvā (ṅ: pāsye vā) yavye ṣoḍaśāsrakaḥ | purāgajastu saumyāyāṃ tathaiśyāṃ sarvabhadrakaḥ || 20 ||
maṇḍapāstu (gh: pāśca) smṛtā miśrā ete yojyāstu sādhane | caturasrādike bhede kuṇḍavṛtte vivartitaḥ || 21 ||
taddiśābhāgavikṣiptāstatkāryakaraṇe hitāḥ | sārdhaitāḥ sādhane yojyā liṅgāni nānyathā kvacit || 22 ||
caturasraṃ (mū, ṅ: tithihastaṃ) samaṃ kṛtvā tithihastaṃ jaghanyake | madhyamādyā dvivṛddhyā ca vibhajetkāmabhāgataḥ || 23 ||
parito bhittayoṃ'śena tribhiraṃśaiśca vīthikā | stambhānvitāḥ puraḥ pṛṣṭhe tryaṃśaistryaṃśaiśca garbhakāḥ || 24 ||
dvegṛhe madhyataḥ kārye bāhya (ṅ: vādya) sopānahetave | tayorbhittī tathāṃśena tryaṃśairdāraṃ ca madhyataḥ || 25 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ bhuvi kartavyaṃ madhye stambha (mū, g: dvāra) catuṣṭatam | satu lopakulaṃ kuryāccatur (g: dvṛtta) bhittīśca koṇagāḥ || 26 ||
caturbhitti (gh: rvīthi) ścaturdvāri paritastambhamālikā | mattavāraṇasaṃyuktamūrdhvaṃ mūrdhvamucchadanānvitam || 27 ||
madhye vimānikāyuktaṃ sugrīvāmalasārakām | sapadmakalaśaṃ kuryāccitrākhyaṃ nṛtyamandiram || 28 ||
nāṭyaśālālakṣaṇam |
sthūlacūleṣṭakākūṭaṃ snigdhamṛtpaṅkasevitam (kh: śobhitam) | khalīcūrṇaiśca saṃśudhya (kh, gh: saṃguṇḍya) cūrṇairmāṣodbhavaistathā || 29 ||
āmrātakodakaiḥ sicya kramāt tryahaṃ tu chādayet | āguṇḍya (mū, a, ṅ: śuṇṭhya; g: galya) sārṣapaiścūrṇaiḥ paścādāstṛṇuyāt sudhīḥ || 30 ||
āmrātakāmbunā bhūyaḥ paścādākoṭya mudgaraiḥ | yāvaddarpaṇasaṃkāśaṃ śaivālaiśchādayettataḥ || 31 ||
vyahā (ṅ: ahā) dākṛṣya śaivālāllimpet (gh: llipyeta) piṇyākakalkalaiḥ | viśrāmyaikāṃ tato (g: mya kārutāṃ) rātriṃ gomayena vilepayet || 32 ||
kṣodalakṣaṇam |
dagdhvā gośarkarāstūpaṃ tato'bhiṣicya yatnataḥ | śaṇaphalyāṅghikāṣāyai (g: sādyai) stopalatārasena vā || 33 ||
āṃmrātakāṅghritoyena triphalākvāthakārite (kh: vāriṇā) | utsvinna (mū: utsvinya) māṣatoyena svinnabilvāmbunāpi vā || 34 ||
kolāvimāṃśutoyairvā takranadya (kh: takranavyā; gh: vakrakravyā; ṅ: takrakaṃvyau) mbunāpi vā | tataścolūkhalādyaistu sthūlacūrṇāni kārayet || 35 ||
sūryaiḥ (g: puṣpaiḥ) prasphoṭya saṃgṛhya taccūrṇāni nicakṣaṇaḥ | sthālyāgarbhe tu saṃsthāpya tato drayāṇi niḥkṣipet || 36 ||
sārdraṃ (kh: sāndraṃ) lulāyacarmātha śaṇatantūṃśca kuṭṭitān | sikrāta (mū, gh, ṅ: sikatā) gavyadugdhāni sarjatailātasīrajaḥ || 37 ||
dadhyumātailatoyena saṃsthāpya nakhavāsaram | āmrātakāmbubhiḥ piṣṭaṃ sthūlāsyā dugdhi (g: vāru) kāhvayā || 38 ||
etairdravyairyutā cānyā ślakṣṇapiṣṭairvarā sudhā | sammardya guḍadadhnā tān saṃllimpe (gh, ṅ: tapalipye) ddugdhikopari || 39 ||
sudhālakṣaṇam |
liṅkhādisandhidārḍhyārthaṃ vajralepamihocyate | ślakṣṇa (mū, g, ṅ: lakṣa) pāṣāṇacūrṇaṃ tu meṣaśṛṅga(/) sucūrṇitam || 40 ||
kārayedvālukāmiśramumātailena mardayet | kvāthena meṣaśṛṅgasya atasīcūrṇamiśritam || 41 ||
sammardya saṃpacettāvadyāvattatsamatāṃ gataḥ | vajralepaḥ samakhyātastathā sarjasamanvitaḥ || 42 ||
atha niṣṭhurabandhena procyate saviśeṣataḥ (mū, ṅ: sāvaśeṣataḥ) | madhūcchiṣṭena kalkaiśca śāṇajaiḥ sudṛḍhairnavaiḥ || 43 ||
guggulaṃ vālukāmiśraṃ cūrṇaṃ pāṣāṇasasbhavam (kh: saṃyutam) | atasītailasammiśraṃ mardayitvā supācitam || 44 ||
vajralepaḥ saṃmākhyātaḥ bhūmibandhastvataḥ (kh, ṅ: vajrabandhastataḥ) param | suraveśmagṛhādīnāṃ bhūmibandho nigadyate || 46 ||
vajralepalakṣaṇam |
mṛttikeṣṭakacūrṇaistu piṇyākenānvitaistathā | sthiratoyopamā kāryā bhūmistu sutalā samā || 47 ||
evaṃ bhūmiṃ samāṃ kṛtvā paścād bhūbandhamārabhet (kh: caret) | gṛhītvā vāluvāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ snigdhāścākhaṇḍitā budhaḥ (kh: stathā) || 48 ||
gṛhītvāmra (ṅ: tvārdra) tvacaṃ vṛkṣāt piṣṭvā kalkaṃ tu kārayet | tatkalkaṃ kārayet piṇḍaṃ viśoṣyaṃ piṇḍamātape || 48 ||
evaṃ saṃśodhya (gh: śoṣya) tatkalkaṃ saptavārān punaḥ punaḥ | tato maṇḍena saṃmardya bhūmibandhaṃ tu kārayet || 49 ||
athavānyena yogena bhūmibandho vidhīyate | kuryād bhūmiṃ samaṃ ramyaṃ susthitaṃ jalapūritam || 50 ||
pūrvoktaścaiva yaḥ kalko niryāsaṃ tasya dāpayeṃt | dravyaṃ kālānurūpeṇa yojayedbhāgasammitam || 51 ||
yathākālānurūpeṇa bhāgasaṅkhyā tu kathyate | grīyme nu pañcabhāgāḥ syuḥ śītakāle tathā trayaḥ || 52 ||
tryardhaṃ śaradi dātavyaṃ dvyaṃśo varṣāsamāgame | evaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ pūrvaṃ bandho'tra kathitaḥ kṣiteḥ || 53 ||
tato vilipya kūrceṃna śuṣke śuṣke krameṇa tu | toyena hatakūrcaṃ tu dāpayettadvicakṣaṇaḥ || 54 ||
kaṣāyaṃ picchilaṃ caiva niryāso valkalaṃ tathā | śālmalītindukādīnāṃ bhūmibandhe praśasyate || 55 ||
iṣṭakādārvayo'śmādi yatsaṃkhyaṃ devaveśmani (gh: sadmani) | tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi kartā nandati tatpure (gh: tpuram) || 56 ||
bhūbandhalakṣaṇam |
pañcasthāḥ pañcaherambā vighnarūpāḥ śivājñayā | ārambhe kaṭināsāsu (kh, g: rāsnāyu) skandhe mūrdhni yathākramam || 57 ||
ālasyo mohanaścāpi vibhramaḥ śāsakastathā | pañcamaḥ kāladaṇḍākhyaḥ sānvayāḥ phaladāyakāḥ || 58 ||
ālasyaṃ cālasaḥ kuryānmohaṃ kuryācca mohanaḥ | vibhrāntiṃ vibhramaḥ kuryācchāsakaḥ śāsayetsadā || 59 ||
kāladaṇḍo mahāraudraḥ kuryād daṇḍabhayaṃ (kh: mbhamayaṃ) mahat | ete suragṛhe vighnā yāvatte tu na pūjitāḥ || 60 ||
sthaṇḍile vā pure ceṣṭvā sitādyāścoktarūpataḥ | ṣaḍaṅgairāvṛtāḥ sarve vighnaghnā balihomakaiḥ || 61 ||
gurvajñātā aniṣṭāśca doṣānkurvantyanekadhā | tasmādādau ca santarpyāḥ śrāddhe nānvīmukhāstathā || 62 ||
bighnanāśāya gaṇeśapūjā |
yatra (kh: yantra g: patra) rūpaṃ dvidhā vidyāt sthalajaṃ jalajaṃ tadhā | sthalajaṃ gotrasambhūtaṃ śilābhedasamaṃ dhanam || 63 ||
sthalajaṃ vipulākhyaṃ syāt patitaṃ cordhvagaṃ dvidhā (g: tathā) | jalajamabjakandotthaṃ tilakāṅkaṃ tri (mū: ka.ṃ karṇi; kh: kāhvāṃ tri; ṅ: kākānti) bhedakam || 64 ||
ghanagranthiviśālāṅkaṃ viṭikāṅkaraśobhitam | vipulaṃ bahuśākhāṅgaṃ (kh: lākhyaṃ) lakṣaṃ komalamadrijam || 65 ||
paṭṭikā (g: viṭikā) ṭilakaṃ caikaṃ tribhaṃgaṃ (gh: tribhagaṃ) ca dvitīyakam | tṛtīyaṃ padmamardhajaṃ (mū: vardhaja) lakṣmaitattilakasya ca || 66 ||
agre bhavet sarojāṅgaṃ kvacidbhinnaṃ sukomalam | sphāraṃ kuṭilasaṃ (ṅ: lajaṃ) sarpi pronnataṃ vitataṃ sphuṭam || 67 ||
kando (gh: kundo) dbhavamidaṃ vaktraṃ śobhanaṃ vārisambhavam | pañcadhā daśarekhābhiḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sakala (kh, gh: sabala) rūpakam || 68 ||
sthalajaṃ jalajaṃ caiva jñeyaṃ dvādaśabhedakam | kalinda (gh: kāliṅga) koladaṣṭrārdraṃ kaṇṭakaiḥ paritairyutam || 69 ||
nīlaṃ sukomalaṃ veṇu(/) (kh: meru) bindurekhakhādyabhaṅguram | kaṇṭakairmeṣaśṛṅgābhaiḥ patraṃ bālābhajaṃ bhavet || 70 ||
dhanaṃ havyākulaṃ (kh: dadākula; g: phaṭākulaṃ) pītaṃ niviḍāṅgaṃ visarpi ca | agastimukulākāraṃ kanakaṃ (kh: kaṇṭhakaṃ) pāvanāhvakam (kh: kaṇṭhakaṃ) || 71 ||
bhāskaraṃ vitataṃ kuryāddharitaṃ sucayā (kh: tāṃśukayā) kulam | śvapucchavacca vṛttāgraṃ mārjāramukha (kh: nakha) bhaṅguram || 72 ||
śukāsyaiḥ kaṇṭhakairvāsṛṅ nāgaraṃ patramucyate | aurvāru (kh, gh: airvāru) tantuvṛttāgraṃ kaṇṭhakaṃ sarpasarpaṇam || 73 ||
paraspareṇa saṃpṛktaṃ (mū, ṅ: saṃvṛktaṃ) bahuparyasti (kh, gh, ṅ: baddhaparyāsti) patrakam | vistṛtaṃ kuñcitāgraṃ ca śvetaṃ raktāsyaśobhitam || 74 ||
taruṇaṃ piñjarāgaṃ ca karkaśaṃ cātikarkaśam | granthipatrāṅkurairyuktaṃ viparyastaiḥsadordhvagam || 75 ||
līlālolavikāśāṅgaṃ pallavaiḥ susamākulam | kvacicchinaṃ kvacidbhinnaṃ kvacit patrārdhaveṣṭitam || 76 ||
palāladhūmasaṅkāśaṃ drāviḍaṃ patramīdṛśam | pūrvoktavallicitrāḍhyaṃ hṛdyaṃ cāru surekhitam || 77 ||
sarvākārairvimiśraṃ ca patraṃ tadveśaraṃ (kh: dvai khara) smṛtam | mūlemadhya tathāgre ca vṛddhaṃ taruṇaśākhikam || 78 ||
likhet trikaṇṭhakaṃ (gh: kaṇṭakaṃ) sarvaṃ patraikaṃ patralakṣmavat (ṅ: yat) | śilpibhirguṇitaṃ kṛtvā paścāt patrāṇi saṃlikhet || 79 ||
stambhakumbhānane dvāre rathe coparathe tathā | nirgataṃ rājahaṃsasya pucchāt kakṣācca (mū: kandācca) kiṃ nṛṇām || 80 ||
