[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye maṇḍapādivartinīlakṣaṇaṃ nāma (śabdo'yaṃ li0 pu0 nāsti) triṃśo vidhiḥ] || 30 ||
[athaikatriṃśaḥ]
tritaye puṣkariṇyādau bhūgṛhasthāpane sadā | yajettadvāstu (mū, gh: dardhastu) devāṃśca vedāsre rudrabhākike || 1 ||
triṣu triṣu ca koṣṭheṣu (mū, kh, gh, ṅ: koṣṭheṣu) yajedatra harādikān | dikpadeṣu marīcyādyā madhye tattveṣu vedhasas || 2 ||
aṣṭāpadīṃśca (ṅ: padāṃśca) koṇāsthān dvidbayāṅghriṣu madhyataḥ | brahmasthāne site padme (mū, ṅ: pakṣe) kālāgniṃ pūjayettataḥ || 3 ||
mūrtyaṅga (mū, ṅ: mūrdhnyaṅga) ṣaṭkasaṃyuktaṃ svanāmādyakṣareṇa ca | hāṭakeśaṃ baleśaṃ (ṅ: caleśaṃ) ca punaścātibalaṃ tathā || 4 ||
mahodaraṃ mahābdhiṃ ca (kh, ṅ: mahāviśva) kumbhārṇavaṃ tathā punaḥ | saptamaṃ ca virūpākṣaṃ bhrukuṭīśaṃ daleṣu ca || 5 ||
prāgādīśāntagandhādyaistathānanttadi (kh, ṅ: nandādi) gātrake | karkoṭāntaṃ svamantreṇa pūjayejjaladiggṛhe || 6 ||
bāhyeṣu ca carakyādīn balihomena tarpayet | tathā grahādilokeśānnraupyā (mū, kh, g, ṅ: nopyā) nnāgāṣṭakāṃstataḥ (kh: tathā) || 7 ||
ananttādyaṃ mahāpadmaṃ takṣakaṃ kulikaṃ tathā | śaṅkhaṃ vāsukiṃ caiva padmaṃ karkoṭakāntakam || 8 ||
snānejyān (?) (mū, a, ṅ: sthānajñān) pūrvataḥ kṛtvā sunimitte suvāsare | pūrvādīśāntagānnyasya madhye coṣadhikā (mū, ṅ: roṣāpahā) dhikān || 9 ||
phalinyuśīrayaṣṭyāhvasahāhilocanāṃ hrikam | vaṃsakūrcārtha (gh: rasakūmreṣu) ratnābjagaṅgāmbu (kh: gandhāmbu) pañcagavyakam || 10 ||
athodakaṃ (kh, g, gh, ṅ: arghodaka) kṣipedvāpyāṃ tanmadhye tvahipaṣṭi (kh, ṅ: ṣaṣṭi) kān | vinyased dviguṇaṃ śvabhrātpādonāṃ vā vasādhikām (mū, g: vādhisārdhakām) || 8 ||
sālasundarikādīnāṃ dṛḍhāṃ dṛṅmānapūrvikām (g: saṃyutān) | susnāpya gandhavastrādyaiḥ saṃpūjyānantamantrataḥ || 12 ||
tenaivāropayenmadhye rakṣāyai bhogiyaṣṭikām | vedatūryaninādena (kh: tūryena vādena) dhvajavatsakale kṛte (mū, ṅ: viṃśa; g, gh: vaṃśa) || 13 ||
saptabhogasukūṭāya viśvā (mū, a, gh: diksthā) dhārasthitāya ca | hū(/) hū(/) anantāya (kh: anantanāgāya) nāgādhipataye namaḥ || 14 ||
anantamantraḥ |
astrodakena cābhyukṣya pāśupatena pāśayet | khurikenāvadhāryeṣa (mū, a, ṅ: jyeṣṭha) guhyenāmbhasi vā kṣipet || 15 ||
nānā (mū, a, ṅ: tāra) pāśakaraḥ kartā japan pāśupataṃ guruḥ | kapilāpuccha (kh, g: vāmadevaṃ) lagno'tra santaredyajamānakaḥ || 16 ||
tatra tīrṇo bhavetkartā ghorāṃ vaitaraṇīṃ nadīm | tataścāṣṭaśataṃ homaṃ bahurūpeṇa homayet || 17 ||
tarpayedvaruṇaṃ devaṃ somadevaṃ (kh: dattvā santoṣayet) ca vā kvacit | caruṃ saṃśādhayettena śāntiṃ tenaiva kārayet || 18 ||
pūrṇāṃ dadyād gururhṛṣṭaḥ śivenāśivahariṇā | tāṃ ca gāṃ gurave dadyāt toṣayecca (gh: khāgnyena) svavittataḥ || 19 ||
kūpe'pyevaṃ kṛte'rkāṃśe sārdhadvyāṅghristhāsthamīśvaram | khāgnīna (kh: gogryūṇa) pitṛrugvā (mū: yugvā) yuditīśānpūjayettathā || 20 ||
aṣṭau tvāpādikāṃścaiva padaikaikeṣu koṇataḥ | dikṣvarkeṣu marīcyādyān madhyeṣaṭpadakeṣvajam (gh: dhvajaḥ) || 21 ||
kūpāṅghrīśe (gh: npīṭhā) pare bhāge tāranāgāṣṭakāvṛtam | tanmadhye kālarudreśaṃ pūjya gandhādipūrvavat || 22 ||
hutvā dadyād baliṃ tebhyo gurave gāṃ tato guruḥ | pañcagavyaṃ kṣipetkūpe gaṅgāmantrāmbunā saha || 23 ||
kartāraṃ prokṣayetpaścādguruḥ śāntyambunā bhṛśam | śakttyā kartāśayedviprān prārthayitvāśiṣo'rthivat (kh, gh: rmithaḥ) || 24 ||
aiṣṭake vāśmaje kūpe dhīrajjudṛḍhamālikām | karāntarasthadārvībhirdhaṭībhirdārucakrakam || 25 ||
yuktaṃ tadgraha (kh: dbham) ṇāttoyaṃ nālābhyāṃ karṣayennaraḥ | nālārdhe (kh, gh: nālau dve) sthāpayettatra (kh, gh: dviṣṇu; g: vipra) prasuptaṃ yāgapūrvakam || 26 ||
puṣkariṇyādiṣaṭkeṣu śileṣṭakākṛteṣu vā | jalatalpo hariḥsthāpyo gaṅgānāgāhvayo'thavā (mū, ṅ: nāgārddhayo) || 27 ||
yateḥ syānāya vāpyādīn kuryāt prāgīśasaumyataḥ | udyāneṣu surāgre vā (kh, ṅ: greṣu) dikṣu kūpaṃ ca pūrvavat || 28 ||
kūpavatsarvakhāteṣu vidhānaṃ cākhilaṃ tu tat | kṣepaṇaṃ vapanaṃ yacca savyāsavyena kārayet || 29 ||
bilvavṛkṣādivṛkṣāṇāṃ nyāsādi majja (g: mārja) nārcanam | svaistārakaiḥ prakuryācca tilairhomaṃ ca madhyagaiḥ || 30 ||
ārāmodyānake'pyevamaiśānyāṃ vṛkṣamāśritam | pūrvāgāre'tha hotavyaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣadaivatam || 31 ||
nyāsārcanādikaṃ kṛtsnaṃ svairmantrairyatibhojanam | bāṇamatātsamādāya likhitaṃ ca tadakṣaraiḥ || 32 ||
[iti lakṣaṇasamuccaye puṣkariṇīkūpavṛkṣodyānārāmasthāpanaṃ nāmai (nāmeti śabdo li0 pu0 nāsti) katriṃśo vidhiḥ] || 31 ||
[atha dvātriṃśaḥ]
sāṃvatsarikapūjādau nyūnasaṃpūraṇāya vai (kh, g: ca) | pavitrārohaṇaṃ (mū: ropaṇaṃ) kāryaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ vrataṃ caran || 1 ||
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe vāpi nabhasye vā tato na tu | pakṣayośceṣṭa (kh, g: sveṣṭa) devānāṃ vahnipratipadādiṣu (kh: ditaḥ) || 2 ||
jvalanabrahmagaurīṇāṃ herambasya ca bhoginām | rudrārka (kh: rudrāṇaṃ) śaṅkarāṇāṃ ca caṇḍīyamaviḍaujasāma || 3 ||
viṣṇumanmathaśambhūnāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā punaḥ | sarveśvara (kh: ṣveva) pitṛṇāṃ ca pavitrārohaṇaṃ matam || 4 ||
nirūpya sthānakaṃ cādau gṛhītvā dantadhāvanam (g: daṇḍadhāraṇam; (k) 24 adhyāyasya 49 ślokādārabhyaitāvatparyanto bhāga ka putake khaṇḍitaḥ) | mṛdbhasmavastrapatrādi tathā sūtraṃ ca saptadhā || 5 ||
kṣaumaṃ mauñjaṃ ca śāṇaṃ vā kauśaṃ paṭṭajameva vā | pādma kārpāsajaṃ sūtraṃ dvijakanyādinirmitam || 6 ||
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya jyeṣṭhādiliṅgamānataḥ |) (ka) daśāṅgulāntarāgranthiścaikaikāṅgulihānitaḥ || 7 ||
dvyaṅgulāntaṃ bhaveccheṣau hastānte ca navādike | sūtraiḥ sāṣṭaśatairjyeṣṭho cānyada (mūṅ: yanmitrā; k, gh: cānyatrā) ṣṭāṣṭahānitaḥ || 8 ||
granthayastantusaṃkhyātā viṣamagranthayaḥ kvacit | rocanākuṅkumāktaiśca madacandraistu śaktitaḥ || 9 ||
rajanyā dhātubhirvāpi granthīṃstāṃstu suśobhayet | tritattve trīṇi kāryāṇi caturthaṃ cāvalaṃbajam || 10 ||
sudhautāni pavitrāṇi pīṭhe liṅgeca mūrdhani | sarvārthapūraṇaṃ dadyāt pṛṣṭhapīṭhe caturthakam || 11 ||
āpādācca lalāṭāntaṃ hṛtkaṇṭhāntaṃ svadehataḥ | sāṣṭaśatāṅghri (kh: tāṅki) varṇākhyaiḥ syustantugranthayaḥ kramāt || 12 ||
svabāhukaratālāntaiḥ padavarṇaṃ sutattvagaiḥ | sthaṇḍile hariśambhostu dale kesarakoṇake || 13 ||
brahmaviṣṇuharādīnāṃ dvātriṃśadbhirvivṛddhitaḥ (kh: rdivṛddhitaḥ) | sūtraiśca granthayo'nyeṣāṃ tathā daśaika (g: dalaika) hānitaḥ || 14 ||
mūrdhāvalaṃbijānvantaṃ pratimānāṃ pavitrakam | vṛṣasya śṛṅgapādāntaṃ pavitraṃ liṅgavanmatam || 15 ||
prāsādamaṭha (mū, ṅ: matha) veśmāni sūtreṇaikeya veṣṭayet | itareṣāṃ tu devānāṃ pavitraṃ syāt trisūtrakam (gh: trakaiḥ) || 16 ||
calaliṅgasya dairghyeṇa sthaṇḍile granthayaḥ samāḥ | kvacidvitastimātraṃ ca śatārdhārdhārdhasūtrakam (kh, gh: trakaiḥ) || 17 ||
padavarṇakalābhiḥ syustattvendrarudratantavaḥ | dvijārkajinasaṃkhyābhiḥ sthirasthaṇḍilagehinām || 18 ||
paṭacitrāgamānāṃ ca bhavedgranthistrisūtrakam | gurvarthātmārthayoḥ sūtraistakarmai (kh, gh: tkāmai) kādaśa kramāt || 19 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṃkhyānairgranthayo naba pañcadhā | kaniṣṭhāmūlakakṣāntaṃ skandhanābhyūrdhvamānakam || 20 ||
snānaṃ pūjā japaṃ homaṃ dhyānaṃ vijñaptimeva ca | pavitrārohaṇaṃ kuryādiṣṭamantraistritattvataḥ || 21 ||
prāgyāmyendupratīcīṣu kramātsthitairdvijātibhiḥ (kh: dvibhiḥ) | dadyāt pavitrakaṃ tadvadvahnyādidikṣu cetaraiḥ || 22 ||
śuciḥ snāho'hnikīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā vai śeṣikāṃ kvacit | tripañcasūtrakairvāpi hṛdā cāmantrarṇa vibhoḥ (k, kh, ṅ: prabhoḥ) || 23 ||
āmantrito'si deveśa pūjāmupahṛtā mayā | gṛhāṇemāṃ mahādeva samastavidhikāraṇa || 24 ||
mṛdaṃ sāmalagandhāmbusubhasmadantadhāvanam | pañcagavyaṃ kamātteṣu tālacandranalohakam || 25 ||
śilāṃ vā rocanāṃ caiva svamantreṇopayojayet | homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sakuśānyaparāparānane || 26 ||
kajjalaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tailaṃ śalākā keśaśodhanam | tāmbūlaṃ guhyake dadyāt sājyaṃ caru nare punaḥ || 27 ||
yaṣṭyakṣasūtrakaupīnabhikṣāpātrāṇi dakṣiṇo | aiśānyāmāsanaṃ chatraṃ pāduke yogapaṭṭakam || 28 ||
yatna (kh: pada) saṃpannameteṣāṃ manasā tatprakalpayet | pātraṃ kṛtvā pavitrāṇi prokṣitāni śivāmbhasā || 29 ||
kṛṣṇājinādicchādya mantrasaṃhitayālabhet | gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpādyaṃ sākṣataṃ ca pavitrakam || 30 ||
paṭhenmantrottamaṃ vidvānāmantreṇa padātmakam | śivaṃ nivedayenmūrdhni recakenāmṛtīkṛtam || 31 ||
oṃ namo vrateśvarā pūraya pūraya svāhā | sopavāso vadedrātrau naktaṃ nakṣatrameva vā | prātaḥ snātaḥ śuciḥ śuddhaḥ pūjāṃ kuryātsvavittataḥ || 32 ||
vastrapūtena toyaina pañcagavyena bhaktitaḥ | pañcabhirmadhuraiḥ snānaṃ jalāntarairvirukṣaṇam || 33 ||
gandhatoyādibhiḥ snānaṃ toyamākṛṣya vāsasā | aṣṭāṅgo'rghaṃ pradāyātha samālabhya prapūjayet || 34 ||
śivakumbhāstrarakṣā ca maṇḍalaṃ śāstracoditam | vastraiḥ saṃchāditaṃ veśma ghaṭācāmarabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 35 ||
puṣpamālāṃ pralambarntī vastrairnānāvidhairvaraiḥ | kadalīcūtamālābhirjātabījasarocakaiḥ (k, kh, g, gh, ṅ: sarāvakaiḥ) || 36 ||
patākādhvajadīpādyairnaivedyaiḥ śobhayedgṛham | nṛtyagītaiḥ kalairvādyairnayedrātriṃ mahotsavaiḥ || 37 ||
daiśikāñchivayogīndrāṃlliṅginaśca svavittataḥ | bhakttyā santoṣayet sarvān vastradānādibhojanaiḥ || 38 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā yathoktaṃ tu pavitrārohaṇaṃ śubham | sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate || 39 ||
ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā pavitraṃ dhārayedgṛhī | khaṭvāśayanamithyokti (kh, gh, ṅ: thyāvān) strīyātrāmiṣavarjakaḥ || 40 ||
cāturmāsyamasāmarthyā (mū: samāsevyā) dyatīnāṃ rugbhayāditaḥ (ṅ: rditaḥ) | pūjāṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ natvā pavitraṃ ca visarjayet || 41 ||
kārtikyāṃ mahatīṃ pūjāṃ pūrvavanmaṇḍalādikam | kṛtvā kṣipetpavitrāṇi śivāgnau vā sadāmbhasi || 42 ||
dīkṣito yo na kuryādvai pavitrārohaṇaṃ vibhoḥ | syātprāyaścityadhogāmī kṛto rudro'bda (mū, ṅ: drākta) koṭiśaḥ || 43 ||
pavitrārohaṇavidhiḥ |
209> hemaliṅgāddhanādhyakṣo (k, kh: rcanātryakṣo) viśvedevāśca tārajāt | tāmraliṅgārcanādarkaḥ piśāco vaṃśasambhavāt || 44 ||
saṃsiddhā vasavo ghoṣādrītijānmaruto'rcanāt | sīsajā (mū: sīsakā) dguhyakāḥ sarve lohādrakṣo'surāntakāḥ || 45 ||
trilohānmātaraḥ sarvā mārtaṇḍastvaṣṭalohajāt | vajrāt surendramārkaṇḍau (mū: mārtaṇḍau) mauktikāccharvarīprabhuḥ || 46 ||
pauṣparāgācchuyācāryo vaidūryādrāghavo nṛpaḥ | padmarāgāddhutāśaśca indranīlārcanāddhariḥ || 47 ||
bāṇo mārakatālliṅgatsphāṭikotthājjalādhipaḥ | vaidrumāsyārcanānnāgāḥ śukraḥ kārketanātsadā || 48 ||
palakotthātta vāgīśo rājāvartācchanaiścara (k: ddhaneśvaraḥ) | paulastyo jīvajātibhyaṣṭai (k, kh: tījārhai) ṭṭibhātsiddhakinnarāḥ || 49 ||
tutthajācca baliḥ siddhaḥ praśāntavān | aśvinau pakvamṛdbhūtādgandharvā dārasambhavāt || 50 ||
brahmā śailodbhavātsiddho munayaḥ paṭacitrajāt | gandhodbhavācca (gh: dbhūtācca) kandarpaḥ pauṣpaliṅgāddigambaraḥ || 51 ||
śārṅga (mū, g: śārga) saṃsevanāddakṣo gajadantācca māruti | kūrmakauśi (kasi) kasabhūtādvāsukinayināyakaḥ || 52 ||
nakulā (kh: lāsthya) (ccā) rcanātsiddho hariścandro narādhipaḥ | ambarīṣaśca saṃsiddho (gh, ṅ: eva surādayaḥ siddhā) liṅgasaṃsthāpanārcanāt || 53 ||
aṣṭapiṣṭāṅgajā (kh: abjapiṣṭodbhavā) lliṅgādaṣṭau siddhā gaṇeśvarāḥ | nāvanītāttu saṃsiddho (mū, ṅ: tātkujaḥ) dhanvantariśca (g: stu) somapāḥ || 54 ||
audanasyārcanāttārkṣyo gauḍaliṅgādbudhastathā | nānāphalotthaliṅgāni vidhinā sevitāni ca || 55 ||
tena te munayaḥ siddhā bālakhilyā mahodayāḥ | saikatādviśvakarmā ca śacīśo lavaṇo (mū: ścalano) dbhavāt || 56 ||
vibhīṣaṇaśca pāṃśūtthān mūlotthāccarako'rcanāt | vaṃśāṅkurotthaliṅgācca sagaro nāma pārthivaḥ || 57 ||
paurājjayadratho rājā rāhū rāmaṭhajārcanāt (mū: sambhavāt) | sarjaliṅgācca (gh, ṅ: mayācca; gh: bimbāt) saumitro yoginyaḥ sikthasambhavāt || 58 ||
lepajātpadmajā devī mṛlliṅgā (mū, a: ardhāntaḥkarma) tpañcapāṇḍavāḥ | aihikasyāśrayātsiddhā likhitā bahuśāstrataḥ || 59 ||
aihikāni yajettasmātpratiṣṭhārahitānyapi | svairmantraiḥ kāma (gh: svairdhāntaiḥ kāma) dāni syuḥ siddhidānīśavākyataḥ || 60 ||
sarvadevamayaṃ liṅgaṃ liṅgaṃ sarveṣu saṃsthitam | sthāpitaṃ vidhi (kh: śiva) mantraistu dharmakāmārthamokṣadam || 61 ||
ekasmiṃsthāpite liṅga iṣṭe vākhiladevatāḥ | pūjitāḥ sthāpitāśca syuḥ pūjyaṃ sthāpyaṃ ca tattvataḥ || 62 ||
sarvayajñatapodānatīrthadeveṣu (gh: vedeṣu) yatphalam | tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sthāpya liṅgaṃ labhetphalam || 63 ||
yo liṅgaṃ sthāpayedekaṃ (mū: devaṃ) vidhipūrvaṃ sadakṣiṇam | sarvāgamoditaṃ puṇyaṃ (mū: sarvaṃ) koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet (kh, gh: labhet) || 64 ||
hastasthakaṅgaṇaṃ spaṣṭaṃ darpaṇenekṣate paśuḥ | liṅgāṅkitaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ bhagāṅkaṃ nāpi paśyati || 65 ||
siddhimuktisusi (kh, gh, ṅ: prasi) ddhyarthaṃ bhaktānāṃ (mū: bhattyā sa) hitakāmyayā | gṛhītvāgamataḥ sarvaṃ likhataṃ śikhabhāṣitam || 66 ||
saṃkṣepaikāgabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā na sasyak sarvaniścayaḥ | vistarādbhīśca mohaḥ syāttamānmadhyataraṃ kṛtam || 67 ||
sundarādyaiḥ pratiṣṭhoktā mayāpyuktālpaśaktinā | yadi vrajati vai tārkṣyaḥ kiṃ na yāntīha ṣaṭpadāḥ || 68 ||
bahuśāstrārthavastrādyā (mū: strārthā) granthasūtraiḥ susūtritāḥ | ajñānaśītanāśāya kaṇṭhācāryai (kh, g, ṅ: vācyatyu) dīritāḥ || 69 ||
śabdākṣarānyano yogātsaṃjñāliṅgapragopanaiḥ | anuktaḥ (mū, a: ānandaḥ) sudhiyāṃ madhye kaścitteno (gh: vistenu) palakṣyate || 70 ||
āsīdgopālabhūpaḥ sakalavasumatībhūṣaṇe doṣahīnastasyāṅgāśo (gh: syāṃśāhvo) mahātmā kṛtanṛpatiyatirdhīranāthaḥ pṛthuśrīḥ | tatputraḥ (mū, a, g: tattasmāt) prāptakīrtirvacanacaturimā viśruto bhūmicakre (kh, gh: radhīnākhyalokānukampaḥ) cakre so'yaṃ (kh, gh: śāstraṃ) pratiṣṭhāvidhimatilalitaṃ pañcavaktropagītam || 71 ||
śrīmanmattamayūrajo harasamaḥ śaivo'rjuna (k, kh: ve kule) dyotakaḥ prakhyāto vimalādikaḥ śivaparaścācāryavaryoṃ'bhavat | pūjyo nirbhayabhūmipasya ca gurustenābhiṣiktaḥ svayaṃ jñānīśānaśivastadaṅghrijanito vairocano daiśikaḥ || 72 ||
māyākarmādijātatrividhamalaharo jñānadehāvatīrṇaḥ śambhoścābhedarūpo munijanaviditaścordhvavaktrābhidhānaḥ | ācāryendraḥ prasiddhaḥ sakalajanahitaḥ śuddhaśaivāśramastho(-) yastatasyāhaṃ namāmi kṣitinihitaśirāḥ pādapadmaṃ gurorme || 73 ||
siddhāntadvayaṭaṅkaśākataka (kh, gh: dṛkca gāruḍa) (ṭa) bṛhattīkṣṇogradaṃṣṭraśca yojihvā yasya sakesarāṇi ca tathā (mū, a, g, ṅ: siratayā) savyāpasavyāgamau | vistīrṇākhilabhūtatantranakharo vairocanaḥ kesarī | so'yaṃ mattamṛgebhadarpadalano bhūkānena bhrāmyati || 74 ||
svatantrādhyayanaṃ vādaḥ paratantrāvalokanam | tadvidyācāryaśaivāya buddhimedhākaro guṇaḥ || 75 ||
vasantatilakaṃ tvādau dīpyante sragdharāstathā | śeṣāścānuṣṭubho madhye guṇasāhasrikaṃ kṛtam || 76 ||
hitāya daiśikānāṃ yaduktaṃ svalpadhiyāmayā | duruktaṃ (k, g: vatna ṭaṅkaḥ pāṣāṇadāraṇa ityamaraḥ | śākaṭo bhāra ācita ityamaraḥ | ) sūktamājñāya tatkariṣyanti paṇḍitāḥ || 77 ||
nānyadarśayine deyametacchāstraṃ magāya ca | śaivebhya etaddātavyamarthataḥ śāstrataḥsadā || 78 ||
paropaṃ (g, gh, ṅ: parāy) yācanāccaurāt (mū, a, ṅ: ddoṣaḥ) snehāt śithisabandhanāt | kaṇṭakā (k, kh, gh, ṅ: valmīkā) khujalāgnibhyo mā rakṣetyāha pustakam || 79 ||
dhatte'nantākhyarudro bhuvamuparigato yadva (k, kh: yāva) dādhāraśakte(-) rjambudvīpasya madhye śikharivaravṛto yāvadāste (kh: bhṛto yāvadāste) sumeruḥ | yāvaccandrārkatārāmayaruciruciraṃ prasphuratyantarikṣaṃ (kh, gh: puṣkaraṃ rājatīyaṃ) | tāvadvairocanasya pravicaratu guroḥ pustarupātra kīrtiḥ || 80 ||
yāvacchrīmānananto dharati vasumatīmūrdhvamādhāraśakte (kh: maghādiyuktāṃ ; gh: ttāra śaktyā) | ryāvatsaptottarī (mū, a, ṅ: ptārṇavī) yārṇavavṛtapṛthivīmadhyago (kh, gh: madhyato) merurasti | yāvaccandrārkatārāgaṇamaṇibhi (k, kh: ghṛṇibhi) ridaṃ bhrājate śubhramabhra (mū, gh, ṅ: mambhaḥ) tāvadvairocanīyā jagati ciramiyaṃ pustarupāstu kīrtiḥ || 81 ||
[iti śrī (pratiṣṭhātantre) pratiṣṭhālakṣaṇasārasamuccaye pavitrārohaṇaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo vidhiḥ] || 32 ||
|| [samāpto'yaṃ granthaḥ] ||
|| śivam ||
